# VAV 婚恋智能服务平台：Codex 可执行 Skills 总方案

以下按**前后端分离、Python + Vue、包含用户端和运营管理端**实施。

原计划书要求两期形成可用闭环：第一期完成官网、用户、活动、课程、辅导、AI 辅导、订单支付和后台；第二期完成婚恋档案、推荐、喜欢、互选、认识邀请、关系状态、会员权限与安全审核。最终真实用户应能够注册、建档、付费、查看推荐、表达选择并进入认识期。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx` `Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

## 一、最终技术架构

### 1. 技术栈

| 层级 | 技术选型 |
|---|---|
| 用户前端 | Vue 3、TypeScript、Vite、Pinia、Vue Router、TanStack Query、Tailwind CSS |
| 管理端 | Vue 3、TypeScript、Element Plus、Pinia、Vue Router |
| 后端 | Python 3.12、FastAPI、Pydantic 2、SQLAlchemy 2、Alembic |
| 数据库 | PostgreSQL 16、pgvector |
| 缓存与任务 | Redis、Celery |
| 对象存储 | S3 协议，开发环境使用 MinIO |
| AI 编排 | LangGraph、结构化输出、Tool Calling、Provider Adapter |
| RAG | PostgreSQL、pgvector、文档切分、引用追踪 |
| 支付 | Stripe、PayPal，全部通过 Webhook 确认 |
| 邮件 | Provider Adapter，开发环境 Mailpit |
| 测试 | pytest、Vitest、Playwright、Schemathesis |
| 可观测性 | OpenTelemetry、结构化日志、Sentry/Langfuse 可选 |
| 部署 | Docker Compose 起步，预留 Kubernetes |
| CI/CD | GitHub Actions |
| 包管理 | Python 使用 uv；前端使用 pnpm |

该架构遵循计划书提出的几个原则：模块化单体优先、AI 与核心业务解耦、支付和权限由后端确认、数据库迁移可追踪、新开发者能够依据文档一键启动。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

# 三、完整 Skills 分批规划

## Batch 1：项目基座与可运行仓库

完成 Monorepo、FastAPI、两个 Vue 应用、PostgreSQL、Redis、MinIO、Docker Compose、CI 和一键启动。

## Batch 2：身份认证、用户与 RBAC

注册、登录、邮箱验证、找回密码、JWT、Refresh Token、角色权限、后台管理员。

## Batch 3：官网、CMS、国际化与管理端框架

首页、关于 VAV、幸福见证、文章、页面管理、简繁英多语言、管理端菜单和权限路由。

## Batch 4：商品、价格与服务目录

活动、课程、辅导、AI 次数包、会员方案的统一商品和价格模型。

## Batch 5：订单、支付、退款与权益开通

订单状态机、Stripe、PayPal、Webhook、幂等、退款、优惠码、支付日志。

## Batch 6：活动中心

活动发布、报名、审核、支付、签到、名单、分组及活动后台。

## Batch 7：课程系统

课程、章节、视频资源、购买权限、学习进度、练习与完成记录。

## Batch 8：真人辅导预约

导师、服务、预约申请、时间段、人工确认、支付、记录和跟进。

## Batch 9：AI 知识库与 RAG

资料导入、切分、Embedding、检索、版本管理、内部引用和知识库管理端。

## Batch 10：哈拿老师 AI 辅导 Agent

LangGraph、多轮状态、结构化分类、Tool Calling、服务推荐、风险识别和人工转介。

AI 回答需要显示来源，不能仅模仿口吻；需识别问题分类、风险等级和建议类型，并对高风险场景停止一般建议、转介真人支持。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

## Batch 11：通知中心

站内通知、邮件、模板、异步发送、重试、用户偏好和管理端发送记录。

## Batch 12：用户中心、隐私与数据权利

个人资料、隐私设置、同意记录、数据导出、更正、删除申请、AI 记忆授权。

## Batch 13：婚恋档案与择偶条件

完整档案、信仰、城市、婚史、家庭、生活方式、照片、自我介绍、隐私和审核。

## Batch 14：筛选与推荐引擎

硬条件过滤、软条件评分、可解释推荐、运营干预、推荐快照和反馈记录。

## Batch 15：喜欢、互选与认识邀请

喜欢、跳过、撤回、互选、邀请认识、接受、婉拒和通知。

## Batch 16：关系状态机

未认识、邀请中、认识期、暂停、结束、确认关系等状态和完整历史。

## Batch 17：会员、权益和访问控制

免费/付费会员、有效期、次数包、订阅、功能权限和服务配额。

## Batch 18：审核、举报、屏蔽与运营后台

照片审核、档案审核、举报处置、屏蔽、防骚扰、操作审计、用户和订单运营。

## Batch 19：测试、安全、可观测性与生产部署

自动化测试、安全测试、备份恢复、日志脱敏、监控告警、部署、回滚和运行手册。

计划书要求关键 API、Webhook、权限及用户旅程具备自动或可复现测试，并保证数据可备份、恢复、导出和迁移。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

## Batch 20：Codex Skill SDK 与完整项目验收

将全部能力封装成 Codex Skills、依赖图、生成器、升级机制、验收器和项目完整度评分。

# Batch 1：项目基座与可运行仓库

## Batch 1 最终目标

Codex 执行本批 Skills 后，应得到一个能够运行的项目：

```bash
git clone <repository>
cd vav-platform
cp .env.example .env
make bootstrap
make dev
```

启动后：

```text
用户端:      http://localhost:5173
管理端:      http://localhost:5174
API:         http://localhost:8000
OpenAPI:     http://localhost:8000/docs
Mailpit:     http://localhost:8025
MinIO:       http://localhost:9001
```

## Skill 1.1：`vav-project-charter`

### 目标

把项目计划书转换为机器可读取的项目约束、阶段边界和待决策事项。

### 输出文件

```text
project-manifest.yaml
docs/product/project-scope.md
docs/product/phase-boundaries.md
docs/product/decision-register.md
docs/product/acceptance-map.md
docs/adr/ADR-0001-project-architecture.md
```

### `project-manifest.yaml`

```yaml
project:
  name: vav-platform
  architecture: modular-monolith
  frontend_backend_separated: true

applications:
  user_web:
    framework: vue
    port: 5173
  admin_web:
    framework: vue
    port: 5174
  api:
    framework: fastapi
    port: 8000
  worker:
    framework: celery

phases:
  phase_1:
    modules:
      - public_site
      - identity
      - activities
      - courses
      - counseling
      - ai_assistant
      - catalog
      - orders
      - payments
      - admin
  phase_2:
    modules:
      - dating_profile
      - partner_preferences
      - recommendations
      - likes
      - matches
      - introductions
      - relationship_state
      - memberships
      - moderation

pending_decisions:
  - payment_legal_entity
  - launch_regions
  - launch_languages
  - membership_plans
  - contact_exchange_policy
  - video_hosting
  - counseling_scheduling_mode
  - ai_knowledge_authorization
  - pilot_user_group
```

这些待决策项来自计划书附录，包括收款主体、首发地区、首发语言、会员方案、联系方式交换、课程视频、辅导排班和 AI 知识来源。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

### Codex 执行规则

```text
1. 不自行决定待确认业务事项。
2. 所有待决策事项必须配置化。
3. 不把第三期能力混入第一、二期。
4. 每个业务需求必须关联到模块、API、页面和验收标准。
5. 生成需求到实现的追踪矩阵。
```

### 验收

```bash
python scripts/validate_manifest.py
```

必须验证：

- 第一、二期边界存在；
- 所有模块具有负责人和状态；
- 所有待决策项有默认的 `undecided` 状态；
- 不允许把未确认事项写成生产默认值。

## Skill 1.2：`vav-monorepo-bootstrap`

### 目标

生成前后端分离的 Monorepo 基础结构。

### 必须生成

```text
apps/user-web
apps/admin-web
services/api
services/worker
packages/api-client
packages/contracts
infra
docs
skills
scripts
```

### 根目录标准

```text
.editorconfig
.env.example
.gitignore
.pre-commit-config.yaml
Makefile
README.md
docker-compose.yml
pnpm-workspace.yaml
pyproject.toml
```

### Makefile 命令

```makefile
bootstrap:
	./scripts/bootstrap.sh

dev:
	docker compose up --build

stop:
	docker compose down

reset:
	docker compose down -v

migrate:
	docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head

seed:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.seed

lint:
	./scripts/lint.sh

test:
	./scripts/test.sh

verify:
	./scripts/verify.sh

openapi:
	./scripts/generate-openapi-client.sh
```

### 约束

- Python 依赖使用 `uv.lock`；
- Node 依赖使用 `pnpm-lock.yaml`；
- 不允许提交 `.env`；
- 不允许提交密钥；
- 所有服务版本固定；
- 所有路径兼容 macOS 和 Linux。

## Skill 1.3：`vav-fastapi-foundation`

### 目标

建立可扩展的 FastAPI 模块化单体。

### 基础目录

```text
services/api/src/vav/
├── main.py
├── api/
│   ├── router.py
│   ├── dependencies.py
│   └── errors.py
├── core/
│   ├── config.py
│   ├── database.py
│   ├── logging.py
│   ├── security.py
│   ├── telemetry.py
│   └── request_context.py
├── common/
│   ├── enums.py
│   ├── pagination.py
│   ├── schemas.py
│   └── exceptions.py
└── modules/
```

### 基础 API

```http
GET /api/v1/health/live
GET /api/v1/health/ready
GET /api/v1/system/version
GET /api/v1/system/config
```

### 标准返回结构

成功：

```json
{
  "data": {},
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "uuid"
  }
}
```

失败：

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "Invalid request",
    "details": []
  },
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "uuid"
  }
}
```

### 必须实现

- 环境配置；
- 数据库 Session；
- 生命周期管理；
- Request ID；
- 结构化日志；
- 全局异常处理；
- CORS；
- API 版本；
- OpenAPI 标签；
- Readiness 检查 PostgreSQL 和 Redis；
- UTC 存储时间；
- 时区显示配置。

### 验收测试

```python
def test_liveness(client):
    response = client.get("/api/v1/health/live")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["data"]["status"] == "ok"
```

## Skill 1.4：`vav-database-foundation`

### 目标

建立 PostgreSQL、pgvector 和 Alembic 迁移基座。

### 初始扩展

```sql
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS citext;
```

### 基础表

```text
system_metadata
system_settings
outbox_events
idempotency_keys
audit_events
```

### 所有业务表统一字段

```text
id               UUID
created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ
updated_at       TIMESTAMPTZ
created_by       UUID nullable
updated_by       UUID nullable
version          INTEGER
```

### 设计要求

- UUID 主键；
- 所有时间使用 `TIMESTAMPTZ`；
- 软删除不得默认滥用；
- 金额不得使用浮点数；
- 金额保存为最小货币单位；
- 数据库迁移不可手工修改生产数据库；
- 每个迁移包含升级和回滚；
- 审计表只追加，不覆盖。

### 验收

```bash
make migrate
docker compose exec api alembic current
docker compose exec api pytest tests/database
```

## Skill 1.7：`vav-local-infrastructure`

### 目标

提供一套完全可复现的本地环境。

### Docker Compose 服务

```yaml
services:
  postgres:
  redis:
  minio:
  minio-init:
  mailpit:
  api:
  worker:
  user-web:
  admin-web:
```

### 基础端口

```text
PostgreSQL  5432
Redis       6379
MinIO       9000
MinIO UI    9001
Mailpit     8025
API         8000
User Web    5173
Admin Web   5174
```

### 健康检查

每个核心容器必须配置：

```yaml
healthcheck:
  test: ["CMD", "..."]
  interval: 10s
  timeout: 5s
  retries: 10
```

### 数据卷

```text
postgres_data
redis_data
minio_data
```

### 安全约束

- 默认密码仅限开发环境；
- 正式环境不得复用 `.env.example`；
- 对象存储默认私有；
- PostgreSQL 不在生产环境直接暴露公网；
- 正式支付密钥不进入 Docker 镜像。

## Skill 1.8：`vav-api-contract-and-sdk`

### 目标

后端 OpenAPI 自动生成用户端和管理端共享的 TypeScript SDK。

### 流程

```text
FastAPI OpenAPI
      ↓
openapi.json
      ↓
orval / openapi-typescript
      ↓
packages/api-client
      ↓
user-web + admin-web
```

### 要求

- 前端不得重复手写后端 DTO；
- CI 检查 OpenAPI 是否发生未提交变更；
- SDK 统一处理 Token、Request ID、错误格式；
- API 破坏性变更必须有版本记录；
- 时间、金额、枚举类型必须明确。

### 生成命令

```bash
make openapi
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-01-project-foundation
description: Build the runnable foundation of the VAV relationship service platform.

# Goal

Create a production-oriented, locally runnable monorepo containing:

- FastAPI backend
- Vue 3 user application
- Vue 3 admin application
- PostgreSQL with pgvector
- Redis
- Celery worker
- MinIO
- Mailpit
- Docker Compose
- OpenAPI-generated TypeScript client
- CI quality gates
- one-command bootstrap and verification

# Required execution order

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Read all skills under `skills/batch-01`.
3. Create an implementation plan.
4. Implement one skill at a time.
5. Run tests after every skill.
6. Commit each completed skill separately.
7. Run `make verify` at the end.

# Architecture constraints

- Use a modular monolith.
- Keep AI unavailable without breaking core business services.
- Backend is the source of truth for permissions and payments.
- Never hard-code undecided product decisions.
- Never commit credentials.
- Every database change must use Alembic.
- User web and admin web are separate applications.
- Shared API contracts must be generated from OpenAPI.

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

- `make bootstrap` succeeds;
- `make dev` starts all services;
- `make test` succeeds;
- `make verify` succeeds;
- README contains clean-machine startup instructions;
- all created files contain working implementation rather than TODO placeholders.

# Failure policy

When a requirement is unclear:

1. record the uncertainty in `docs/product/decision-register.md`;
2. choose the least destructive configurable implementation;
3. do not invent business policy;
4. continue with infrastructure that does not depend on the unresolved decision.

# 一、Batch 2 最终交付能力

## 用户端

用户可以完成：

```text
注册
→ 接收验证邮件
→ 验证邮箱
→ 登录
→ 获取 Access Token
→ 自动刷新会话
→ 查看和管理登录设备
→ 修改密码
→ 忘记密码并重置
→ 退出当前设备
→ 退出全部设备
```

## 管理端

管理员可以完成：

```text
管理员邀请
→ 接受邀请并设置密码
→ 管理端独立登录
→ 根据角色访问菜单与 API
→ 查询用户
→ 暂停或恢复账户
→ 分配或撤销角色
→ 强制注销用户会话
→ 查看权限变更和安全审计记录
```

## 安全保证

```text
Access Token 短时有效
Refresh Token 单次轮换
Refresh Token 重用检测
用户端与管理端 Token Audience 隔离
密码只保存 Argon2id Hash
邮箱验证 Token 只保存 Hash
找回密码 Token 只保存 Hash
管理员敏感操作必须填写原因
权限始终由后端校验
所有权限变更产生不可变审计事件
```

# 四、身份与权限数据模型

## 4.1 用户表

```sql
CREATE TABLE users (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    email CITEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    display_email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL,

    password_hash TEXT,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    email_verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    preferred_locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'zh-CN',
    timezone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC',

    failed_login_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    locked_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
    last_login_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    password_changed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    auth_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    rbac_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    terms_version VARCHAR(32),
    terms_accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    privacy_version VARCHAR(32),
    privacy_accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    deletion_requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
);
```

## 4.2 用户状态

```python
class UserStatus(StrEnum):
    PENDING_VERIFICATION = "pending_verification"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    LOCKED = "locked"
    SUSPENDED = "suspended"
    DELETION_PENDING = "deletion_pending"
    DELETED = "deleted"
```

状态转换：

```text
注册
  ↓
PENDING_VERIFICATION
  ↓ 邮箱验证
ACTIVE
  ├── 登录失败过多 → LOCKED
  ├── 管理员暂停   → SUSPENDED
  └── 用户申请删除 → DELETION_PENDING → DELETED
```

用户应能够查看、更正、导出或申请删除自己的资料；相关操作在 Batch 2 建立身份入口，完整数据权利流程在后续隐私 Batch 扩展。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

## 4.3 登录会话表

```sql
CREATE TABLE auth_sessions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    session_family_id UUID NOT NULL,
    refresh_token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    audience VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    issued_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    last_used_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    replaced_by_session_id UUID,
    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revoke_reason VARCHAR(128),

    device_name VARCHAR(128),
    user_agent_hash VARCHAR(128),
    ip_address_hash VARCHAR(128),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 4.4 邮箱验证 Token

```sql
CREATE TABLE email_verification_tokens (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    consumed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    invalidated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 4.5 密码重置 Token

```sql
CREATE TABLE password_reset_tokens (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    consumed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    invalidated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 4.6 RBAC 表

```sql
CREATE TABLE roles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    is_system BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE permissions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    resource VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    risk_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE role_permissions (
    role_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES roles(id),
    permission_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES permissions(id),
    granted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    granted_by UUID,
    PRIMARY KEY (role_id, permission_id)
);

CREATE TABLE user_roles (
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    role_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES roles(id),
    granted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    granted_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    grant_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revoked_by UUID,
    revoke_reason TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role_id)
);
```

# 五、Skill 2.1：`vav-identity-domain-model`

## 目标

建立用户、登录会话、Token、角色、权限与安全事件的数据库模型和领域规则。

## 输入

```text
project-manifest.yaml
Batch 1 数据库基座
Batch 1 outbox_events
Batch 1 audit_events
```

## 输出

```text
services/api/src/vav/modules/identity/
services/api/migrations/versions/0002_identity_users.py
services/api/migrations/versions/0003_identity_sessions.py
services/api/migrations/versions/0004_identity_rbac.py
services/api/migrations/versions/0005_identity_security_events.py
docs/architecture/identity-domain.md
docs/architecture/auth-state-machines.md
```

## 实施要求

1. 邮箱采用 `CITEXT` 唯一索引。
2. 原始密码和原始 Token 不得进入数据库或日志。
3. 用户、会话、角色和权限必须使用 UUID。
4. 所有时间统一使用 UTC。
5. 会话撤销不得物理删除审计证据。
6. 系统角色不可由普通管理员删除。
7. 每次角色变更必须递增 `rbac_version`。
8. 每次修改密码、暂停账户或全设备退出必须递增 `auth_version`。

# 六、Skill 2.2：`vav-user-registration-login`

## 目标

实现用户注册、密码认证、当前用户查询和密码修改。

## API

```http
POST /api/v1/auth/register
POST /api/v1/auth/login
POST /api/v1/auth/logout
POST /api/v1/auth/logout-all
GET  /api/v1/auth/me
POST /api/v1/auth/password/change
```

## 注册请求

```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "correct horse battery staple",
  "preferred_locale": "zh-CN",
  "timezone": "Asia/Taipei",
  "terms_version": "2026-07-01",
  "privacy_version": "2026-07-01"
}
```

## 注册响应

```json
{
  "data": {
    "registration_status": "verification_required",
    "email": "u***@example.com"
  },
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "uuid"
  }
}
```

## 登录请求

```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "correct horse battery staple",
  "device_name": "MacBook Chrome"
}
```

## 密码规则

默认实现配置：

```text
最少 12 个字符
最多 128 个字符
允许空格和 Unicode
不强制固定大小写、数字、符号组合
拒绝与邮箱完全相同的密码
拒绝常见弱密码表
密码使用 Argon2id
```

环境变量：

```dotenv
AUTH_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH=12
AUTH_PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH=128
AUTH_ARGON2_TIME_COST=3
AUTH_ARGON2_MEMORY_COST=65536
AUTH_ARGON2_PARALLELISM=4
AUTH_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS=5
AUTH_LOCKOUT_MINUTES=15
```

## 登录失败返回

不得暴露以下差异：

```text
邮箱不存在
密码错误
邮箱未验证
账户被暂停
```

外部统一响应：

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_CREDENTIALS",
    "message": "Email or password is incorrect."
  }
}
```

内部安全事件记录真实原因。

## 密码修改

修改密码时必须：

```text
验证当前密码
撤销其他所有 Refresh Session
递增 auth_version
保留当前会话或根据配置要求重新登录
发送密码已修改邮件
写入安全事件
```

# 七、Skill 2.3：`vav-email-verification-password-recovery`

## 目标

实现邮箱验证、重新发送验证邮件、忘记密码和密码重置。

计划书把邮箱或手机验证列入用户身份模块；Batch 2 先完成邮箱验证，手机验证保持接口边界，后续按运营地区和服务商决策接入。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

## API

```http
POST /api/v1/auth/email-verification/send
POST /api/v1/auth/email-verification/confirm

POST /api/v1/auth/password/forgot
POST /api/v1/auth/password/reset
```

## 邮箱验证流程

```text
注册成功
  ↓
生成 32 字节随机 Token
  ↓
数据库只保存 SHA-256/HMAC Hash
  ↓
通过 Outbox 发送验证邮件
  ↓
用户点击前端验证地址
  ↓
前端调用 confirm API
  ↓
Token 一次性消费
  ↓
用户状态变为 ACTIVE
```

## 验证邮件链接

```text
https://frontend-domain/auth/verify-email?token=<opaque-token>
```

Token 不使用用户 ID、邮箱或可预测序列。

## 密码找回防枚举

无论邮箱是否存在：

```http
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
```

```json
{
  "data": {
    "message": "If the account is eligible, a reset email will be sent."
  }
}
```

## 默认有效期

```dotenv
AUTH_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_TTL_HOURS=24
AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_TTL_MINUTES=30
AUTH_EMAIL_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS=60
```

## 重置成功后

```text
旧密码失效
所有 Refresh Session 被撤销
auth_version 递增
所有旧重置 Token 失效
发送安全通知邮件
记录 password.reset.completed
```

## 邮件模板

```text
services/api/src/vav/templates/email/
├── verify-email.zh-CN.html
├── verify-email.zh-TW.html
├── verify-email.en.html
├── reset-password.zh-CN.html
├── reset-password.zh-TW.html
├── reset-password.en.html
├── password-changed.zh-CN.html
├── password-changed.zh-TW.html
└── password-changed.en.html
```

# 八、Skill 2.4：`vav-jwt-access-token`

## 目标

实现短时有效、用途隔离、可验证的 JWT Access Token。

## 技术方案

```text
Access Token：JWT
Refresh Token：高熵不透明 Token
```

Refresh Token 不使用 JWT，避免长期凭证携带不可撤销的授权声明；服务器通过会话表完成轮换、撤销和重用检测。

## JWT 算法

生产环境：

```text
EdDSA / Ed25519
```

开发环境由脚本生成本地密钥：

```bash
./scripts/generate-dev-auth-keys.sh
```

密钥文件：

```text
.dev-secrets/auth-private.pem
.dev-secrets/auth-public.pem
```

`.dev-secrets` 必须进入 `.gitignore`。

## JWT Claims

```json
{
  "iss": "vav-platform",
  "aud": "vav-user",
  "sub": "user-uuid",
  "sid": "session-uuid",
  "jti": "token-uuid",
  "typ": "access",
  "auth_version": 3,
  "rbac_version": 7,
  "iat": 1785456000,
  "nbf": 1785456000,
  "exp": 1785456900
}
```

管理端 Token 使用：

```json
{
  "aud": "vav-admin"
}
```

用户端 Token 不得访问管理端 API；管理端 Token 也不作为普通用户端业务 Token 使用。

## 默认配置

```dotenv
AUTH_ISSUER=vav-platform
AUTH_USER_AUDIENCE=vav-user
AUTH_ADMIN_AUDIENCE=vav-admin
AUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS=900
AUTH_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS=30
AUTH_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE=/run/secrets/auth_private_key
AUTH_PUBLIC_KEY_FILE=/run/secrets/auth_public_key
AUTH_ACTIVE_KEY_ID=dev-key-1
```

## Token 校验顺序

```text
签名
→ kid
→ issuer
→ audience
→ typ
→ expiration
→ not-before
→ session 状态
→ user 状态
→ auth_version
→ rbac_version
```

## FastAPI Dependency

```python
CurrentUser = Annotated[
    AuthenticatedPrincipal,
    Depends(require_authenticated_user),
]

AdminPrincipal = Annotated[
    AuthenticatedPrincipal,
    Depends(require_admin_principal),
]
```

# 九、Skill 2.5：`vav-refresh-session-rotation`

## 目标

实现 Refresh Token 轮换、会话管理、主动撤销和重用攻击检测。

## Refresh Token 格式

```text
vav_rt_<base64url-encoded-32-byte-random-value>
```

数据库只保存：

```python
refresh_token_hash = hmac_sha256(
    server_pepper,
    raw_refresh_token,
)
```

## Cookie

用户端：

```text
名称：vav_user_refresh
HttpOnly：true
Secure：生产环境 true
SameSite：Lax
Path：/api/v1/auth
```

管理端：

```text
名称：vav_admin_refresh
HttpOnly：true
Secure：生产环境 true
SameSite：Strict
Path：/api/v1/admin/auth
```

## API

```http
POST   /api/v1/auth/refresh
GET    /api/v1/auth/sessions
DELETE /api/v1/auth/sessions/{session_id}

POST   /api/v1/admin/auth/refresh
GET    /api/v1/admin/auth/sessions
DELETE /api/v1/admin/auth/sessions/{session_id}
```

## 正常轮换

```text
Refresh Token A
  ↓ refresh
A 标记为 replaced
  ↓
创建 Refresh Token B
  ↓
返回新 Access Token
  ↓
Set-Cookie B
```

## 重用检测

当已被替换的 Token A 再次出现：

```text
判定 Token Family 可能泄漏
→ 撤销同一 session_family_id 的全部会话
→ 递增用户 auth_version
→ 记录 refresh_token.reuse_detected
→ 发送安全通知
→ 返回 AUTH_SESSION_COMPROMISED
```

## 并发刷新处理

必须使用数据库行锁或原子更新：

```sql
SELECT *
FROM auth_sessions
WHERE refresh_token_hash = :hash
FOR UPDATE;
```

两个请求同时刷新同一 Token 时，只允许一个成功。

## 会话查询响应

```json
{
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "uuid",
        "device_name": "MacBook Chrome",
        "issued_at": "2026-07-31T01:00:00Z",
        "last_used_at": "2026-07-31T01:40:00Z",
        "expires_at": "2026-08-30T01:00:00Z",
        "current": true
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

不得向前端返回 Refresh Token Hash、完整 IP 或原始 User-Agent。

# 十、Skill 2.6：`vav-rbac-permission-engine`

## 目标

建立后端权威的 Role-Based Access Control。

## 权限命名规则

```text
<resource>.<action>
```

示例：

```text
users.read
users.update
users.suspend
users.restore
users.sessions.revoke

roles.read
roles.create
roles.update
roles.assign
roles.revoke

admins.read
admins.invite
admins.disable
admins.restore

audit.read
audit.export

content.read
content.manage
activities.manage
courses.manage
counseling.manage
orders.read
orders.manage
payments.read
moderation.manage
ai_knowledge.manage
analytics.read
```

## 默认系统角色

| 角色 | 核心权限 |
|---|---|
| `super_admin` | 所有管理权限 |
| `platform_admin` | 平台运营管理，不含超级管理员治理 |
| `user_manager` | 用户查询、暂停、恢复、会话撤销 |
| `content_manager` | 官网、文章和内容管理 |
| `activity_manager` | 活动管理 |
| `course_manager` | 课程管理 |
| `counseling_manager` | 辅导服务管理 |
| `order_manager` | 商品与订单管理 |
| `payment_auditor` | 支付只读与审计 |
| `moderation_agent` | 档案、照片、举报和屏蔽管理 |
| `ai_knowledge_manager` | AI 知识库管理 |
| `analyst` | 聚合数据和报表只读 |
| `support_agent` | 用户基础只读和服务处理 |
| `member` | 普通用户基础身份 |

## 后端权限检查

```python
@router.post(
    "/users/{user_id}/suspend",
    dependencies=[Depends(require_permission("users.suspend"))],
)
async def suspend_user(...):
    ...
```

或：

```python
principal.require("users.suspend")
```

## 资源级策略

仅有权限码仍不足以执行所有操作，还需应用策略：

```text
管理员不能暂停自己
管理员不能撤销自己的最后一个关键角色
普通管理员不能修改 super_admin
非 super_admin 不能授予自己没有的权限
不能移除系统中的最后一个 active super_admin
过期角色授权不计入权限
被暂停管理员不得继续调用后台 API
```

## 权限缓存

Redis Key：

```text
rbac:user:{user_id}:version:{rbac_version}
```

角色变化后：

```text
数据库事务提交
→ rbac_version + 1
→ 删除旧缓存
→ 写入审计事件
```

# 十一、Skill 2.7：`vav-admin-account-governance`

## 目标

实现管理端管理员邀请、激活、禁用和角色治理。

## 管理员不是独立用户表

管理员仍然是 `users` 中的用户，通过管理角色获得后台访问权，避免：

```text
用户账户与管理员账户重复
邮箱重复
密码体系重复
注销与审计规则不一致
```

## 管理员邀请表

```sql
CREATE TABLE admin_invitations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    email CITEXT NOT NULL,
    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    proposed_role_ids JSONB NOT NULL,
    invited_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## API

```http
POST /api/v1/admin/auth/login
POST /api/v1/admin/auth/logout
POST /api/v1/admin/auth/logout-all
GET  /api/v1/admin/auth/me

POST /api/v1/admin/admins/invitations
GET  /api/v1/admin/admins/invitations
POST /api/v1/admin/admins/invitations/{id}/revoke

POST /api/v1/admin/admins/invitations/accept

GET  /api/v1/admin/admins
GET  /api/v1/admin/admins/{user_id}
POST /api/v1/admin/admins/{user_id}/disable
POST /api/v1/admin/admins/{user_id}/restore
```

## 邀请流程

```text
super_admin / 有 admins.invite 权限的管理员
→ 输入邮箱、角色和邀请原因
→ 创建一次性邀请 Token
→ 发送邀请邮件
→ 受邀者设置密码并接受条款
→ 分配角色
→ 记录管理员激活审计事件
```

## 超级管理员初始化

本地或首次部署：

```bash
make create-super-admin \
  EMAIL=admin@example.com
```

命令行为：

```text
交互式读取密码
不允许密码出现在命令历史
创建已验证用户
分配 super_admin
记录 bootstrap 管理事件
首次登录提示修改密码
```

生产环境不得通过 Seed 自动创建固定默认管理员。

# 十二、Skill 2.8：`vav-user-web-authentication`

## 目标

完成 Vue 用户端注册、登录、邮箱验证、密码重置和会话管理。

## 页面

```text
/auth/register
/auth/login
/auth/verify-email
/auth/verification-pending
/auth/forgot-password
/auth/reset-password
/account/security
/account/sessions
```

## Pinia Store

```text
apps/user-web/src/stores/auth.ts
```

核心状态：

```ts
interface AuthState {
  user: CurrentUser | null;
  accessToken: string | null;
  status:
    | "unknown"
    | "authenticated"
    | "anonymous"
    | "refreshing";
}
```

## Token 存储策略

```text
Access Token：仅保存在内存
Refresh Token：HttpOnly Cookie
localStorage：不得保存 Access Token 或 Refresh Token
```

## 页面刷新恢复登录

```text
Vue 启动
→ POST /auth/refresh
→ 成功：写入内存 Access Token
→ GET /auth/me
→ 渲染用户页面
```

## API 请求拦截器

```text
请求前附加 Authorization: Bearer <access-token>
→ 返回 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED
→ 全局单例 Refresh Promise
→ 成功后只重试原请求一次
→ Refresh 失败则清空身份并跳转登录
```

必须防止多个并发请求同时触发多次 Refresh。

## Router Guard

```ts
meta: {
  requiresAuth: true,
  requiresVerifiedEmail: true,
}
```

前端路由守卫只改善体验，不构成权限控制；后端必须重复校验。

## 安全页面

`/account/security` 包含：

```text
修改密码
当前邮箱验证状态
退出所有设备
最近安全事件摘要
```

`/account/sessions` 包含：

```text
设备名称
首次登录时间
最近使用时间
过期时间
是否当前会话
撤销设备按钮
```

# 十四、Skill 2.10：`vav-permission-security-audit`

## 目标

记录认证、管理员和权限相关的不可变审计证据。

## 审计表

```sql
CREATE TABLE security_audit_events (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    event_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    actor_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    actor_user_id UUID,
    actor_session_id UUID,

    target_type VARCHAR(64),
    target_id UUID,

    request_id UUID,
    reason TEXT,

    before_state JSONB,
    after_state JSONB,
    metadata JSONB,

    ip_address_hash VARCHAR(128),
    user_agent_hash VARCHAR(128),

    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 事件类型

```text
auth.registration.created
auth.email_verification.sent
auth.email_verification.completed
auth.login.succeeded
auth.login.failed
auth.account.locked
auth.password.changed
auth.password.reset.requested
auth.password.reset.completed

auth.session.refreshed
auth.session.revoked
auth.session.family_revoked
auth.refresh_token.reuse_detected

admin.invitation.created
admin.invitation.accepted
admin.invitation.revoked
admin.account.disabled
admin.account.restored

rbac.role.created
rbac.role.updated
rbac.role.assigned
rbac.role.revoked
rbac.permission.added
rbac.permission.removed

user.account.suspended
user.account.restored
user.sessions.revoked
```

## 审计原则

```text
只追加，不更新
普通管理员不能删除
密码和 Token 永远不进入 metadata
邮箱按查看者权限进行遮盖
IP 默认保存不可逆 Hash 或网络前缀
before_state 和 after_state 仅保存必要字段
导出审计记录需要 audit.export 权限
```

## API

```http
GET /api/v1/admin/audit/security-events
GET /api/v1/admin/audit/security-events/{event_id}
POST /api/v1/admin/audit/security-events/export
```

查询条件：

```text
event_type
severity
actor_user_id
target_type
target_id
occurred_from
occurred_to
request_id
```

审计与日志不得暴露正式密钥、原始 Token 或敏感密码。计划书也要求环境变量和密钥位置可以说明，但不得在代码或普通文档中暴露正式密钥。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

# 十五、Skill 2.11：`vav-auth-abuse-protection`

## 目标

实现登录、邮件、刷新和管理员接口的滥用防护。

## Redis 限流键

```text
rate:login:ip:{ip_hash}
rate:login:email:{email_hash}
rate:register:ip:{ip_hash}
rate:verify-email:user:{user_id}
rate:forgot-password:email:{email_hash}
rate:refresh:session:{session_id}
rate:admin-login:ip:{ip_hash}
```

## 默认限流

| 操作 | 默认限制 |
|---|---:|
| 登录/IP | 10 次/分钟 |
| 登录/账户 | 5 次/15 分钟 |
| 注册/IP | 5 次/小时 |
| 重发验证邮件 | 1 次/分钟，5 次/小时 |
| 找回密码 | 5 次/小时 |
| Refresh | 30 次/分钟 |
| 管理端登录/IP | 5 次/15 分钟 |

全部通过环境变量配置，不作为不可修改的业务政策。

## 账户锁定

```text
连续失败次数达到阈值
→ locked_until 写入数据库
→ 记录 auth.account.locked
→ 正确密码也必须等待锁定结束
```

成功登录后：

```text
failed_login_count = 0
locked_until = NULL
```

## Origin 与 CSRF

由于 Refresh Token 使用 Cookie：

```text
Refresh、Logout、Logout All
必须校验 Origin
必须使用 CSRF Header
```

前端从非 HttpOnly CSRF Cookie 中读取随机值，并发送：

```http
X-CSRF-Token: <token>
```

服务端检查 Cookie 与 Header 一致。

## 管理端加强策略

```text
更短的空闲超时
SameSite=Strict
独立 Cookie 名称
独立 JWT Audience
更严格的登录限流
所有管理员状态变更写审计
生产环境可配置管理员 IP Allowlist
```

管理员 MFA 可以在后续安全增强 Batch 接入，本批需保证认证接口和会话模型不阻碍 MFA 扩展。

# 十六、Skill 2.12：`vav-auth-testing-acceptance`

## 目标

建立完整认证、权限和管理端自动化验收体系。

## 测试目录

```text
services/api/tests/identity/
├── unit/
│   ├── test_password_hasher.py
│   ├── test_token_service.py
│   ├── test_permission_policy.py
│   └── test_user_state_machine.py
├── integration/
│   ├── test_registration.py
│   ├── test_email_verification.py
│   ├── test_login.py
│   ├── test_password_reset.py
│   ├── test_refresh_rotation.py
│   ├── test_session_revocation.py
│   ├── test_rbac.py
│   ├── test_admin_invitation.py
│   └── test_security_audit.py
└── security/
    ├── test_email_enumeration.py
    ├── test_refresh_reuse.py
    ├── test_token_audience_isolation.py
    ├── test_privilege_escalation.py
    ├── test_csrf_protection.py
    └── test_rate_limits.py
```

前端：

```text
apps/user-web/src/**/*.spec.ts
apps/admin-web/src/**/*.spec.ts
e2e/auth/
├── user-registration.spec.ts
├── email-verification.spec.ts
├── login-refresh.spec.ts
├── password-reset.spec.ts
├── session-management.spec.ts
├── admin-login.spec.ts
├── role-management.spec.ts
└── permission-denied.spec.ts
```

## 必须通过的关键场景

### 注册和验证

```text
新邮箱注册成功
重复邮箱不泄露过多账户信息
未验证用户不能进入受保护功能
验证 Token 只能使用一次
过期验证 Token 被拒绝
重新发送后旧 Token 失效
```

### 登录和密码

```text
正确密码登录成功
错误密码返回统一错误
连续失败触发锁定
修改密码撤销其他会话
找回密码接口不泄露账户是否存在
重置 Token 只能使用一次
密码重置撤销全部旧会话
```

### JWT

```text
过期 Token 被拒绝
错误 issuer 被拒绝
错误 audience 被拒绝
用户 Token 不能访问管理端
管理端 Token 不能冒充普通业务 Token
auth_version 不一致时 Token 被拒绝
```

### Refresh Token

```text
正常刷新成功
刷新后旧 Token 失效
重用旧 Token 撤销整个 Token Family
并发刷新只有一个成功
退出后 Refresh Token 失效
退出所有设备后全部 Session 失效
```

### RBAC

```text
无权限用户返回 403
隐藏前端按钮不能绕过后端权限
角色授权立即生效
角色撤销立即失效
普通管理员不能修改 super_admin
不能删除最后一个 active super_admin
管理员不能提升自己到超出自身权限的角色
```

### 审计

```text
角色分配产生审计事件
账户暂停产生审计事件
Refresh Token 重用产生高严重性事件
审计事件不能通过普通 API 修改或删除
审计内容不包含密码、原始 Token 和密钥
```

`.env.example` 只能包含示例值，不得包含正式私钥或 Token Pepper。

# 二十、Batch 2 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-02/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-02-identity-access-control
description: Implement complete user and administrator identity, authentication, session, RBAC and security-audit capabilities for the VAV platform.
---

# Goal

Implement a production-oriented identity and access-control system containing:

- user registration;
- email verification;
- password login;
- password recovery;
- JWT access tokens;
- rotating opaque refresh tokens;
- refresh-token reuse detection;
- device and session management;
- role-based access control;
- administrator invitations and account governance;
- user-web authentication;
- admin-web authentication;
- immutable permission and security audit records;
- abuse protection;
- automated security and end-to-end tests.

# Prerequisites

Before implementation:

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 passes `make verify`.
3. Read all skills under `skills/batch-02`.
4. Inspect existing database, outbox and audit abstractions.
5. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-02-plan.md`.

# Required implementation order

1. Identity domain model and migrations.
2. Password hashing and user registration.
3. Email verification and password recovery.
4. JWT access-token service.
5. Refresh-session rotation and revocation.
6. RBAC permission engine.
7. Administrator account governance.
8. User-web authentication flows.
9. Admin-web authentication flows.
10. Security and permission audit.
11. Rate limiting and abuse protection.
12. Unit, integration, security and E2E acceptance tests.

# Security invariants

- Never store or log raw passwords.
- Never store or log raw refresh, verification or password-reset tokens.
- Access tokens must be short lived.
- Refresh tokens must rotate on every successful refresh.
- Reuse of a replaced refresh token must revoke the entire token family.
- User and administrator JWT audiences must be different.
- Authorization must be enforced by the backend.
- Frontend permission hiding is not authorization.
- Role and permission changes must invalidate cached authorization state.
- Sensitive administrator actions must include an explicit reason.
- Permission and security audit events must be append-only.
- No default production administrator password may exist.
- No secret may be committed to the repository.

# Product constraints

- Email verification is implemented in this batch.
- Phone verification remains an extension boundary.
- Undecided business rules must remain configurable.
- Account and session security must not depend on AI services.
- Suspended, deleted or compromised users must not receive valid access tokens.
- User privacy settings and full deletion workflows may be extended later, but the identity model must support them.

# Required commands

The completed batch must support:

```bash
make auth-migrate
make auth-seed
make create-super-admin
make auth-test
make auth-security-test
make auth-e2e
make auth-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. A new user can register and verify their email.
2. A verified user can log in.
3. Access tokens expire and are validated correctly.
4. Refresh tokens rotate on every use.
5. Refresh-token reuse revokes the full token family.
6. Users can inspect and revoke their sessions.
7. Password recovery works without account enumeration.
8. User tokens cannot access administrator APIs.
9. Administrator tokens cannot bypass user-domain authorization.
10. Roles and permissions are enforced by backend dependencies.
11. Administrator invitations and role assignment work.
12. Privilege-escalation safeguards pass.
13. Sensitive actions produce immutable audit records.
14. User-web authentication E2E tests pass.
15. Admin-web authentication and permission E2E tests pass.
16. `make auth-verify` succeeds from a clean database.
17. `make verify` from Batch 1 still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When implementation reveals an unresolved business decision:

1. record it in `docs/product/decision-register.md`;
2. implement a configurable, least-privilege default;
3. do not invent permanent business policy;
4. continue with security boundaries that do not depend on that decision.

When a security test fails:

1. stop feature development;
2. document the failing invariant;
3. fix the root cause;
4. add a regression test;
5. rerun the complete Batch 2 security suite.
```

# 四、内容领域模型

## 4.1 内容条目表

统一管理页面、文章、幸福见证等内容的生命周期。

```sql
CREATE TABLE content_entries (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    entry_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    internal_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    canonical_slug VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    default_locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    visibility VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'public',

    author_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    reviewer_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    published_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    scheduled_publish_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    archived_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    current_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(entry_type, canonical_slug)
);
```

## 4.2 内容类型

```python
class ContentEntryType(StrEnum):
    PAGE = "page"
    ARTICLE = "article"
    TESTIMONIAL = "testimonial"
    FAQ = "faq"
    ANNOUNCEMENT = "announcement"
```

本批正式实现：

```text
PAGE
ARTICLE
TESTIMONIAL
```

其他类型只保留扩展边界。

## 4.3 发布状态

```python
class ContentStatus(StrEnum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    IN_REVIEW = "in_review"
    SCHEDULED = "scheduled"
    PUBLISHED = "published"
    ARCHIVED = "archived"
```

状态机：

```text
DRAFT
  ├── submit → IN_REVIEW
  ├── publish directly → PUBLISHED
  └── schedule → SCHEDULED

IN_REVIEW
  ├── approve → PUBLISHED
  ├── schedule → SCHEDULED
  └── reject → DRAFT

SCHEDULED
  ├── scheduled time reached → PUBLISHED
  ├── cancel → DRAFT
  └── archive → ARCHIVED

PUBLISHED
  ├── create new revision → DRAFT
  └── archive → ARCHIVED

ARCHIVED
  └── restore → DRAFT
```

是否强制审核由配置控制：

```dotenv
CMS_REQUIRE_REVIEW_FOR_PUBLISH=true
```

---

# 五、多语言内容模型

## 5.1 本地化表

```sql
CREATE TABLE content_localizations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    entry_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES content_entries(id),

    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    localized_slug VARCHAR(200),

    title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    subtitle VARCHAR(500),
    excerpt TEXT,

    content_blocks JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    plain_text TEXT,

    seo_title VARCHAR(300),
    seo_description VARCHAR(500),
    social_title VARCHAR(300),
    social_description VARCHAR(500),

    cover_media_id UUID,
    translation_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(entry_id, locale),
    UNIQUE(locale, localized_slug)
);
```

## 5.2 支持语言

```python
class SupportedLocale(StrEnum):
    ZH_CN = "zh-CN"
    ZH_TW = "zh-TW"
    EN = "en"
```

配置：

```dotenv
CMS_SUPPORTED_LOCALES=zh-CN,zh-TW,en
CMS_DEFAULT_LOCALE=zh-CN
CMS_FALLBACK_LOCALE=zh-CN
```

默认语言只属于技术环境默认值，不代表正式产品首发语言。

## 5.3 翻译状态

```python
class TranslationStatus(StrEnum):
    MISSING = "missing"
    DRAFT = "draft"
    REVIEW_REQUIRED = "review_required"
    READY = "ready"
    OUTDATED = "outdated"
```

当源语言内容更新后，其他语言自动转为：

```text
OUTDATED
```

后台必须显示：

```text
简体中文：已发布
繁体中文：需要更新
英文：缺失
```

## 5.4 回退规则

用户访问某语言内容时：

```text
目标语言存在并已发布
→ 返回目标语言

目标语言不存在
→ 根据配置回退默认语言

配置禁止回退
→ 返回 404 或 CONTENT_TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE
```

配置：

```dotenv
CMS_ALLOW_LOCALE_FALLBACK=true
```

    entry_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES content_entries(id),

    snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

## 实施约束

6. 数据库不得保存未经清理的任意 HTML。
7. 已被页面引用的媒体不能直接永久删除。

CREATE TABLE testimonial_metadata (
    entry_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES content_entries(id),

    subject_display_name VARCHAR(160),
    relationship_stage VARCHAR(64),
    consent_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    consent_record_id UUID,

    anonymity_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    featured BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE
);
```

## 见证隐私等级

```python
class TestimonialAnonymityLevel(StrEnum):
    FULLY_ANONYMOUS = "fully_anonymous"
    FIRST_NAME_ONLY = "first_name_only"
    PSEUDONYM = "pseudonym"
    APPROVED_PUBLIC_NAME = "approved_public_name"
```

## 见证发布硬性条件

```text
consent_status == approved
且
存在授权记录
且
发布者具有 testimonials.publish 权限
```

否则返回：

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "TESTIMONIAL_CONSENT_REQUIRED",
    "message": "Publishing requires an approved consent record."
  }
}
```

## 公共 API

```http
GET /api/v1/public/articles
GET /api/v1/public/articles/{slug}
GET /api/v1/public/testimonials
GET /api/v1/public/testimonials/{slug}
```

查询参数：

```text
locale
page
page_size
category
featured
published_from
published_to
```

## 管理 API

```http
GET    /api/v1/admin/content/articles
POST   /api/v1/admin/content/articles
GET    /api/v1/admin/content/articles/{id}
PATCH  /api/v1/admin/content/articles/{id}

GET    /api/v1/admin/content/testimonials
POST   /api/v1/admin/content/testimonials
GET    /api/v1/admin/content/testimonials/{id}

# 十、Skill 3.4：`vav-media-library`

## 目标

实现基于 MinIO/S3 的媒体上传、管理、转换和引用保护。

## 媒体表

```sql
CREATE TABLE media_assets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    storage_provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    bucket_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    object_key VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    original_filename VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    media_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    mime_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    byte_size BIGINT NOT NULL,

    width INTEGER,
    height INTEGER,
    duration_seconds NUMERIC(12, 3),

    checksum_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    visibility VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private',
    processing_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    uploaded_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 媒体本地化元数据

```sql
CREATE TABLE media_asset_localizations (
    media_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES media_assets(id),
    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    alt_text VARCHAR(500),
    caption TEXT,
    accessibility_description TEXT,

    PRIMARY KEY(media_id, locale)
);
```

## 上传流程

```text
管理端请求上传
→ 后端验证文件类型和大小
→ 创建待上传记录
→ 返回 Presigned Upload URL
→ 浏览器直接上传 MinIO/S3
→ 管理端调用 complete
→ 后端校验对象、大小、MIME 和 Hash
→ 异步生成缩略图
→ 标记 ready
```

## API

```http
POST   /api/v1/admin/media/uploads
POST   /api/v1/admin/media/uploads/{id}/complete
GET    /api/v1/admin/media
GET    /api/v1/admin/media/{id}
PATCH  /api/v1/admin/media/{id}
DELETE /api/v1/admin/media/{id}
GET    /api/v1/admin/media/{id}/references
```

## 支持类型

第一期默认：

```text
image/jpeg
image/png
image/webp
image/avif
application/pdf
```

禁止：

```text
SVG 默认禁止
HTML
JavaScript
可执行文件
压缩包
未识别二进制内容
```

SVG 如后续启用，必须经过专门 Sanitizer。

## 图片衍生尺寸

```text
thumbnail: 320px
small:     640px
medium:    1280px
large:     1920px
```

## 删除策略

```text
无引用
→ 软删除
→ 延迟清理对象

有内容引用
→ 返回 MEDIA_IN_USE
→ 展示引用页面
```

## 上传配置

```dotenv
MEDIA_MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_MB=10
MEDIA_MAX_DOCUMENT_SIZE_MB=25
MEDIA_ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES=image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/avif
MEDIA_DEFAULT_VISIBILITY=private
MEDIA_PRESIGNED_UPLOAD_TTL_SECONDS=900
```

# 十二、Skill 3.6：`vav-internationalization-localization`

## 目标

统一用户端、管理端、后端错误消息和内容数据的语言策略。

## 前端目录

```text
apps/user-web/src/i18n/
├── index.ts
├── locales/
│   ├── zh-CN.json
│   ├── zh-TW.json
│   └── en.json
└── formatters/
    ├── date.ts
    ├── currency.ts
    └── number.ts

apps/admin-web/src/i18n/
├── index.ts
└── locales/
    ├── zh-CN.json
    ├── zh-TW.json
    └── en.json
```

## 语言选择优先级

```text
URL locale
→ 用户账户 preferred_locale
→ Locale Cookie
→ 浏览器 Accept-Language
→ CMS_DEFAULT_LOCALE
```

## URL

```text
/zh-CN/
/zh-TW/
/en/

/zh-CN/about
/zh-TW/about
/en/about
```

## Locale Cookie

```text
名称：vav_locale
HttpOnly：false
Secure：生产环境 true
SameSite：Lax
有效期：一年
```

## 内容与 UI 翻译分离

```text
UI 字符串：
前端 JSON 语言包

运营内容：
PostgreSQL content_localizations

后端错误：
稳定 error.code + 可选本地化 message
```

前端不得依赖后端英文错误消息进行业务判断，只使用：

```text
error.code
```

## 日期、货币与时区

```ts
formatDate(date, locale, timezone)
formatCurrency(amountMinor, currency, locale)
formatNumber(value, locale)
```

禁止：

```text
在模板中直接拼接 "$"
把 UTC 时间直接显示给用户
假定所有语言具有相同字符长度
```

## 翻译完整性脚本

```bash
pnpm i18n:check
```

检查：

```text
缺失键
未使用键
不同语言参数占位符不一致
硬编码用户可见字符串
无效 locale
```

# 十六、Skill 3.9：`vav-publishing-preview-cache`

## 目标

实现安全预览、定时发布、缓存和发布失效。

## 预览 Token

```sql
CREATE TABLE content_preview_tokens (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    entry_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES content_entries(id),
    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    locale VARCHAR(16),
    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    consumed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 预览 API

```http
POST /api/v1/admin/content/{entry_id}/preview-token
GET  /api/v1/public/preview/{raw_token}
```

要求：

```text
Token 高熵随机
数据库只保存 Hash
默认 30 分钟失效
可以主动撤销
只能查看指定内容
不得扩大到后台权限
预览页面设置 noindex
```

## 定时发布

Celery Beat 任务：

```text
publish_scheduled_content
```

执行频率：

```text
每分钟
```

数据库事务：

```text
锁定到期的 SCHEDULED 内容
→ 校验发布条件
→ 生成正式发布版本
→ 写入 published_at
→ 写审计
→ 发出 content.entry.published Outbox Event
```

## Redis Cache Key

```text
cms:page:{locale}:{slug}:{published_version}
cms:article:{locale}:{slug}:{published_version}
cms:stories:{locale}:{page}:{filters_hash}
cms:navigation:{locale}:{menu_code}:{version}
cms:site-settings:{version}
```

## 发布后失效

```text
内容发布
→ 删除对应旧缓存
→ 删除关联列表缓存
→ 删除首页引用缓存
→ 发送 cache.invalidation.completed
```

缓存失败不能阻止数据库发布，但必须告警，并采用短 TTL 防止长期陈旧。

# 十八、Skill 3.11：`vav-seo-accessibility-security`

## 目标

为公共网站补齐 SEO、无障碍、性能和内容安全。

## SEO

每个可公开内容支持：

```text
title
description
canonical URL
Open Graph
Twitter/X Card
robots
hreflang
structured data
```

## Hreflang 示例

```html
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="zh-CN" href="..." />
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="zh-TW" href="..." />
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="..." />
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="x-default" href="..." />
```

## Sitemap

```http
GET /sitemap.xml
GET /sitemaps/pages.xml
GET /sitemaps/articles.xml
GET /robots.txt
```

只包含：

```text
已发布
公开
允许索引
具有可用语言版本
```

## 结构化数据

可支持：

```text
Organization
WebSite
Article
BreadcrumbList
FAQPage
```

不得生成没有真实依据的评分、婚恋成功率或组织认证信息。

## 无障碍要求

```text
语义化标题层级
键盘可操作
焦点状态清晰
图片支持 alt
表单标签完整
错误信息与字段关联
颜色不作为唯一信息来源
Modal 焦点锁定
支持 prefers-reduced-motion
```

## 图片规则

发布前检查：

```text
内容图片必须具有对应语言 alt 文本
纯装饰图片可以 alt=""
重要文字不得只存在于图片中
```

## 内容安全策略

建议生产头：

```text
Content-Security-Policy
X-Content-Type-Options
Referrer-Policy
Permissions-Policy
Strict-Transport-Security
```

## 外链规则

后台保存外部链接时校验：

```text
仅允许 http/https
拒绝 javascript:
拒绝 data:
拒绝不安全协议
新窗口打开时添加 noopener noreferrer
```

## Rich Text Sanitization

允许：

```text
paragraph
heading
list
blockquote
strong
emphasis
link
```

拒绝：

```text
script
iframe
style
event handler
form
object
embed
任意自定义 HTML
```

课程视频嵌入应在后续课程 Batch 使用受控 Provider，而不是开放任意 iframe。

# 十九、Skill 3.12：`vav-cms-testing-acceptance`

## 目标

建立 CMS、国际化、官网和管理端完整测试体系。

## 后端测试

```text

# 二十、必须通过的验收场景

## 1. 页面管理

```text
管理员创建页面草稿
添加结构化区块
保存中文内容
添加英文翻译
提交审核
发布
用户端可访问
未发布草稿不可通过公共 API 读取
```

## 2. 多语言

```text
访问 /zh-CN/about 返回简体中文
访问 /zh-TW/about 返回繁体中文
访问 /en/about 返回英文
缺失语言根据配置回退或返回不可用
源语言变更后其他翻译标记为 outdated
```

## 3. 内容权限

```text
只有 read 权限可以查看列表
没有 update 权限不能修改
没有 publish 权限不能发布
前端隐藏按钮不能绕过后端 API
普通管理员不能自行授予发布权限
```

## 4. 版本控制

```text
每次保存生成版本记录
已发布版本不会被直接覆盖
旧版本可以预览
有权限者可以回滚
回滚本身生成新版本
并发编辑返回版本冲突
```

## 5. 媒体安全

```text
合法图片可以上传
伪造扩展名被拒绝
超大文件被拒绝
未完成上传不能使用
被引用媒体不能直接删除
私有媒体不能匿名读取
```

## 6. 幸福见证

```text
无授权记录不能发布
匿名等级正确应用
后台审计记录发布者
公共 API 不返回内部授权信息
```

## 7. 联系表单

```text
合法提交成功
隐私同意缺失时拒绝
高频请求被限流
后台可分配和处理
普通内容编辑无权导出联系记录
```

## 8. 安全

```text
Rich Text 中 script 被清除
javascript: 链接被拒绝
预览 Token 只能查看指定内容
过期预览 Token 无效
Site Settings 公共 API 不泄露私密配置
```

# 二十五、Batch 3 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存到：

```text
skills/batch-03/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-03-public-site-cms-i18n
description: Implement the VAV public website, structured CMS, multilingual content, media library, publishing workflows and administration framework.
---

# Goal

Build a complete public-content platform containing:

- responsive multilingual public website;
- structured page-content management;
- articles;
- approved testimonials;
- media library backed by S3-compatible storage;
- navigation and footer management;
- public site settings;
- simplified Chinese, traditional Chinese and English support;
- translation-status management;
- drafts, reviews, previews, scheduled publication and archiving;
- immutable content versions;
- cooperation and contact submissions;
- SEO metadata;
- accessibility foundations;
- content-security controls;
- user-web and admin-web end-to-end tests.

# Source requirements

The project plan requires:

- a responsive VAV website;
- basic content management;
- home, about, testimonials, articles and cooperation-contact content;
- multilingual expansion capability;
- an operations administration interface;
- a maintainable architecture that can be handed to another developer.

Do not fabricate business claims, testimonials, legal approval, success rates,
service outcomes, staff biographies or launch-language decisions.

# Prerequisites

Before implementation:

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 with `make verify`.
3. Verify Batch 2 with `make auth-verify`.
4. Read every skill under `skills/batch-03`.
5. Inspect the existing RBAC, audit, outbox, storage and Vue foundations.
6. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-03-plan.md`.
7. Record unresolved content and branding decisions in the decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. CMS domain model and migrations.
2. Content-block schemas and validation.
3. Page-content management.
4. Articles and testimonials.
5. Media-library storage and upload flows.
6. Navigation and site settings.
7. Internationalization and localization.
8. Public user-web pages.
9. Admin CMS framework and editors.
10. Preview, scheduled publication and cache invalidation.
11. Contact and cooperation submissions.
12. SEO, accessibility and content security.
13. Unit, integration, security and E2E tests.

# Architecture constraints

- Store content as validated structured blocks.
- Do not allow arbitrary executable HTML.
- Keep published content immutable through version snapshots.
- Every content update must produce a new version.
- Every publish, archive and rollback action must be audited.
- Public APIs may return only published and visible content.
- Drafts may be viewed only through scoped preview tokens.
- Preview tokens must be random, hashed in storage and short lived.
- Media objects are private until explicitly published.
- Referenced media must not be permanently deleted.
- UI translations and business content translations remain separate.
- Content permissions must be enforced by the backend.
- Frontend permission directives are only user-experience controls.
- Site settings must distinguish public from secret values.
- Publishing must not depend on AI availability.

# Content integrity rules

- Do not invent testimonials.
- Do not invent success rates.
- Do not invent legal-policy approval.
- Do not publish testimonials without a consent record.
- Do not expose personal consent records through public APIs.
- Do not create claims that VAV services are medically, legally or
  therapeutically certified unless supplied and approved by the business owner.
- Mark generated placeholder copy clearly as draft.
- Preserve unresolved launch-language and branding decisions as configuration.

# Localization rules

- Support `zh-CN`, `zh-TW` and `en`.
- Do not assume the default technical locale is the launch locale.
- Mark translations outdated when the source version changes.
- Do not silently return draft translations.
- Locale fallback must be configurable.
- API business logic must use stable error codes rather than localized text.

# Security invariants

- Reject script, iframe, event-handler and unsafe URL content.
- Validate real MIME type and size for every upload.
- Never expose private S3 object keys unnecessarily.
- Never expose secret site settings through public endpoints.
- Contact forms must include privacy consent and abuse protection.
- Preview tokens must not grant administrator privileges.
- SEO output must not contain fabricated ratings or outcomes.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make cms-migrate
make cms-seed
make i18n-check
make cms-test
make cms-security-test
make cms-user-e2e
make cms-admin-e2e
make cms-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. An authorized editor can create a page.
2. The editor can add validated content blocks.
3. The editor can maintain separate locale versions.
4. The editor can preview an unpublished version.
5. An authorized publisher can publish the page.
6. An unauthorized editor cannot publish.
7. Published content is available through public APIs.
8. Draft content is not publicly accessible.
9. Content history and rollback work.
10. Scheduled publication works.
11. Cache invalidation works after publication.
12. Articles can be listed and viewed.
13. Testimonials cannot be published without approved consent.
14. Media can be uploaded safely and referenced by content.
15. Referenced media cannot be deleted.
16. Navigation and footer content are configurable.
17. Public settings do not expose secret values.
18. Locale switching works in user-web.
19. Translation completeness checks pass.
20. The contact form stores privacy consent and resists abuse.
21. SEO metadata and sitemap generation work.
22. XSS and unsafe-link security tests pass.
23. Public-site E2E tests pass.
24. Admin CMS E2E tests pass.
25. `make auth-verify` still succeeds.
26. `make verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When business content is unavailable:

1. create the content structure;
2. mark the content as draft or pending;
3. do not fabricate final copy;
4. record the missing business input;
5. continue implementing functionality independent of the missing copy.

When a content-security test fails:

1. stop publication-related feature work;
2. document the violated invariant;
3. fix sanitization, validation or authorization at the backend;
4. add a regression test;
5. rerun the full CMS security suite.
```

# 五、统一商品领域设计

## 5.1 商品与 SKU 的区别

```text
Product
表示业务意义上的商品或服务。

SKU
表示用户实际购买的可售单元。
```

示例：

```text
Product：VAV 关系成长课程
├── SKU：课程线上版
├── SKU：课程线上版＋辅导一次
└── SKU：课程团体学习版

Product：婚恋会员
├── SKU：月度会员
├── SKU：季度会员
└── SKU：年度会员
```

商品负责：

```text
名称
介绍
内容分类
服务类型
品牌展示
上下架

# 十、多币种金额规范

计划书要求前台支持 CNY、USD、TWD、HKD，并在后台保留原币、实付币种、结算币种和支付渠道信息。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

## 10.1 Money Value Object

```python
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Money:
    amount_minor: int
    currency: str
```

示例：

```text
USD 19.99 → amount_minor = 1999
CNY 199.00 → amount_minor = 19900
TWD 1200   → amount_minor = 1200
HKD 299.50 → amount_minor = 29950
```

## 10.2 禁止浮点运算

禁止：

```python
price = 19.99
discount = price * 0.15
```

允许：

```python
price = Money(amount_minor=1999, currency="USD")
discount_minor = round_discount(price.amount_minor, 1500)
```

折扣率使用 Basis Points：

```text
15% = 1500 basis points
100% = 10000 basis points
```

## 10.3 货币元数据

```sql
CREATE TABLE supported_currencies (
    currency_code CHAR(3) PRIMARY KEY,
    exponent SMALLINT NOT NULL,
    enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    display_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

默认 Seed：

```text
CNY exponent 2
USD exponent 2
TWD exponent 0
HKD exponent 2
```

必须从货币元数据读取 exponent，不能假定所有货币都是两位小数。

# 十一、Skill 4.4：`vav-price-book-and-multi-currency`

## 目标

实现版本化价格簿、多币种价格和有效期。

## Price Book

```sql
CREATE TABLE price_books (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    price_book_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

    region_code VARCHAR(64),
    customer_segment VARCHAR(64),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',

    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,

    priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

示例：

```text
GLOBAL_STANDARD
TAIWAN_STANDARD
US_STANDARD
EARLY_ACCESS
INTERNAL_TEST
```

## Price

```sql
CREATE TABLE prices (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    sku_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES product_skus(id),
    price_book_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES price_books(id),

    currency_code CHAR(3)
        NOT NULL REFERENCES supported_currencies(currency_code),

    unit_amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    compare_at_amount_minor BIGINT,

    billing_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    billing_interval VARCHAR(32),
    billing_interval_count INTEGER,

    tax_behavior VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unspecified',

    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',

    external_price_references JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    supersedes_price_id UUID REFERENCES prices(id)
);
```

## 价格不可变规则

价格启用后：

```text
unit_amount_minor 不允许修改
currency_code 不允许修改
billing_type 不允许修改
billing_interval 不允许修改
```

变价必须：

```text
创建新价格
→ 指向 supersedes_price_id
→ 设置未来 valid_from
→ 旧价格设置 valid_until
```

这样 Batch 5 创建订单时可以保存真实成交价格快照。

## 外部支付价格映射

{
  "stripe": {
    "test": "price_test_xxx",
    "live": null
  },
  "paypal": {
    "test": "P-TEST-XXX",
    "live": null
  }
}
```

Batch 4 只保存映射，不调用支付和订阅 API。

## 管理 API

```http
GET    /api/v1/admin/catalog/price-books

PATCH  /api/v1/admin/catalog/price-books/{id}

POST   /api/v1/admin/catalog/price-books/{id}/deactivate

```

# 十二、汇率与本地价格策略

本系统优先采用**显式本币价格**：

```text
同一 SKU
├── CNY 价格
├── USD 价格
├── TWD 价格
└── HKD 价格
```

而不是每次购买时实时汇率换算。

原因：

```text
营销价格通常不是纯汇率结果
各地区购买力不同
支付渠道手续费不同
退款和对账需要稳定成交金额
实时汇率会导致展示价频繁变化
```

## 汇率只用于后台辅助

```sql
CREATE TABLE exchange_rate_snapshots (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    base_currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
    quote_currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL,

    rate_scaled BIGINT NOT NULL,
    scale INTEGER NOT NULL,

    source VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    observed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

汇率可用于：

```text
后台建议价格
财务换算参考
报表聚合
价格差异检查
```

不得用于：

```text
修改已生成报价
修改已创建订单
修改已支付金额
替代支付服务返回的结算信息
```

# 十三、Skill 4.5：`vav-pricing-engine`

## 目标

实现确定性、可审计的报价计算引擎。

## 输入

```python
class PricingRequest(BaseModel):
    sku_id: UUID
    quantity: PositiveInt
    requested_currency: str
    locale: str
    user_id: UUID | None
    coupon_code: str | None
    pricing_context: PricingContext
```

## Pricing Context

```python
class PricingContext(BaseModel):
    region_code: str | None
    customer_segment: str | None
    requested_at: datetime
    channel: Literal["user_web", "admin", "api"]
```

## 输出

```python
class PricingQuoteResult(BaseModel):
    quote_id: UUID
    sku_id: UUID
    quantity: int
    currency: str

    unit_amount_minor: int
    subtotal_minor: int

    discounts: list[AppliedDiscount]
    discount_total_minor: int

    tax_estimate_minor: int | None
    total_minor: int

    price_id: UUID
    price_book_id: UUID

    inventory_reservation_required: bool
    expires_at: datetime
```

## 报价计算顺序

```text
1. 校验商品和 SKU 是否可售
2. 校验购买时间窗口
3. 解析用户地区和客户分组
4. 选择 Price Book
5. 选择请求币种价格
6. 计算数量小计
7. 发现自动促销
8. 校验优惠码
9. 应用互斥和叠加规则
10. 计算优惠总额
11. 应用最低金额边界
12. 生成报价快照
13. 返回库存是否需要预留
```

## 报价快照

```sql
CREATE TABLE pricing_quotes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    anonymous_session_id UUID,

    sku_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES product_skus(id),
    price_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES prices(id),
    price_book_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES price_books(id),

    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    currency_code CHAR(3) NOT NULL,

    unit_amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    subtotal_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    discount_total_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    tax_estimate_minor BIGINT,
    total_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,

    calculation_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    consumed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 报价 API

```http
POST /api/v1/public/catalog/pricing/quote
GET  /api/v1/public/catalog/pricing/quotes/{quote_id}
```

获取报价时：

```text
匿名报价需绑定 anonymous_session_id
用户报价需绑定 user_id
过期报价不能创建订单
报价只能消费一次或由 Batch 5 显式标记已消费
```

## 价格选择确定性

当多个价格同时匹配时，排序规则必须固定：

```text
Price Book priority 降序
→ 地区匹配优先
→ 用户分组匹配优先
→ valid_from 最新
→ price_id 稳定排序
```

如仍存在不可消解的同优先级冲突：

```text
返回 PRICING_CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT
记录高严重性配置错误
不得随机选价
```

## 库存项目表

CREATE TABLE inventory_items (

    inventory_policy VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    oversell_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 可售数量

```text
available =
total_capacity
- reserved_quantity
- sold_quantity
- safety_stock
```

若允许超卖：

```text
available =
total_capacity
+ oversell_limit
- reserved_quantity
- sold_quantity
- safety_stock
```

## 库存流水

```sql
CREATE TABLE inventory_movements (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    inventory_item_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_items(id),

    movement_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    quantity_delta INTEGER NOT NULL,

    before_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    after_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,

    reference_type VARCHAR(64),
    reference_id UUID,

    reason TEXT NOT NULL,

    actor_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    request_id UUID,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## Movement Type

```text
capacity_increase
capacity_decrease
reservation_created
reservation_released
reservation_confirmed
manual_adjustment
correction
cancellation_return
```

## 管理 API

```http
GET  /api/v1/admin/catalog/inventory
GET  /api/v1/admin/catalog/inventory/{sku_id}
POST /api/v1/admin/catalog/inventory/{sku_id}/adjust
GET  /api/v1/admin/catalog/inventory/{sku_id}/movements
```

## 调整请求

```json
{
  "quantity_delta": 20,
  "reason": "Venue confirmed twenty additional seats.",
  "expected_version": 4
}
```

## 约束

```text
库存不能在没有原因时修改
减少后的容量不能小于已售数量
减少后的容量不能小于已售＋当前有效预留
库存调整必须使用乐观锁或行锁
所有库存调整必须产生流水和审计
```

# 十六、Skill 4.7：`vav-inventory-reservations`

## 目标

在用户进入购买流程时短暂锁定库存，防止超卖。

## 预留表

```sql
CREATE TABLE inventory_reservations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    inventory_item_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_items(id),
    sku_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES product_skus(id),

    user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    anonymous_session_id UUID,

    pricing_quote_id UUID REFERENCES pricing_quotes(id),

    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    released_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    release_reason VARCHAR(128),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## Reservation Status

```python
class ReservationStatus(StrEnum):
    ACTIVE = "active"
    CONFIRMED = "confirmed"
    RELEASED = "released"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
```

## 创建预留

```text
开始事务
→ SELECT inventory_item FOR UPDATE
→ 计算 available
→ 校验 available >= requested
→ reserved_quantity += requested
→ 创建 reservation
→ 写入库存流水
→ 提交事务
```

## API

Batch 4 提供内部接口：

```http
POST /api/v1/internal/inventory/reservations
POST /api/v1/internal/inventory/reservations/{id}/confirm
POST /api/v1/internal/inventory/reservations/{id}/release
```

公共前端不能直接调用 confirm。

Batch 5 调用：

```text
创建订单前：create reservation
支付成功后：confirm reservation
订单取消或支付失败：release reservation
```

## 预留过期任务

Celery Beat：

```text
expire_inventory_reservations
```

默认每分钟执行：

```text
查找 ACTIVE 且 expires_at <= now
→ 行锁
→ 标记 EXPIRED
→ reserved_quantity 减少
→ 写库存流水
```

## 幂等性

```text
重复 confirm 已确认预留 → 返回原结果
重复 release 已释放预留 → 返回原结果
confirm 已过期预留 → 拒绝
release 已确认预留 → 拒绝或走取消退回流程
```

# 十七、优惠领域模型

## 17.1 Promotion 与 Coupon 区别

```text
Promotion
定义优惠规则。

Coupon
是用户输入或系统分发的兑换凭证。
```

示例：

```text
Promotion：新用户首单立减 100 TWD
Coupon：WELCOME100

Promotion：指定课程九折
Coupon：可无优惠码，自动应用
```

## 17.2 Promotion 表

```sql
CREATE TABLE promotions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    promotion_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    internal_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

    promotion_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    application_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',

    priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    stackability VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'exclusive',

    rules JSONB NOT NULL,
    benefits JSONB NOT NULL,

    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,

    total_redemption_limit INTEGER,
    per_user_redemption_limit INTEGER,

    budget_limit_minor BIGINT,
    budget_currency CHAR(3),

    current_redemption_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    current_discount_total_minor BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 17.3 Coupon 表

```sql
CREATE TABLE coupons (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    promotion_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES promotions(id),

    coupon_code_normalized VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    display_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',

    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,

    total_redemption_limit INTEGER,
    per_user_redemption_limit INTEGER,

    current_redemption_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    assigned_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

# 十八、Skill 4.8：`vav-promotions-and-coupons`

## 目标

实现可配置、可预测、可审计的优惠引擎。

## 优惠类型

```python
class PromotionType(StrEnum):
    PERCENTAGE = "percentage"
    FIXED_AMOUNT = "fixed_amount"
    FIXED_PRICE = "fixed_price"
    FREE_ITEM = "free_item"
```

本批完整支持：

```text
PERCENTAGE
FIXED_AMOUNT
FIXED_PRICE
```

`FREE_ITEM` 保留 Schema 和拒绝未实现的明确错误，不生成半成品行为。

## 应用模式

```python
class PromotionApplicationMode(StrEnum):
    AUTOMATIC = "automatic"
    COUPON_REQUIRED = "coupon_required"
```

## 叠加策略

```python
class Stackability(StrEnum):
    EXCLUSIVE = "exclusive"
    STACKABLE = "stackable"
    STACKABLE_WITH_AUTOMATIC_ONLY = "stackable_with_automatic_only"
```

## Rules Schema

```json
{
  "eligible_product_ids": [],
  "eligible_sku_ids": [],
  "eligible_category_ids": [],
  "excluded_product_ids": [],
  "allowed_currencies": ["TWD"],
  "minimum_subtotal_minor": 1000,
  "first_purchase_only": true,
  "customer_segments": ["new_member"],
  "minimum_quantity": 1
}
```

## Benefits Schema

百分比优惠：

```json
{
  "percentage_basis_points": 1000,
  "maximum_discount_minor": 500
}
```

固定金额优惠：

```json
{
  "amounts": {
    "TWD": 100,
    "USD": 300,
    "CNY": 2000
  }
}
```

固定价：

```json
{
  "fixed_prices": {
    "TWD": 999,
    "USD": 3200
  }
}
```

## 优惠应用顺序

```text
1. 验证自动优惠
2. 验证优惠码
3. 排除不符合条件的优惠
4. 按 priority 排序
5. 应用 exclusive 规则
6. 应用 stackability 规则
7. 百分比折扣
8. 固定金额折扣
9. 固定价格覆盖
10. 保证 total >= 0
```

具体顺序必须被写入版本化算法，不得依赖数据库返回顺序。

## 优惠结果

```json
{
  "promotion_id": "uuid",
  "promotion_code": "WELCOME10",
  "discount_type": "percentage",
  "discount_amount_minor": 120,
  "description": "10% first purchase discount"
}
```

## 优惠码安全

```text
规范化大小写
去除首尾空格
限制尝试次数
不可通过错误信息枚举所有优惠码
用户绑定优惠码不能被其他用户使用
失效优惠码不能参与报价
```

## 优惠管理 API

```http
GET    /api/v1/admin/catalog/promotions
POST   /api/v1/admin/catalog/promotions
GET    /api/v1/admin/catalog/promotions/{id}
PATCH  /api/v1/admin/catalog/promotions/{id}
POST   /api/v1/admin/catalog/promotions/{id}/activate
POST   /api/v1/admin/catalog/promotions/{id}/deactivate

GET    /api/v1/admin/catalog/coupons
POST   /api/v1/admin/catalog/coupons
POST   /api/v1/admin/catalog/coupons/bulk-create
PATCH  /api/v1/admin/catalog/coupons/{id}
POST   /api/v1/admin/catalog/coupons/{id}/disable
```

## 优惠验证 API

```http
POST /api/v1/public/catalog/coupons/validate
```

不得单独返回优惠码是否存在的详细内部状态。建议由报价 API 统一验证。

# 十九、优惠兑换的并发控制

优惠码验证不等于最终兑换。

流程：

```text
报价时
→ 暂时判断资格
→ 不增加正式兑换次数

订单创建时
→ Batch 5 创建 coupon_redemption reservation

支付成功时
→ 正式确认兑换

支付失败或订单取消
→ 释放兑换预留
```

## 兑换预留表

```sql
CREATE TABLE coupon_redemption_reservations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    coupon_id UUID REFERENCES coupons(id),
    promotion_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES promotions(id),

    user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    pricing_quote_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES pricing_quotes(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    reserved_discount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    currency_code CHAR(3) NOT NULL,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    released_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

Batch 4 实现模型和内部服务；Batch 5 在订单事务中调用。

# 二十四、缓存设计

## 公共目录缓存

```text

catalog:products:{locale}:{currency}:{filters_hash}:{version}
catalog:product:{locale}:{currency}:{slug}:{version}
catalog:availability:{sku_id}:{inventory_version}
catalog:price:{sku_id}:{currency}:{context_hash}:{pricing_version}
```

## 缓存失效

```text
商品发布或下架
→ 清理商品详情
→ 清理商品列表
→ 清理分类列表

价格启用或过期
→ 清理价格缓存
→ 清理对应商品详情

库存变化
→ 清理 availability 缓存

优惠变化
→ 增加 promotion_rules_version
→ 旧报价缓存自然失效
```

Pricing Quote 本身不得仅依赖缓存，最终生成时必须以数据库有效配置为准。

# 二十六、必须通过的金额测试

## 基本金额

```text
1999 × 2 = 3998
不得得到 3997 或 3999
```

## 百分比折扣

```text
小计：1999
折扣：15% = 1500 basis points
原始折扣：299.85 minor units
根据统一规则舍入为 300
总价：1699
```

## 固定金额不能产生负数

```text
小计：500
优惠：800
实际优惠：500
总价：0
```

## TWD 零小数

```text
TWD 1,200
amount_minor = 1200
不能保存为 120000
```

## 不同币种不能直接运算

```python
Money(1000, "USD") + Money(1000, "TWD")
```

必须抛出：

```text
CURRENCY_MISMATCH
```

---

# 二十七、库存并发验收

## 最后一个名额

初始：

```text
available = 1
```

两个并发请求各预留 1：

```text
请求 A：成功
请求 B：失败 INVENTORY_NOT_AVAILABLE
```

最终：

```text
reserved_quantity = 1
available = 0
```

不得出现：

```text
reserved_quantity = 2
available = -1
```

## 预留过期

```text
创建预留
→ reserved_quantity +1
→ 到期任务运行
→ 状态 EXPIRED
→ reserved_quantity -1
→ 库存流水完整
```

## 重复确认

```text
第一次确认：成功
第二次确认：幂等返回成功
sold_quantity 只增加一次
```

# 三十四、Batch 4 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-04/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-04-catalog-pricing-inventory-promotions
description: Implement the unified VAV product catalog, SKU model, multi-currency pricing, capacity control, inventory reservations, promotion engine and administration product center.
---

# Goal

Build a complete catalog and pricing foundation containing:

- unified products for activities, courses, counseling, AI coaching and memberships;
- sellable SKUs;
- structured fulfillment definitions;
- product categories;
- multilingual product descriptions;
- price books;
- explicit CNY, USD, TWD and HKD prices;
- immutable versioned prices;
- one-time and recurring price definitions;
- deterministic pricing quotes;
- finite inventory;
- service capacity;
- inventory reservations;
- oversell prevention;
- promotion rules;
- coupon codes;
- user-web service catalog;
- admin-web product center;
- audit events;
- concurrency tests;
- security and E2E acceptance tests.

# Source requirements

The project plan requires a unified product, price, order and payment model
covering:

- activity registration;
- individual courses and course packages;
- counseling sessions and packages;
- AI coaching credit packages or subscriptions;
- monthly, quarterly and annual memberships;
- CNY, USD, TWD and HKD display prices.

This batch implements the catalog, pricing, inventory and promotion layers.
Orders, payment execution, refunds, Webhooks and entitlement activation belong
to Batch 5.

# Prerequisites

Before implementation:

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 with `make verify`.
3. Verify Batch 2 with `make auth-verify`.
4. Verify Batch 3 with `make cms-verify`.
5. Read every skill under `skills/batch-04`.
6. Inspect existing RBAC, audit, outbox, media and localization abstractions.
7. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-04-plan.md`.
8. Record unresolved membership, regional-pricing and tax decisions in the
   decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. Catalog domain model and migrations.
2. Product categories.
3. Products and multilingual product content.
4. SKUs and fulfillment schemas.
5. Supported currencies and Money value objects.
6. Price books and immutable prices.
7. Deterministic pricing engine.
8. Inventory and service capacity.
9. Inventory reservations.
10. Promotions and coupons.
11. Public catalog user interface.
12. Administration product center.
13. Audit, metrics and cache invalidation.
14. Unit, integration, concurrency, security and E2E tests.

# Architecture constraints

- A Product represents a business offering.
- A SKU represents the exact purchasable unit.
- Product display content must not contain billing logic.
- Prices must be immutable after activation.
- Price changes must create new price records.
- Money must use integer minor units.
- Never use floating-point values for prices or discounts.
- Currency exponent must come from currency metadata.
- Different currencies must not be added or compared directly.
- Explicit local-currency prices are preferred over live checkout conversion.
- Exchange-rate data is reference information only.
- Pricing results must be deterministic.
- Price resolution conflicts must fail closed.
- Quotes must store complete calculation snapshots.
- Quotes must not grant access or prove payment.
- Inventory changes must be atomic and auditable.
- Concurrent requests must not oversell finite capacity.
- Refreshing a page must not create duplicate reservations.
- Promotion evaluation must have an explicit stable ordering.
- Discounts must never reduce totals below zero.
- Backend APIs are authoritative for prices, availability and discounts.
- Frontend-supplied totals must never be trusted.

# Product-type constraints

Support these product types:

- `activity_ticket`;
- `course`;
- `course_bundle`;
- `counseling_session`;
- `counseling_package`;
- `ai_credit_package`;
- `ai_subscription`;
- `membership`;
- `digital_service`.

Every product type must have a validated fulfillment configuration.
Do not store arbitrary unvalidated JSON as a service definition.

# Currency constraints

Support:

- `CNY`;
- `USD`;
- `TWD`;
- `HKD`.

Do not assume every currency has two decimal places.
Do not fabricate prices for currencies that are not configured.
When a requested currency is unavailable, return a stable
`PRICE_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_CURRENCY` error and list valid currencies.

# Price invariants

- An active paid SKU must have at least one active price.
- A free SKU must be explicitly marked as free.
- Active price validity windows must not create unresolved conflicts.
- An activated price cannot change amount, currency, billing type or interval.
- Superseding a price must preserve the old price for order history.
- Recurring prices must define interval and interval count.
- One-time prices must not define recurring intervals.

# Inventory invariants

- `UNLIMITED` inventory does not create stock reservations.
- `FINITE` inventory requires capacity.
- `SERVICE_CAPACITY` requires a capacity source.
- Inventory may not become lower than confirmed sales plus active reservations.
- Every manual adjustment requires a reason.
- Every reservation transition must be idempotent.
- Expired reservations must release capacity.
- Confirmed reservations cannot be released through the normal expiry path.

# Promotion invariants

- Promotion rules and benefits must use versioned validated schemas.
- Coupon validation must not expose internal coupon inventory.
- Per-user and global redemption limits must be enforced atomically.
- A quote may evaluate a coupon but must not permanently redeem it.
- Promotion stacking must follow explicit priority and stackability rules.
- Fixed discounts cannot exceed eligible subtotal.
- Promotion results must be included in the quote snapshot.

# Security invariants

- Public APIs may return only active and visible products.
- Draft prices, products and promotions must never appear publicly.
- Frontend totals, discounts, inventory and currencies are untrusted input.
- Only privileged administrators may adjust inventory.
- Only privileged administrators may activate prices or promotions.
- Coupon brute-force attempts must be rate limited.
- Internal price costs, notes and audit data must not appear in public DTOs.
- All publish, price, inventory and promotion changes must be audited.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make catalog-migrate
make catalog-seed
make catalog-test
make catalog-concurrency-test
make catalog-security-test
make catalog-user-e2e
make catalog-admin-e2e
make catalog-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Administrators can create product categories.
2. Administrators can create multilingual products.
3. Products can contain one or more SKUs.
4. Every SKU has a validated fulfillment configuration.
5. CNY, USD, TWD and HKD are supported correctly.
6. Money calculations use integer minor units.
7. Active prices are immutable.
8. New prices can supersede old prices.
9. Pricing resolution is deterministic.
10. Public pricing quotes contain calculation snapshots.
11. Quotes expire correctly.
12. Missing-currency prices fail explicitly.
13. Finite inventory prevents concurrent overselling.
14. Inventory reservations expire and release capacity.
15. Inventory confirmation is idempotent.
16. Manual adjustments require reasons and audit records.
17. Percentage discounts work.
18. Fixed discounts work.
19. Fixed-price promotions work.
20. Promotion stacking rules work.
21. Coupon limits are concurrency safe.
22. Draft products remain private.
23. Public catalog pages work in all configured locales.
24. The user can switch among available currencies.
25. The admin product center can manage products, SKUs and prices.
26. The admin product center can manage inventory and promotions.
27. Pricing simulation does not mutate inventory or coupon state.
28. Catalog security tests pass.
29. Catalog concurrency tests pass.
30. Public-catalog E2E tests pass.
31. Admin-catalog E2E tests pass.
32. `make cms-verify` still succeeds.
33. `make auth-verify` still succeeds.
34. `make verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When a pricing, tax, membership or regional decision is unresolved:

1. record it in `docs/product/decision-register.md`;
2. implement a configurable extension point;
3. use the least-privilege and least-destructive default;
4. do not fabricate a permanent commercial policy;
5. continue implementing unrelated catalog functionality.

When an inventory concurrency test fails:

1. stop catalog feature development;
2. preserve the failing test;
3. identify the missing lock, constraint or idempotency rule;
4. fix the root cause;
5. run the complete inventory and pricing test suites.

When a Money test fails:

1. do not patch the displayed result only;
2. fix the underlying rounding or currency-exponent logic;
3. add regression cases for every supported currency;
4. rerun the complete pricing suite.
```

# 五、核心状态机

## 5.1 购物车状态

```python
class CartStatus(StrEnum):
    ACTIVE = "active"
    CHECKOUT_STARTED = "checkout_started"
    CONVERTED = "converted"
    ABANDONED = "abandoned"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
```

状态：

```text
ACTIVE
  ├── 开始结账 → CHECKOUT_STARTED
  ├── 超时 → EXPIRED
  └── 用户放弃 → ABANDONED

CHECKOUT_STARTED
  ├── 创建订单 → CONVERTED
  └── 结账超时 → ACTIVE / EXPIRED
```

## 5.2 订单状态

```python
class OrderStatus(StrEnum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    PENDING_PAYMENT = "pending_payment"
    PAYMENT_PROCESSING = "payment_processing"
    PAID = "paid"
    FULFILLING = "fulfilling"
    FULFILLED = "fulfilled"
    PARTIALLY_REFUNDED = "partially_refunded"
    REFUNDED = "refunded"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    PAYMENT_FAILED = "payment_failed"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
    MANUAL_REVIEW = "manual_review"
```

核心状态转换：

```text
DRAFT
→ PENDING_PAYMENT
→ PAYMENT_PROCESSING
→ PAID
→ FULFILLING
→ FULFILLED
```

失败分支：

```text
PENDING_PAYMENT
├── 用户取消 → CANCELLED
├── 超时 → EXPIRED
└── 支付失败 → PAYMENT_FAILED
```

退款分支：

```text
PAID / FULFILLED
├── 部分退款 → PARTIALLY_REFUNDED
└── 全额退款 → REFUNDED
```

任何异常状态不得由前端直接修改。

## 5.3 支付状态

```python
class PaymentStatus(StrEnum):
    CREATED = "created"
    REQUIRES_ACTION = "requires_action"
    PROCESSING = "processing"
    SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
    FAILED = "failed"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    PARTIALLY_REFUNDED = "partially_refunded"
    REFUNDED = "refunded"
    DISPUTED = "disputed"
```

## 5.4 订阅状态

```python
class SubscriptionStatus(StrEnum):
    INCOMPLETE = "incomplete"
    TRIALING = "trialing"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    PAST_DUE = "past_due"
    PAUSED = "paused"
    CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END = "cancel_at_period_end"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
```

## 5.5 权益状态

```python
class EntitlementStatus(StrEnum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    SUSPENDED = "suspended"
    EXHAUSTED = "exhausted"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
    REVOKED = "revoked"
```
