# 六、Skill 5.1：`vav-cart-and-checkout`

## 目标

实现服务端购物车、报价重新校验和结账会话。

## 购物车表

```sql
CREATE TABLE carts (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    anonymous_session_id UUID,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    currency_code CHAR(3) NOT NULL,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    converted_order_id UUID,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 购物车项

```sql
CREATE TABLE cart_items (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    cart_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES carts(id),

    sku_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES product_skus(id),
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,

    coupon_code VARCHAR(128),

    last_quote_id UUID REFERENCES pricing_quotes(id),
    added_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(cart_id, sku_id)
);
```

## API

```http
GET    /api/v1/cart
POST   /api/v1/cart/items
PATCH  /api/v1/cart/items/{item_id}
DELETE /api/v1/cart/items/{item_id}
DELETE /api/v1/cart

POST   /api/v1/checkout/preview
POST   /api/v1/checkout/orders
```

## 结账原则

创建订单前必须重新校验：

```text
商品仍然可售
SKU 仍然有效
价格仍然有效
报价没有过期
库存仍然可预留
优惠仍然有效
购买数量没有超过限制
用户满足购买资格
币种仍被支付渠道支持
```

前端传入的金额仅用于比对，后端必须重新计算。

## Checkout Preview

响应：

```json
{
  "data": {
    "currency": "TWD",
    "items": [],
    "subtotal_minor": 3200,
    "discount_total_minor": 200,
    "tax_estimate_minor": null,
    "total_minor": 3000,
    "quote_expires_at": "2026-07-31T03:30:00Z",
    "available_payment_providers": [
      "stripe",
      "paypal"
    ]
  }
}
```

# 七、Skill 5.2：`vav-order-domain-and-state-machine`

## 目标

实现不可篡改的订单、订单项快照和状态机。

## 订单表

```sql
CREATE TABLE orders (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    order_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    currency_code CHAR(3) NOT NULL,

    subtotal_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    discount_total_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    tax_total_minor BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    total_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    refunded_total_minor BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    pricing_quote_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES pricing_quotes(id),

    billing_email CITEXT NOT NULL,
    billing_name VARCHAR(200),

    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    region_code VARCHAR(64),

    placed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    fulfilled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    expired_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 订单项快照

```sql
CREATE TABLE order_items (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id),

    product_id UUID NOT NULL,
    sku_id UUID NOT NULL,
    price_id UUID NOT NULL,

    product_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    sku_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    product_name_snapshot VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    sku_name_snapshot VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,

    product_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    fulfillment_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    subtotal_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    discount_total_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    total_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,

    fulfillment_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
    promotion_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 订单不可变字段

订单进入 `PENDING_PAYMENT` 后，不允许修改：

```text
用户
币种
SKU
数量
单价
优惠结果
总金额
交付定义
```

用户想更改商品时，应取消旧订单并创建新订单。

## 订单日志

```sql
CREATE TABLE order_status_history (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id),

    from_status VARCHAR(32),
    to_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    reason_code VARCHAR(128),
    reason TEXT,

    actor_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    actor_user_id UUID,

    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

计划书要求订单日志、退款和服务开通记录可审计。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

# 八、订单创建事务

订单创建必须在一个业务事务中完成：

```text
1. 锁定并消费 Pricing Quote
2. 创建订单和订单项快照
3. 创建库存预留
4. 创建优惠兑换预留
5. 创建支付尝试占位
6. 写订单状态历史
7. 写 Outbox Event
8. 提交事务
```

失败时必须全部回滚。

## 幂等键

```http
Idempotency-Key: 91ab...
```

相同：

```text
用户
操作
Idempotency-Key
请求 Body Hash
```

必须返回相同订单。

相同 Key 但不同 Body：

```text
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_REQUEST
```

# 九、Skill 5.3：`vav-payment-provider-abstraction`

## 目标

建立 Stripe 和 PayPal 之外可扩展的统一支付边界。

## Provider Interface

```python
class PaymentProvider(Protocol):
    async def create_payment(
        self,
        request: CreateProviderPaymentRequest,
    ) -> ProviderPaymentResult:
        ...

    async def get_payment(
        self,
        provider_payment_id: str,
    ) -> ProviderPaymentState:
        ...

    async def cancel_payment(
        self,
        provider_payment_id: str,
    ) -> ProviderOperationResult:
        ...

    async def create_refund(
        self,
        request: ProviderRefundRequest,
    ) -> ProviderRefundResult:
        ...

    async def verify_webhook(
        self,
        headers: Mapping[str, str],
        raw_body: bytes,
    ) -> VerifiedWebhookEvent:
        ...
```

## 支付尝试表

```sql
CREATE TABLE payment_attempts (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id),

    provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    provider_environment VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    provider_payment_id VARCHAR(255),
    provider_customer_id VARCHAR(255),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    currency_code CHAR(3) NOT NULL,

    client_action JSONB,
    failure_code VARCHAR(128),
    failure_message_safe VARCHAR(500),

    idempotency_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(provider, idempotency_key)
);
```

## Provider-neutral Client Action

```json
{
  "type": "redirect",
  "url": "https://provider.example/checkout/..."
}
```

或：

```json
{
  "type": "client_secret",
  "client_secret": "provider-limited-client-secret"
}
```

后端不得把正式 API Secret 返回前端。

# 十、Skill 5.4：`vav-stripe-payments`

## 目标

实现 Stripe 一次性付款与订阅适配器。

## 一次性支付

推荐映射：

```text
VAV Order
→ Stripe Payment/Checkout 对象
→ Stripe 支付事件
→ VAV PaymentAttempt
→ VAV Order PAID
```

创建时传入可追踪 Metadata：

```json
{
  "vav_order_id": "uuid",
  "vav_order_number": "VAV-20260731-000001",
  "vav_user_id": "uuid",
  "environment": "test"
}
```

Metadata 不得包含：

```text
辅导内容
婚恋档案
AI 对话
敏感联系方式
密码或 Token
```

## Stripe Customer Mapping

```sql
CREATE TABLE payment_customers (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    provider_customer_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(user_id, provider),
    UNIQUE(provider, provider_customer_id)
);
```

## 安全要求

```text
信用卡资料不进入 VAV 数据库
服务端创建支付对象
Webhook 决定最终状态
测试环境和正式环境完全分离
Provider ID 不能跨环境复用
所有创建操作使用幂等键
```

信用卡资料由 Stripe/PayPal 托管，不应进入 VAV 数据库。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

# 十一、Skill 5.5：`vav-paypal-payments`

## 目标

实现 PayPal 一次性支付与订阅适配器。

## 一次性流程

```text
创建 VAV Order
→ 创建 PayPal Order
→ 返回 Approval URL
→ 用户跳转 PayPal
→ 用户批准
→ 服务端捕获或由 Provider 流程完成
→ Webhook 确认
→ 更新 PaymentAttempt
→ 更新 VAV Order
```

## PayPal 映射字段

```text
custom_id        → VAV order_id
invoice_id       → VAV order_number
currency_code    → VAV order currency
value            → VAV total
```

捕获前必须验证：

```text
Provider Order ID
订单归属
币种
金额
当前订单状态
是否已经捕获
```

## 支付成功页面

```text
用户从 PayPal 返回
→ 前端显示“正在确认支付”
→ 查询 VAV 后端订单状态
→ 不自行显示“已付款”
```

# 十二、Skill 5.6：`vav-payment-webhooks`

## 目标

实现 Webhook 验签、去重、顺序容错和重放。

## Webhook 路由

```http
POST /api/v1/webhooks/stripe
POST /api/v1/webhooks/paypal
```

必须使用原始 Body 验签，不能先将 Body 解析后再重建。

## Webhook 事件表

```sql
CREATE TABLE payment_webhook_events (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    provider_event_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    event_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    signature_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

    payload JSONB NOT NULL,
    payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    processing_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    received_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    processing_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    last_error_code VARCHAR(128),
    last_error_safe TEXT,

    UNIQUE(provider, provider_event_id)
);
```

## 处理状态

```python
class WebhookProcessingStatus(StrEnum):
    RECEIVED = "received"
    PROCESSING = "processing"
    PROCESSED = "processed"
    IGNORED = "ignored"
    RETRY_PENDING = "retry_pending"
    FAILED = "failed"
```

## 处理步骤

```text
1. 读取原始请求体
2. 校验 Provider 签名
3. 提取 Provider Event ID
4. 插入事件记录
5. 如果重复则返回 2xx
6. 放入异步队列
7. Worker 查询 Provider 或解析事件
8. 锁定 PaymentAttempt/Order
9. 校验金额、币种和归属
10. 执行幂等状态转换
11. 写审计和 Outbox
12. 标记事件已处理
```

## 无序事件处理

不能假设：

```text
payment_created
一定早于
payment_succeeded
```

处理者必须根据当前数据库状态和 Provider 当前状态决定是否合法。

## Webhook 成功响应

验签和持久化完成后尽快返回：

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

业务开通可异步进行，避免 Provider 超时重试。

## Webhook 重放

管理端：

```http
POST /api/v1/admin/payments/webhook-events/{id}/replay
```

重放必须：

```text
使用已保存的已验签事件
再次执行幂等处理
记录 replay actor 和原因
不能跳过金额与订单校验
```

---

# 十三、支付成功事务

接收到支付成功事件后：

```text
开始事务
→ 锁定 PaymentAttempt
→ 锁定 Order
→ 验证金额和币种
→ PaymentAttempt → SUCCEEDED
→ Order → PAID
→ 确认库存预留
→ 确认优惠兑换预留
→ 创建 Entitlement Activation Jobs
→ 写订单历史
→ 写支付审计
→ 写 Outbox
→ 提交
```

权益实际开通可以由 Worker 完成，但支付确认、库存确认和开通任务创建必须具有原子一致性。

# 十四、Skill 5.7：`vav-subscription-billing`

## 目标

实现会员和 AI 辅导周期订阅。

## 订阅表

```sql
CREATE TABLE subscriptions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    sku_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES product_skus(id),

    provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    provider_subscription_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    currency_code CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
    recurring_amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,

    billing_interval VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    billing_interval_count INTEGER NOT NULL,

    current_period_start TIMESTAMPTZ,
    current_period_end TIMESTAMPTZ,

    cancel_at_period_end BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ended_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    latest_order_id UUID REFERENCES orders(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(provider, provider_subscription_id)
);
```

## 订阅周期订单

每个账单周期应生成独立订单或账单记录：

```text
Subscription
├── Initial Order
├── Renewal Order 1
├── Renewal Order 2
└── Renewal Order N
```

这样可以正确记录：

```text
每期币种
每期金额
优惠
支付状态
退款
权益周期
```

## 订阅事件

```text
subscription.created
subscription.activated
subscription.renewal.payment_succeeded
subscription.renewal.payment_failed
subscription.past_due
subscription.cancel_scheduled
subscription.cancelled
subscription.expired
```

## 取消策略

用户可以选择：

```text
立即取消
周期结束时取消
```

是否开放立即取消及其退款规则属于业务政策，必须配置化：

```dotenv
SUBSCRIPTION_IMMEDIATE_CANCELLATION_ENABLED=false
SUBSCRIPTION_CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END_DEFAULT=true
```

## 支付失败

```text
续费失败
→ Subscription PAST_DUE
→ 权益按宽限期策略处理
→ 发送通知
→ Provider 重试
→ 成功后恢复 ACTIVE
→ 最终失败后 CANCELLED/EXPIRED
```

宽限期配置：

```dotenv
SUBSCRIPTION_GRACE_PERIOD_DAYS=3
```

# 十五、Skill 5.8：`vav-refunds-and-cancellations`

## 目标

实现订单取消、部分退款、全额退款和退款审计。

## 退款表

```sql
CREATE TABLE refunds (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    refund_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id),
    payment_attempt_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES payment_attempts(id),

    provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    provider_refund_id VARCHAR(255),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,
    currency_code CHAR(3) NOT NULL,

    reason_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,

    requested_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    provider_submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    succeeded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    failed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 退款状态

```python
class RefundStatus(StrEnum):
    REQUESTED = "requested"
    APPROVAL_REQUIRED = "approval_required"
    APPROVED = "approved"
    SUBMITTED = "submitted"
    PROCESSING = "processing"
    SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
    FAILED = "failed"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
```

## 退款规则

```text
退款总额不得超过已支付金额
同一支付允许多次部分退款
成功退款后累计 refunded_total_minor
全额退款后订单变为 REFUNDED
部分退款后订单变为 PARTIALLY_REFUNDED
Provider 退款结果仍通过 Webhook 或主动查询确认
退款不能只修改数据库而不调用 Provider
```

## 权益处理

退款成功后根据商品类型和退款策略：

```text
未使用权益
→ 全部撤销

部分使用的次数包
→ 根据政策按比例或人工审核

已参加活动
→ 进入人工审核

已观看课程
→ 根据退款政策决定是否撤销

订阅退款
→ 结合周期和取消状态处理
```

退款政策必须版本化保存：

```sql
CREATE TABLE refund_policy_snapshots (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    order_item_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES order_items(id),
    policy_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    policy_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    policy_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

计划书要求正式上线前审阅适用地区的消费者保护、订阅和退款规则，因此代码必须支持政策版本，而不是硬编码单一规则。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

---

# 十六、Skill 5.9：`vav-entitlement-activation`

## 目标

建立统一权益模型，将订单与具体服务解耦。

## 权益表

```sql
CREATE TABLE entitlements (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id),
    order_item_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES order_items(id),

    entitlement_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    resource_type VARCHAR(64),
    resource_id UUID,

    quantity_granted INTEGER,
    quantity_consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    configuration_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

    activated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    suspended_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    revoke_reason VARCHAR(128),

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 权益类型

```python
class EntitlementType(StrEnum):
    ACTIVITY_ADMISSION = "activity_admission"
    COURSE_ACCESS = "course_access"
    COUNSELING_CREDITS = "counseling_credits"
    AI_CREDITS = "ai_credits"
    AI_SUBSCRIPTION = "ai_subscription"
    MEMBERSHIP = "membership"
```

## 权益开通映射

```text
EVENT_ADMISSION
→ ACTIVITY_ADMISSION

DIGITAL_ACCESS
→ COURSE_ACCESS

APPOINTMENT_CREDITS
→ COUNSELING_CREDITS

AI_CREDITS
→ AI_CREDITS

MEMBERSHIP_ENTITLEMENT
→ MEMBERSHIP
```

## 激活任务表

```sql
CREATE TABLE entitlement_activation_jobs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    order_item_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES order_items(id),
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    last_error_code VARCHAR(128),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(order_item_id)
);
```

## 幂等激活

相同 `order_item_id` 只能产生一组确定权益。

重复 Webhook、Worker 重试或人工重放不能重复增加：

```text
课程权限
会员有效期
辅导次数
AI 次数
活动名额
```

## 权益消费

本批提供基础内部接口：

```http
POST /api/v1/internal/entitlements/{id}/consume
POST /api/v1/internal/entitlements/{id}/release-consumption
POST /api/v1/internal/entitlements/{id}/suspend
POST /api/v1/internal/entitlements/{id}/revoke
```

消费必须使用：

```text
幂等键
乐观锁
数量上限
有效期校验
状态校验
```

---

# 十七、权益开通失败策略

支付成功但权益暂时开通失败时：

```text
Order 保持 PAID 或 FULFILLING
Payment 不回退
Entitlement Job 标记 RETRY_PENDING
系统自动重试
运营后台显示异常
成功后 Order → FULFILLED
超过重试阈值 → MANUAL_REVIEW
```

不能因为下游课程、活动或 AI 模块短暂故障而把已成功支付标记为失败。

这符合计划书要求 AI 服务与核心业务解耦，AI 故障不能影响登录、付款和其他基本服务。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

# 十八、Skill 5.10：`vav-reconciliation-and-ledger`

## 目标

建立内部支付流水账、Provider 对账和异常检测。

## 内部支付账本

```sql
CREATE TABLE payment_ledger_entries (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    entry_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    order_id UUID REFERENCES orders(id),
    payment_attempt_id UUID REFERENCES payment_attempts(id),
    refund_id UUID REFERENCES refunds(id),
    subscription_id UUID REFERENCES subscriptions(id),

    provider VARCHAR(32),
    provider_reference VARCHAR(255),

    currency_code CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
    amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL,

    effective_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 账本类型

```text
payment_authorized
payment_succeeded
payment_failed
refund_submitted
refund_succeeded
refund_failed
dispute_opened
dispute_won
dispute_lost
provider_fee_recorded
provider_payout_recorded
```

## 对账任务

Celery Beat：

```text
reconcile_recent_payments
reconcile_provider_settlements
detect_stale_payment_attempts
detect_paid_orders_without_entitlements
detect_entitlements_without_paid_orders
```

## 对账差异表

```sql
CREATE TABLE reconciliation_discrepancies (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    discrepancy_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    provider VARCHAR(32),
    internal_reference_type VARCHAR(64),
    internal_reference_id UUID,
    provider_reference VARCHAR(255),

    expected_snapshot JSONB,
    actual_snapshot JSONB,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
    assigned_to UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    resolution_reason TEXT
);
```

## 必查差异

```text
Provider 成功但内部订单未支付
内部订单支付但 Provider 不存在
金额不一致
币种不一致
重复支付
重复退款
退款金额超限
已支付订单没有权益
未支付订单已有权益
订阅状态不一致
Webhook 长时间未处理
```

# 二十三、安全与幂等不变量

支付风险在计划书中被明确列为高风险项，控制措施包括 Webhook、幂等、测试环境、最小权限和密钥管理。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

本批必须满足：

```text
前端永远不能决定订单已付款
Webhook 必须验签
Webhook 必须去重
金额和币种必须再次校验
支付创建必须幂等
订单创建必须幂等
退款创建必须幂等
权益开通必须幂等
库存确认必须幂等
优惠确认必须幂等
测试与正式 Provider ID 分离
正式密钥不进入代码、日志和数据库普通字段
```

## Provider Secret

使用：

```text
环境变量
Docker Secret
云密钥管理服务
```

不得保存到：

```text
Git
数据库 Site Settings
前端环境变量
日志
错误追踪上下文
```

# 二十七、必须通过的订单场景

```text
用户从有效报价创建订单
过期报价不能创建订单
报价不能被不同用户使用
相同幂等键重复创建返回同一订单
相同幂等键不同请求被拒绝
订单金额来自服务端
订单项保存商品、SKU、价格和优惠快照
有限库存订单创建时预留库存
订单过期后释放库存和优惠预留
已付款订单不能取消为未付款取消
订单状态非法跳转被拒绝
```

---

# 二十八、必须通过的 Webhook 场景

```text
合法签名事件被处理
非法签名被拒绝
重复事件不重复开通权益
乱序事件不会破坏订单状态
未知订单事件进入人工审核
金额不一致不标记已付款
币种不一致不标记已付款
Provider 成功后订单变为 PAID
库存只确认一次
优惠只确认一次
权益只开通一次
Webhook 重放仍保持幂等
```

---

# 二十九、必须通过的支付场景

```text
Stripe 测试支付成功
Stripe 测试支付失败
Stripe 需要额外操作
PayPal 创建和批准支付
PayPal 用户取消支付
支付页面返回但 Webhook 未到时显示处理中
Provider 返回页不能直接修改订单
重复支付创建不会产生重复 PaymentAttempt
不同订单不能共享同一 Provider Payment ID
```

---

# 三十、必须通过的订阅场景

```text
创建月度订阅
创建年度订阅
首次付款成功后开通权益
续费成功后延长权益
续费失败后进入 PAST_DUE
宽限期内权益按策略保持或暂停
恢复付款后权益恢复
周期结束取消
立即取消按配置限制
重复订阅事件不重复延长有效期
```

---

# 三十一、必须通过的退款场景

```text
未付款订单不能退款
退款金额不能超过可退余额
部分退款正确累计
全额退款改变订单状态
重复退款请求保持幂等
Provider 退款失败不修改为成功
退款成功后按政策撤销权益
已消费权益进入人工审核
退款申请、审批和提交权限分离
所有退款操作具有原因和审计
```

---

# 三十二、必须通过的对账场景

```text
Provider 成功而内部未支付被发现
内部支付而 Provider 不存在被发现
金额差异被发现
币种差异被发现
重复退款被发现
付款成功但未开通权益被发现
未付款订单存在权益被发现
Webhook 处理停滞被发现
对账差异只能由授权人员关闭
关闭时必须填写解决原因
```

- unified service entitlements;
- user commerce pages;
- administration order, payment, refund and reconciliation pages;
- automated unit, integration, concurrency, security and E2E tests.

# Source requirements

The project plan requires all paid services to share unified product, price,
order and payment capabilities.

The platform must:

- support activity, course, counseling, AI and membership purchases;
- display and retain multiple currencies;
- keep card data outside the VAV database;
- confirm payment through Webhooks;
- audit refunds, cancellations, order logs and service activation;
- ensure users receive the correct access after payment.

# Prerequisites

Before implementation:

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 with `make verify`.
3. Verify Batch 2 with `make auth-verify`.
4. Verify Batch 3 with `make cms-verify`.
5. Verify Batch 4 with `make catalog-verify`.
6. Read every skill under `skills/batch-05`.
7. Inspect the existing pricing, inventory, promotion, outbox and audit systems.
8. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-05-plan.md`.
9. Record unresolved refund, tax, subscription and legal-entity decisions in
   the product decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. Cart domain and APIs.
2. Checkout preview and server-side price validation.
3. Order domain and state machine.
4. Atomic order creation with reservations.
5. Payment-provider abstraction.
6. Stripe adapter.
7. PayPal adapter.
8. Webhook verification, persistence and processing.
9. Payment-success transaction.
10. Subscription lifecycle.
11. Refund and cancellation workflows.
12. Entitlement activation.
13. Reconciliation and payment ledger.
14. User-web commerce pages.
15. Admin-web commerce pages.
16. Unit, integration, webhook, concurrency, security and E2E tests.

# Architecture constraints

- The backend is authoritative for all amounts.
- Never trust totals supplied by the frontend.
- Order items must contain immutable product, SKU, price, promotion and
  fulfillment snapshots.
- Orders must use explicit state machines.
- Invalid state transitions must fail.
- Order creation must be idempotent.
- Provider payment creation must be idempotent.
- Refund creation must be idempotent.
- Entitlement activation must be idempotent.
- Inventory and coupon confirmation must be idempotent.
- Payment success pages do not prove payment.
- Only verified Provider Webhooks or verified Provider-state reconciliation
  may confirm payment.
- Card and wallet credentials must never enter the VAV database.
- Payment-provider adapters must not leak Provider-specific state into core
  order logic.
- Test and production environments must remain isolated.
- AI availability must not affect payment confirmation.
- A paid order may remain `FULFILLING` while entitlement activation retries.
- Do not roll back a successful payment because a downstream service is
  temporarily unavailable.

# Order invariants

- An order must reference a non-expired pricing quote.
- The quote must belong to the current user or anonymous checkout session.
- An order currency must match the selected price and payment attempt.
- The order total must equal the sum of order-item snapshots.
- The same pricing quote may not create multiple active orders.
- Paid orders cannot be changed back to draft or pending payment.
- Refunded totals cannot exceed paid totals.
- Order state changes must create history records and audit events.

# Webhook invariants

- Verify signatures using the raw HTTP body.
- Persist verified events before asynchronous processing.
- Deduplicate events by Provider event ID.
- Duplicate events must return success without duplicate side effects.
- Webhook processing must tolerate out-of-order delivery.
- Verify Provider amount, currency and order ownership.
- Unknown or conflicting events must fail closed and enter manual review.
- Replaying an event must preserve all normal validations.
- Raw secrets and sensitive payment details must not be logged.

# Subscription invariants

- Every billing period must have an auditable order or billing record.
- Renewal success may extend entitlements only once.
- Renewal failure must not be represented as a successful order.
- Cancellation behavior must be configurable.
- Provider status and internal subscription status must be reconciled.
- Past-due and grace-period rules must be explicit and tested.

# Refund invariants

- Refund totals cannot exceed the paid and unrefunded amount.
- Provider confirmation is required for successful refund status.
- A database-only refund is forbidden.
- Refund approval and refund submission permissions must be separable.
- Refund policy versions must be snapshotted on order items.
- Entitlement revocation must follow the snapshotted policy.
- Consumed or exceptional services must support manual review.

# Entitlement invariants

- Each paid order item maps to deterministic entitlement records.
- The same order item cannot create duplicate credits or access periods.
- Entitlements must preserve the original order-item configuration.
- Entitlement activation failures must retry without changing payment status.
- Entitlement consumption must use idempotency and optimistic locking.
- Refunds, disputes and subscription expiry may suspend or revoke
  entitlements only through explicit policies.

# Security invariants

- Provider secrets must use environment variables or secret managers.
- Provider secrets must never be exposed to the frontend.
- Public users may read only their own orders, subscriptions and entitlements.
- Administrative payment and refund actions require RBAC.
- High-risk actions require an explicit reason.
- Webhook payloads shown in the admin interface must be redacted.
- Payment metadata must not contain counseling, dating-profile or AI
  conversation content.
- All payment, refund and entitlement operations must be audited.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make commerce-migrate
make commerce-seed
make commerce-test
make commerce-webhook-test
make commerce-concurrency-test
make commerce-security-test
make commerce-user-e2e
make commerce-admin-e2e
make commerce-reconcile
make commerce-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Users can add products to a server-side cart.
2. Checkout recalculates prices on the backend.
3. Orders preserve immutable snapshots.
4. Order creation is idempotent.
5. Inventory and coupon reservations are created atomically.
6. Stripe test payments work.
7. PayPal sandbox payments work.
8. Webhook signatures are verified.
9. Duplicate Webhooks produce no duplicate side effects.
10. Out-of-order Webhooks are handled safely.
11. Frontend return URLs cannot mark an order paid.
12. Payment-success processing validates amount and currency.
13. Paid orders confirm inventory exactly once.
14. Paid orders confirm promotion use exactly once.
15. Paid order items create entitlements exactly once.
16. Subscription creation and renewal work.
17. Subscription payment failure enters a non-active billing state.
18. Subscription cancellation works according to configuration.
19. Partial refunds work.
20. Full refunds work.
21. Refund totals cannot exceed payment totals.
22. Refund success updates entitlement state according to policy.
23. Reconciliation detects payment and entitlement mismatches.
24. Users can view their orders, subscriptions and entitlements.
25. Administrators can inspect orders and payment attempts.
26. Authorized staff can request and approve refunds.
27. Authorized staff can replay failed Webhook events.
28. All high-risk actions produce immutable audit records.
29. Commerce security tests pass.
30. Commerce concurrency tests pass.
31. User commerce E2E tests pass.
32. Admin commerce E2E tests pass.
33. `make catalog-verify` still succeeds.
34. `make cms-verify` still succeeds.
35. `make auth-verify` still succeeds.
36. `make verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When payment-provider configuration is unavailable:

1. keep the Provider adapter disabled;
2. use an explicit test fake only in local and automated-test environments;
3. never represent fake payments as production transactions;
4. continue implementing Provider-independent order and entitlement logic.

When a Webhook security test fails:

1. stop payment feature development;
2. preserve the failing event fixture;
3. fix signature, deduplication, ordering or validation logic;
4. add a regression test;
5. rerun all Webhook and payment suites.

When a reconciliation discrepancy is discovered:

1. do not silently overwrite internal or Provider data;
2. record the discrepancy;
3. route it to manual review or an explicit repair command;
4. audit the resolution;
5. preserve both original states.
```

# 三、关键架构原则

## 3.1 活动不是商品副本

```text
Activity
负责活动业务、时间、场地、报名要求和参与流程。

Product
负责销售展示和商品分类。

SKU
负责具体可购买票种。

Price
负责金额和币种。

Inventory
负责名额和预留。

Order/Payment
负责付款。

Entitlement
证明用户拥有参加资格。
```

正确关联：

```text
Activity
  └── Activity Ticket Type
          └── Catalog SKU
                  ├── Price
                  ├── Inventory
                  └── Order Item
                          └── Activity Admission Entitlement
```

禁止在活动表中再保存一套独立价格、折扣和已售库存。

## 3.2 支付返回页不确认报名

```text
用户完成支付并返回
→ 页面显示正在确认
→ 等待 Batch 5 Webhook 确认订单
→ 激活 ACTIVITY_ADMISSION 权益
→ 活动模块确认报名
```

计划书明确要求支付状态由 Webhook 确认，不能以用户返回成功页面作为唯一凭据。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

## 3.3 单向活动选择严格保密

```text
A 选择 B，B 未选择 A
→ A 不知道 B 是否选择自己
→ B 不收到“A 已选择你”的通知
→ 管理员除安全调查外不应随意查看单向关系

A 选择 B，B 也选择 A
→ 生成 Mutual Choice
→ 后续按联系方式交换政策进入认识邀请
```

联系方式是互选后直接开放还是双方再次确认，计划书仍列为待确认产品决策，因此本批不得自动公开联系方式。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

# 六、活动领域状态机

## 6.1 活动状态

```python
class ActivityStatus(StrEnum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    IN_REVIEW = "in_review"
    SCHEDULED = "scheduled"
    PUBLISHED = "published"
    REGISTRATION_OPEN = "registration_open"
    REGISTRATION_CLOSED = "registration_closed"
    IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    ARCHIVED = "archived"
```

典型流程：

```text
DRAFT
→ IN_REVIEW
→ SCHEDULED/PUBLISHED
→ REGISTRATION_OPEN
→ REGISTRATION_CLOSED
→ IN_PROGRESS
→ COMPLETED
→ ARCHIVED
```

取消分支：

```text
DRAFT/PUBLISHED/REGISTRATION_OPEN/REGISTRATION_CLOSED
→ CANCELLED
```

活动开始后取消必须走专门的运营事故流程，不能直接普通取消。

## 6.2 报名状态

```python
class RegistrationStatus(StrEnum):
    STARTED = "started"
    PENDING_APPROVAL = "pending_approval"
    APPROVED_PENDING_PAYMENT = "approved_pending_payment"
    PENDING_PAYMENT = "pending_payment"
    PAYMENT_PROCESSING = "payment_processing"
    CONFIRMED = "confirmed"
    WAITLISTED = "waitlisted"
    REJECTED = "rejected"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
```

签到和到场状态独立保存，不能把 `CHECKED_IN` 混入报名审批状态。

## 6.3 到场状态

```python
class AttendanceStatus(StrEnum):
    NOT_CHECKED_IN = "not_checked_in"
    CHECKED_IN = "checked_in"
    CHECKIN_REVOKED = "checkin_revoked"
    NO_SHOW = "no_show"
```

    PROMOTION_OFFERED = "promotion_offered"
    PROMOTED = "promoted"

# 七、Skill 6.1：`vav-activity-domain-model`

## 目标

建立活动、场次、地点、票种映射、报名、候补、签到、分组和活动后互选的数据模型。

## 7.1 活动表

```sql
CREATE TABLE activities (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    activity_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    internal_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

    activity_format VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    visibility VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'public',

    default_locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    timezone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    registration_opens_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    registration_closes_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    post_event_choice_opens_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    post_event_choice_closes_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    approval_policy VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    payment_timing_policy VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    waitlist_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    post_event_choice_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    minimum_age INTEGER,
    maximum_age INTEGER,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    updated_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    archived_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 7.2 活动形式

```python
class ActivityFormat(StrEnum):
    IN_PERSON = "in_person"
    ONLINE = "online"
    HYBRID = "hybrid"
```

## 7.3 活动本地化

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_localizations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),

    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    slug VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

    title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    summary VARCHAR(500),
    description_blocks JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    venue_display_name VARCHAR(300),
    address_display_text VARCHAR(500),

    participation_notes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    cancellation_notice TEXT,

    seo_title VARCHAR(300),
    seo_description VARCHAR(500),

    cover_media_id UUID REFERENCES media_assets(id),
    translation_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(activity_id, locale),
    UNIQUE(locale, slug)
);
```

## 7.4 活动地点

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_locations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),

    location_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    venue_name VARCHAR(300),
    country_code CHAR(2),
    region VARCHAR(128),
    city VARCHAR(128),
    address_line_1 VARCHAR(300),
    address_line_2 VARCHAR(300),
    postal_code VARCHAR(32),

    latitude NUMERIC(10, 7),
    longitude NUMERIC(10, 7),

    online_provider VARCHAR(64),
    online_join_url_encrypted TEXT,
    online_meeting_reference VARCHAR(255),

    public_address_precision VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'city_only',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

线上会议链接不得通过公共活动详情 API 直接返回；仅向已确认且满足开放时间的参与者返回。

## 7.5 活动场次

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_sessions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),

    session_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    location_id UUID REFERENCES activity_locations(id),

    checkin_opens_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    checkin_closes_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(activity_id, session_code)
);
```

## 输出迁移

```text
services/api/migrations/versions/0016_activities.py
services/api/migrations/versions/0017_activity_registrations.py
services/api/migrations/versions/0018_activity_waitlists.py
services/api/migrations/versions/0019_activity_checkins_groups.py
services/api/migrations/versions/0020_activity_choices.py
```

# 八、Skill 6.2：`vav-activity-publishing-schedule`

## 目标

实现活动创建、编辑、审核、发布、报名开放、结束和取消。

## 管理 API

```http
GET    /api/v1/admin/activities
POST   /api/v1/admin/activities
GET    /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}
PATCH  /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}

PUT    /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/localizations/{locale}

POST   /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/submit-review
POST   /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/approve
POST   /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/publish
POST   /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/schedule
POST   /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/open-registration
POST   /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/close-registration
POST   /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/start
POST   /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/complete
POST   /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/cancel
POST   /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/archive
```

## 发布前校验

```text
至少一个 READY 本地化版本
开始和结束时间合法
报名开放时间早于报名截止时间
报名截止时间不晚于活动开始时间
时区有效
线下活动存在地点
线上活动存在安全的会议配置
至少一个可售票种
票种关联有效 Catalog SKU
收费 SKU 存在当前或未来有效价格
有限名额 SKU 存在库存配置
取消和退款政策快照已配置
活动后互选时间晚于活动开始时间
```

## 定时任务

```text
publish_scheduled_activities
open_scheduled_activity_registration
close_scheduled_activity_registration
start_scheduled_activities
complete_ended_activities
```

状态转换必须幂等。

## 活动取消

取消请求：

```json
{
  "reason_code": "venue_unavailable",
  "reason": "The venue became unavailable.",
  "refund_policy_action": "request_refunds",
  "notify_participants": true
}
```

取消后：

```text
阻止新报名
取消未付款报名
释放未确认名额
生成已付款订单处理任务
按政策发起退款或人工审核
撤销未使用活动权益
发出通知事件
记录审计
```

不得在活动事务中直接同步调用所有外部退款，应该生成 Commerce 工作任务。

# 九、Skill 6.3：`vav-ticket-types-catalog-integration`

## 目标

将活动票种与 Batch 4 Catalog SKU、价格和库存建立稳定关联。

## 活动票种表

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_ticket_types (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),

    ticket_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    internal_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

    catalog_product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),
    catalog_sku_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES product_skus(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',

    registration_opens_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    registration_closes_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    approval_policy_override VARCHAR(32),
    payment_timing_override VARCHAR(32),

    waitlist_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    max_quantity_per_user INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    eligibility_rules JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(activity_id, ticket_code),
    UNIQUE(activity_id, catalog_sku_id)
);
```

## 审批政策

```python
class ApprovalPolicy(StrEnum):
    AUTOMATIC = "automatic"
    MANUAL = "manual"
    RULE_ASSISTED = "rule_assisted"
```

`RULE_ASSISTED` 只能生成审核建议，默认不得以不透明算法自动拒绝用户。

## 付款时间政策

```python
class PaymentTimingPolicy(StrEnum):
    BEFORE_APPROVAL = "before_approval"
    AFTER_APPROVAL = "after_approval"
    NOT_REQUIRED = "not_required"
```

建议行为：

```text
免费活动
→ NOT_REQUIRED

自动审核付费活动
→ BEFORE_APPROVAL 可用

人工审核付费活动
→ AFTER_APPROVAL 优先，避免先收费后拒绝
```

最终由活动配置决定，不在代码中永久固定。

## 票种本地化

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_ticket_type_localizations (
    ticket_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_ticket_types(id),
    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description VARCHAR(500),
    eligibility_notice TEXT,

    PRIMARY KEY(ticket_type_id, locale)
);
```

## 票种公共 API

```http
GET /api/v1/public/activities/{activity_id}/ticket-types
GET /api/v1/public/activities/{activity_id}/availability
```

公共响应从 Catalog 获取：

```text
币种价格
优惠
可售状态
剩余名额等级
购买时间
```

默认不公开精确剩余人数，可配置为：

```python
class CapacityDisplayMode(StrEnum):
    HIDDEN = "hidden"
    STATUS_ONLY = "status_only"
    EXACT = "exact"
```

# 十、Skill 6.4：`vav-registration-and-approval`

## 目标

实现报名表、资格校验、免费/付费报名和人工审核。

## 10.1 报名表定义

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_registration_forms (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    activity_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES activities(id),

    schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    form_schema JSONB NOT NULL,

    consent_requirements JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

表单字段示例：

```json
{
  "fields": [
    {
      "key": "city",
      "type": "text",
      "required": true,
      "label": {
        "zh-CN": "所在城市",
        "zh-TW": "所在城市",
        "en": "City"
      }
    },
    {
      "key": "dietary_requirements",
      "type": "textarea",
      "required": false,
      "sensitivity": "restricted"
    }
  ]
}
```

禁止由运营人员创建：

```text
密码字段
银行卡字段
身份证完整扫描件字段
不必要的医疗或极敏感字段
任意可执行 HTML
```

高敏字段必须经过字段类型白名单和数据保护评审。

## 10.2 报名表

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_registrations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    registration_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),
    ticket_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_ticket_types(id),
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    form_schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    form_response_encrypted JSONB NOT NULL,

    pricing_quote_id UUID REFERENCES pricing_quotes(id),
    order_id UUID REFERENCES orders(id),
    entitlement_id UUID REFERENCES entitlements(id),

    review_status VARCHAR(32),
    reviewed_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    review_reason_code VARCHAR(128),
    review_notes_encrypted TEXT,

    confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(activity_id, user_id)
);
```

默认一个用户对同一活动只能有一个有效报名；需要代他人购票时应建立独立受益人模型，不能简单通过增加数量绕过身份和互选规则。

## 10.3 报名状态历史

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_registration_history (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    registration_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_registrations(id),
    from_status VARCHAR(32),
    to_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    reason_code VARCHAR(128),
    reason TEXT,

    actor_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    actor_user_id UUID,

    request_id UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 用户 API

```http
POST /api/v1/activities/{activity_id}/registrations
GET  /api/v1/account/activity-registrations
GET  /api/v1/account/activity-registrations/{registration_id}
POST /api/v1/account/activity-registrations/{registration_id}/cancel
```

## 管理 API

```http
GET  /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/registrations
GET  /api/v1/admin/activity-registrations/{registration_id}

POST /api/v1/admin/activity-registrations/{registration_id}/approve
POST /api/v1/admin/activity-registrations/{registration_id}/reject
POST /api/v1/admin/activity-registrations/{registration_id}/request-information
POST /api/v1/admin/activity-registrations/{registration_id}/cancel
```

## 报名事务：免费自动审核

```text
锁定用户与活动
→ 校验活动开放
→ 校验唯一报名
→ 校验资格
→ 创建免费 Pricing Quote
→ 原子确认库存
→ 创建免费订单或零金额业务记录
→ 创建 ACTIVITY_ADMISSION 权益
→ 创建 CONFIRMED 报名
→ 写历史和 Outbox
```

## 报名事务：审核后付款

```text
提交报名
→ PENDING_APPROVAL
→ 管理员批准
→ APPROVED_PENDING_PAYMENT
→ 生成限时付款邀请
→ 用户创建订单
→ Webhook 确认支付
→ 激活活动权益
→ CONFIRMED
```

## 审核要求

拒绝或取消必须填写：

```text
内部原因代码
安全的用户可见说明
内部备注
```

内部备注不能通过用户 API 返回。

---

# 十一、支付与报名投影

Batch 5 发出：

```text
commerce.order.paid
entitlement.activated
refund.succeeded
entitlement.revoked
```

活动模块消费事件：

```text
ACTIVITY_ADMISSION entitlement activated
→ 报名转 CONFIRMED

活动权益 revoked
→ 按活动政策转 CANCELLED 或 MANUAL_REVIEW

全额退款成功
→ 报名取消
→ 释放参与资格
→ 触发候补递补
```

必须使用 Inbox 去重：

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_inbox_events (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    source_event_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    event_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    processing_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    received_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

重复支付 Webhook 或重复 Outbox 消费不能生成重复报名。

# 十二、Skill 6.5：`vav-waitlist-and-promotion`

## 目标

实现候补队列、空位递补和付款邀请。

## 候补记录

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_waitlist_entries (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),
    ticket_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_ticket_types(id),
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    registration_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_registrations(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    sequence_number BIGINT NOT NULL,
    priority_score INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    joined_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    promotion_offered_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    promotion_offer_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    promoted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    manual_order_override INTEGER,
    override_reason TEXT,
    overridden_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(activity_id, ticket_type_id, user_id)
);
```

## 排序规则

默认：

```text
priority_score 降序
→ manual_order_override 升序
→ sequence_number 升序
```

默认所有普通用户：

```text
priority_score = 0
```

任何优先级调整都必须有明确业务规则和审计，不能暗中插队。

## 候补流程

```text
票种售罄
→ 用户选择加入候补
→ WAITLISTED
→ 获得候补位置或状态

确认报名取消
→ 释放名额
→ 锁定候补队列
→ 选取第一名合格候补
→ 创建 PROMOTION_OFFERED
→ 发送限时确认/付款邀请
```

## 递补方式

### 免费票

```text
候补用户确认
→ 原子确认名额
→ 创建权益
→ 报名 CONFIRMED
```

### 付费票

```text
候补用户获得限时结账资格
→ 创建库存预留
→ 完成支付
→ 报名 CONFIRMED
```

## 递补过期

```text
邀请到期
→ OFFER_EXPIRED
→ 释放专属名额
→ 自动邀请下一位
```

## API

```http
POST /api/v1/activities/{activity_id}/waitlist
GET  /api/v1/account/activity-waitlist
POST /api/v1/account/activity-waitlist/{entry_id}/accept
POST /api/v1/account/activity-waitlist/{entry_id}/decline

GET  /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/waitlist
POST /api/v1/admin/activity-waitlist/{entry_id}/reorder
POST /api/v1/admin/activity-waitlist/{entry_id}/offer
POST /api/v1/admin/activity-waitlist/{entry_id}/cancel
```

## 并发不变量

```text
一个空位只能递补一位
同一用户不能重复加入候补
过期邀请不能再购买专属名额
多个 Worker 不能同时晋升同一位置
已确认用户不能继续留在候补队列
```

# 十三、Skill 6.6：`vav-check-in-operations`

## 目标

实现安全二维码、手工签到、撤销和现场签到工作台。

## 签到凭证

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_checkin_credentials (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    registration_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE
        REFERENCES activity_registrations(id),

    public_reference VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    credential_secret_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    rotated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

二维码 Payload：

```json
{
  "type": "vav_activity_checkin",
  "reference": "public-random-reference",
  "nonce": "signed-short-lived-nonce",
  "exp": 1785456900
}
```

二维码不得直接包含：

```text
姓名
邮箱
手机号
婚恋档案
活动表单答案
订单金额
用户 UUID
```

## 签到事件

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_checkin_events (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),
    session_id UUID REFERENCES activity_sessions(id),
    registration_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_registrations(id),

    action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    method VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    performed_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    reason TEXT,
    device_reference VARCHAR(128),
    request_id UUID,

    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 签到方法

```python
class CheckinMethod(StrEnum):
    QR_SCAN = "qr_scan"
    MANUAL_SEARCH = "manual_search"
    MANUAL_CODE = "manual_code"
    ADMIN_OVERRIDE = "admin_override"
```

## API

用户：

```http
GET /api/v1/account/activity-registrations/{id}/checkin-pass
```

后台：

```http
POST /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/checkin/scan
POST /api/v1/admin/activity-registrations/{registration_id}/checkin
POST /api/v1/admin/activity-registrations/{registration_id}/revoke-checkin
GET  /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/attendance
```

## 签到校验

```text
报名 CONFIRMED
活动/场次匹配
签到窗口开放
凭证有效
凭证未撤销
用户未被暂停或安全限制
没有已生效的重复签到
```

重复扫描：

```text
返回 ALREADY_CHECKED_IN
显示首次签到时间
不重复增加人数
```

## 撤销签到

只能由授权管理员执行，并要求填写原因：

```json
{
  "reason": "Checked in the wrong participant."
}
```

撤销不会删除原始签到事件，而是追加 `revoke` 事件。

# 十四、Skill 6.7：`vav-grouping-engine`

## 目标

实现活动现场分组、锁定和调整历史。

## 分组方案

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_grouping_plans (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),
    plan_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

    grouping_method VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    target_group_size INTEGER,
    target_group_count INTEGER,

    rule_schema_version INTEGER,
    grouping_rules JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    random_seed VARCHAR(128),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    locked_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    locked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 分组

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_groups (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    grouping_plan_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_grouping_plans(id),

    group_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    display_name VARCHAR(200),

    facilitator_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    capacity INTEGER,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(grouping_plan_id, group_code)
);
```

## 分组成员

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_group_members (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    group_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_groups(id),
    registration_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_registrations(id),

    assignment_source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    assignment_reason TEXT,

    assigned_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    assigned_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    removed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    removed_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    removal_reason TEXT
);
```

## 分组方式

```python
class GroupingMethod(StrEnum):
    RANDOM = "random"
    MANUAL = "manual"
    RULE_ASSISTED = "rule_assisted"
```

## 随机分组

必须使用保存的 `random_seed`，保证：

```text
相同参与者集合
相同规则
相同 seed
→ 生成相同结果
```

## 规则辅助分组

允许规则：

```text
小组人数上下限
已签到参与者
指定人员分开
指定人员同组
语言偏好
参与场次
工作人员分布
```

敏感或受保护属性不得自动成为分组依据，除非业务负责人明确确认必要性、合法性和用户告知。

## API

```http
GET  /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/grouping-plans
POST /api/v1/admin/activities/{activity_id}/grouping-plans
POST /api/v1/admin/activity-grouping-plans/{id}/generate
POST /api/v1/admin/activity-grouping-plans/{id}/lock
POST /api/v1/admin/activity-grouping-plans/{id}/unlock

POST /api/v1/admin/activity-groups/{group_id}/members
DELETE /api/v1/admin/activity-groups/{group_id}/members/{registration_id}

GET /api/v1/account/activities/{activity_id}/group
```

参与者只能查看自己小组中允许公开的显示信息。

# 十五、Skill 6.8：`vav-post-event-mutual-choice`

## 目标

实现活动结束后的参与者目录、私密选择和双向互选。

## 15.1 参与资格

默认满足全部条件：

```text
活动状态 COMPLETED
活动启用 post_event_choice
当前时间位于互选窗口内
用户报名 CONFIRMED
用户已签到
用户账户 ACTIVE
用户未被活动管理员移除
用户未被举报或安全限制
```

是否允许未签到者参加互选必须配置化，默认关闭。

## 15.2 参与者投影

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_participant_profiles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),
    registration_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_registrations(id),
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    dating_profile_id UUID,

    display_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
    avatar_media_id UUID REFERENCES media_assets(id),
    brief_introduction VARCHAR(500),

    visibility_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    profile_snapshot_version INTEGER,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(activity_id, user_id)
);
```

Batch 13 上线前，活动投影只使用用户明确授权的活动展示资料；不能自动暴露账户资料或报名表内容。

## 15.3 选择表

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_post_event_choices (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),

    chooser_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    chosen_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    choice VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',

    submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    withdrawn_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    UNIQUE(activity_id, chooser_user_id, chosen_user_id),

    CHECK (chooser_user_id <> chosen_user_id)
);
```

## 选择值

```python
class PostEventChoice(StrEnum):
    INTERESTED = "interested"
    PASS = "pass"
```

`PASS` 不向对方公开，也不应展示成“被拒绝”。

## 15.4 双向互选

```sql
CREATE TABLE activity_mutual_choices (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    activity_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activities(id),

    user_a_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    user_b_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    first_choice_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_post_event_choices(id),
    second_choice_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES activity_post_event_choices(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    matched_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    platform_match_id UUID,
    introduction_invitation_id UUID,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(activity_id, user_a_id, user_b_id),
    CHECK (user_a_id <> user_b_id)
);
```

写入前必须将用户 ID 规范排序，避免：

```text
(A, B)
和
(B, A)
```

生成两条互选。

## 互选事务

```text
锁定 chooser/chosen 组合
→ 校验双方资格
→ 校验未屏蔽
→ Upsert 当前选择
→ 查询反向 INTERESTED
→ 若不存在：结束，不通知对方
→ 若存在：创建唯一 Mutual Choice
→ 写 Outbox
→ 后续生成认识邀请或待确认状态
```

## 用户 API

```http
GET  /api/v1/account/activities/{activity_id}/participant-directory
GET  /api/v1/account/activities/{activity_id}/post-event-choices
PUT  /api/v1/account/activities/{activity_id}/post-event-choices/{participant_id}
DELETE /api/v1/account/activities/{activity_id}/post-event-choices/{participant_id}
GET  /api/v1/account/activity-mutual-choices
```

请求：

```json
{
  "choice": "interested"
}
```

## 最大选择数

配置：

```dotenv
ACTIVITY_POST_EVENT_MAX_INTERESTED_CHOICES=5
```

是否限制及限制数属于活动配置，可为不同活动覆盖。

## 联系方式保护

互选成功后默认只返回：

```text
互选成功
对方公开活动卡片
认识邀请状态
```

不直接返回：

```text
邮箱
手机号
微信
家庭地址
私人社交账号
```

## 屏蔽联动

在 Batch 18 完成前建立接口：

```python
await moderation_gateway.can_users_interact(
    user_a_id,
    user_b_id,
)
```

若存在屏蔽、安全限制或举报处置：

```text
不创建新互选
已存在互选可转 SUSPENDED
不向双方暴露具体风控原因
记录安全事件
```

---

# 十六、活动后互选关闭处理

互选窗口关闭后：

```text
未提交选择保持无选择
单向选择永久保密
不再允许普通修改
已生成互选保持有效
管理员不能代替用户创建感兴趣选择
```

管理员允许执行：

```text
暂停异常互选
因安全原因撤销互选
重新开放整个活动互选窗口
```

管理员不得执行：

```text
查看谁拒绝了谁作为一般运营娱乐
代用户选择某人
批量制造互选
向单向选择对象发送提示
```

## 目标

定义活动事件和通知契约，不重复建设 Batch 11 的通知中心。

## Outbox 事件

```text
activity.published
activity.registration.opened
activity.registration.submitted
activity.registration.approved
activity.registration.rejected
activity.registration.confirmed
activity.registration.cancelled

activity.waitlist.joined
activity.waitlist.promotion_offered
activity.waitlist.offer_expired
activity.waitlist.promoted

activity.payment_invitation.created
activity.checkin.available
activity.checkin.completed
activity.checkin.revoked

activity.cancelled
activity.reminder.due

activity.post_event_choice.opened
activity.post_event_choice.closing_soon
activity.mutual_choice.created
```

## 通知接收约束

```text
活动发布
→ 仅发送给明确订阅相应通知的用户

报名审核结果
→ 发送给该报名用户

候补递补
→ 发送限时操作入口

互选成功
→ 只发送给互选双方

单向选择
→ 不发送给被选择方
```

## 通知数据最小化

互选通知 Payload：

```json
{
  "mutual_choice_id": "uuid",
  "activity_id": "uuid",
  "recipient_user_id": "uuid"
}
```

不得在队列中传播完整婚恋档案或敏感报名表答案。

# 二十七、必须通过的活动发布场景

```text
管理员创建活动草稿
配置中文、繁体和英文内容
配置时间、时区和场地
关联有效活动票 SKU
发布活动
用户端能够访问

无票种不能发布
无有效价格的收费票不能发布
有限票无库存不能发布
结束时间早于开始时间不能发布
报名截止晚于活动开始不能发布
线上活动无安全会议配置不能发布
草稿活动不能通过公共 API 读取
```

# 二十八、必须通过的报名场景

```text
免费自动审核报名成功
付费自动审核生成订单
人工审核报名进入 PENDING_APPROVAL
批准后生成付款邀请
拒绝时不产生有效权益
重复提交不产生重复报名
不同用户不能查看彼此报名
过期付款邀请不能确认报名
支付返回页不能直接确认报名
Webhook 和权益激活后报名转 CONFIRMED
重复支付事件不会重复确认
```

---

# 二十九、必须通过的名额和候补场景

```text
最后一个名额只有一个用户获得
售罄后用户进入候补
同一用户不能重复加入候补
取消报名释放名额
空位触发第一位候补
候补付款邀请过期
过期后下一位获得机会
两个 Worker 不会同时晋升两人
人工调序必须填写原因
候补用户支付成功后只确认一次
```

---

# 三十、必须通过的签到场景

```text
已确认报名可以获取签到凭证
未付款或未确认报名不能获取
二维码不包含个人敏感信息
伪造二维码被拒绝
过期二维码被拒绝
首次签到成功
重复扫码不重复增加到场人数
授权管理员可以手工签到
撤销签到必须填写原因
撤销保留原始事件
非签到工作人员不能执行签到
```

---

# 三十一、必须通过的分组场景

```text
随机分组结果在相同 seed 下可复现
参与者不会同时存在于两个活动小组
锁定后不能静默重新生成
手工移动保留历史
没有权限的人员不能调整
用户只看到自己的分组
用户看不到内部规则和管理员备注
敏感报名字段不能自动进入分组输出
```

# 三十二、必须通过的活动后互选场景

```text
只有合格参与者能进入目录
未签到用户默认不能参与
用户不能选择自己
用户不能选择不在该活动的用户
用户不能看到对方是否已选择自己
单向选择不发送通知
双方感兴趣生成一个 Mutual Choice
并发双向提交只生成一条互选
撤回后按窗口和状态规则处理
互选后不自动公开联系方式
屏蔽关系阻止互选
活动窗口关闭后普通用户不能修改
管理员不能代替用户提交感兴趣选择
```

取消后停止新报名

所有操作可审计
```

# 三十四、Batch 6 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-06/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-06-activities-registration-operations
description: Implement VAV activity publication, ticket integration, registration, approval, waitlists, payment projection, check-in, grouping and private post-event mutual choice.
---

# Goal

Build a complete activity-service module containing:

- multilingual activity publication;
- online, in-person and hybrid activities;
- locations and multiple sessions;
- catalog-linked ticket types;
- free and paid registration;
- automatic and manual approval;
- configurable approval/payment ordering;
- waitlists and automatic promotion;
- secure check-in credentials;
- manual and QR check-in;
- activity grouping;
- private post-event participant choice;
- mutual-choice detection;
- user-web activity journeys;
- admin-web activity operations;
- audit, metrics, concurrency and security tests.

# Source requirements

The project plan requires:

- activity display;
- registration;
- order and payment integration;
- administration support;
- activity review and operational handling;
- activity-after mutual choice linked to platform user profiles.

The platform must not create a separate activity price, inventory or payment
system. Reuse the catalog, commerce and entitlement foundations.

# Prerequisites

Before implementation:

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 with `make verify`.
3. Verify Batch 2 with `make auth-verify`.
4. Verify Batch 3 with `make cms-verify`.
5. Verify Batch 4 with `make catalog-verify`.
6. Verify Batch 5 with `make commerce-verify`.
7. Read every skill under `skills/batch-06`.
8. Inspect the existing catalog, inventory, commerce, entitlement, RBAC,
   audit and outbox contracts.
9. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-06-plan.md`.
10. Record unresolved activity eligibility, contact exchange, refund and
    participant-visibility rules in the decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. Activity domain model and migrations.
2. Activity publishing and lifecycle.
3. Ticket types linked to Catalog SKUs.
4. Registration forms and eligibility validation.
5. Free and paid registration workflows.
6. Manual approval workflows.
7. Commerce and entitlement event projections.
8. Waitlist ordering and promotion.
9. Secure check-in credentials and operations.
10. Grouping plans and assignments.
11. Participant-directory projection.
12. Post-event private choice and mutual-choice detection.
13. User-web activity journeys.
14. Admin-web activity center.
15. Unit, integration, concurrency, security and E2E tests.

# Architecture constraints

- Activity is the source of truth for event operations.
- Catalog is the source of truth for products, SKUs and prices.
- Inventory is the source of truth for finite capacity.
- Commerce is the source of truth for orders and payment.
- Entitlements are the source of truth for purchased admission rights.
- Do not duplicate price, discount, payment or sold-capacity fields in the
  activity domain.
- Payment return pages never confirm registration.
- A paid registration becomes confirmed only after verified commerce events
  and entitlement activation.
- All consumed external events must be deduplicated.
- Activity operations must continue if AI services are unavailable.
- Public APIs must not expose private addresses, online-meeting secrets,
  registration answers or internal notes.

# Activity lifecycle invariants

- An activity end time must be later than its start time.
- Registration windows must be valid.
- A published activity must have at least one active ticket type.
- Every paid ticket type must reference a valid active SKU and price.
- Every finite-capacity ticket type must reference valid inventory.
- Activity cancellation must stop sales and create explicit downstream
  cancellation/refund work.
- Completed and cancelled activities cannot silently return to active sales.

# Registration invariants

- A user may have only one active registration per activity unless a future
  beneficiary model explicitly supports otherwise.
- Registration responses must be validated against a versioned form schema.
- Sensitive responses must not be exposed through ordinary APIs or logs.
- Registration approval and payment timing must be explicit.
- Rejected registrations must not receive active admission entitlements.
- Paid registration confirmation must be idempotent.
- Registration state transitions must create history records.
- Frontend-supplied payment status is untrusted.

# Waitlist invariants

- Waitlist ordering must be deterministic.
- Ordinary users receive equal default priority.
- Manual reordering requires a reason and audit event.
- A released seat may promote only one waitlisted user.
- Promotion offers must expire.
- Expired offers must release reserved capacity.
- Confirmed users must be removed from active waitlists.
- Concurrent promotion workers must not oversubscribe capacity.

# Check-in invariants

- Check-in credentials must not contain direct personal information.
- Only confirmed registrations may check in.
- Credentials must be signed, scoped and expiring.
- Duplicate scans must not create duplicate attendance.
- Check-in revocation must append an event rather than erase history.
- Check-in workers may not receive unnecessary payment or profile data.

# Grouping invariants

- Group generation must be reproducible when a random seed is saved.
- A registration cannot be active in multiple groups in the same plan.
- Locked grouping plans cannot be regenerated silently.
- Manual member moves require audit history.
- Sensitive or protected attributes must not be used without an explicit,
  reviewed business rule.
- Users may read only their own group and approved public member fields.

# Post-event choice invariants

- Only eligible participants may enter the participant directory.
- Participation requires confirmed registration and, by default, check-in.
- A user cannot choose themselves.
- A user cannot choose someone outside the same eligible activity population.
- One-sided choices are confidential.
- One-sided choices must not trigger notifications to the selected user.
- A mutual choice requires two valid interested choices.
- Concurrent reciprocal choices must create only one mutual-choice record.
- Contact details must not be exposed automatically.
- Blocked, restricted or moderated relationships must not create new matches.
- Administrators must not submit interest choices for users.
- Post-event choices must not expose rejection information.

# Security invariants

- Public activity APIs return only published activity data.
- Private location details are restricted to eligible confirmed users.
- Online meeting links are restricted and time-bound.
- Registration forms cannot collect arbitrary secrets or executable content.
- Check-in QR values must resist tampering and replay.
- Participant-directory DTOs must contain only explicitly permitted fields.
- Sensitive registration and one-sided-choice access requires separate RBAC.
- High-risk operations require explicit reasons.
- All activity, registration, waitlist, check-in and match transitions must
  be audited.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make activity-migrate
make activity-seed
make activity-test
make activity-concurrency-test
make activity-security-test
make activity-user-e2e
make activity-admin-e2e
make activity-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Administrators can create multilingual activities.
2. Activities can contain multiple sessions and locations.
3. Ticket types link to Catalog SKUs.
4. Paid ticket prices come from Catalog.
5. Finite capacity comes from Inventory.
6. Users can complete free registration.
7. Users can complete paid registration.
8. Manual approval works.
9. Approval-before-payment works.
10. Payment-before-approval works when explicitly configured.
11. Payment return pages cannot confirm registration.
12. Entitlement activation confirms registration exactly once.
13. Users can join a sold-out activity waitlist.
14. Released capacity promotes exactly one user.
15. Waitlist offers expire safely.
16. Users can obtain secure check-in passes.
17. Duplicate check-in is prevented.
18. Authorized staff can perform and revoke check-in.
19. Administrators can generate and lock activity groups.
20. Group assignments preserve history.
21. Eligible participants can view the post-event directory.
22. One-sided choices remain private.
23. Reciprocal choices create exactly one mutual choice.
24. Mutual choices do not automatically expose contact details.
25. Blocked or restricted users cannot form a new activity match.
26. Activity cancellation stops sales and creates downstream handling.
27. User activity E2E tests pass.
28. Admin activity E2E tests pass.
29. Activity concurrency tests pass.
30. Activity security tests pass.
31. `make commerce-verify` still succeeds.
32. `make catalog-verify` still succeeds.
33. `make cms-verify` still succeeds.
34. `make auth-verify` still succeeds.
35. `make verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When an activity business rule is unresolved:

1. record it in `docs/product/decision-register.md`;
2. implement the rule as configuration;
3. choose the least-disclosing and least-destructive default;
4. do not invent permanent eligibility, refund or contact-exchange policy;
5. continue implementing unrelated activity capabilities.

When a capacity or waitlist concurrency test fails:

1. stop activity registration feature work;
2. preserve the failing test;
3. identify the missing lock, constraint or idempotency boundary;
4. fix the root cause;
5. rerun inventory, commerce and activity concurrency suites.

When a one-sided-choice privacy test fails:

1. stop post-event feature work;
2. remove the disclosure path;
3. verify API, cache, log, notification and admin projections;
4. add a regression test;
5. rerun the complete activity security suite.
```

```text
Course
├── Course Localization
├── Instructor
├── Course Module
│   └── Lesson
│       ├── Lesson Localization
│       ├── Lesson Resource
│       ├── Video Asset
│       └── Exercise
├── Completion Policy
├── Catalog Product/SKU
└── Course Enrollment
    ├── Lesson Progress
    ├── Learning Events
    ├── Exercise Attempts
    └── Certificate
```

核心关系：

```text
Catalog SKU
→ 支付成功
→ COURSE_ACCESS Entitlement
→ Course Enrollment
→ Lesson Access
→ Progress
→ Completion Evaluation
→ Certificate
```

课程访问不能由前端根据“订单成功页面”决定，而必须由后端检查有效权益。

# 六、课程状态机

## 6.1 课程状态

```python
class CourseStatus(StrEnum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    IN_REVIEW = "in_review"
    SCHEDULED = "scheduled"
    PUBLISHED = "published"
    ENROLLMENT_CLOSED = "enrollment_closed"
    UNPUBLISHED = "unpublished"
    ARCHIVED = "archived"
```

典型流程：

```text
DRAFT
→ IN_REVIEW
→ SCHEDULED/PUBLISHED
→ ENROLLMENT_CLOSED
→ UNPUBLISHED
→ ARCHIVED
```

已购用户是否可以继续访问下架课程，由访问政策决定：

```python
class UnpublishedAccessPolicy(StrEnum):
    RETAIN_EXISTING_ACCESS = "retain_existing_access"
    BLOCK_NEW_ENROLLMENT_ONLY = "block_new_enrollment_only"
    REVOKE_ALL_ACCESS = "revoke_all_access"
```

默认使用：

```text
BLOCK_NEW_ENROLLMENT_ONLY
```

即停止新销售，但不轻易剥夺已付款用户的合法访问权。

## 6.2 课时状态

```python
class LessonStatus(StrEnum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    READY = "ready"
    PUBLISHED = "published"
    UNPUBLISHED = "unpublished"
    ARCHIVED = "archived"
```

## 6.3 学习注册状态

```python
class EnrollmentStatus(StrEnum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
    SUSPENDED = "suspended"
    REVOKED = "revoked"
```

# 七、Skill 7.1：`vav-course-domain-model`

## 目标

建立课程、模块、课时、讲师、资源、学习注册、进度、练习和证书领域模型。

## 7.1 课程表

```sql
CREATE TABLE courses (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    course_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    internal_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

    course_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    visibility VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'public',

    default_locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    difficulty_level VARCHAR(32),
    estimated_duration_minutes INTEGER,

    enrollment_opens_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    enrollment_closes_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    content_release_policy VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all_at_once',
    unpublished_access_policy VARCHAR(64)
        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'block_new_enrollment_only',

    catalog_product_id UUID REFERENCES products(id),
    primary_catalog_sku_id UUID REFERENCES product_skus(id),

    completion_policy_id UUID,

    featured BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    updated_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    archived_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 7.2 课程类型

```python
class CourseType(StrEnum):
    SELF_PACED = "self_paced"
    COHORT = "cohort"
    HYBRID = "hybrid"
```

本批重点完整支持：

```text
SELF_PACED
```

`COHORT` 和 `HYBRID` 支持课程结构与活动关联，但复杂班级运营可后续扩展。

## 7.3 课程本地化

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_localizations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    course_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id),

    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    slug VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

    title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    subtitle VARCHAR(500),
    summary TEXT,

    description_blocks JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    learning_outcomes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    target_audience JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    prerequisites JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    instructor_summary TEXT,
    refund_notice TEXT,

    seo_title VARCHAR(300),
    seo_description VARCHAR(500),

    cover_media_id UUID REFERENCES media_assets(id),

    translation_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(course_id, locale),
    UNIQUE(locale, slug)
);
```

## 7.4 讲师

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_instructors (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    instructor_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    linked_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    display_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',

    avatar_media_id UUID REFERENCES media_assets(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE course_instructor_assignments (
    course_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id),
    instructor_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES course_instructors(id),

    role VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    PRIMARY KEY(course_id, instructor_id, role)
);
```

不得自行生成未经业务方确认的讲师履历或资质。

# 八、Skill 7.2：`vav-course-catalog-publication`

## 目标

实现课程目录、审核、发布、试听和上下架。

## 公共 API

```http

GET /api/v1/public/courses/{course_id}/access-summary
```

## 管理 API

```http
GET    /api/v1/admin/courses
POST   /api/v1/admin/courses
GET    /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}
PATCH  /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}

PUT    /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}/localizations/{locale}

POST   /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}/submit-review
POST   /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}/approve
POST   /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}/publish
POST   /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}/schedule
POST   /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}/close-enrollment
POST   /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}/unpublish
POST   /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}/archive
```

## 发布前校验

```text
至少一个 READY 语言版本
存在课程封面或明确允许无封面
至少一个已发布模块
至少一个可访问课时
所有必修课时均 READY
视频课时存在可用视频资产
练习课时存在有效题目和评分规则
完成规则合法

免费课程明确设置免费访问政策
购买权益映射合法
课程退款政策快照来源明确
```

## 试听

```text
preview_policy
```

支持：

```python
class PreviewPolicy(StrEnum):
    NONE = "none"
    PUBLIC = "public"
    AUTHENTICATED = "authenticated"
```

试听只能访问明确标记的课时，不能通过修改前端 URL 访问其他课时。

locale
category
course_type
difficulty
price_type

instructor
keyword
page
page_size
sort
```

# 九、Skill 7.3：`vav-course-structure-lessons`

## 目标

建立模块、章节、课时、先修关系和内容解锁策略。

## 9.1 课程模块

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_modules (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    course_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id),

    module_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    internal_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL,

    release_offset_days INTEGER,
    release_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(course_id, module_code)
);
```

## 9.2 模块本地化

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_module_localizations (
    module_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES course_modules(id),
    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,

    PRIMARY KEY(module_id, locale)
);
```

## 9.3 课时

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_lessons (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    module_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES course_modules(id),

    lesson_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    internal_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

    lesson_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',

    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL,

    required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    preview_policy VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',

    estimated_duration_minutes INTEGER,

    completion_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    completion_threshold JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    release_offset_days INTEGER,
    release_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(module_id, lesson_code)
);
```

## 9.4 课时类型

```python
class LessonType(StrEnum):
    VIDEO = "video"
    RICH_TEXT = "rich_text"
    AUDIO = "audio"
    DOCUMENT = "document"
    EXERCISE = "exercise"
    ASSIGNMENT = "assignment"
    EXTERNAL_ACTIVITY = "external_activity"
```

## 9.5 课时本地化

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_lesson_localizations (
    lesson_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES course_lessons(id),
    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    summary TEXT,
    content_blocks JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    PRIMARY KEY(lesson_id, locale)
);
```

## 9.6 先修关系

```sql
CREATE TABLE lesson_prerequisites (
    lesson_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES course_lessons(id),
    prerequisite_lesson_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES course_lessons(id),

    required_completion BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    minimum_score_basis_points INTEGER,

    PRIMARY KEY(lesson_id, prerequisite_lesson_id),

    CHECK (lesson_id <> prerequisite_lesson_id)
);
```

必须检测依赖环：

```text
Lesson A → Lesson B → Lesson C → Lesson A
```

存在循环时禁止发布。

## 9.7 内容释放策略

```python
class ContentReleasePolicy(StrEnum):
    ALL_AT_ONCE = "all_at_once"
    ENROLLMENT_DRIP = "enrollment_drip"
    SCHEDULED = "scheduled"
    PREREQUISITE_GATED = "prerequisite_gated"
```

解锁时间统一由后端计算。

# 十、课程结构版本与已购用户稳定性

课程发布后修改结构时，不能静默破坏已学习用户的完成状态。

## 10.1 课程版本

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_versions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    course_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id),

    version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    curriculum_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

    change_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(course_id, version_number)
);
```

## 10.2 Enrollment 绑定课程版本

```text
新注册用户
→ 默认绑定最新发布版本

已注册用户
→ 默认保持原课程版本

管理员显式迁移
→ 运行兼容性分析
→ 记录迁移计划
→ 不丢失已有进度
```

允许配置：

```python
class EnrollmentVersionPolicy(StrEnum):
    PIN_AT_ENROLLMENT = "pin_at_enrollment"
    AUTO_UPGRADE_COMPATIBLE = "auto_upgrade_compatible"
```

默认：

```text
PIN_AT_ENROLLMENT
```

# 十一、Skill 7.4：`vav-course-bundles-catalog-integration`

## 目标

将课程和课程套餐映射到 Batch 4 Product/SKU。

## 11.1 SKU 与课程映射

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_sku_mappings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    catalog_sku_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES product_skus(id),
    course_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id),

    access_duration_days INTEGER,
    access_start_policy VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    course_version_policy VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(catalog_sku_id, course_id)
);
```

## 11.2 访问开始策略

```python
class AccessStartPolicy(StrEnum):
    AT_PURCHASE = "at_purchase"
    AT_FIRST_ACCESS = "at_first_access"
    FIXED_DATE = "fixed_date"
```

## 11.3 套餐

课程套餐仍是 Batch 4 的 `COURSE_BUNDLE Product`。

一个 Bundle SKU 可以映射多个课程：

```text
Relationship Foundations Bundle
├── Course A
├── Course B
└── Course C
```

购买套餐后，Batch 5 可以生成：

```text
一条订单项
→ 多条 COURSE_ACCESS Entitlement
→ 多条 Course Enrollment
```

## 11.4 套餐快照

订单项必须保存：

```json
{
  "bundle_code": "RELATIONSHIP-FOUNDATIONS",
  "included_courses": [
    {
      "course_id": "uuid",
      "course_version": 3,
      "access_duration_days": 365
    }
  ]
}
```

以后修改套餐内容不能改变既有订单的购买范围。

## 管理 API

```http
GET  /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}/catalog-mappings
POST /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}/catalog-mappings
DELETE /api/v1/admin/courses/{course_id}/catalog-mappings/{mapping_id}

GET  /api/v1/admin/course-bundles
POST /api/v1/admin/course-bundles/{sku_id}/courses
DELETE /api/v1/admin/course-bundles/{sku_id}/courses/{course_id}
```

# 十二、Skill 7.5：`vav-video-resource-access`

## 目标

实现私有视频、外部视频 Provider 和短时播放授权。

课程视频采用外部视频平台、私有链接还是平台托管，仍属于待确认产品决策，因此本批必须通过 Provider Adapter 支持替换，不能把业务逻辑绑定到单一视频服务。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

## 12.1 视频资产

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_video_assets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    provider VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    provider_environment VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    media_asset_id UUID REFERENCES media_assets(id),
    provider_video_id VARCHAR(255),

    processing_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    duration_seconds INTEGER,
    width INTEGER,
    height INTEGER,

    playback_format VARCHAR(32),
    drm_policy VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',

    original_source_visibility VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private',

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 12.2 视频课时关联

```sql
CREATE TABLE lesson_video_resources (
    lesson_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES course_lessons(id),
    video_asset_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES course_video_assets(id),

    required_watch_basis_points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 9000,
    allow_seek BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    allow_playback_speed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    captions_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

`9000 basis points` 表示要求观看约 90%，但这只是课程完成规则，不应被描述成用户确实认真理解了 90%。

## 12.3 Video Provider Interface

```python
class CourseVideoProvider(Protocol):
    async def create_playback_authorization(
        self,
        video: CourseVideoAsset,
        principal: CoursePlaybackPrincipal,
    ) -> PlaybackAuthorization:
        ...

    async def get_processing_status(
        self,
        video: CourseVideoAsset,
    ) -> VideoProcessingState:
        ...

    async def revoke_playback_session(
        self,
        playback_session_id: UUID,
    ) -> None:
        ...
```

## 12.4 播放授权 API

```http
POST /api/v1/learning/lessons/{lesson_id}/playback-sessions
POST /api/v1/learning/playback-sessions/{session_id}/heartbeat
POST /api/v1/learning/playback-sessions/{session_id}/complete
```

## 12.5 播放会话

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_playback_sessions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    enrollment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES course_enrollments(id),
    lesson_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES course_lessons(id),
    video_asset_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES course_video_assets(id),

    access_token_hash VARCHAR(128),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    last_heartbeat_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    last_position_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    maximum_position_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    device_session_hash VARCHAR(128),
    ip_address_hash VARCHAR(128),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 播放授权校验

```text
用户已登录
课程 Enrollment 有效
权益 ACTIVE
课时已发布
课时已解锁
先修课已满足
视频已处理完成
播放会话未超过并发限制
```

## 播放地址保护

公共 API 不得返回：

```text
原始 S3 Object Key
永久公开 URL
Provider Secret
视频转码管理地址
后台上传凭证
```

返回短时授权：

```json
{
  "playback_session_id": "uuid",
  "playback_type": "hls",
  "playback_url": "short-lived-signed-url",
  "expires_at": "2026-07-31T04:15:00Z"
}
```

## 下载

视频默认不可下载：

```dotenv
COURSE_VIDEO_DOWNLOAD_ENABLED=false
```

课件文档是否允许下载由资源级策略决定。

---

# 十三、视频进度可信边界

播放心跳可用于用户体验和完成判定，但不能被宣传为严格防作弊系统。

## 心跳请求

```json
{
  "sequence": 18,
  "position_seconds": 620,
  "played_seconds_since_last_heartbeat": 20,
  "playback_rate": 1.25,
  "client_timestamp": "2026-07-31T04:10:00Z"
}
```

## 服务端校验

```text
sequence 单调递增
position 不超过视频时长
相邻心跳时间合理
played_seconds 不超过实际经过时间容差
会话未过期
用户和 Enrollment 匹配
```

## 完成计算

```text
有效观看区间并集
÷ 视频总时长
≥ required_watch_basis_points
```

不能简单使用：

```text
用户把播放位置拖到结尾
→ 自动完成
```

# 十四、Skill 7.6：`vav-enrollment-entitlement-access`

## 目标

通过 Batch 5 `COURSE_ACCESS` 权益创建和管理课程学习注册。

## 14.1 Enrollment

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_enrollments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    course_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id),
    course_version_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES course_versions(id),
