    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    suspended_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(user_id, course_id, entitlement_id)
);
```

## 14.2 Enrollment Source

```python
class EnrollmentSourceType(StrEnum):
    PURCHASE = "purchase"
    BUNDLE_PURCHASE = "bundle_purchase"
    MEMBERSHIP = "membership"
    FREE_ENROLLMENT = "free_enrollment"
    ADMIN_GRANT = "admin_grant"
```

## 14.3 免费课程

免费课程也应创建 Enrollment，不直接绕过课程访问模型。

```text
用户点击开始学习
→ 校验免费策略
→ 创建 FREE_ENROLLMENT
→ 绑定课程版本
→ 开始记录进度
```

## 14.4 权益事件消费

消费：

```text
entitlement.activated
entitlement.suspended
entitlement.revoked
entitlement.expired
```

行为：

```text
COURSE_ACCESS activated
→ 创建或激活 Enrollment

Entitlement suspended
→ Enrollment SUSPENDED

Entitlement revoked
→ Enrollment REVOKED

Entitlement expired
→ Enrollment EXPIRED
```

使用 Inbox 去重：

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_inbox_events (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    source_event_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    event_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    processing_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    received_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 14.5 访问判定

```python
class CourseAccessDecision(BaseModel):
    allowed: bool
    access_level: str
    reason_code: str | None
    enrollment_id: UUID | None
    expires_at: datetime | None
```

校验顺序：

```text
公开试听
→ 登录状态
→ 用户状态
→ Enrollment 状态
→ Entitlement 状态
→ 访问有效期
→ 课程版本
→ 课时发布状态
→ 释放时间
→ 先修条件
→ 风控限制
```

## 用户 API

```http
POST /api/v1/courses/{course_id}/enroll-free
GET  /api/v1/account/course-enrollments
GET  /api/v1/account/course-enrollments/{enrollment_id}
GET  /api/v1/learning/courses/{course_id}/access
GET  /api/v1/learning/lessons/{lesson_id}/access
```

# 十五、会员与课程访问边界

会员权益可能包含：

```text
全部课程
指定课程
指定分类
每月若干门课程
会员期内访问
会员期结束后继续访问已完成课程
```

这些规则由 Batch 17 会员模块最终定义。

Batch 7 提供标准接口：

```python
await entitlement_gateway.resolve_course_access(
    user_id=user_id,
    course_id=course_id,
)
```

不得在课程代码中硬编码：

```text
premium 会员可以看所有课程
```

## 目标

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

);
```

## 16.2 进度状态

```python
class LessonProgressStatus(StrEnum):
    NOT_STARTED = "not_started"
    IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    RESET = "reset"
```

## 16.3 完成模式

```python
class LessonCompletionMode(StrEnum):
    MANUAL = "manual"
    VIEWED = "viewed"
    VIDEO_THRESHOLD = "video_threshold"
    EXERCISE_PASSED = "exercise_passed"
    ASSIGNMENT_APPROVED = "assignment_approved"
    EXTERNAL_ACTIVITY_COMPLETED = "external_activity_completed"
```

## 16.4 学习事件

```sql
CREATE TABLE learning_events (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    event_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    event_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL,

    received_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

);

## 16.5 课程汇总进度

```text
必修课时已完成数
÷ 必修课时总数
```

以 Basis Points 存储：

```text
8750 = 87.5%
```

选修课时默认不影响课程完成率，但可单独展示。

## 16.6 进度 API

```http
GET  /api/v1/learning/courses/{course_id}/progress
GET  /api/v1/learning/lessons/{lesson_id}/progress

```

## 16.7 多设备同步

更新规则：

```text
完成状态不能因旧设备同步而自动回退
maximum_position_seconds 取最大可信值
last_position_seconds 可随用户当前位置变化
事件按 sequence 和 idempotency_key 去重
冲突时返回当前服务端版本
```

管理员重置进度属于显式操作，要求原因并保留历史。

# 十八、练习安全与隐私

## 答案保护

以下内容不得返回普通答题 API：

```text
answer_key_encrypted
正确答案
评分内部规则
其他用户答案
批改内部备注
```

答案公布策略：

```python
class RevealAnswersPolicy(StrEnum):
    NEVER = "never"
    AFTER_SUBMISSION = "after_submission"
    AFTER_PASS = "after_pass"
    AFTER_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED = "after_attempts_exhausted"
    AFTER_COURSE_END = "after_course_end"
```

## 文件作业

复用 Batch 3 私有媒体或建立私有作业对象：

```text
默认私有
短时上传 URL
MIME 和大小校验
病毒扫描边界
仅学员和授权批改人可访问
退款或账户删除时按保留政策处理
```

## 反思题

反思内容可能涉及关系经历和个人隐私，应：

```text
默认不公开
不用于外部模型训练
不进入普通日志
批改权限单独控制
支持用户删除或隐私流程
```

计划书要求辅导记录和 AI 对话默认不公开；课程反思内容虽然不是 AI 对话，也应采用同等级的最小访问原则。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

---

# 十九、自动评分规则

## 单选

```text
选择与答案键一致
→ 满分
否则
→ 0 分
```

## 多选

默认：

```text
完全一致才得分
```

可配置部分得分，但必须版本化：

```json
{
  "partial_credit": true,
  "incorrect_option_penalty": true,
  "minimum_score": 0
}
```

## 判断

```text
正确 → 满分
错误 → 0
```

## 文本和文件

```text
进入人工批改
```

自动评分应是纯函数：

```python
grade(
    question_snapshot,
    answer_key,
    response,
    grading_schema,
) -> ScoreResult
```

相同快照和答案必须得到相同结果。

CREATE TABLE course_completion_policies (

    policy_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

## 20.2 完成评估

```text
Enrollment ACTIVE
必修课时完成
必修练习通过
课程总体进度满足阈值
当前课程版本要求满足
无待批改的必修作业
无管理员阻止完成标记
```

完成必须由后端重新计算，不能信任前端发送：

```json
{
  "completed": true
}
```

## 20.3 Completion Record

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_completion_records (

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE course_certificates (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    certificate_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    completion_record_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE
        REFERENCES course_completion_records(id),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    course_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id),

    recipient_name_snapshot VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    course_title_snapshot VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,

    issued_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    verification_token_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    certificate_document_media_id UUID REFERENCES media_assets(id),

    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revoked_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 20.5 证书状态

```python
class CertificateStatus(StrEnum):
    PENDING_GENERATION = "pending_generation"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    REVOKED = "revoked"
    REPLACED = "replaced"
```

## 20.6 证书内容

```text
证书编号
学员显示姓名
课程名称
完成日期
VAV 名称
验证二维码
验证地址
```

不得写入未经确认的：

```text
学历学分
专业执照
官方职业认证
心理治疗资格
政府认可
```

## 20.7 证书验证

```http
GET /api/v1/public/certificates/verify/{token}
```

返回最少信息：

```json
{
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "certificate_number": "VAV-C-2026-000001",
    "recipient_name": "Z*** W***",
    "course_title": "Relationship Foundations",
    "issued_at": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z",
    "status": "active"
  }
}
```

用户可以配置是否公开完整姓名；默认遮盖。

## 证书撤销

必须填写原因：

```text
错误颁发
证书信息更正
课程完成记录撤销
安全或欺诈调查
```

撤销不会删除原证书记录。

```text
course:list:{locale}:{filters_hash}:{version}

失效来源：

```text

权益变化

证书状态变化

学习课程结构缓存必须按 Enrollment 和课程版本隔离，不能让旧版本学员读取不兼容的新版本结构。

# 三十、必须通过的课程发布场景

```text
管理员创建课程草稿
配置多语言内容
创建模块和课时
关联讲师
关联 Catalog SKU
发布课程
用户端可以看到

无课时不能发布
必修视频未处理完成不能发布
收费课程没有有效 SKU 不能发布
免费课程未声明免费策略不能发布
练习课没有题目不能发布
先修关系有循环不能发布
完成策略引用不存在课时不能发布
草稿课程不能通过公共 API 访问
```

---

# 三十一、必须通过的购买权限场景

```text
未登录用户只能访问公开试听
已登录但未购买用户不能访问收费课时
支付返回页不能开通课程
COURSE_ACCESS 权益激活后创建 Enrollment
重复权益事件不创建重复 Enrollment
课程套餐购买创建多个 Enrollment
权益暂停后禁止新课时访问
权益恢复后恢复访问
权益过期后停止受限课时访问
已购课程下架后按政策保留或限制访问
不同用户不能使用彼此 Enrollment
```

---

# 三十二、必须通过的视频访问场景

```text
有效 Enrollment 可以创建播放会话
未购买用户不能获得播放 URL
播放 URL 短时失效
原始 S3 Key 不通过 API 返回
Provider Secret 不返回前端
播放会话绑定用户和课时
跨用户使用播放会话被拒绝
重复心跳幂等
不合理播放时间不计入有效观看
拖到视频结尾不自动完成
达到观看阈值后完成课时
视频 Provider 故障不影响图文课时访问
```

AI 或视频子系统故障不能破坏登录、付款以及其他核心访问链路，这符合计划书的解耦原则。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

---

# 三十三、必须通过的进度场景

```text
首次打开课时创建 IN_PROGRESS
多设备同步不回退已完成状态
旧设备位置不能覆盖更高可信进度
同一事件重复提交只处理一次
完成课时更新模块进度
完成模块更新课程进度
选修课默认不阻止课程完成
管理员重置进度必须填写原因
进度重置保留原事件历史
课程版本升级不丢失原进度
```

---

# 三十四、必须通过的练习场景

```text
用户创建答题尝试
自动保存答案
提交后不能静默修改原答案
单选自动评分正确
多选评分规则正确
判断题评分正确
文本题进入人工批改
文件作业保持私有
答案键不返回普通 API
达到尝试上限后不能继续
冷却期生效
批改者只能查看授权范围
反思题需要敏感内容权限
练习通过后解锁后续课时
```

# 三十五、必须通过的完成和证书场景

```text
未完成必修课不能完成课程
未通过必修练习不能完成课程
待人工批改时不能提前完成
满足规则后只创建一条 Completion Record
并发完成检查只颁发一张证书
证书生成失败可以重试
证书编号唯一
公共验证 Token 不可预测
公共验证页最小化个人数据
撤销证书后验证页显示 revoked
重新颁发保留旧证书和替代关系
证书不声明未经确认的官方资质
```

# 三十六、课程版本迁移验收

```text
已发布课程生成不可变版本快照
新 Enrollment 使用最新版本
旧 Enrollment 默认保持原版本
删除旧版本课时不能破坏既有进度
管理员可以运行迁移预览
迁移显示新增、删除和修改课时
迁移前进行兼容性校验
迁移后保留已完成课时映射
无法映射的进度进入人工审核
迁移具有操作者、原因和审计
```

# 三十七、Batch 7 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-07/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-07-courses-learning-progress-certificates
description: Implement VAV course catalogs, bundles, curriculum, secure video access, entitlement-based enrollment, learning progress, exercises, completion certificates and course administration.
---

# Goal

Build a complete course and learning module containing:

- multilingual course catalog;
- instructors;
- modules and lessons;
- course versions;
- course and bundle Catalog integration;
- public preview lessons;
- private video and learning resources;
- short-lived playback authorization;
- entitlement-based enrollment;
- free enrollment;
- lesson, module and course progress;
- multiple-device progress synchronization;
- quizzes, reflection exercises and assignments;
- automatic and manual grading;
- completion-policy evaluation;
- verifiable certificates;
- user-web learning journeys;
- admin-web course operations;
- unit, integration, concurrency, security and E2E tests.

# Source requirements

The project plan requires:

- course display;
- course purchasing;
- access to purchased courses;
- learning progress;
- exercises;
- completion records;
- an administration interface;
- maintainable and transferable implementation.

The project plan does not yet decide whether course videos use an external
platform, private links or platform-managed hosting. Implement a replaceable
video-provider boundary and record the final hosting decision separately.

# Prerequisites

Before implementation:

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 with `make verify`.
3. Verify Batch 2 with `make auth-verify`.
4. Verify Batch 3 with `make cms-verify`.
5. Verify Batch 4 with `make catalog-verify`.
6. Verify Batch 5 with `make commerce-verify`.
7. Verify Batch 6 with `make activity-verify`.
8. Read every skill under `skills/batch-07`.
9. Inspect Catalog SKU, Entitlement, Commerce, Media, RBAC, Audit and Outbox
   contracts.
10. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-07-plan.md`.
11. Record unresolved video hosting, download, certificate, course expiry and
    membership-access policies in the decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. Course domain model and migrations.
2. Instructor and localization models.
3. Course publication and public catalog.
4. Modules, lessons and prerequisite graph.
5. Immutable course versions.
6. Catalog SKU and course-bundle mappings.
7. Video-provider abstraction.
8. Private playback sessions.
9. Entitlement-driven enrollment.
10. Free enrollment.
11. Learning progress and event history.
12. Exercises and assessments.
13. Manual grading workflows.
14. Course completion evaluation.
15. Certificate generation and verification.
16. User-web learning experience.
17. Admin-web course center.
18. Unit, integration, concurrency, security and E2E tests.

# Architecture constraints

- Course is the source of truth for curriculum and learning.
- Catalog is the source of truth for products, SKUs and prices.
- Commerce is the source of truth for orders and payment.
- Entitlements are the source of truth for purchased access rights.
- Media and video providers are the source of truth for stored resources.
- Do not duplicate prices, payments or entitlement states in the Course
  domain.
- Payment return pages must never grant course access.
- Course access must be decided by the backend.
- Frontend route protection is not authorization.
- Course structures must be versioned after publication.
- Existing enrollments must not silently move to incompatible versions.
- Video-provider failure must not break text lessons or core commerce.
- AI availability must not affect course access.

# Course publication invariants

- A published course must have a ready localization.
- A published course must contain at least one published lesson.
- Required lessons must have valid completion rules.
- Paid courses must reference valid Catalog SKUs.
- Free courses must explicitly declare free access.
- Video lessons must reference ready video assets.
- Exercise lessons must reference valid exercises.
- Prerequisite graphs must be acyclic.
- Completion policies must reference valid curriculum elements.
- Draft courses and draft lessons must never appear through public learning
  APIs.

# Versioning invariants

- Every published curriculum creates an immutable course version.
- Enrollments bind to a specific course version.
- Existing enrollments default to their original version.
- Curriculum changes must not silently erase progress.
- Enrollment migration must be explicit, auditable and compatibility checked.
- Existing order and entitlement snapshots must not change when the course
  catalog changes.

# Video-access invariants

- Original private video locations must not be exposed publicly.
- Playback URLs must be short lived.
- Playback sessions must be scoped to user, enrollment, lesson and video.
- Only active and eligible enrollments may create playback sessions.
- Heartbeats must be idempotent and monotonically sequenced.
- Seeking directly to the end must not prove completion.
- Video watch data is completion evidence, not proof of attention or
  understanding.
- Provider secrets must never reach the frontend.
- Video download is disabled unless explicitly enabled per resource.

# Enrollment invariants

- Every paid course enrollment must be backed by an active entitlement.
- Duplicate entitlement events must not create duplicate enrollments.
- Free courses must still create enrollment records.
- Suspended or revoked entitlements must affect access explicitly.
- Users may access only their own enrollments.
- Administrators may grant access only with permission and an audit reason.

# Progress invariants

- Learning events must use idempotency keys.
- Completed lesson state cannot be rolled back by stale client updates.
- Playback maximum position must not decrease.
- Course progress must be derived from the enrollment curriculum version.
- Optional lessons do not block completion unless the policy says otherwise.
- Administrative progress reset must preserve history and require a reason.

# Exercise invariants

- Exercise questions and grading rules must be versioned through attempt
  snapshots.
- Submitted attempts must preserve the original questions and responses.
- Answer keys must never be exposed through learner APIs.
- Automatic grading must be deterministic.
- Manual grading must identify the grader and time.
- Sensitive reflections and assignments require separate permissions.
- File assignments must remain private.
- Exercise attempts must respect maximum-attempt and cooldown policies.

# Completion and certificate invariants

- Course completion must be recalculated by the backend.
- The frontend cannot directly mark a course completed.
- The same enrollment may create only one active completion record.
- Certificate issuance must be idempotent.
- Certificate verification tokens must be unpredictable.
- Public certificate verification must minimize personal data.
- Revoked certificates remain auditable.
- Certificates must not claim government, academic, professional, medical or
  legal recognition unless explicitly supplied and approved.

# Security invariants

- Users may read only courses, enrollments, progress and attempts they are
  authorized to access.
- Preview access must be limited to explicitly previewable lessons.
- Video URLs and assignment files must not leak through public DTOs.
- Answer keys must be encrypted or separately protected at rest.
- Sensitive learner responses must not enter ordinary logs, metrics or
  notification payloads.
- Administrative enrollment, progress, grading and certificate actions must
  use RBAC.
- High-risk actions require explicit reasons.
- All publication, access, grading, completion and certificate transitions
  must be audited.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make course-migrate
make course-seed
make course-test
make course-concurrency-test
make course-security-test
make course-user-e2e
make course-admin-e2e
make course-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Administrators can create multilingual courses.
2. Courses can contain modules and lessons.
3. Lessons support video, text, audio, documents, exercises and assignments.
4. Curriculum prerequisite graphs reject cycles.
5. Published curriculum creates immutable course versions.
6. Course SKUs map to deterministic course access.
7. Course bundles activate every snapshotted included course.
8. Users can access public preview lessons.
9. Unpurchased users cannot access paid lessons.
10. Verified entitlements activate enrollments exactly once.
11. Free courses create normal enrollments.
12. Video playback URLs are short lived.
13. Video playback sessions are user scoped.
14. Video watch progress cannot be completed by seeking to the end.
15. Learning progress synchronizes safely across devices.
16. Completed progress cannot be overwritten by stale updates.
17. Quiz automatic grading works.
18. Manual assignment grading works.
19. Answer keys remain private.
20. Sensitive reflections require separate permissions.
21. Completion policies evaluate required lessons and exercises.
22. Completion creates one completion record.
23. Certificate issuance is idempotent.
24. Public certificate verification works.
25. Certificate revocation works.
26. Users can browse and learn courses through user-web.
27. Administrators can manage curriculum and learners through admin-web.
28. Course concurrency tests pass.
29. Course security tests pass.
30. User course E2E tests pass.
31. Admin course E2E tests pass.
32. `make activity-verify` still succeeds.
33. `make commerce-verify` still succeeds.
34. `make catalog-verify` still succeeds.
35. `make cms-verify` still succeeds.
36. `make auth-verify` still succeeds.
37. `make verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When course-video hosting is unresolved:

1. use the Video Provider interface;
2. configure a local private-storage provider for development;
3. do not hard-code a permanent production provider;
4. record the unresolved decision;
5. continue implementing provider-independent learning capabilities.

When an access-security test fails:

1. stop learning-access development;
2. identify the leaked resource or missing authorization boundary;
3. fix backend authorization and DTO filtering;
4. add a regression test;
5. rerun the full course security suite.

When a progress concurrency test fails:

1. preserve the failing event sequence;
2. identify the missing idempotency, version or monotonicity rule;
3. correct the progress aggregate;
4. add multi-device regression cases;
5. rerun all progress and completion tests.

When a certificate test fails:

1. do not manually insert a replacement certificate;
2. fix completion or issuance idempotency;
3. preserve the original certificate record;
4. add a regression test;
5. rerun completion and certificate suites.
```

# 三、核心架构原则

## 3.1 辅导服务不复制商品和支付

```text
Counseling Service
负责服务内容、时长、适用对象和预约规则。

Catalog Product/SKU
负责销售规格和价格。

COUNSELING_CREDITS
证明用户拥有可消费的辅导次数。

Appointment
负责具体时间、导师和参与者。

Counseling Session
负责实际服务交付和记录。
```

标准关系：

```text
Counseling Service
  └── Service Offering
          └── Catalog SKU
                  ├── Price
                  └── COUNSELING_CREDITS Entitlement
                          └── Appointment
                                  └── Counseling Session
```

不得在预约表内重新保存一套可变价格规则。

## 3.2 日历可用不等于预约已确认

```text
时段看起来可用
→ 用户提交申请
→ 服务端原子占用临时时段
→ 根据策略等待审核或直接确认
→ 必要时完成付款
→ 生成最终 Appointment
```

前端展示的时段只是查询结果，最终必须由后端重新校验。

## 3.3 辅导记录分层

```text
用户可见摘要
导师内部工作记录
风险与转介记录
运营服务记录
审计记录
```

这些数据不得混入同一个通用备注字段。

## 3.4 支付成功不等于辅导完成

```text
支付成功
→ 获得辅导权益或预约资格

实际辅导完成
→ 消费权益
→ 产生 Session Completion
```

不得在支付时直接把服务标记为“已完成”。

# 六、核心状态机

## 6.1 预约状态

```python
class AppointmentStatus(StrEnum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    REQUESTED = "requested"
    PENDING_REVIEW = "pending_review"
    TIME_PROPOSED = "time_proposed"
    APPROVED_PENDING_PAYMENT = "approved_pending_payment"
    PAYMENT_PROCESSING = "payment_processing"
    CONFIRMED = "confirmed"
    RESCHEDULE_REQUESTED = "reschedule_requested"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
    REJECTED = "rejected"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    NO_SHOW = "no_show"
    MANUAL_REVIEW = "manual_review"
```

典型人工确认流程：

```text
REQUESTED
→ PENDING_REVIEW
→ TIME_PROPOSED
→ 用户接受
→ APPROVED_PENDING_PAYMENT
→ PAYMENT_PROCESSING
→ CONFIRMED
→ COMPLETED
```

已有有效次数权益时：

```text
REQUESTED
→ PENDING_REVIEW
→ TIME_PROPOSED
→ 用户接受
→ CONFIRMED
→ COMPLETED
```

## 6.2 时段占用状态

```python
class SlotHoldStatus(StrEnum):
    ACTIVE = "active"

# 九、Skill 8.3：`vav-availability-scheduling-engine`

## 目标

实现重复工作时间、特殊开放时间、请假、时段计算和并发占用。

## 9.1 重复工作时间规则

```sql
CREATE TABLE mentor_availability_rules (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    mentor_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES mentors(id),
    counseling_service_id UUID REFERENCES counseling_services(id),

    timezone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    weekday SMALLINT NOT NULL,
    start_local_time TIME NOT NULL,
    end_local_time TIME NOT NULL,

    valid_from DATE,
    valid_until DATE,

    recurrence_interval_weeks INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    CHECK (weekday BETWEEN 0 AND 6),
    CHECK (start_local_time < end_local_time)
);
```

## 9.2 特殊开放或阻断时间

```sql
CREATE TABLE mentor_schedule_overrides (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    mentor_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES mentors(id),
    counseling_service_id UUID REFERENCES counseling_services(id),

    override_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    reason TEXT NOT NULL,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    CHECK (starts_at < ends_at)
);
```

类型：

```python
class ScheduleOverrideType(StrEnum):
    AVAILABLE = "available"
    BLOCKED = "blocked"
    LEAVE = "leave"
    INTERNAL_EVENT = "internal_event"
```

## 9.3 外部日历阻断边界

```sql
CREATE TABLE mentor_external_calendar_blocks (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    mentor_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES mentors(id),
    provider VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    provider_event_reference_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    sync_version VARCHAR(128),
    synced_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(mentor_id, provider, provider_event_reference_hash)
);
```

本批建立 Adapter 边界，不强制依赖某个日历 Provider。

## 9.4 Slot Hold

```sql
CREATE TABLE counseling_slot_holds (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    mentor_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES mentors(id),
    counseling_service_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES counseling_services(id),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    appointment_id UUID,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    CHECK (starts_at < ends_at)
);
```

PostgreSQL 可使用排斥约束防止重叠：

```sql
EXCLUDE USING gist (
    mentor_id WITH =,
    tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at, '[)') WITH &&
)
WHERE (status IN ('active', 'converted'));
```

## 9.5 可用时段生成顺序

```text
1. 读取导师时区
2. 展开重复排班
3. 合并特殊开放时间
4. 减去请假和阻断时间
5. 减去已确认预约
6. 减去有效 Slot Hold
7. 加入服务前后缓冲
8. 应用每日和每周上限
9. 应用最短提前预约时间
10. 应用最大提前预约天数
11. 转换为用户时区
12. 返回候选时间
```

## API

```http
GET /api/v1/public/counseling-availability
POST /api/v1/counseling/slot-holds
DELETE /api/v1/counseling/slot-holds/{hold_id}
```

查询参数：

```text
mentor_id
service_id
date_from
date_to
user_timezone
```

## 时区规则

数据库统一保存 UTC，排班规则保留导师 IANA 时区。

必须正确处理：

```text
夏令时缺失时刻
夏令时重复时刻
用户时区和导师时区不同
跨日期预约
```

不得只保存固定 UTC Offset。

## 人工确认流程

```text
用户提交预约申请
→ REQUESTED
→ 后台分配导师
→ PENDING_REVIEW
→ 导师或管理员提出时间
→ TIME_PROPOSED
→ 用户接受
→ 原子创建 Slot Hold
→ 根据支付策略进入付款或直接确认
```

## 直接预约流程

```text
用户选择可用时段
→ 创建短时 Slot Hold
→ 提交 Intake
→ 校验资格
→ 有有效权益：CONFIRMED
→ 需付款：PENDING_PAYMENT
```

# 十一、预约并发与幂等

## 最后一个时段

两个用户同时选择同一导师同一时段：

```text
用户 A：成功获得 Slot Hold
用户 B：返回 COUNSELING_SLOT_UNAVAILABLE
```

不得出现两条重叠有效预约。

## 创建预约

需要：

```http
Idempotency-Key: <uuid>
```

相同用户、Key 和请求内容：

```text
返回同一 Appointment
```

相同 Key 不同内容：

```text
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_REQUEST
```

## 时间提议版本

用户接受时间时必须携带：

```json
{
  "time_preference_id": "uuid",
  "expected_appointment_version": 7
}
```

避免用户接受已被导师替换的旧时间。

# 十二、Skill 8.5：`vav-payment-entitlement-integration`

## 目标

连接辅导预约与 Batch 5 订单、支付和 `COUNSELING_CREDITS` 权益。

## 支持的付款策略

```python
class CounselingPaymentTimingPolicy(StrEnum):
    BEFORE_CONFIRMATION = "before_confirmation"
    AFTER_TIME_APPROVAL = "after_time_approval"
    CREDIT_REQUIRED = "credit_required"
    NOT_REQUIRED = "not_required"
```

## 12.1 单次购买

```text
预约时间获批
→ 创建 Pricing Quote
→ 创建订单
→ 用户支付
→ Webhook 确认
→ 创建/激活 COUNSELING_CREDITS
→ 将一份 Credit 预留给 Appointment
→ Appointment CONFIRMED
```

## 12.2 次数包

```text
用户已有 5 次辅导 Credit
→ 预约时锁定 1 次
→ 预约 CONFIRMED
→ 会话完成后正式消费
```

## 12.3 权益预留

```sql
CREATE TABLE counseling_credit_reservations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    entitlement_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES entitlements(id),
    appointment_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE
        REFERENCES counseling_appointments(id),

    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    reserved_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    consumed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    released_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    release_reason VARCHAR(128),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

状态：

```python
class CreditReservationStatus(StrEnum):
    RESERVED = "reserved"
    CONSUMED = "consumed"
    RELEASED = "released"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
```

## 12.4 消费时间

默认：

```text
辅导会话标记 COMPLETED
→ 消费一份 Credit
```

未到政策可配置为：

```python
class NoShowCreditPolicy(StrEnum):
    CONSUME = "consume"
    RELEASE = "release"
    MANUAL_REVIEW = "manual_review"
```

## 12.5 Commerce 事件

消费：

```text
commerce.order.paid
entitlement.activated
entitlement.suspended
entitlement.revoked
refund.succeeded
```

行为：

```text
订单支付成功
→ 检查 Appointment
→ 预留 Credit
→ 确认预约

权益暂停
→ 尚未开始的预约进入 MANUAL_REVIEW

权益撤销
→ 释放未消费预留
→ 预约取消或人工审核

退款成功
→ 根据辅导状态和政策处理 Credit
```

使用 Inbox 去重，重复 Webhook 不得重复确认预约或增加次数。

# 十三、Skill 8.6：`vav-reschedule-cancellation-no-show`

## 目标

实现用户改期、导师改期、取消、迟到和未到处理。

## 13.1 改期请求

```sql
CREATE TABLE counseling_reschedule_requests (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    appointment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES counseling_appointments(id),

    requested_by_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    requested_by_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    reason_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    reason_encrypted TEXT,

    original_starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    original_ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    proposed_starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    proposed_ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 13.2 改期流程

```text
创建新时间临时 Hold
→ 保留原预约
→ 对方接受
→ 原子释放旧时间
→ 新 Hold 转换
→ 更新 Appointment
→ 写历史
```

不能先释放旧时间，再等待新时间确认，否则用户可能同时失去两边。

## 13.3 取消政策快照

```sql
CREATE TABLE counseling_policy_snapshots (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    appointment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES counseling_appointments(id),

    cancellation_policy_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    cancellation_policy_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    cancellation_policy_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

    no_show_policy_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    no_show_policy_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    no_show_policy_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 13.4 用户取消

根据取消距离开始时间：

```text
允许免费取消
→ 释放 Credit
→ 释放时段
→ Appointment CANCELLED

产生取消费用
→ 进入退款/部分退款流程

超过截止时间
→ 根据政策消费 Credit 或人工审核
```

## 13.5 导师取消

通常：

```text
不消费用户 Credit
释放权益预留
优先提供改期
必要时进入全额退款
记录导师取消原因
```

## API

```http
POST /api/v1/account/counseling-appointments/{id}/reschedule
POST /api/v1/account/counseling-reschedule-requests/{id}/accept
POST /api/v1/account/counseling-reschedule-requests/{id}/decline
POST /api/v1/account/counseling-appointments/{id}/cancel

POST /api/v1/admin/counseling-appointments/{id}/reschedule
POST /api/v1/admin/counseling-appointments/{id}/cancel
POST /api/v1/admin/counseling-appointments/{id}/mark-client-no-show
POST /api/v1/admin/counseling-appointments/{id}/mark-mentor-no-show
```

所有后台取消、未到和改期操作必须填写原因。

# 十四、Skill 8.7：`vav-session-delivery-meeting-access`

## 目标

实现辅导会话、线上会议入口、线下地址保护和服务完成。

## 14.1 辅导会话

```sql
CREATE TABLE counseling_sessions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    appointment_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE
        REFERENCES counseling_appointments(id),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    mentor_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES mentors(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    scheduled_starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    scheduled_ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    actual_started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    actual_ended_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    delivery_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    meeting_provider VARCHAR(64),
    meeting_reference_encrypted TEXT,

    location_reference_id UUID,

    client_checked_in_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    mentor_checked_in_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    completion_reason_code VARCHAR(128),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 14.2 Meeting Provider Interface

```python
class CounselingMeetingProvider(Protocol):
    async def create_meeting(
        self,
        request: CreateMeetingRequest,
    ) -> MeetingReference:
        ...

    async def create_participant_join_token(
        self,
        session: CounselingSession,
        principal: MeetingPrincipal,
    ) -> MeetingJoinAuthorization:
        ...

    async def cancel_meeting(
        self,
        meeting_reference: str,
    ) -> None:
        ...
```

## 14.3 安全会议入口

```http
POST /api/v1/account/counseling-sessions/{id}/join
POST /api/v1/mentor/counseling-sessions/{id}/join
```

校验：

```text
用户属于该预约
导师属于该会话
Appointment CONFIRMED
当前时间处于允许加入窗口
会话未取消
账户未暂停
安全限制未生效
```

返回：

```json
{
  "join_url": "short-lived-url",
  "expires_at": "2026-08-01T04:15:00Z"
}
```

不得通过预约详情长期返回会议原始链接。

## 14.4 线下地址

公开服务页只显示：

```text
城市
区域
大致地点
```

完整地址只向：

```text
已确认预约用户
指定导师
授权运营人员
```

在允许时间范围内返回。

## 14.5 会话操作

```http
POST /api/v1/mentor/counseling-sessions/{id}/start
POST /api/v1/mentor/counseling-sessions/{id}/complete
POST /api/v1/mentor/counseling-sessions/{id}/interrupt
POST /api/v1/account/counseling-sessions/{id}/check-in
```

完成会话时：

```text
Session → COMPLETED
Appointment → COMPLETED
Credit Reservation → CONSUMED
创建辅导记录草稿
创建跟进评估任务
发出 session.completed
```

操作必须幂等。

# 十五、录音、录像与转录边界

默认：

```dotenv
COUNSELING_RECORDING_ENABLED=false
COUNSELING_TRANSCRIPTION_ENABLED=false
```

若未来启用，必须具备：

```text
单独明确同意
会话级同意记录
随时撤回
双方可见录制状态
严格访问权限
独立保存期限
删除机制
禁止默认用于模型训练
```

不得以“提高服务质量”为笼统理由默认录制私人辅导。

CREATE TABLE counseling_session_summaries (

# 十七、辅导记录版本与可见性

## 17.1 可见性等级

```python
class CounselingRecordVisibility(StrEnum):
    CLIENT_VISIBLE = "client_visible"
    MENTOR_RESTRICTED = "mentor_restricted"
    SERVICE_TEAM_RESTRICTED = "service_team_restricted"
    SAFETY_TEAM_RESTRICTED = "safety_team_restricted"
```

## 17.2 不允许的行为

```text
把导师内部记录直接发布给用户
把用户可见摘要用作内部风险记录
普通客服查看完整辅导内容
将辅导内容写入普通操作日志
在错误追踪中上传完整请求 Body
把辅导内容用于外部模型训练
```

## 17.3 修改记录

发布后的用户摘要不得静默覆盖：

```text
生成新版本
保留旧版本
记录修改者
记录修改摘要
必要时通知用户
```

## 17.4 删除和保留

具体期限由适用地区政策决定，本批实现配置化：

```dotenv
COUNSELING_CLIENT_SUMMARY_RETENTION_DAYS=0
COUNSELING_MENTOR_NOTE_RETENTION_DAYS=0
COUNSELING_SAFETY_RECORD_RETENTION_DAYS=0
```

`0` 表示尚未由业务和法务确定，不表示永久保留。正式上线前不得使用未确认的保留政策。

# 十八、Skill 8.9：`vav-safety-referral-data-governance`

## 目标

建立服务边界、风险标记、人工转介和敏感数据治理。

计划书要求在涉及自伤、暴力、严重心理健康、人身安全、法律或医疗问题时停止一般关系建议并转介真人或专业支持。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

## 18.1 安全事件

```sql
CREATE TABLE counseling_safety_referrals (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    appointment_id UUID REFERENCES counseling_appointments(id),
    counseling_session_id UUID REFERENCES counseling_sessions(id),

    risk_category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    risk_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    observed_by_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    observed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    observation_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,
    immediate_actions_encrypted JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    assigned_to UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    resolution_encrypted TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 18.2 风险类别

```python
class CounselingRiskCategory(StrEnum):
    SELF_HARM = "self_harm"
    VIOLENCE = "violence"
    ABUSE = "abuse"
    IMMEDIATE_SAFETY = "immediate_safety"
    SEVERE_MENTAL_HEALTH = "severe_mental_health"
    MEDICAL = "medical"
    LEGAL = "legal"
    PASTORAL_ESCALATION = "pastoral_escalation"
    FRAUD_OR_EXPLOITATION = "fraud_or_exploitation"
```

## 18.3 风险等级

```python
class CounselingRiskLevel(StrEnum):
    LOW = "low"
    MODERATE = "moderate"
    HIGH = "high"
    IMMEDIATE = "immediate"
```

## 18.4 安全响应

```text
LOW
→ 普通记录和跟进

MODERATE
→ 提醒导师
→ 建立人工跟进任务

HIGH
→ 停止一般性建议
→ 安全团队人工处理
→ 必要时暂停预约流程

IMMEDIATE
→ 明确停止一般辅导
→ 执行适用地区的紧急响应流程
→ 记录最小必要信息
```

本系统不得自行宣称替代当地紧急服务。

## 18.5 权限隔离

安全记录只能由：

```text
授权安全负责人
指定高级导师
经授权的服务负责人
```

查看。

普通预约运营人员只能看到：

```text
存在处理限制
请联系安全负责人
```

不能看到完整风险详情。

## 18.6 数据加密

以下字段应进行应用层加密：

```text
Intake 敏感答案
导师内部记录
风险观察
安全行动
用户可见摘要
行动项私密描述
跟进详情
会议原始引用
```

加密密钥由 Secret Manager 管理，不能存入数据库。

# 三十八、Batch 8 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-08/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-08-counseling-appointments-followup
description: Implement VAV mentors, counseling services, availability, appointment approval, payment and credit integration, private session records, follow-up and counseling administration.
---

# Goal

Build a complete counseling-service module containing:

- multilingual mentor profiles;
- counseling-service definitions;
- Catalog product and SKU mappings;
- recurring mentor availability;
- schedule overrides and leave;
- timezone-safe available-slot generation;
- short-lived slot holds;
- appointment requests;
- manual confirmation;
- direct-slot booking as a configurable mode;
- mentor assignment;
- candidate-time proposals;
- payment invitations;
- COUNSELING_CREDITS reservation and consumption;
- appointment rescheduling and cancellation;
- no-show handling;
- secure online meeting access;
- in-person location protection;
- counseling-session delivery;
- layered counseling records;
- user action items;
- follow-up plans;
- course, activity and service recommendations;
- safety referral;
- user-web appointment journeys;
- admin-web counseling operations;
- unit, integration, concurrency, security and E2E tests.

# Source requirements

The project plan requires:

- counseling-service presentation;
- mentors;
- appointment applications;
- payment;
- administration processing;
- counseling records;
- later follow-up.

The project plan leaves open whether the first release uses manual confirmation
or directly bookable time slots. Support both through configuration, with
`request_and_confirm` as the protective default.

Counseling services must not be represented as psychotherapy, medical
diagnosis, crisis intervention, legal advice or final pastoral judgment.

# Prerequisites

Before implementation:

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 with `make verify`.
3. Verify Batch 2 with `make auth-verify`.
4. Verify Batch 3 with `make cms-verify`.
5. Verify Batch 4 with `make catalog-verify`.
6. Verify Batch 5 with `make commerce-verify`.
7. Verify Batch 6 with `make activity-verify`.
8. Verify Batch 7 with `make course-verify`.
9. Read every skill under `skills/batch-08`.
10. Inspect Catalog, Commerce, Entitlement, Media, RBAC, Audit and Outbox
    contracts.
11. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-08-plan.md`.
12. Record unresolved scheduling, cancellation, no-show, recording, retention
    and professional-scope policies in the decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. Counseling domain model and migrations.
2. Mentor profiles and service publication.
3. Catalog and SKU mappings.
4. Availability rules and overrides.
5. Timezone-safe slot generation.
6. Atomic slot holds.
7. Appointment request and intake forms.
8. Manual assignment and time proposal.
9. Direct-booking mode.
10. Commerce and entitlement integration.
11. Credit reservation and consumption.
12. Reschedule, cancellation and no-show policies.
13. Secure meeting and location access.
14. Session lifecycle.
15. User-visible summaries and mentor notes.
16. Action items and follow-up plans.
17. Safety referral and data governance.
18. User-web counseling journeys.
19. Admin-web counseling center.
20. Unit, integration, concurrency, security and E2E tests.

# Architecture constraints

- Counseling Service is the source of truth for service delivery rules.
- Catalog is the source of truth for products, SKUs and prices.
- Commerce is the source of truth for orders and payment.
- Entitlements are the source of truth for counseling credits.
- Appointment is the source of truth for a scheduled service.
- Counseling Session is the source of truth for actual delivery.
- Do not duplicate pricing and payment logic in the counseling module.
- A visible slot is not a confirmed booking.
- Final slot assignment must be verified atomically by the backend.
- Payment-return pages never confirm appointments.
- Payment does not mean a session was delivered.
- Credits are consumed only through an explicit delivery or no-show policy.
- AI availability must not affect scheduling, payment or session access.

# Mentor and service invariants

- Public mentor profiles contain only approved public information.
- Mentor credentials and experience must not be fabricated.
- Paused or inactive mentors cannot receive new appointments.
- A published paid service must reference a valid Catalog SKU.
- A free service must explicitly declare free access.
- A published service must declare scope and cancellation policies.
- Service types must not claim unverified therapeutic, medical or legal
  qualifications.

# Scheduling invariants

- Availability rules preserve the mentor's IANA timezone.
- Stored appointment times use UTC.
- Daylight-saving transitions must be tested.
- Schedule overrides take precedence over recurring rules.
- Confirmed appointments and active slot holds block availability.
- Buffer times must be respected.
- Daily and weekly limits must be enforced.
- Slot creation must be concurrency safe.
- Two active appointments may not overlap for the same mentor.
- Expired slot holds must release availability.

# Appointment invariants

- Users may read only their own appointments.
- Mentors may read only assigned appointments.
- Intake responses must be validated against a versioned schema.
- Sensitive intake fields must be encrypted.
- Appointment state transitions must be explicit and auditable.
- Old time proposals cannot be accepted after a newer version is created.
- Manual rejection requires a safe user-facing message and an internal reason.
- Duplicate appointment requests must be idempotent.

# Payment and credit invariants

- Appointment totals come from Catalog and Commerce.
- Frontend-supplied payment status is untrusted.
- Verified Commerce events confirm payment.
- Duplicate payment events cannot confirm an appointment twice.
- A credit reservation belongs to one appointment.
- A credit can be consumed only once.
- Session completion consumes reserved credit idempotently.
- Cancellation and no-show behavior must follow snapshotted policies.
- Refunds and entitlement revocations must project safely into appointments.

# Meeting invariants

- Meeting join URLs must be short lived.
- Join authorization must be scoped to user, appointment and session.
- Raw meeting references and provider secrets must not appear in public APIs.
- Full in-person addresses are visible only to eligible confirmed parties.
- Recording and transcription are disabled by default.
- Recording cannot be enabled without explicit, separate consent.

# Record invariants

- Client-visible summaries and mentor-private notes are separate data types.
- Mentor notes must not be returned through client APIs.
- Ordinary operations staff must not receive private session notes.
- Published client summaries are versioned.
- Sensitive records must be encrypted at rest.
- Counseling content must not enter ordinary logs, metrics or notification
  payloads.
- Counseling content must not be used to train external models without
  explicit authorization.

# Safety invariants

- Safety referral is not medical diagnosis.
- High-risk and immediate-risk records use a restricted permission domain.
- Ordinary schedulers see only the operational restriction, not full details.
- High-risk situations may stop general advice and create human escalation.
- The system must not represent itself as emergency services.
- Safety actions must preserve auditable records with minimal disclosure.

# Security invariants

- Cross-user appointment, session and record access must be rejected.
- Mentor access must be assignment scoped.
- Intake, notes, summaries, follow-ups and safety observations must be
  encrypted or separately protected.
- Meeting URLs and private locations must not leak through public DTOs.
- High-risk administrative actions require explicit reasons.
- RBAC must be enforced by backend dependencies.
- Frontend menu hiding is not authorization.
- All scheduling, appointment, credit, session and record transitions must be
  audited.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make counseling-migrate
make counseling-seed
make counseling-test
make counseling-concurrency-test
make counseling-security-test
make counseling-user-e2e
make counseling-admin-e2e
make counseling-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Administrators can create multilingual mentor profiles.
2. Administrators can publish counseling services.
3. Paid services map to valid Catalog SKUs.
4. Mentor availability supports recurrence and overrides.
5. User and mentor timezones display correctly.
6. Daylight-saving boundary tests pass.
7. Active slot holds prevent double booking.
8. Expired holds release availability.
9. Users can submit appointment requests.
10. Manual mentor assignment works.
11. Candidate-time proposals work.
12. Users can accept or decline proposed times.
13. Direct booking works when explicitly enabled.
14. Payment-return pages cannot confirm appointments.
15. Verified payment events confirm appointments exactly once.
16. Existing counseling credits can reserve appointments.
17. Session completion consumes a credit exactly once.
18. Rescheduling preserves the original appointment until the replacement is
    accepted.
19. Cancellation applies a snapshotted policy.
20. Client and mentor no-show policies work.
21. Meeting join links are short lived and principal scoped.
22. Private addresses remain restricted.
23. Users can view published session summaries.
24. Users cannot view mentor-private notes.
25. Mentors can create action items and follow-up plans.
26. Recommendations reference currently valid services.
27. Safety referrals use restricted permissions.
28. Recording and transcription remain disabled by default.
29. User counseling E2E tests pass.
30. Admin counseling E2E tests pass.
31. Counseling concurrency tests pass.
32. Counseling security tests pass.
33. `make course-verify` still succeeds.
34. `make activity-verify` still succeeds.
35. `make commerce-verify` still succeeds.
36. `make catalog-verify` still succeeds.
37. `make cms-verify` still succeeds.
38. `make auth-verify` still succeeds.
39. `make verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When scheduling or cancellation policy is unresolved:

1. record it in `docs/product/decision-register.md`;
2. expose the policy through validated configuration;
3. choose manual confirmation and least-destructive defaults;
4. do not invent a permanent commercial policy;
5. continue implementing unrelated counseling capabilities.

When a slot concurrency test fails:

1. stop booking feature development;
2. preserve the competing requests;
3. identify the missing exclusion constraint, lock or idempotency boundary;
4. fix the root cause;
5. rerun scheduling, Commerce and Entitlement concurrency suites.

When a counseling-record privacy test fails:

1. stop record-related development;
2. identify every API, cache, log, trace and notification disclosure path;
3. remove the disclosure;
4. add regression coverage;
5. rerun the complete counseling security suite.

When a credit-consumption test fails:

1. do not manually correct the entitlement count;
2. fix reservation or consumption idempotency;
3. preserve the original event history;
4. add a regression test;
5. rerun Commerce, Entitlement and Counseling suites.
```

# 三、核心架构原则

## 3.1 知识库不是文件夹

```text
Knowledge Space
→ Source
→ Document
→ Document Version
→ Parsed Unit
→ Chunk
→ Embedding
→ Search Index
→ Retrieval Result
→ Citation
```

每层都必须可追踪，不能只把文本切成数组后写入向量库。

## 3.2 原始内容、解析内容和检索内容分离

```text
Original Asset
原始文件和校验值

Parsed Document
解析后的结构化正文

Knowledge Chunk
面向检索的最小知识单位

Embedding
特定模型和版本生成的向量

Published Index Version
实际被生产检索使用的版本
```

更新文档时，不得原地覆盖旧版本并失去历史。

## 3.3 授权先于索引

```text
文件已上传
≠ 可以用于 AI

内容可以内部查看
≠ 可以用于 RAG

内容可以用于 RAG
≠ 可以公开引用原文

内容可以公开引用
≠ 可以用于外部模型训练
```

授权范围必须分开记录。

## 3.4 检索时再次执行 ACL

在写入索引前过滤一次并不足够。

每次查询必须重新检查：

```text
知识空间
文档状态
版本状态
授权状态
用户角色
查询用途
语言
有效期
地区限制
敏感等级
```

## 3.5 引用必须绑定具体版本

不能只返回：

```text
来源：《关系课程讲义》
```

必须尽可能返回：

```text
文档
版本
页码或标题路径
Chunk
可展示片段
引用权限
```

# 六、知识库状态机

## 6.1 文档状态

```python
class KnowledgeDocumentStatus(StrEnum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    AUTHORIZATION_PENDING = "authorization_pending"
    AUTHORIZED = "authorized"
    INGESTING = "ingesting"
    PROCESSING = "processing"
    REVIEW_REQUIRED = "review_required"
    READY = "ready"
    PUBLISHED = "published"
    SUSPENDED = "suspended"
    REVOKED = "revoked"
    ARCHIVED = "archived"
    FAILED = "failed"
```

典型流程：

```text
DRAFT
→ AUTHORIZATION_PENDING
→ AUTHORIZED
→ INGESTING
→ PROCESSING
→ REVIEW_REQUIRED
→ READY
→ PUBLISHED
```

风险分支：

```text
授权撤销
→ REVOKED
→ 立即停止新检索
→ 清理缓存
→ 创建索引失效任务
```

## 6.2 处理任务状态

```python
class KnowledgeJobStatus(StrEnum):
    QUEUED = "queued"
    RUNNING = "running"
    SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
    PARTIALLY_SUCCEEDED = "partially_succeeded"
    RETRY_PENDING = "retry_pending"
    FAILED = "failed"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
```

## 6.3 索引版本状态

```python
class KnowledgeIndexStatus(StrEnum):
    BUILDING = "building"
    VALIDATING = "validating"
    READY = "ready"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    SUPERSEDED = "superseded"
    ROLLED_BACK = "rolled_back"
    FAILED = "failed"
```

# 八、Skill 9.2：`vav-content-authorization-governance`

## 目标

实现内容版权、授权范围、引用权限、地区和有效期治理。

计划书将书稿、讲义、课程、文章、案例的授权与优先级列为待确认产品决策，因此不能把已上传内容自动视为已授权 AI 使用。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

## 8.1 授权记录

```sql
CREATE TABLE knowledge_authorizations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    document_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_documents(id),

    authorization_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    rights_holder_name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    authorization_basis VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    allowed_uses JSONB NOT NULL,
    prohibited_uses JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    allowed_regions JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    prohibited_regions JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,

    evidence_media_id UUID REFERENCES media_assets(id),
    evidence_reference TEXT,

    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    revoked_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revocation_reason TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 8.2 授权用途

```python
class KnowledgeAllowedUse(StrEnum):
    INTERNAL_REVIEW = "internal_review"
    RAG_RETRIEVAL = "rag_retrieval"
    INTERNAL_QUOTATION = "internal_quotation"
    PUBLIC_CITATION = "public_citation"
    PARAPHRASE_GENERATION = "paraphrase_generation"
    SUMMARY_GENERATION = "summary_generation"
    EVALUATION = "evaluation"
```

外部模型训练不得被默认包含：

```text
external_model_training
```

如未来需要，必须独立明确授权。

## 8.3 授权来源

```python
class AuthorizationBasis(StrEnum):
    OWNED_BY_VAV = "owned_by_vav"
    WRITTEN_LICENSE = "written_license"
    PUBLIC_DOMAIN = "public_domain"
    CONTRACTUAL_PERMISSION = "contractual_permission"
    USER_SUPPLIED_AUTHORIZED = "user_supplied_authorized"
```

## 8.4 引用权限

```python
class CitationPermission(StrEnum):
    NONE = "none"
    INTERNAL_REFERENCE_ONLY = "internal_reference_only"
    SHORT_PUBLIC_EXCERPT = "short_public_excerpt"
    PUBLIC_TITLE_ONLY = "public_title_only"
```

## 8.5 授权判定

```text
authorization_status == approved
且当前时间在有效期内
且查询用途属于 allowed_uses
且地区不受禁止
且文档未撤销
且调用者具有空间权限
```

否则不得进入生产检索结果。

## 8.6 撤销传播

授权撤销后：

```text
Document → REVOKED
→ 禁止检索
→ 清理检索缓存
→ Active Index 标记该文档不可见
→ 取消待处理任务
→ 记录受影响 Chunk 和 Embedding
→ 产生重建索引任务
→ 写审计
```

历史回答引用可以保留审计记录，但后续查看时应显示：

```text
该来源已撤销或不再可用
```

## 管理 API

```http
GET  /api/v1/admin/knowledge/authorizations
POST /api/v1/admin/knowledge/documents/{id}/authorizations
POST /api/v1/admin/knowledge/authorizations/{id}/approve
POST /api/v1/admin/knowledge/authorizations/{id}/reject
POST /api/v1/admin/knowledge/authorizations/{id}/revoke
GET  /api/v1/admin/knowledge/authorizations/{id}/impact
```

高风险授权操作必须填写原因并保留证据。

# 九、敏感等级与访问策略

```python
class KnowledgeSensitivity(StrEnum):
    PUBLIC = "public"
    INTERNAL = "internal"
    RESTRICTED = "restricted"
    HIGHLY_RESTRICTED = "highly_restricted"
```

## 默认使用规则

| 敏感等级 | AI 可检索 | 可公开引用 | 管理端访问 |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Public | 是 | 按授权 | 一般知识管理员 |
| Internal | 内部 Agent | 否 | 知识管理员 |
| Restricted | 特定 Agent | 否 | 独立权限 |
| Highly restricted | 默认否 | 否 | 特批 |

以下内容默认不得进入普通 AI 知识库：

```text
用户婚恋档案
辅导 Intake
导师私密记录
AI 私人对话
支付信息
安全转介详情
密码、Token 或密钥
未脱敏真实案例
```

# 十、Skill 9.3：`vav-document-ingestion-connectors`

## 目标

实现文件上传、业务内容同步和可替换连接器。

## 10.1 文档版本

```sql
CREATE TABLE knowledge_document_versions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    document_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_documents(id),

    version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    version_label VARCHAR(128),

    source_checksum_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_media_id UUID REFERENCES media_assets(id),

    source_mime_type VARCHAR(128),
    source_filename VARCHAR(500),
    source_byte_size BIGINT,

    source_reference_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    ingestion_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    processing_configuration JSONB NOT NULL,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(document_id, version_number)
);
```

## 10.2 支持格式

第一版：

```text
application/pdf
application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
text/markdown
text/plain
text/html
```

暂不默认支持：

```text
扫描件 OCR
音频转录
视频转录
压缩包批量导入
未知二进制格式
```

OCR 和转录作为高成本、需人工复核的独立 Adapter。

## 10.3 文件上传流程

```text
创建上传任务
→ 返回私有 Presigned URL
→ 上传文件
→ 完成上传
→ 校验大小
→ 校验真实 MIME
→ 校验 SHA-256
→ 病毒扫描 Adapter
→ 创建 Document Version
→ 进入授权审批或解析队列
```

## API

```http
POST /api/v1/admin/knowledge/uploads
POST /api/v1/admin/knowledge/uploads/{id}/complete

POST /api/v1/admin/knowledge/documents
GET  /api/v1/admin/knowledge/documents
GET  /api/v1/admin/knowledge/documents/{id}
POST /api/v1/admin/knowledge/documents/{id}/versions
GET  /api/v1/admin/knowledge/documents/{id}/versions
```

## 10.4 业务连接器

### CMS Connector

只同步：

```text
PUBLISHED
公开或明确允许 AI 使用
当前语言版本
```

### Course Connector

同步：

```text
已发布课程说明
明确授权进入知识库的课时内容
课程学习目标
FAQ
```

默认不同步：

```text
学员答案
反思内容
作业
批改记录
```

### Activity Connector

同步：

```text
已发布活动说明
活动规则
公开 FAQ
```

不把过期活动写死为当前推荐；活动实时可用性由 Batch 10 Tool Calling 查询。

### Counseling Connector

同步：

```text
公开服务说明
服务范围
适合与不适合情形
安全声明
```

不包含真实辅导记录。

class ParsedDocument(BaseModel):

class ParsedBlock(BaseModel):

```text
document_title
heading
paragraph
list_item
quote
table
caption
footnote
code
page_break
```

```text
Unicode 规范化
换行统一
多余空白清理

断行修复
列表层级恢复
标题层级恢复

# 十三、PII 与敏感内容检查

## 13.1 检测结果

```sql
CREATE TABLE knowledge_content_findings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    document_version_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES knowledge_document_versions(id),

    finding_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    block_id UUID REFERENCES knowledge_parsed_blocks(id),

    location_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
    finding_value_hash VARCHAR(128),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',

    reviewed_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    resolution TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

可能发现：

```text
email
phone
address
identity_number
financial_information
private_case_name
medical_information
credential
api_secret
prompt_injection_pattern
```

## 13.2 处理方式

```text
发现密钥或凭证
→ 阻止处理
→ 高严重性告警

发现真实案例个人信息
→ REVIEW_REQUIRED
→ 脱敏或取得明确授权

发现普通联系方式
→ 按文档用途和授权处理

发现 Prompt Injection 内容
→ 标记为不可信内容
→ 检索时作为数据处理，不作为系统指令
```

比较：

新增章节
删除章节
修改段落
授权变化

Embedding 模型变化
检索影响
```

# 十五、Skill 9.6：`vav-semantic-chunking`

## 目标

实现结构感知、可配置、可重建的分块。

## 15.1 Chunk 模型

```sql
CREATE TABLE knowledge_chunks (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    document_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_documents(id),
    document_version_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES knowledge_document_versions(id),

    chunk_version INTEGER NOT NULL,

    chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    chunk_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    sensitivity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    title_path JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    source_block_ids JSONB NOT NULL,

    text_content TEXT NOT NULL,
    text_checksum_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    token_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    character_count INTEGER NOT NULL,

    page_start INTEGER,
    page_end INTEGER,

    previous_chunk_id UUID,
    next_chunk_id UUID,

    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(document_version_id, chunk_version, chunk_index)
);
```

## 15.2 Chunk 策略

优先级：

```text
标题边界
→ 段落边界
→ 列表边界
→ 表格边界
→ 语义边界
→ 最大 Token 限制
```

不得默认在句子中间硬切。

## 15.3 Chunk 类型

```python
class KnowledgeChunkType(StrEnum):
    NARRATIVE = "narrative"
    FAQ = "faq"
    PROCEDURE = "procedure"
    DEFINITION = "definition"
    POLICY = "policy"
    TABLE = "table"
    LIST = "list"
    QUOTE = "quote"
    SERVICE_DESCRIPTION = "service_description"
    SAFETY_BOUNDARY = "safety_boundary"
```

## 15.4 Parent-Child Chunk

支持：

```text
Parent Chunk
较大上下文，用于最终生成

Child Chunk
较小文本，用于精确召回
```

```sql
ALTER TABLE knowledge_chunks
ADD COLUMN parent_chunk_id UUID REFERENCES knowledge_chunks(id);
```

检索时：

```text
Child 命中
→ 返回 Child 评分
→ 根据策略扩展 Parent
```

## 15.5 默认配置

```dotenv
KNOWLEDGE_CHUNK_TARGET_TOKENS=500
KNOWLEDGE_CHUNK_MAX_TOKENS=800
KNOWLEDGE_CHUNK_MIN_TOKENS=100
KNOWLEDGE_CHUNK_OVERLAP_TOKENS=80
KNOWLEDGE_PARENT_CHUNK_MAX_TOKENS=1600
```

以上是技术默认值，应通过评测调整，不能被当成永久最优值。

## 15.6 重复内容

按以下层次检查：

```text
精确 Hash
近似文本 Hash
同文档重复页眉页脚
跨文档重复片段
旧版本重复
```

检索时避免同一段内容以多个版本重复占据 Top K。

# 十六、切分策略注册表

```python
class ChunkingStrategy(Protocol):
    name: str
    version: str

    def chunk(
        self,
        parsed_document: ParsedDocument,
        configuration: ChunkingConfiguration,
    ) -> list[KnowledgeChunkDraft]:
        ...
```

默认策略：

```text
heading_aware_v1
faq_pair_v1
policy_section_v1
table_preserving_v1
course_lesson_v1
```

不同来源可配置不同策略：

```text
FAQ
→ 问题与答案保持同一 Chunk

课程
→ 按课时、标题和概念分块

政策
→ 条款与适用条件保持同块

表格
→ 保留表头并复制到分段表格
```

# 十七、Skill 9.7：`vav-embedding-pgvector`

## 目标

实现可替换 Embedding Provider、向量版本和 pgvector 存储。

## 17.1 Embedding Profile

```sql
CREATE TABLE embedding_profiles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    profile_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    provider VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    model_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    model_revision VARCHAR(128),

    dimensions INTEGER NOT NULL,
    distance_metric VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    supported_locales JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    configuration JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 17.2 Embedding 表

维度必须与启用的 Profile 一致。实际迁移可按确定后的模型维度生成专用列或采用受控多表方案。

```sql
CREATE TABLE knowledge_embeddings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    chunk_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_chunks(id),
    embedding_profile_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES embedding_profiles(id),

    embedding VECTOR NOT NULL,

    input_checksum_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    token_count INTEGER NOT NULL,

    provider_request_reference_hash VARCHAR(128),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(chunk_id, embedding_profile_id)
);
```

## 17.3 Embedding Provider

```python
class EmbeddingProvider(Protocol):
    async def embed_documents(
        self,
        texts: list[str],
        profile: EmbeddingProfile,
    ) -> list[EmbeddingResult]:
        ...

    async def embed_query(
        self,
        text: str,
        profile: EmbeddingProfile,
    ) -> EmbeddingResult:
        ...
```

## 17.4 批处理

```text
按 Token 总量分批
按 Provider 限流
失败项独立重试
保存输入 Hash
同模型同文本复用向量
记录成本和延迟
```

## 17.5 模型变更

Embedding 模型改变时：

```text
新建 Embedding Profile
→ 重新生成向量
→ 构建新 Index Version
→ 运行评测
→ 通过后切换
```

不能在旧向量列上直接混用不同模型。

## 17.6 向量检索

```sql
SELECT
    chunk_id,
    embedding <=> :query_embedding AS distance
FROM knowledge_embeddings
WHERE embedding_profile_id = :profile_id
ORDER BY embedding <=> :query_embedding
LIMIT :candidate_count;
```

实际距离运算符必须与 Profile 的距离度量一致，并通过测试固定。

# 十八、全文索引

## 18.1 Search Document

```sql
CREATE TABLE knowledge_search_documents (
    chunk_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES knowledge_chunks(id),

    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    search_vector TSVECTOR NOT NULL,

    title_text TEXT,
    body_text TEXT NOT NULL,

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 18.2 多语言策略

```text
英文
→ 对应英文全文配置

简体/繁体中文
→ 使用可替换中文分词 Adapter
→ 无可靠分词时保留 trigram/关键词扩展边界
```

不要把英文 Tokenizer 直接假定适用于中文。

## 18.3 查询扩展

支持受控扩展：

```text
同义词
简称
课程名称
服务别名
简繁体映射
常见拼写变体
```

同义词表必须版本化和审计。

# 十九、Skill 9.8：`vav-hybrid-retrieval-reranking`

## 目标

实现向量＋关键词＋元数据＋重排的混合检索。

## 19.1 检索请求

```python
class KnowledgeRetrievalRequest(BaseModel):
    query: str
    knowledge_space_codes: list[str]

    locale: str
    fallback_locales: list[str] = []

    purpose: str
    principal: RetrievalPrincipal

    top_k: int = 8
    candidate_count: int = 40

    filters: RetrievalFilters
    citation_mode: str
```

## Principal

```python
class RetrievalPrincipal(BaseModel):
    user_id: UUID | None
    roles: list[str]
    permissions: list[str]
    region_code: str | None
    agent_id: str
```

## 19.2 检索步骤

```text
1. 输入验证
2. Prompt Injection 模式检查
3. 知识空间授权
4. 查询语言识别
5. Query Embedding
6. 向量候选召回
7. 全文候选召回
8. 元数据过滤
9. 文档授权过滤
10. 敏感级别 ACL
11. 版本和有效期过滤
12. 候选融合
13. 去重
14. 重排
15. 多样性选择
16. Parent Context 扩展
17. 引用构建
18. 返回 Retrieval Bundle
```

## 19.3 候选融合

建议使用可替换融合策略：

```python
class FusionStrategy(StrEnum):
    RECIPROCAL_RANK_FUSION = "reciprocal_rank_fusion"
    WEIGHTED_SCORE = "weighted_score"
```

默认先使用 RRF 类策略，避免直接比较不同评分空间的原始数值。

## 19.4 重排接口

```python
class Reranker(Protocol):
    async def rerank(
        self,
        query: str,
        candidates: list[RetrievalCandidate],
        top_k: int,
    ) -> list[RerankedCandidate]:
        ...
```

重排失败时：

```text
回退到融合排序
记录降级
不阻断核心检索
```

## 19.5 Retrieval Bundle

```python
class RetrievalBundle(BaseModel):
    query_id: UUID
    index_version_id: UUID

    results: list[RetrievedKnowledge]
    warnings: list[str]

    retrieval_trace: RetrievalTraceSummary
```

## Result

```python
class RetrievedKnowledge(BaseModel):
    chunk_id: UUID
    document_id: UUID
    document_version_id: UUID

    text: str
    title_path: list[str]

    relevance_score: float
    vector_rank: int | None
    lexical_rank: int | None
    rerank_score: float | None

    citation: KnowledgeCitation
    authorization_scope: str
```

# 二十、检索过滤和时效性

## 必须支持

```text
knowledge_space
locale
document_type
source_type
sensitivity
valid_from
valid_until
published_version
authorization_use
region
tag
course_id
activity_id
service_id
```

## 动态业务内容

以下内容不应仅依赖 RAG：

```text
当前可报名活动
当前课程价格
当前可预约导师
实时名额
订单状态
会员权益
```

知识库可以解释服务是什么；实时状态必须由 Batch 10 Tool Calling 查询。

这符合计划书“通过 Tool Calling 读取已发布活动、课程与可预约辅导服务，不把过期内容写死在 Prompt”的要求。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

---

# 二十一、Prompt Injection 内容防护

知识文档可能包含：

```text
忽略系统提示
泄露内部配置
调用某个工具
把用户数据发送出去
```

这些内容必须作为**被检索数据**，不能升级为系统指令。

## 处理规则

```text
文档文本永远是 data
系统指令只能来自受控 Prompt Registry
检索结果使用明确分隔结构
禁止把文档中的工具调用描述直接执行
检测到注入模式时降低信任或排除
记录安全事件
```

Retrieval Result 包装：

```json
{
  "source_type": "knowledge_chunk",
  "trust_level": "authorized_content",
  "content": "...",
  "instructions_allowed": false
}
```

# 二十二、Skill 9.9：`vav-citation-provenance`

## 目标

实现从回答引用追踪到原始文件位置的完整证据链。

## 22.1 Citation 模型

```sql
CREATE TABLE knowledge_citations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    query_id UUID NOT NULL,
    chunk_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_chunks(id),

    document_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_documents(id),
    document_version_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES knowledge_document_versions(id),

    citation_label VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,

    page_start INTEGER,
    page_end INTEGER,
    section_path JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    excerpt_text TEXT,
    excerpt_checksum_sha256 VARCHAR(64),

    citation_permission VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    source_locator JSONB NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 22.2 查询记录

```sql
CREATE TABLE knowledge_retrieval_queries (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    query_text_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,
    query_text_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    principal_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
    purpose VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    knowledge_space_ids JSONB NOT NULL,
    index_version_ids JSONB NOT NULL,

    retrieval_configuration JSONB NOT NULL,

    candidate_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    result_count INTEGER NOT NULL,

    duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 22.3 引用展示

公开引用可返回：

```json
{
  "citation_id": "uuid",
  "label": "《关系成长课程》第 2 章",
  "page": 18,
  "section": ["第二章", "边界"],
  "excerpt": "..."
}
```

内部引用可返回：

```json
{
  "citation_id": "uuid",
  "label": "内部讲义 DOC-102 v3",
  "section": ["主动性", "行动建议"],
  "excerpt": null
}
```

## 22.4 引用片段规则

只有授权为：

```text
SHORT_PUBLIC_EXCERPT
```

时才向终端用户返回原文片段。

若只允许内部引用：

```text
返回标题或内部引用编号
不返回原文
```

## 22.5 引用验证

```http
GET /api/v1/internal/knowledge/citations/{citation_id}
```

应验证：

```text
文档存在
版本一致
Chunk Hash 一致
位置存在
授权仍有效
引用片段没有被篡改
```

# 二十三、回答与引用绑定边界

Batch 9 返回：

```text
Retrieval Bundle
候选知识
Citation IDs
引用权限
```

Batch 10 生成回答后保存：

```text
回答中哪一条陈述使用了哪些 Citation
哪些内容是模型推理
哪些内容没有直接来源
```

      "claim_id": "c1",
      "text": "建议先明确双方对关系阶段的理解。",
      "citation_ids": ["citation-1", "citation-2"],
      "support_level": "supported"
    }
  ]
}
```

# 二十四、Skill 9.10：`vav-rag-evaluation-datasets`

## 目标

建立检索基准、引用基准、ACL 基准和版本回归评测。

计划书要求至少建立 30 条典型辅导测试案例，记录回答质量、越界风险和推荐准确性。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

Batch 9 先建立知识检索层评测；Batch 10 在其上增加完整回答评测。

## 24.1 Evaluation Dataset

```sql
CREATE TABLE knowledge_evaluation_datasets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    dataset_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,

    purpose VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    locale VARCHAR(16),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 24.2 Evaluation Case

```sql
CREATE TABLE knowledge_evaluation_cases (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    dataset_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES knowledge_evaluation_datasets(id),

    case_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    query_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    query_locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    principal_fixture JSONB NOT NULL,
    filters_fixture JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    expected_document_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    expected_chunk_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    required_concepts JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    forbidden_document_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    expected_citation_policy VARCHAR(32),

    category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    difficulty VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(dataset_id, case_code)
);
```

## 24.3 基础案例分类

至少包含：

```text
直接事实查找
概念解释
跨章节综合
FAQ
服务范围
安全边界
多语言
简繁体映射
同义词
过期版本
冲突版本
授权撤销
Restricted ACL
Prompt Injection 文档
无答案
低相关度
活动实时性边界
课程实时性边界
辅导服务实时性边界
```

## 24.4 Retrieval Run

```sql
CREATE TABLE knowledge_evaluation_runs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    dataset_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES knowledge_evaluation_datasets(id),

    index_version_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES knowledge_index_versions(id),

    retrieval_configuration JSONB NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    metrics JSONB,
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)
);
```

## 24.5 指标

```text
Recall@K
Precision@K
MRR
NDCG
Expected Document Hit Rate
Expected Chunk Hit Rate
Forbidden Document Leakage Rate
Citation Locator Accuracy
Authorization Violation Rate
No-answer Correctness
Latency P50/P95
Embedding Cost
Reranking Cost
```

## 24.6 发布门禁

新 Index Version 激活前必须达到：

```text
授权违规率 = 0
Forbidden Document Leakage = 0
核心安全边界案例全部通过
引用位置正确率达到项目阈值
整体召回不低于当前生产版本允许的回归阈值
```

具体业务阈值写入配置和验收文档，不在代码中假定唯一标准。

# 四十二、Batch 9 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-09/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-09-knowledge-rag-retrieval
description: Implement VAV knowledge spaces, content authorization, document ingestion, versioned parsing, semantic chunking, embeddings, pgvector hybrid retrieval, citations, evaluation datasets and the administration knowledge center.
---

# Goal

Build a production-oriented knowledge and retrieval platform containing:

- isolated knowledge spaces;
- content sources;
- document and version management;
- copyright and usage authorization;
- private file ingestion;
- CMS, course, activity and counseling source connectors;
- structured parsing;
- normalization;
- PII and secret findings;
- semantic chunking;
- parent-child chunks;
- replaceable embedding providers;
- pgvector storage;
- PostgreSQL full-text retrieval;
- hybrid ranking;
- replaceable reranking;
- runtime ACL filtering;
- citation and provenance tracking;
- retrieval-query audit;
- at least thirty evaluation cases;
- blue-green index publication;
- index rollback;
- an administration knowledge center;
- unit, integration, retrieval, security and E2E tests.

# Source requirements

The project plan requires:

- PostgreSQL and pgvector;
- optional full-text search;
- knowledge from Hanna's materials, courses, activities and FAQ content;
- visible sources or internal references;
- Tool Calling for current activity, course and counseling availability;
- at least thirty representative AI evaluation cases;
- tracking of model latency, failures, tokens and costs.

This batch implements the trusted knowledge and retrieval layer.
Conversation orchestration, response generation, risk classification, service
recommendations and human escalation belong to Batch 10.

# Prerequisites

Before implementation:

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 with `make verify`.
3. Verify Batch 2 with `make auth-verify`.
4. Verify Batch 3 with `make cms-verify`.
5. Verify Batch 4 with `make catalog-verify`.
6. Verify Batch 5 with `make commerce-verify`.
7. Verify Batch 6 with `make activity-verify`.
8. Verify Batch 7 with `make course-verify`.
9. Verify Batch 8 with `make counseling-verify`.
10. Read every skill under `skills/batch-09`.
11. Inspect Media, CMS, Course, Activity, Counseling, RBAC, Audit and Outbox
    contracts.
12. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-09-plan.md`.
13. Record unresolved source authorization, embedding-provider, retention and
    public-citation decisions in the decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. Knowledge-space domain and migrations.
2. Source and document models.
3. Authorization and usage-policy models.
4. File-upload and source connectors.
5. Structured parsers.
6. Text normalization and quality reports.
7. PII, secret and injection findings.
8. Immutable document versions.
9. Semantic chunking and parent-child chunks.
10. Embedding-provider abstraction.
11. pgvector storage.
12. PostgreSQL full-text indexing.
13. Hybrid retrieval.
14. ACL, authorization and validity filtering.
15. Reranking and fallback.
16. Citation and provenance tracking.
17. Blue-green index publication and rollback.
18. Evaluation datasets and quality gates.
19. Admin-web knowledge center.
20. Unit, integration, retrieval, security and E2E tests.

# Architecture constraints

- A knowledge space is an explicit security and purpose boundary.
- Documents must not enter production retrieval without valid authorization.
- Original files, parsed documents, chunks, embeddings and indexes are
  separate versioned artifacts.
- Published document versions are immutable.
- Updating a source creates a new document version.
- Changing chunking configuration creates a new chunk version.
- Changing the embedding model creates a new embedding profile and index.
- Production index activation must be atomic and reversible.
- Existing active indexes must remain available while a new index builds.
- Retrieval must not depend on AI conversation services being available.
- Current prices, availability and operational states must come from tools,
  not stale knowledge chunks.

# Authorization invariants

- File upload does not imply AI-use authorization.
- Internal viewing does not imply RAG authorization.
- RAG authorization does not imply public quotation permission.
- External model training is never authorized by default.
- Authorization use, region, validity and citation permission must be
  explicit.
- Revoked and expired authorization must stop new retrieval immediately.
- Authorization changes must invalidate caches and active visibility.
- Authorization evidence must remain private.
- Authorization approval and knowledge processing permissions must be
  separable.

# Ingestion invariants

- Original assets are private.
- File MIME type, size and checksum must be verified.
- Every ingestion attempt references an immutable document version.
- Processing jobs must be idempotent and retryable.
- Failed new versions must not damage the active published version.
- Low-quality parsing must enter human review.
- Parsers must preserve title paths, pages, blocks and source locators where
  available.
- Raw secrets and credentials must block publication.

# Chunking invariants

- Chunks must preserve document and version identity.
- Chunks must preserve source block IDs, page ranges and title paths.
- Chunk boundaries should respect semantic and structural boundaries.
- FAQ questions and answers must remain connected.
- Table segments must preserve headers.
- Parent-child relationships must be explicit.
- Duplicate current and superseded content must not dominate retrieval.
- Published chunks must never be edited in place.

# Embedding invariants

- Embeddings bind to one explicit embedding profile.
- Profile dimensions and distance metrics must be validated.
- Different models must not be silently mixed.
- The same text and profile may reuse a verified embedding.
- Embedding failures must be independently retryable.
- A new embedding profile must build a new index version.
- Sensitive unauthorized content must not be sent to an external provider.
- Token, latency, failure and cost information must be observable.

# Retrieval invariants

- Retrieval must apply knowledge-space, authorization, ACL, sensitivity,
  region, locale, version and validity filters.
- Filtering must occur at query time even when indexing already filtered.
- Retrieval caches must include the caller's permission scope.
- Vector, lexical and reranking scores must not be compared without an
  explicit fusion strategy.
- Fusion ordering must be deterministic.
- Reranker failure must degrade safely.
- The system may return fewer than `top_k` results.
- Irrelevant chunks must not be returned merely to fill a result count.
- Prompt instructions found inside knowledge documents are untrusted data.
- Retrieved document text must never directly authorize tool execution.

# Citation invariants

- Every retrieved result must include document, version and chunk identity.
- Citations must preserve source locators.
- Page and section information must be returned when available.
- Public excerpts require explicit quotation permission.
- Internal-reference-only sources must not expose source text publicly.
- Citation excerpts must be hash-verifiable.
- Revoked citations remain auditable but show unavailable status.
- A citation must never point to a different document version silently.

# Evaluation invariants

- The initial evaluation dataset must contain at least thirty cases.
- Evaluation must cover relevance, multilingual search, ACL, authorization,
  expired content, conflicting versions, no-answer behavior and injection
  resistance.
- New indexes must be compared with the active index.
- Authorization violations must be zero.
- Forbidden-document leakage must be zero.
- Core safety-boundary cases must pass before activation.
- Failed quality gates must prevent production index activation.

# Privacy and security invariants

- Dating profiles, private counseling records, assignments and AI
  conversations are excluded by default.
- Sensitive source text must not enter ordinary logs or metrics.
- Query text must be encrypted when persisted.
- High-privilege retrieval results must not be served from a low-privilege
  cache entry.
- Secrets detected in source content must block publication.
- Public APIs must never return embeddings, private storage keys or
  authorization evidence.
- All authorization, publication, rollback and sensitive review actions must
  be audited.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make knowledge-migrate
make knowledge-seed
make knowledge-ingest-fixtures
make knowledge-build-index
make knowledge-test
make knowledge-retrieval-test
make knowledge-security-test
make knowledge-eval
make knowledge-admin-e2e
make knowledge-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Administrators can create isolated knowledge spaces.
2. Administrators can upload supported document formats.
3. Uploaded documents remain private.
4. Documents require valid authorization before production retrieval.
5. Authorization use and citation permissions are independently enforced.
6. CMS content can be synchronized.
7. Course content can be synchronized without learner submissions.
8. Activity content can be synchronized without stale live availability.
9. Counseling service content can be synchronized without private records.
10. Parsers preserve structural and source-locator information.
11. Low-quality parsing enters human review.
12. Secret findings block publication.
13. Every source update creates a new document version.
14. Semantic chunks preserve provenance.
15. Parent-child retrieval works.
16. Embeddings are versioned by profile.
17. pgvector similarity retrieval works.
18. Full-text retrieval works.
19. Hybrid fusion works deterministically.
20. Runtime ACL filtering works.
21. Authorization revocation immediately stops retrieval.
22. Cross-role retrieval-cache leakage is prevented.
23. Reranking works or degrades safely.
24. Retrieval may return a supported no-answer result.
25. Citations identify document, version, chunk and source location.
26. Public excerpts respect quotation permission.
27. Blue-green index activation works.
28. Index rollback works.
29. At least thirty evaluation cases exist.
30. Evaluation covers ACL, authorization, multilingual, no-answer and
    injection cases.
31. Failed quality gates block index activation.
32. Admin knowledge-center E2E tests pass.
33. Knowledge security tests pass.
34. Knowledge retrieval tests pass.
35. `make counseling-verify` still succeeds.
36. `make course-verify` still succeeds.
37. `make activity-verify` still succeeds.
38. `make commerce-verify` still succeeds.
39. `make catalog-verify` still succeeds.
40. `make cms-verify` still succeeds.
41. `make auth-verify` still succeeds.
42. `make verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When source authorization is unclear:

1. keep the document outside production retrieval;
2. mark it `AUTHORIZATION_PENDING`;
3. record the missing evidence;
4. do not infer permission from possession of the file;
5. continue processing only where internal review is authorized.

When a retrieval ACL test fails:

1. stop retrieval-related feature development;
2. invalidate affected caches;
3. identify the missing principal, filter or policy boundary;
4. fix the backend filtering;
5. add a regression case;
6. rerun all security and evaluation suites.

When an index evaluation regresses:

1. do not activate the new index;
2. preserve the failed run and configuration;
3. compare candidate recall, fusion, reranking and filtering stages;
4. correct the root cause;
5. rerun the full evaluation dataset.

When an active source authorization is revoked:

1. fail closed;
2. stop returning the source immediately;
3. invalidate caches;
4. schedule index repair;
5. preserve historical audit and citation identity;
6. do not silently delete evidence.
```
