    asset_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    field_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,

    sensitivity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    data_category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    encryption_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    masking_policy_code VARCHAR(128),
    access_policy_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    log_policy VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    export_policy VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    erasure_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    approved_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(asset_code, field_path)
);
```

## 21.3 示例分类

| 数据 | 等级 |
|---|---|
| 公开课程标题 | Public |
| 内部商品备注 | Internal |
| 邮箱、手机号 | Confidential |
| 婚恋档案、AI 对话 | Restricted |
| 导师私密记录、安全转介、密钥 | Highly Restricted |

## 21.4 加密信封

建议：

```text
Data Encryption Key
→ 加密字段

Key Encryption Key
→ 加密 Data Encryption Key

Secret Manager/KMS
→ 管理 Key Encryption Key
```

数据库只保存：

```text
ciphertext
key_reference
algorithm
version
```

## 21.5 可搜索字段

需要按邮箱或电话搜索时保存：

```text
encrypted_value
＋
normalized HMAC
```

不能保存无盐普通 SHA-256 作为低熵手机号的唯一保护。

---

# 二十二、API 脱敏

```python
class MaskingPolicy(StrEnum):
    NONE = "none"
    EMAIL_PARTIAL = "email_partial"
    PHONE_PARTIAL = "phone_partial"
    NAME_PARTIAL = "name_partial"
    CITY_ONLY = "city_only"
    YEAR_ONLY = "year_only"
    REDACTED = "redacted"
```

示例：

```text
user@example.com → u***@example.com
+886912345678    → +886******678
赵某某             → 赵**
完整地址           → 城市级
出生日期           → 年龄范围
```

掩码不能代替权限检查；无权限者应优先根本不获取字段。

---

# 二十三、Break-glass 紧急访问

## 23.1 Access Grant

```sql
CREATE TABLE privacy_break_glass_access (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    request_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    requester_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    subject_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    data_scope JSONB NOT NULL,
    purpose VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    reason_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    used_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 23.2 适用场景

```text
安全事件
已批准的高风险转介
严重账户接管调查
重大支付欺诈调查
```

不适用于普通客服好奇查看。

## 23.3 必须满足

```text
明确目的
最小范围
短时有效
独立审批
访问审计
访问后复核
```

---

# 二十四、Skill 12.10：`vav-ai-memory-authorization`

## 目标

实现 AI 长期记忆的显式授权、事实/推断区分、编辑、删除和过期。

## 24.1 AI 记忆偏好

```sql
CREATE TABLE ai_memory_preferences (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id),

    long_term_memory_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    allow_profile_facts BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    allow_service_history BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    allow_relationship_context BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    allow_cross_conversation_use BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    consent_id UUID REFERENCES user_consents(id),

    settings_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 24.2 Memory Item

```sql
CREATE TABLE ai_memory_items (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    memory_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    content_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    source_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_reference_id UUID,

    provenance_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

    certainty VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    user_confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    allowed_purposes JSONB NOT NULL,
    allowed_agent_profiles JSONB NOT NULL,

    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    last_used_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 24.3 Memory Type

```python
class AiMemoryType(StrEnum):
    USER_PREFERENCE = "user_preference"
    STATED_GOAL = "stated_goal"
    RELATIONSHIP_CONTEXT = "relationship_context"
    SERVICE_PREFERENCE = "service_preference"
    COMMUNICATION_PREFERENCE = "communication_preference"
    USER_CONFIRMED_FACT = "user_confirmed_fact"
    MODEL_INFERENCE = "model_inference"
```

## 24.4 Certainty

```python
class MemoryCertainty(StrEnum):
    USER_CONFIRMED = "user_confirmed"
    USER_STATED = "user_stated"
    INFERRED_LOW = "inferred_low"
    INFERRED_MEDIUM = "inferred_medium"
```

模型推断默认不能直接变成 Active 长期记忆。

## 24.5 记忆候选流程

```text
Agent 提出记忆候选
→ 检查长期记忆同意
→ 检查记忆类型是否允许
→ 检查敏感字段
→ 用户确认或按低风险规则保存
→ ACTIVE
```

以下默认禁止自动记忆：

```text
密码和认证信息
支付信息
身份证件
精确家庭地址
医疗诊断
法律问题
安全转介详情
第三方敏感信息
模型对用户人格的武断判断
```

## 用户 API

```http
GET  /api/v1/account/ai-memory/preferences
PUT  /api/v1/account/ai-memory/preferences

GET    /api/v1/account/ai-memory/items
PATCH  /api/v1/account/ai-memory/items/{id}
DELETE /api/v1/account/ai-memory/items/{id}

POST /api/v1/account/ai-memory/items/{id}/approve
POST /api/v1/account/ai-memory/items/{id}/reject
POST /api/v1/account/ai-memory/clear-all
```

# 二十五、关闭 AI 长期记忆

用户关闭后：

```text
停止读取长期记忆
停止写入长期记忆
取消待批准记忆候选
清除记忆缓存
询问是否删除已有记忆
保留关闭同意的审计
```

用户选择“全部删除”：

```text
删除 Memory Item 内容
删除向量或搜索投影
删除缓存
保留最小审计元数据
```

不得继续以会话摘要名义暗中保留跨会话记忆。

# 三十三、环境变量

```dotenv
# Privacy
PRIVACY_ENABLED=true
PRIVACY_DEFAULT_MODE=strict
PRIVACY_REQUIRE_REAUTH_FOR_EXPORT=true
PRIVACY_REQUIRE_REAUTH_FOR_ERASURE=true

# Data subject requests
PRIVACY_REQUEST_DEFAULT_DUE_DAYS=30
PRIVACY_REQUEST_IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_TTL_MINUTES=30
PRIVACY_REQUEST_MAX_ACTIVE_PER_USER=3

# Export
PRIVACY_EXPORT_FORMATS=json,csv,html
PRIVACY_EXPORT_DOWNLOAD_TTL_HOURS=24
PRIVACY_EXPORT_ARCHIVE_RETENTION_DAYS=7
PRIVACY_EXPORT_MAX_SIZE_MB=1024
PRIVACY_EXPORT_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED=true

# Erasure
PRIVACY_ERASURE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED=true
PRIVACY_ERASURE_COOLING_OFF_DAYS=7
PRIVACY_ERASURE_MAX_ATTEMPTS=10
PRIVACY_ERASURE_RETRY_SECONDS=300
PRIVACY_ERASURE_FAIL_CLOSED=true

# Retention
PRIVACY_RETENTION_JOB_INTERVAL_HOURS=24
PRIVACY_RETENTION_POLICY_REQUIRED=true
PRIVACY_ALLOW_UNBOUNDED_RETENTION=false

# Sensitive data
PRIVACY_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED=true
PRIVACY_SEARCH_HMAC_PEPPER=
PRIVACY_BREAK_GLASS_DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES=30
PRIVACY_BREAK_GLASS_APPROVAL_REQUIRED=true

# AI memory
AI_LONG_TERM_MEMORY_ENABLED=true
AI_LONG_TERM_MEMORY_OPT_IN_REQUIRED=true
AI_LONG_TERM_MEMORY_DEFAULT=false
AI_MEMORY_DEFAULT_TTL_DAYS=365
AI_MEMORY_INFERRED_ITEM_USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED=true
AI_EXTERNAL_TRAINING_DEFAULT=false

# Audit
PRIVACY_SENSITIVE_ACCESS_AUDIT_ENABLED=true
PRIVACY_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS=730
```

`PRIVACY_ALLOW_UNBOUNDED_RETENTION=false` 表示正式策略必须有期限或明确的持续复核机制。

	docker compose exec api pytest tests/privacy/concurrency -q

privacy-retention-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/privacy/retention -q

privacy-user-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test e2e/user-privacy

privacy-admin-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test e2e/admin-privacy

privacy-verify:
	$(MAKE) privacy-migrate
	$(MAKE) privacy-seed
	$(MAKE) privacy-seed-inventory
	$(MAKE) privacy-test
	$(MAKE) privacy-security-test
	$(MAKE) privacy-concurrency-test
	$(MAKE) privacy-retention-test
	$(MAKE) privacy-user-e2e
	$(MAKE) privacy-admin-e2e
```

# 三十六、必须通过的用户资料场景

```text
用户可以查看自己的基础资料
用户可以修改显示名称、城市、语言和时区
用户不能读取其他用户私密资料
联系方式默认不可公开
新联系方式必须单独验证
法律姓名不作为默认显示名称
出生日期不通过普通 API 公开
资料更新使用乐观锁

# 四十五、Batch 12 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-12/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-12-privacy-data-rights-ai-memory
description: Implement VAV user profiles, privacy controls, consent management, data inventories, exports, corrections, erasure, retention, sensitive-data governance, AI memory authorization and the privacy administration center.
---

# Goal

Build a production-oriented privacy control plane containing:

- general user profiles;
- separately managed contact points;
- privacy modes;
- field-level visibility;
- purpose-based data access;
- versioned consent definitions and releases;
- consent evidence and withdrawal;
- data-asset inventory;
- processing-activity inventory;
- module-level privacy-provider contracts;
- data inventory requests;
- encrypted data exports;
- correction requests;
- account deletion and anonymization planning;
- module-level erasure jobs;
- retention policies;
- legal and security holds;
- field sensitivity classifications;
- application-layer encryption;
- masking policies;
- sensitive-access audit;
- break-glass access;
- AI long-term-memory consent;
- memory review, editing and deletion;
- user-web privacy center;
- admin-web privacy operations;
- unit, integration, concurrency, retention, security and E2E tests.

# Source requirements

The project plan requires:

- sensitive dating, counseling, contact and AI data to use tiered
  authorization;
- users to view, correct, export or request deletion of their data;
- counseling and AI conversations to remain private;
- external-model training to require explicit authorization;
- AI long-term memory to require consent and support deletion;
- clear consent, privacy policy, terms, refunds and AI-use explanations.

This batch provides platform-wide privacy infrastructure. Each business module
remains the source of truth for its own data and must implement the standard
privacy-provider contract.

# Prerequisites

Before implementation:

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 through Batch 11.
3. Verify Batch 11 with `make notification-verify`.
4. Read every skill under `skills/batch-12`.
5. Inspect Identity, Commerce, Activity, Course, Counseling, Knowledge, AI,
   Notification, RBAC, Audit, Media and Outbox contracts.
6. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-12-plan.md`.
7. Produce `docs/architecture/privacy-control-plane.md`.
8. Produce `docs/privacy/data-inventory.md`.
9. Record unresolved retention, deletion, legal-hold, recording and
   jurisdiction-specific policies in the decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. User-profile domain.
2. Contact-point management.
3. Privacy modes and field-level visibility.
4. Consent definitions and immutable consent releases.
5. Consent evidence and withdrawal propagation.
6. Data-asset and processing-activity inventories.
7. Module privacy-provider contracts.
8. Data inventory and export requests.
9. Correction requests.
10. Deletion planning.
11. Module erasure and anonymization jobs.
12. Retention policies and instances.
13. Legal and security holds.
14. Sensitive-field classifications.
15. Encryption, masking and searchable HMAC values.
16. Break-glass access.
17. AI memory preferences and memory items.
18. User-web privacy center.
19. Admin-web privacy center.
20. Unit, integration, concurrency, retention, security and E2E tests.

# Architecture constraints

- Business modules remain the source of truth for their own data.
- The Privacy module coordinates through explicit provider interfaces.
- Privacy operations must not perform arbitrary cross-module SQL.
- Every module must expose inventory, export, correction and erasure
  capabilities.
- Data exports, erasure and retention jobs must be asynchronous and
  idempotent.
- Privacy failures must not silently report completion.
- Sensitive fields must not be returned to the frontend merely to be hidden.
- Access control, field selection and masking must occur on the backend.
- AI availability must not affect privacy-request execution.

# Profile invariants

- General account profile and dating profile remain separate domains.
- Legal names and contact points are private by default.
- Public display names do not imply disclosure of legal identity.
- Contact points must be verified independently.
- New contact points default to private.
- Sensitive profile updates require appropriate verification.
- Cross-user profile reads must apply field-level visibility rules.

# Visibility invariants

- New users use strict privacy defaults.
- Every field has an explicit default visibility.
- Field-level rules may restrict but must not silently broaden mandatory
  safety restrictions.
- Contact details are never exposed automatically after a match.
- Activity, matchmaking, mentor and AI access use separate purposes.
- Visibility decisions are evaluated at query time.
- Privacy-setting changes invalidate projections and caches.

# Consent invariants

- Consent purposes are separate.
- Registration does not imply marketing consent.
- AI use does not imply long-term memory consent.
- Long-term memory does not imply external-model training.
- Recording and transcription require separate explicit consent.
- Consent releases are immutable after activation.
- Consent evidence includes version, time and source.
- Withdrawable consent can be withdrawn.
- Withdrawal must propagate to future processing.
- Historical consent records remain auditable.

# Export invariants

- High-risk exports require reauthentication.
- Users may export only their own data.
- Module exports use a stable schema and manifest.
- Export archives are encrypted.
- Download tokens are random, hashed and short lived.
- Export archives expire and are deleted.
- Other users' data and internal secrets must be excluded or redacted.
- Partial module failure must be visible and retryable.
- An export is not complete until every included module reports a final
  result.

# Correction invariants

- Directly editable and review-required fields are distinct.
- Historical financial and security facts are not silently overwritten.
- Corrections may append an amendment while preserving audit history.
- Review decisions must have a safe user-facing explanation.
- Correction execution must be module scoped and auditable.

# Erasure invariants

- Account deletion is a planned workflow, not a single SQL deletion.
- Active services, unresolved financial operations and valid holds may block
  affected operations.
- Blocking conditions must be explained.
- Erasure plans declare delete, anonymize, pseudonymize, restrict or manual
  review per asset.
- Every module erasure job is idempotent.
- Login sessions are revoked when deletion processing begins.
- New purchases and bookings are blocked during deletion.
- Public projections, caches, search indexes and vectors must be removed.
- Required retained records must be isolated and minimized.
- Erasure completion must be verifiable.

# Retention and hold invariants

- Every sensitive data asset has a retention policy.
- Retention policies are versioned.
- Retention start events and actions are explicit.
- Unbounded retention is not a default.
- Holds use the minimum required scope.
- Holds require authorized creation and a reason.
- Holds require expiry or periodic review.
- Released holds allow retention evaluation to resume.
- Ordinary administrators cannot create or release holds.

# Sensitive-data invariants

- Restricted and highly restricted fields use application-layer encryption
  where required.
- Searchable sensitive values use keyed HMAC values.
- Plain low-entropy hashes are insufficient for phone numbers or identifiers.
- DTOs include only necessary fields.
- Logs, traces and metrics never contain decrypted values.
- Caches include permission scope.
- Break-glass access is short lived, separately approved and audited.
- Masking is not a replacement for authorization.

# AI-memory invariants

- Long-term memory is disabled by default.
- Long-term memory requires explicit opt-in.
- Cross-conversation memory requires separate permission.
- Model inference is not a confirmed user fact.
- Inferred memory requires user review unless an approved low-risk policy
  explicitly allows otherwise.
- Users can view, edit and delete memory items.
- Users can clear all long-term memory.
- Disabling memory stops both reads and writes.
- Deleted memories are removed from vectors, indexes and caches.
- Passwords, payment credentials, safety details and third-party secrets
  cannot become memory.
- External-model training remains disabled without explicit authorization.

# Security invariants

- Users may access only their own profile, requests, exports and memories.
- Export and deletion requests require identity verification.
- Sensitive administrative access requires RBAC and purpose.
- Break-glass requests require approval.
- Export download tokens are not logged.
- Sensitive values do not enter ordinary audit records.
- High-risk operations require explicit reasons.
- All consent, export, correction, erasure, hold and sensitive-access events
  are audited.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make privacy-migrate
make privacy-seed
make privacy-seed-inventory
make privacy-test
make privacy-security-test
make privacy-concurrency-test
make privacy-retention-test
make privacy-user-e2e
make privacy-admin-e2e
make privacy-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Users can view and edit their general profiles.
2. Contact points remain private by default.
3. Strict privacy is the new-user default.
4. Field-level visibility works.
5. AI profile access requires permission.
6. Consent definitions and releases are versioned.
7. Marketing, AI memory, recording and training consents remain separate.
8. Consent withdrawal propagates.
9. Every business module registers privacy assets.
10. Every business module implements the privacy-provider contract.
11. Users can request a data inventory.
12. Users can request an encrypted export.
13. Export tokens are short lived and user scoped.
14. Cross-user export access is rejected.
15. Users can request data corrections.
16. Historical audit and financial facts are preserved.
17. Users can request account deletion.
18. Deletion produces a module-level impact plan.
19. Active-service and hold blockers work.
20. Module erasure jobs are idempotent.
21. Public projections and caches are cleared.
22. Retained records are minimized and restricted.
23. Retention policies execute automatically.
24. Active holds prevent affected deletion.
25. Hold release resumes retention.
26. Sensitive fields are classified.
27. Restricted values are encrypted.
28. Searchable sensitive fields use keyed HMAC values.
29. Break-glass access requires approval.
30. Every sensitive access is audited.
31. AI long-term memory remains off without opt-in.
32. Users can review, edit and delete AI memories.
33. Clearing memory removes vectors and caches.
34. External-model training remains disabled by default.
35. User privacy E2E tests pass.
36. Admin privacy E2E tests pass.
37. Privacy security tests pass.
38. Privacy concurrency tests pass.
39. Retention tests pass.
40. `make notification-verify` still succeeds.
41. `make ai-verify` still succeeds.
42. `make knowledge-verify` still succeeds.
43. `make counseling-verify` still succeeds.
44. `make course-verify` still succeeds.
45. `make activity-verify` still succeeds.
46. `make commerce-verify` still succeeds.
47. `make catalog-verify` still succeeds.
48. `make cms-verify` still succeeds.
49. `make auth-verify` still succeeds.
50. `make verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When a retention or deletion rule is unresolved:

1. record the unresolved policy;
2. restrict access to affected data;
3. do not silently delete legally or operationally significant records;
4. do not claim indefinite retention is approved;
5. route the affected item to manual review.

When a cross-user privacy test fails:

1. stop the affected release;
2. invalidate related caches and projections;
3. identify the missing ownership, purpose or visibility boundary;
4. fix backend authorization and DTO filtering;
5. add a regression test;
6. rerun the complete privacy security suite.

When an erasure job fails:

1. do not report the request as completed;
2. preserve the failed module and operation;
3. retry idempotently;
4. route persistent failures to manual review;
5. keep the user-visible request status accurate.

When a consent withdrawal propagation fails:

1. stop the affected future processing;
2. invalidate cached consent decisions;
3. identify downstream systems still using the withdrawn purpose;
4. repair the propagation;
5. add a regression test.

When AI memory is found without valid consent:

1. immediately block memory reads and writes;
2. identify all affected memory items;
3. offer deletion or delete according to policy;
4. preserve minimal incident audit;
5. add a release-blocking evaluation case.

项目计划书要求第二期交付完整婚恋档案，涵盖基本资料、信仰、城市、婚史、家庭、生活方式、照片和自我介绍，并实现择偶条件、推荐列表、资料与照片审核、举报和屏蔽。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

最终上线验收要求真实用户能够注册、验证身份并建立婚恋档案，运营人员能够审核资料、处理举报并管理用户，同时敏感信息流程不得存在重大安全问题。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

本批只建设**档案、择偶条件、隐私、版本和审核基础**。筛选、推荐和匹配排序由 Batch 14 实现；喜欢、互选和认识邀请由 Batch 15 实现。

# 三、核心架构原则

## 3.1 通用资料与婚恋档案分离

```text
User
账户与登录身份

UserProfile
通用个人资料

DatingProfile
婚恋场景资料

PartnerPreferenceProfile
用户希望认识怎样的人
```

不能把账户邮箱、支付姓名或辅导 Intake 自动复制到婚恋档案。

## 3.2 档案记录与展示投影分离

```text
原始婚恋档案
→ 隐私判定
→ 审核判定
→ 查看者关系判定
→ Dating Profile View Projection
```

前端不能直接读取完整档案后自行隐藏敏感字段。

## 3.3 档案和择偶条件分离

```text
DatingProfile
描述“我是谁”。

PartnerPreferenceProfile
描述“我希望认识怎样的人”。
```

推荐引擎不能反向推断用户没有填写的择偶要求。

## 3.4 完整度不是人格质量评分

完整度只回答：

```text
是否填写了平台要求的信息
是否上传了合格照片
是否完成隐私和同意设置
```

不得将完整度描述成：

```text
婚恋价值
成熟度
属灵程度
匹配成功概率
```

## 3.5 审核不代表真实性认证

资料审核表示：

```text
字段格式通过
内容符合平台规则
照片可用于平台展示
没有明显违规内容
```

不表示平台已经独立证明所有个人陈述真实。实名认证需作为后续独立能力。

---

# 四、成年用户保护性默认

婚恋推荐和互选模块采用：

```text
成人用户限定
```

基础规则：

```text
未达到平台批准的最低年龄
→ 不得创建可发布婚恋档案
→ 不得进入推荐、活动互选或认识邀请
```

默认工程配置：

```dotenv
DATING_MINIMUM_AGE=18
```

首发地区若有更严格要求，应采用更严格配置。年龄校验必须由后端根据受保护的出生日期计算，不能信任前端提交的年龄数字。

# 七、核心状态机

## 7.1 婚恋档案状态

```python
class DatingProfileStatus(StrEnum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    INCOMPLETE = "incomplete"
    READY_TO_SUBMIT = "ready_to_submit"
    SUBMITTED = "submitted"
    IN_REVIEW = "in_review"
    CHANGES_REQUESTED = "changes_requested"
    APPROVED = "approved"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    PAUSED_BY_USER = "paused_by_user"
    SUSPENDED = "suspended"
    REJECTED = "rejected"
    DELETION_PENDING = "deletion_pending"
    ARCHIVED = "archived"
```

典型流程：

```text
DRAFT
→ INCOMPLETE
→ READY_TO_SUBMIT
→ SUBMITTED
→ IN_REVIEW
├── APPROVED → ACTIVE
├── CHANGES_REQUESTED → DRAFT/INCOMPLETE
└── REJECTED
```

用户可执行：

```text
ACTIVE → PAUSED_BY_USER → ACTIVE
```

平台可执行：

```text
ACTIVE → SUSPENDED
```

## 7.2 照片状态

```python
class DatingPhotoStatus(StrEnum):
    UPLOADING = "uploading"
    PROCESSING = "processing"
    REVIEW_REQUIRED = "review_required"
    APPROVED = "approved"
    REJECTED = "rejected"
    HIDDEN = "hidden"
    DELETED = "deleted"
```

## 7.3 审核状态

```python
class ProfileReviewStatus(StrEnum):
    NOT_REQUIRED = "not_required"
    PENDING = "pending"
    ASSIGNED = "assigned"
    IN_REVIEW = "in_review"
    CHANGES_REQUESTED = "changes_requested"
    APPROVED = "approved"
    REJECTED = "rejected"
    ESCALATED = "escalated"
```

# 八、Skill 13.1：`vav-dating-profile-domain`

## 目标

建立婚恋档案、档案版本、字段数据和生命周期模型。

## 8.1 主档案表

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_profiles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id),

    profile_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    review_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',

    schema_release_id UUID NOT NULL,

    default_locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    relationship_intent VARCHAR(64),
    current_city_code VARCHAR(128),

    completeness_basis_points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    searchable BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    current_version_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    approved_version_number INTEGER,

    submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    activated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    paused_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    suspended_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    suspension_reason_code VARCHAR(128),

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    archived_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 8.2 关系目标

```python
class RelationshipIntent(StrEnum):
    MARRIAGE_ORIENTED = "marriage_oriented"
    SERIOUS_RELATIONSHIP = "serious_relationship"
    GETTING_TO_KNOW = "getting_to_know"
    UNDECIDED = "undecided"
```

平台是否只允许婚姻导向用户，应由业务负责人确认；代码不应在未确认前永久固定。

## 8.3 档案版本

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_profile_versions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    dating_profile_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES dating_profiles(id),

    version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    schema_release_id UUID NOT NULL,

    snapshot_encrypted JSONB NOT NULL,
    snapshot_checksum_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    change_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    review_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(dating_profile_id, version_number)
);
```

## 8.4 基础资料

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_profile_core_details (
    dating_profile_id UUID PRIMARY KEY
        REFERENCES dating_profiles(id),

    date_of_birth_source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    age_display_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    gender_code VARCHAR(64),
    eligible_partner_gender_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    country_code CHAR(2),
    region_code VARCHAR(128),
    city_code VARCHAR(128),

    citizenship_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    residence_status_code VARCHAR(128),

    relocation_willingness VARCHAR(64),

    primary_language_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    additional_language_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    education_level_code VARCHAR(128),
    occupation_category_code VARCHAR(128),

    height_cm INTEGER,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

出生日期应从 Batch 12 受保护资料读取；婚恋模块保存来源和展示策略，不重复保存明文出生日期。

# 九、Skill 13.2：`vav-profile-schema-taxonomies`

## 目标

建立版本化档案 Schema、字段定义、枚举词典和多语言标签。

## 9.1 Schema Release

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_profile_schema_releases (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    schema_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    field_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    completeness_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    submission_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(schema_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 9.2 字段定义

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_profile_field_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    schema_release_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES dating_profile_schema_releases(id),

    field_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    section_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    field_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    value_schema JSONB NOT NULL,

    required_for_submission BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    required_for_recommendation BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    sensitivity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    default_visibility VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    searchable BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    recommendation_eligible BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(schema_release_id, field_code)
);
```

## 9.3 第一版 Section

```text
basic
location
faith
relationship_history
family
children_and_parenting
lifestyle
education_and_work
interests
communication
relationship_values
self_introduction
future_vision
photos
privacy
```

## 9.4 Taxonomy

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_taxonomies (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    taxonomy_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    values_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(taxonomy_code, semantic_version)
);
```

示例：

```text
faith_status
church_tradition
church_participation
marital_status
children_status
relocation_willingness
education_level
occupation_category
lifestyle_habits
communication_style
relationship_value
```

## 原则

- 管理端不能随意创建任意敏感字段。
- 新敏感字段必须经过隐私分类和审核。
- Taxonomy 值改变不能破坏既有档案。
- 删除枚举项应转为停用，不能使历史值失效。
- 业务规则不能依赖多语言显示文本。

# 十、Skill 13.3：`vav-faith-family-history-lifestyle`

## 目标

实现信仰、婚史、家庭、子女、生育和生活方式资料。

## 10.1 信仰资料

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_profile_faith_details (
    dating_profile_id UUID PRIMARY KEY
        REFERENCES dating_profiles(id),

    faith_status_code VARCHAR(128),
    faith_started_year INTEGER,

    church_tradition_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    current_church_participation_code VARCHAR(128),

    devotional_life_code VARCHAR(128),
    small_group_participation_code VARCHAR(128),
    ministry_participation_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    marriage_faith_importance INTEGER,
    future_church_expectation_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    faith_journey_summary_encrypted TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

`marriage_faith_importance` 可使用经业务批准的等级枚举，不应被解释为“属灵分数”。

## 10.2 婚史

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_profile_relationship_history (
    dating_profile_id UUID PRIMARY KEY
        REFERENCES dating_profiles(id),

    marital_status_code VARCHAR(128),

    prior_marriage_count INTEGER,
    relationship_history_disclosure_level VARCHAR(64),

    has_children BOOLEAN,
    children_count_range VARCHAR(64),
    children_living_arrangement_code VARCHAR(128),

    open_to_partner_with_children VARCHAR(64),

    history_summary_encrypted TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

以下内容不应默认公开：

```text
前任姓名
离异诉讼详情
子女姓名
监护安排详细文件
家庭住址
第三方未经同意的私人信息
```

    family_summary_encrypted TEXT,

);
```

CREATE TABLE dating_profile_lifestyle_details (

# 十一、Skill 13.4：`vav-narratives-localization`

## 目标

实现自我介绍、婚姻愿景、信仰经历和生活叙述。

## 11.1 叙述表

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_profile_narratives (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    dating_profile_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES dating_profiles(id),
    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    self_introduction TEXT,
    faith_journey TEXT,
    relationship_values TEXT,
    marriage_vision TEXT,
    family_vision TEXT,
    strengths_and_growth TEXT,
    interests_and_lifestyle TEXT,
    hoped_for_relationship TEXT,

    moderation_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'review_required',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(dating_profile_id, locale)
);
```

## 11.2 文本限制

```dotenv
DATING_SELF_INTRO_MIN_CHARS=80
DATING_SELF_INTRO_MAX_CHARS=3000
DATING_NARRATIVE_MAX_CHARS=4000
```

## 11.3 内容规则

拒绝或进入审核：

```text
公开手机号、邮箱、微信等绕过平台的联系方式
外部付款要求
诈骗或投资邀约
仇恨和侮辱内容
露骨性内容
威胁
第三方私人信息
虚假机构身份
恶意引导到站外
```

## 11.4 AI 辅助写作边界

可以提供：

```text
语法润色
结构建议
表达清晰化
敏感信息提醒
```

不得：

```text
虚构学历、职业、信仰经历或人生故事
自动把模型生成内容当作用户事实
夸大个人品质
创建虚假的见证
```

AI 生成内容必须经用户确认后保存。

# 十二、Skill 13.5：`vav-profile-photo-management`

## 目标

实现私有照片上传、处理、审核和查看权限。

## 12.1 照片表

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_profile_photos (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    dating_profile_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES dating_profiles(id),
    media_asset_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES media_assets(id),

    photo_role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    visibility VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'verified_members',

    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    content_checksum_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    processing_report JSONB,
    moderation_report_encrypted JSONB,

    reviewed_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    rejection_reason_code VARCHAR(128),
    rejection_message_safe TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 12.2 照片角色

```python
class DatingPhotoRole(StrEnum):
    PRIMARY = "primary"
    GALLERY = "gallery"
    ACTIVITY = "activity"
```

## 12.3 上传流程

```text
请求上传
→ 私有 Presigned URL
→ 上传
→ 校验 MIME
→ 校验文件大小
→ 解码图片
→ 清除 EXIF
→ 重新编码
→ 生成缩略图
→ 安全检查
→ REVIEW_REQUIRED
→ 人工审核
→ APPROVED
```

## 12.4 默认限制

```dotenv
DATING_PHOTO_MIN_COUNT_FOR_SUBMISSION=1
DATING_PHOTO_MAX_COUNT=8
DATING_PHOTO_MAX_SIZE_MB=10
DATING_PHOTO_ALLOWED_TYPES=image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp
```

## 12.5 禁止默认进行

```text
人脸身份识别
跨站人脸搜索
根据照片推断种族、宗教、健康或性格
未经同意的生物特征模板
```

可以做非身份性质量检查：

```text
图片损坏
分辨率不足
明显重复
过暗
违规内容检测
```

自动结果只能作为审核辅助，不应独立决定用户身份真实性。

## 12.6 照片访问

```http
POST /api/v1/dating-profiles/{profile_id}/photos/{photo_id}/view-token
```

返回短时签名地址，后端必须验证：

```text
查看者账户状态
目标档案状态
照片审核状态
字段可见性
是否被屏蔽
业务关系
安全限制
```

# 十三、Skill 13.6：`vav-partner-preferences`

## 目标

建立可供 Batch 14 使用的择偶条件和重要性模型。

## 13.1 偏好档案

```sql
CREATE TABLE partner_preference_profiles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id),
    dating_profile_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE
        REFERENCES dating_profiles(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
    schema_release_id UUID NOT NULL,

    preference_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    allow_recommendation_relaxation BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 13.2 偏好条件

```sql
CREATE TABLE partner_preference_criteria (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    partner_preference_profile_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES partner_preference_profiles(id),

    criterion_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    operator VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    desired_value JSONB NOT NULL,

    importance VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    hard_constraint BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    allow_unknown BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    allow_system_relaxation BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    user_explanation TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(partner_preference_profile_id, criterion_code)
);
```

## 13.3 重要性

```python
class PreferenceImportance(StrEnum):
    REQUIRED = "required"
    VERY_IMPORTANT = "very_important"
    IMPORTANT = "important"
    NICE_TO_HAVE = "nice_to_have"
    NO_PREFERENCE = "no_preference"
```

## 13.4 Operator

```python
class PreferenceOperator(StrEnum):
    EQUALS = "equals"
    IN = "in"
    RANGE = "range"
    AT_LEAST = "at_least"
    AT_MOST = "at_most"
    CONTAINS_ANY = "contains_any"
    CONTAINS_ALL = "contains_all"
    BOOLEAN = "boolean"
```

## 13.5 支持条件

第一版可支持：

```text
年龄范围
国家/地区/城市
距离或迁居意愿
服务语言
信仰状态
教会传统
信仰在婚姻中的重要性
婚姻状态
是否有子女
是否接受对方有子女
生育期待
教育水平
生活作息
吸烟
饮酒
兴趣
沟通方式
关系目标
```

## 13.6 保护规则

- 只有经过业务、隐私和适用法域审核的字段才能进入自动筛选。
- 偏好数据默认只向用户本人和推荐引擎开放。
- 普通档案查看者不得看到用户完整择偶过滤条件。
- 用户必须知道哪些条件会造成硬性排除。
- 系统不得在未获得允许时自动放宽硬性条件。
- 不应根据叙述文本秘密推断隐藏偏好。

# 十五、隐私字段注册

Batch 13 必须向 Batch 12 注册：

```text
dating_profile.basic
dating_profile.location
dating_profile.faith
dating_profile.relationship_history
dating_profile.children
dating_profile.family
dating_profile.lifestyle
dating_profile.narratives
dating_profile.photos
dating_profile.partner_preferences
dating_profile.review_notes
```

建议等级：

| 数据 | 敏感等级 |
|---|---|
| 批准后的展示名称 | Public/受控公开 |
| 城市级位置 | Confidential |
| 精确地址 | Highly Restricted，婚恋档案禁止使用 |
| 信仰资料 | Restricted |
| 婚史与子女资料 | Restricted |
| 自我介绍 | 受控公开 |
| 择偶条件 | Restricted |
| 审核内部备注 | Highly Restricted |
| 联系方式 | Restricted |
| 照片原始文件 | Restricted |

# 十六、Skill 13.8：`vav-completeness-versioning`

## 目标

实现资料完整度、提交门槛、版本差异和已批准版本稳定性。

## 16.1 完整度快照

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_profile_completeness_snapshots (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    dating_profile_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES dating_profiles(id),
    profile_version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,

    policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    total_basis_points INTEGER NOT NULL,
    section_scores JSONB NOT NULL,

    missing_required_fields JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    missing_recommended_fields JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    submission_eligible BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    recommendation_eligible BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

    evaluated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(dating_profile_id, profile_version_number)
);
```

## 16.2 完整度计算

建议：

```text
必填基本资料
信仰核心资料
关系目标
婚史基础说明
家庭与生活方式核心字段
自我介绍
主照片
隐私设置确认
必要同意
```

各项权重来自 Schema Release，不能硬编码在 Vue 页面。

## 16.3 示例

```json
{
  "total_basis_points": 8250,
  "sections": {
    "basic": 10000,
    "faith": 9000,
    "relationship_history": 10000,
    "family": 6500,
    "lifestyle": 7000,
    "narratives": 7500,
    "photos": 10000,
    "privacy": 10000
  },
  "missing_required_fields": [
    "family.desire_children"
  ]
}
```

## 16.4 提交门槛

```dotenv
DATING_PROFILE_SUBMISSION_MIN_COMPLETENESS_BPS=8000
DATING_PROFILE_RECOMMENDATION_MIN_COMPLETENESS_BPS=9000
```

即使达到总分，任何必填字段缺失仍不能提交。

## 16.5 版本策略

```text
ACTIVE Profile Version 4
用户开始编辑
→ Draft Version 5

Version 5 未批准期间
→ 推荐池继续使用 Version 4

Version 5 批准
→ 原子切换批准版本
→ 更新投影
→ 清理缓存
```

这样用户修改一个字段不会导致整个档案立即从推荐中消失，除非修改涉及安全风险或用户主动暂停。

---

# 十七、档案差异

```http
GET /api/v1/account/dating-profile/versions/{a}/diff/{b}
GET /api/v1/admin/dating-profile-versions/{a}/diff/{b}
```

比较：

```text
新增字段
修改字段
删除字段
隐私变化
照片变化
择偶条件变化
审核状态变化
```

审核人员默认只复核发生变化的字段，但严重修改可以触发全量复核。

# 十八、Skill 13.9：`vav-profile-submission-review`

## 目标

实现档案提交、审核任务、字段级结果、修改要求和暂停。

## 18.1 审核案例

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_profile_review_cases (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    dating_profile_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES dating_profiles(id),
    profile_version_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES dating_profile_versions(id),

    review_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    priority VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal',

    assigned_to UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    assigned_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    overall_decision VARCHAR(32),

    user_message_safe TEXT,
    internal_summary_encrypted TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(profile_version_id, review_type)
);
```

## 18.2 字段审核项

```sql
CREATE TABLE dating_profile_review_items (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    review_case_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES dating_profile_review_cases(id),

    item_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    field_code VARCHAR(128),
    photo_id UUID REFERENCES dating_profile_photos(id),

    decision VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    reason_code VARCHAR(128),
    user_message_safe TEXT,
    internal_note_encrypted TEXT,

    reviewed_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 18.3 Decision

```python
class ProfileReviewDecision(StrEnum):
    APPROVE = "approve"
    CHANGES_REQUIRED = "changes_required"
    REJECT = "reject"
    ESCALATE = "escalate"
    SUSPEND = "suspend"
```

## 18.4 用户 API

```http
POST /api/v1/account/dating-profile/submit
GET  /api/v1/account/dating-profile/review-status
GET  /api/v1/account/dating-profile/review-feedback

POST /api/v1/account/dating-profile/pause
POST /api/v1/account/dating-profile/reactivate
```

## 18.5 管理 API

```http
GET  /api/v1/admin/dating-profile-reviews
GET  /api/v1/admin/dating-profile-reviews/{case_id}

POST /api/v1/admin/dating-profile-reviews/{case_id}/assign
POST /api/v1/admin/dating-profile-reviews/{case_id}/start
POST /api/v1/admin/dating-profile-reviews/{case_id}/items
POST /api/v1/admin/dating-profile-reviews/{case_id}/approve
POST /api/v1/admin/dating-profile-reviews/{case_id}/request-changes
POST /api/v1/admin/dating-profile-reviews/{case_id}/reject
POST /api/v1/admin/dating-profile-reviews/{case_id}/escalate

POST /api/v1/admin/dating-profiles/{profile_id}/suspend
POST /api/v1/admin/dating-profiles/{profile_id}/restore
```

## 18.6 审核原则

- 用户可见说明与内部备注分离。
- 拒绝或暂停必须有原因。
- 自动审核只能提供风险提示。
- 涉及身份、欺诈或安全风险时升级到 Batch 18。
- 审核员不能修改用户陈述来使其“通过”。
- 审核员不能代替用户填写档案。
- 所有敏感资料访问记录用途和审计。

# 二十六、缓存设计

```text
dating-profile:self:{user_id}:{version}
dating-profile:view:
  {viewer_scope_hash}:{profile_id}:{approved_version}:{privacy_version}

dating-profile:preview:
  {user_id}:{draft_version}:{view_context}

  {profile_id}:{profile_version}:{policy_version}

dating-profile:recommendation-projection:
  {profile_id}:{projection_version}
```

缓存键必须包含查看者权限和业务关系，不能把管理员视图缓存返回给普通用户。

```text
档案版本批准
用户隐私设置变化
照片批准或删除
档案暂停或恢复
屏蔽关系变化
安全限制变化
用户账户状态变化

# 三十、必须通过的档案创建场景

```text
用户创建唯一婚恋档案
用户可以分阶段保存
出生日期从受保护资料读取
年龄由后端计算
未成年人不能发布档案
字段值符合当前 Schema
停用 Taxonomy 值不再用于新档案
历史档案仍能解释旧值
不同用户不能修改彼此档案
```

---

# 三十一、必须通过的信仰、婚史和家庭场景

```text
用户可以填写信仰状态
信仰字段具有受限隐私默认值
信仰重要性不被称为属灵评分
婚史字段保持私密
第三方姓名不能进入公开投影
子女姓名不能进入公开档案
家庭描述不能自动暴露精确地址
财务观念不要求银行和资产明细
```

---

# 三十二、必须通过的照片场景

```text
用户可以私有上传照片
伪造 MIME 被拒绝
超大文件被拒绝
EXIF 被清理
未审核照片不进入推荐卡片
被拒照片不向其他用户返回
只有一张主照片
并发设置主照片仍保持唯一
照片删除清理缓存和投影
原始对象 Key 不通过 API 返回
不默认创建生物识别模板
```

---

# 三十三、必须通过的择偶条件场景

```text
用户可以设置年龄范围
用户可以设置地区和迁居要求
用户可以设置信仰要求
用户可以设置婚史和子女接受范围
用户可以区分硬性和一般偏好
系统不自动放宽硬性条件
系统不从叙述中秘密推断新条件
普通用户不能查看他人完整择偶条件
无效条件组合给出明确提示
```

---

# 三十四、必须通过的隐私场景

```text
新档案使用 Strict 隐私
联系方式永不进入推荐卡片
活动参与者视图只返回授权字段
互选后仍不自动公开联系方式
AI 未获同意时不能读取婚恋档案
审核员只读取审核必要字段
高敏感字段访问产生审计
档案隐私更新立即清理缓存
被屏蔽用户不能查看档案
管理员视图缓存不泄露给普通用户
```

---

# 三十五、必须通过的完整度场景

```text
完整度从当前 Schema 计算
Vue 不自行决定完整度
缺少必填字段不能提交
达到总分但缺少必填项仍不能提交
照片未批准时不能进入推荐池
完整度变化生成快照
政策版本变化可以重新计算
完整度不会被描述为人格或婚恋价值
```

---

# 三十六、必须通过的版本和审核场景

```text
提交审核创建不可变档案版本
审核期间用户修改产生新草稿版本
旧批准版本继续用于展示
未批准版本不会对其他用户公开
审核员查看版本差异
批准后原子切换批准版本
要求修改返回字段级说明
拒绝和暂停必须填写原因
审核员不能代用户修改资料
审核结果产生完整审计
```

---

# 三十七、必须通过的推荐投影场景

```text
仅 ACTIVE 档案进入推荐投影
投影只使用批准版本
投影只使用当前隐私允许字段
投影不含联系方式
投影不含精确出生日期
投影不含叙述全文
投影不含审核内部备注
暂停档案立即从推荐池移除
隐私变化重建投影
重复事件不会生成冲突投影
```

# 三十八、Batch 13 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-13/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-13-dating-profiles-preferences-review
description: Implement complete VAV dating profiles, faith and family details, lifestyle, photos, narratives, partner preferences, field-level privacy, completeness and administration review workflows.
---

# Goal

Build a production-oriented dating-profile platform containing:

- one dating profile per eligible user;
- versioned profile schemas;
- versioned taxonomies;
- protected date-of-birth and adult eligibility;
- basic background and location data;
- faith and church-life information;
- relationship and marriage history;
- children and parenting expectations;
- family background and future-family expectations;
- lifestyle and communication preferences;
- multilingual personal narratives;
- private profile-photo upload;
- photo processing and review;
- partner-preference criteria;
- required and soft preferences;
- field-level privacy;
- viewer-specific profile projections;
- profile completeness;
- immutable profile versions;
- profile submission and review;
- change requests and suspension;
- recommendation-engine projections;
- user-web profile journeys;
- admin-web review operations;
- unit, integration, concurrency, security and E2E tests.

# Source requirements

The project plan requires the second phase to contain:

- complete dating profiles;
- basic information;
- faith;
- city;
- marriage history;
- family;
- lifestyle;
- photos;
- self-introduction;
- partner preferences;
- profile and photo review;
- privacy and safety controls.

This batch implements profile and preference foundations. Recommendation,
ranking, likes, mutual choice and introductions belong to later batches.

# Prerequisites

Before implementation:

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 through Batch 12.
3. Verify Batch 12 with `make privacy-verify`.
4. Read every skill under `skills/batch-13`.
5. Inspect Identity, Privacy, Media, Activity, Notification, RBAC, Audit and
   Moderation extension contracts.
6. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-13-plan.md`.
7. Produce `docs/architecture/dating-profile-domain.md`.
8. Produce `docs/privacy/dating-profile-field-classification.md`.
9. Record unresolved gender, relationship eligibility, faith taxonomy,
   profile visibility and contact-exchange policies in the decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. Dating-profile domain and lifecycle.
2. Profile-schema and taxonomy registry.
3. Basic and location details.
4. Faith details.
5. Relationship and marriage history.
6. Family, children and parenting details.
7. Lifestyle and communication details.
8. Multilingual narratives.
9. Photo upload, processing and review.
10. Partner-preference profile and criteria.
11. Privacy and viewer projections.
12. Completeness policy.
13. Immutable profile versions.
14. Submission and review workflow.
15. Recommendation projections.
16. User-web profile setup.
17. Admin-web review center.
18. Unit, integration, concurrency, security and E2E tests.

# Architecture constraints

- General user profiles and dating profiles remain separate domains.
- Dating profiles must not copy payment, counseling or AI data implicitly.
- A user may have only one active dating profile.
- Profile schemas and taxonomies must be versioned.
- Published and approved profile versions are immutable.
- Draft changes must not overwrite the current approved profile.
- Viewer-specific DTOs must be generated by the backend.
- Frontend hiding is not field-level privacy.
- Recommendation projections must contain only approved, necessary fields.
- Matching, ranking and like behavior are outside this batch.
- AI availability must not affect profile editing or review.

# Eligibility invariants

- Dating profiles are available only to users meeting the configured adult
  age requirement.
- Age is calculated from protected date-of-birth data by the backend.
- Frontend-submitted age values are not authoritative.
- Suspended, deletion-pending and ineligible accounts cannot enter the
  recommendation pool.
- Eligibility changes must invalidate profile projections.

# Profile invariants

- A profile binds to one schema release.
- Every field value must validate against its field definition.
- Taxonomy display labels are not business identifiers.
- Disabled taxonomy values remain interpretable for historical versions.
- Sensitive fields use Privacy classifications.
- Third-party private information must not appear in public profile fields.
- Contact information must not be placed in profile narratives.
- Profile updates use optimistic concurrency.

# Faith and personal-information invariants

- Faith information is sensitive and private by default.
- Faith fields must not be represented as a spiritual-quality score.
- Marriage history, children and family data are restricted fields.
- Children and former partners must not be personally identified publicly.
- Financial-lifestyle questions must not collect bank or asset records.
- The platform must not fabricate credentials, faith histories or personal
  stories.

# Photo invariants

- Original photos remain private.
- File type, size and image decoding must be verified.
- EXIF metadata must be removed.
- Unapproved and rejected photos must not appear to other users.
- Only one approved primary photo may be active.
- Photo access uses short-lived authorized URLs.
- Original storage keys must not appear in public DTOs.
- Biometric identification and cross-site face search are disabled.
- Automated moderation is advisory unless an approved policy says otherwise.

# Preference invariants

- Partner preferences are private by default.
- Hard constraints and soft preferences are explicit.
- Users must know which criteria act as hard exclusions.
- Hard criteria are not relaxed without explicit permission.
- The system must not infer hidden preferences from narratives.
- Only approved criteria may enter automated filtering.
- Other users cannot view a person's full preference profile.
- Invalid or contradictory criteria must be explained to the user.

# Privacy invariants

- New profiles use strict privacy defaults.
- Field visibility is evaluated at query time.
- Recommendation cards, profile details, activity directories and mutual
  matches use different view contexts.
- Contact details are never exposed automatically.
- AI profile access requires the relevant Privacy consent.
- Blocked and restricted users cannot access each other's profiles.
- Sensitive administrative access requires separate permission and audit.
- Privacy changes invalidate caches and projections immediately.

# Completeness invariants

- Completeness is calculated from the active schema policy.
- Completeness calculations are backend authoritative.
- Missing required fields block submission.
- Total completeness cannot override a missing mandatory field.
- Recommendation eligibility may require a higher threshold than submission.
- Completeness measures form completion, not personal quality or suitability.
- Completeness snapshots preserve policy versions.

# Version and review invariants

- Submission creates an immutable profile version.
- Editing during review creates a separate draft version.
- Existing approved versions remain active until a replacement is approved.
- Unapproved versions must not appear to other users.
- Review decisions may apply to individual fields or photos.
- Rejection and suspension require reasons.
- Reviewers cannot rewrite user statements.
- Automated checks may assist but must not silently assert identity fraud.
- Every review and sensitive read must be audited.

# Projection invariants

- Recommendation projections use only the approved profile version.
- Projections include only necessary normalized fields.
- Contact details, exact birth dates, narratives, private notes and raw photo
  locations are excluded.
- Profile pause, suspension, privacy withdrawal and account ineligibility
  remove the user from the recommendation pool.
- Projection updates are idempotent.
- Projection caches include profile, preference and privacy versions.

# Security invariants

- Users may edit only their own profiles and preferences.
- Cross-user draft and review access must be rejected.
- Admin review requires RBAC.
- Original-photo access requires separate permission.
- Sensitive preference and history access requires separate permission.
- Admin and user profile caches must remain isolated.
- Logs, traces and audit events must not contain complete sensitive values.
- All submission, review, photo and projection changes must be audited.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make dating-profile-migrate
make dating-profile-seed
make dating-profile-seed-taxonomies
make dating-profile-test
make dating-profile-concurrency-test
make dating-profile-security-test
make dating-profile-user-e2e
make dating-profile-admin-e2e
make dating-profile-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. An eligible user can create one dating profile.
2. Ineligible users cannot publish a profile.
3. Users can complete basic, faith, history, family and lifestyle sections.
4. Narratives support approved locales.
5. Sensitive fields remain private by default.
6. Users can upload private profile photos.
7. EXIF data is removed.
8. Unapproved photos remain private.
9. Photo review works.
10. Users can configure partner preferences.
11. Hard and soft preferences remain distinguishable.
12. Other users cannot read full preference criteria.
13. Field-level privacy works for every view context.
14. Contact information is not exposed automatically.
15. Completeness is calculated by the backend.
16. Missing mandatory fields prevent submission.
17. Submission creates an immutable version.
18. Review does not expose draft versions publicly.
19. Change requests identify affected fields safely.
20. Approved versions activate atomically.
21. Existing approved versions remain stable while edits are reviewed.
22. Paused and suspended profiles leave the recommendation pool.
23. Recommendation projections contain no prohibited fields.
24. Privacy changes rebuild projections.
25. Cross-user profile security tests pass.
26. Photo security tests pass.
27. Review concurrency tests pass.
28. User profile E2E tests pass.
29. Admin review E2E tests pass.
30. `make privacy-verify` still succeeds.
31. `make notification-verify` still succeeds.
32. `make ai-verify` still succeeds.
33. `make knowledge-verify` still succeeds.
34. `make counseling-verify` still succeeds.
35. `make course-verify` still succeeds.
36. `make activity-verify` still succeeds.
37. `make commerce-verify` still succeeds.
38. `make catalog-verify` still succeeds.
39. `make cms-verify` still succeeds.
40. `make auth-verify` still succeeds.
41. `make verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When a dating-profile field or taxonomy policy is unresolved:

1. record it in the decision register;
2. keep the field optional or unavailable;
3. use a restricted privacy default;
4. do not invent a permanent social or theological policy;
5. continue implementing unrelated profile capabilities.

When a profile-privacy test fails:

1. stop the affected release;
2. invalidate related caches and projections;
3. identify the missing viewer, purpose or relationship check;
4. fix backend DTO generation;
5. add a regression test;
6. rerun all profile and Privacy security suites.

When a photo-security test fails:

1. remove the affected photo from all projections;
2. revoke existing view tokens;
3. repair processing, review or access control;
4. add a regression test;
5. rerun media and profile-photo suites.

When review concurrency fails:

1. preserve the competing profile versions and decisions;
2. prevent either decision from silently overwriting the other;
3. repair optimistic locking and review-state validation;
4. add a regression test;
5. rerun profile review and projection suites.
```

# 三、核心架构原则

## 3.1 推荐系统不是“全表打分”

推荐流程应为：

```text
推荐池资格
→ 安全排除
→ 双方硬条件过滤
→ 候选召回
→ 双向软评分
→ 多样化和曝光约束
→ 可解释性生成
→ 推荐批次冻结
→ 用户展示
```

不能：

```text
读取所有用户完整档案
→ 让模型自由判断谁适合谁
```

## 3.2 批准投影是唯一档案输入

推荐只能读取 Batch 13 的：

```text
dating_profile_recommendation_projections
```

不能直接读取：

```text
草稿档案
未审核叙述
原始照片
联系方式
完整出生日期
审核备注
AI 对话
辅导记录
支付资料
```

## 3.3 双向条件优先于单向得分

A 觉得 B 符合，不代表 B 愿意认识 A。

推荐资格必须满足：

```text
A 的硬条件接受 B
并且
B 的硬条件接受 A
```

软评分也应同时计算：

```text
A → B
B → A
```

不能只优化单边点击率。

## 3.4 推荐是探索机会，不是婚恋结论

系统可以表达：

```text
你们在以下方面较为接近
对方符合你设置的若干重要条件
有些信息仍需进一步了解
```

不得表达：

```text
你们有 93% 概率结婚
这是你的灵魂伴侣
平台保证你们适合
对方一定会喜欢你
```

## 3.5 用户明确偏好优先

优先级：

```text
用户硬条件
→ 用户重要性设置
→ 平台透明默认权重
→ 反馈形成的可撤销调整
```

不得根据外貌、文本或行为秘密推断未声明的敏感偏好。

class RecommendationItemStatus(StrEnum):
    READY = "ready"
    EXPOSED = "exposed"
    VIEWED = "viewed"
    ACTED = "acted"
    SKIPPED = "skipped"
    WITHDRAWN = "withdrawn"
    INVALIDATED = "invalidated"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
```

## 6.3 候选关系状态

```python
class CandidatePairStatus(StrEnum):
    ELIGIBLE = "eligible"
    HARD_CONSTRAINT_FAILED = "hard_constraint_failed"
    SAFETY_BLOCKED = "safety_blocked"
    PRIVACY_BLOCKED = "privacy_blocked"
    COOLDOWN = "cooldown"
    ALREADY_INTERACTED = "already_interacted"
    RANKED = "ranked"
    EXPOSED = "exposed"
    INVALIDATED = "invalidated"
```

# 七、Skill 14.1：`vav-recommendation-domain-model`

## 目标

建立推荐策略、候选关系、特征快照、评分结果、批次、推荐项、曝光和反馈模型。

## 7.1 推荐策略

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_strategies (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    strategy_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    hard_constraint_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    feature_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    scoring_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    bidirectional_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    ranking_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    diversification_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    exposure_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    explanation_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    applicable_regions JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    applicable_segments JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(strategy_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 7.2 候选对

用户对必须规范化：

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_candidate_pairs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_low_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    user_high_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    low_profile_projection_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    high_profile_projection_version INTEGER NOT NULL,

    low_preference_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    high_preference_version INTEGER NOT NULL,

    strategy_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES recommendation_strategies(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    eligibility_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
    hard_constraint_snapshot JSONB,
    score_snapshot JSONB,

    generated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,

    invalidated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    invalidation_reason VARCHAR(128),

    CHECK (user_low_id <> user_high_id),
    CHECK (user_low_id < user_high_id),

    UNIQUE(
        user_low_id,
        user_high_id,
        strategy_id,
        low_profile_projection_version,
        high_profile_projection_version,
        low_preference_version,
        high_preference_version
    )
);
```

用户 UUID 的数据库排序实现应使用稳定规范化函数，不能依赖调用方传入顺序。

## 7.3 推荐批次

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_batches (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    batch_number BIGINT NOT NULL,
    batch_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    strategy_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES recommendation_strategies(id),

    profile_projection_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    preference_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    privacy_settings_version INTEGER NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    requested_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    generated_size INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    generated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    activated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    generation_report JSONB,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(user_id, batch_number)
);
```

## 7.4 推荐项

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_items (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    recommendation_batch_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES recommendation_batches(id),

    viewer_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    recommended_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    candidate_pair_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES recommendation_candidate_pairs(id),

    rank_position INTEGER NOT NULL,

    viewer_to_candidate_score_bps INTEGER NOT NULL,
    candidate_to_viewer_score_bps INTEGER NOT NULL,
    bidirectional_score_bps INTEGER NOT NULL,

    confidence_bps INTEGER NOT NULL,

    explanation_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
    visible_profile_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ready',

    available_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    exposed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    viewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(recommendation_batch_id, recommended_user_id)
);
```

## 输出迁移

```text
services/api/migrations/versions/0054_recommendation_strategies.py
services/api/migrations/versions/0055_recommendation_candidates_scores.py
services/api/migrations/versions/0056_recommendation_batches_items.py
services/api/migrations/versions/0057_recommendation_exposures.py
services/api/migrations/versions/0058_recommendation_feedback.py
services/api/migrations/versions/0059_recommendation_evaluations_experiments.py
```

# 八、推荐资格规则

推荐池用户必须满足：

```text
账户 ACTIVE
婚恋档案 ACTIVE
批准版本存在
推荐投影 eligible = true
年龄资格有效
用户允许进入推荐池
择偶条件有效
主照片满足平台策略
没有删除申请执行中
没有安全暂停
没有推荐暂停
```

推荐对必须满足：

```text
不是同一用户
双方未屏蔽
双方不处于安全限制关系
双方未有进行中的认识期或关系
双方未存在未结束的互选/邀请
不在近期跳过冷却期
双方隐私允许被推荐
双方关系资格兼容
```

---

# 九、Skill 14.2：`vav-candidate-eligibility-generation`

## 目标

实现推荐池、基础候选召回、安全排除和候选对生成。

## 9.1 推荐池投影

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_pool_entries (
    user_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id),

    dating_profile_id UUID NOT NULL,
    profile_projection_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    preference_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    privacy_settings_version INTEGER NOT NULL,

    region_code VARCHAR(128),
    city_code VARCHAR(128),
    age_bucket VARCHAR(32),
    gender_code VARCHAR(64),

    relationship_intent VARCHAR(64),

    eligible BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    eligibility_reasons JSONB NOT NULL,

    searchable_from TIMESTAMPTZ,
    searchable_until TIMESTAMPTZ,

    pool_version INTEGER NOT NULL,

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 9.2 基础召回策略

第一版采用确定性规则召回：

```text
关系资格兼容
年龄基础区间
地区或迁居基础条件
语言基础兼容
信仰基础要求
婚史与子女硬条件
```

在召回阶段只读取允许自动推荐的规范化字段。

## 9.3 候选生成 API

内部：

```http
POST /api/v1/internal/recommendations/users/{user_id}/candidate-generation
GET  /api/v1/internal/recommendations/users/{user_id}/candidate-diagnostics
```

## 9.4 安全 Gateway

```python
await moderation_gateway.evaluate_recommendation_pair(
    viewer_user_id=user_id,
    candidate_user_id=candidate_id,
)
```

返回：

```python
class RecommendationSafetyDecision(BaseModel):
    allowed: bool
    reason_code: str | None
    restriction_version: int
    valid_until: datetime | None
```

安全服务只返回推荐是否允许，不向推荐模块泄露完整举报或调查详情。

## 9.5 候选生成上限

```dotenv
RECOMMENDATION_MAX_CANDIDATES_PER_USER=1000
```

候选太多时先进行粗筛，不允许一次把所有用户完整特征加载到应用内存。

---

# 十、基础关系资格

## 双方期望对象兼容

```text
A 的 eligible_partner_gender_codes 接受 B
并且
B 的 eligible_partner_gender_codes 接受 A
```

关系资格政策必须来自版本化 Schema 和业务规则。

推荐系统不应自行扩大用户明确的关系对象范围。

---

# 十一、候选失效

以下事件应立即失效相关候选：

```text
dating_profile.paused
dating_profile.suspended
dating_profile.privacy_updated
dating_profile.preference_updated
dating_profile.approved
user.account.suspended
moderation.block.created
moderation.restriction.created
matchmaking.relationship.started
privacy.erasure.started
```

失效采用：

```text
标记 INVALIDATED
→ 清理未曝光推荐项
→ 撤销相关缓存
→ 不删除历史评分审计
```

---

# 十二、Skill 14.3：`vav-hard-constraint-engine`

## 目标

实现双方显式硬条件过滤和失败原因。

## 12.1 硬条件结果

```python
class HardConstraintEvaluation(BaseModel):
    passed: bool

    viewer_constraints: list[ConstraintResult]
    candidate_constraints: list[ConstraintResult]

    blocking_codes: list[str]
    unknown_codes: list[str]

    policy_version: str
```

## 12.2 单条件结果

```python
class ConstraintResult(BaseModel):
    criterion_code: str
    direction: Literal[
        "viewer_to_candidate",
        "candidate_to_viewer",
    ]

    passed: bool | None
    reason_code: str

    source_preference_version: int
    evaluated_value_snapshot: dict

    unknown_policy: str | None
```

## 12.3 第一版硬条件

```text
relationship_eligibility
age_range
country_region_city
relocation_willingness
language_requirement
faith_status
church_tradition
marital_status
partner_with_children
desire_children
smoking_status
relationship_intent
```

只有用户明确标记为：

```text
hard_constraint = true
```

或系统批准的安全/资格条件，才执行硬性排除。

## 12.4 未知值策略

用户可以选择：

```text
未知也可以推荐
未知则不推荐
未知降低得分，但不排除
```

由：

```text
allow_unknown
```

决定。

系统不能把候选人未填写某字段自动当作“不符合”。

## 12.5 自动放宽

默认禁止：

```dotenv
RECOMMENDATION_HARD_CONSTRAINT_AUTO_RELAX=false
```

只有用户明确启用：

```text
allow_system_relaxation = true
```

时，系统才可生成“扩展推荐”，且必须明显标记：

```text
此推荐放宽了你允许放宽的地区偏好。
```

系统不得放宽：

```text
成人资格
双方关系对象资格
安全屏蔽
明确不接受的婚史条件
用户禁止放宽的信仰要求
```

---

# 十三、硬条件诊断

用户端可以看到自己的候选不足原因摘要：

```text
你当前的硬性条件较多
当前地区合格档案较少
部分用户相关信息尚未填写
```

不得向用户显示：

```text
具体是谁因为哪个隐私条件被排除
其他用户完整择偶偏好
某个用户拒绝了你的特定属性
```

管理端诊断也应优先展示聚合统计。

---

# 十四、Skill 14.4：`vav-soft-scoring-engine`

## 目标

实现基于显式偏好、平台默认策略和信息置信度的软条件评分。

## 14.1 Feature 定义

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_feature_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    feature_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    feature_group VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    value_schema JSONB NOT NULL,
    scoring_function_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    sensitivity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    explainable BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    user_configurable BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(feature_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 14.2 第一版 Feature Group

```text
faith_and_values
location_and_relocation
family_and_parenting
relationship_intent
lifestyle
communication
interests
language
education_and_work
profile_readiness
```

`profile_readiness` 只可以影响展示信心或排序稳定性，不能作为人格价值分。

## 14.3 用户重要性到基础权重

建议默认映射：

```text
VERY_IMPORTANT → 100
IMPORTANT      → 70
NICE_TO_HAVE   → 35
NO_PREFERENCE  → 0
```

`REQUIRED` 应进入硬条件，不再作为普通软分重复加权。

权重必须保存在策略版本中，不硬编码在多个服务。

## 14.4 单向得分

```python
class DirectionalCompatibilityScore(BaseModel):
    source_user_id: UUID
    target_user_id: UUID

    total_score_bps: int
    confidence_bps: int

    feature_scores: list[FeatureScore]
    missing_information: list[str]
    unknown_feature_count: int

    scoring_policy_version: str
```

## Feature Score

```python
class FeatureScore(BaseModel):
    feature_code: str
    raw_match_bps: int
    importance_weight: int
    weighted_score: int

    confidence_bps: int
    explanation_code: str | None
```

## 14.5 得分计算

概念上：

```text
加权匹配和
÷
具有有效信息的权重和
```

并单独计算：

```text
confidence_bps
```

避免：

```text
只填写一个字段且正好相同
→ 得到 100% 高置信推荐
```

## 14.6 Missingness

信息缺失不应默认为 0 分。

支持：

```text
IGNORE_AND_LOWER_CONFIDENCE
NEUTRAL_SCORE
CONFIGURED_PENALTY
```

默认：

```text
忽略该项
降低置信度
在解释中标记需要进一步了解
```

---

# 十五、第一版评分函数

## Exact Match

适用于：

```text
relationship_intent
smoking_status
language
```

## Set Overlap

适用于：

```text
interests
church_traditions
communication_preferences
family_values
```

可使用 Jaccard 类重合度，但结果必须归一化并可解释。

## Ordered Distance

适用于：

```text
faith importance
exercise frequency
social style
```

## Geographic Compatibility

结合：

```text
同城市
同地区
跨地区
双方迁居意愿
线上认识意愿
```

不能直接读取精确地址。

## Range Match

适用于：

```text
年龄
身高等可选范围
```

硬范围已在过滤阶段处理，软范围用于偏好中心程度。

---

# 十六、禁止的隐性评分

第一版不得自动从以下内容生成未审阅评分：

```text
照片吸引力
人脸特征
肤色或种族推断
收入推断
阶层推断
健康推断
人格诊断
属灵成熟度
心理健康状态
AI 对话中的私人内容
辅导记录
支付能力
消费金额
```

运营人员也不能通过后台临时添加这些隐性特征。

---

# 十七、Skill 14.5：`vav-bidirectional-compatibility`

## 目标

将 A→B 和 B→A 的适配度合成为双向推荐得分。

## 17.1 双向得分结果

```python
class BidirectionalCompatibilityResult(BaseModel):
    user_a_to_b_score_bps: int
    user_b_to_a_score_bps: int

    combined_score_bps: int
    minimum_directional_score_bps: int
    balance_score_bps: int
    confidence_bps: int

    asymmetric_features: list[str]
    mutual_strengths: list[str]
    mutual_unknowns: list[str]

    policy_version: str
```

## 17.2 推荐合成策略

推荐采用可配置组合：

```text
最低方向得分
＋
几何平均或调和平均
＋
平衡度
```

不能只用简单算术平均，否则：

```text
A→B = 95
B→A = 25
平均 = 60
```

可能掩盖明显单边不适配。

## 17.3 默认保护规则

```dotenv
RECOMMENDATION_MIN_DIRECTIONAL_SCORE_BPS=4000
RECOMMENDATION_MIN_BIDIRECTIONAL_SCORE_BPS=5000
```

这是工程默认，不代表婚恋适配的科学真理，应通过真实业务数据和评测调整。

## 17.4 Balance Score

用于识别：

```text
双方得分是否过于不对称
```

但不能展示：

```text
对方对你的系统估计分数是 42%
```

用户端只显示双向共同点和需要进一步了解的信息。

## 17.5 对称性不变量

对同一候选对：

```text
Pair(A, B)
与
Pair(B, A)
```

必须共享一个候选对记录，但可以为每个查看者生成不同推荐解释和可见档案快照。

---

# 十八、Skill 14.6：`vav-ranking-diversification`

## 目标

实现稳定排序、多样化、新颖性和曝光约束。

## 18.1 排序输入

```text
双向适配得分
最低单向得分
置信度
档案当前有效性
新颖性
近期曝光
用户反馈
多样化约束
冷启动探索
会员权益边界
安全限制
```

会员权益只能影响：

```text
每天可查看数量
高级筛选能力
推荐频率
```

不能让付费用户无视对方硬条件或安全限制。

## 18.2 稳定排序

同一批次必须固定：

```text
Strategy Version
Candidate Snapshot
Scoring Version
Random Seed
Ranking Policy
```

用户刷新页面不能无原因大幅改变同一批次排序。

## 18.3 多样化维度

可在合格范围中适度多样化：

```text
城市或距离
兴趣组合
生活方式组合
资料新颖度
从未曝光的档案
```

不得通过多样化绕过硬条件。

## 18.4 MMR 类多样化边界

可以使用最大边际相关性类策略：

```text
高适配
＋
与已选推荐不过度重复
```

特征和参数必须版本化，结果必须可复现。

## 18.5 排序结果

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_rank_results (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    recommendation_batch_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES recommendation_batches(id),

    candidate_pair_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES recommendation_candidate_pairs(id),

    base_score_bps INTEGER NOT NULL,
    adjusted_score_bps INTEGER NOT NULL,

    novelty_adjustment_bps INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    diversity_adjustment_bps INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    exposure_adjustment_bps INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    exploration_adjustment_bps INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    final_rank INTEGER NOT NULL,

    adjustment_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(recommendation_batch_id, candidate_pair_id)
);
```

调整后的得分不得伪装成原始适配度。

---

# 十九、人工运营干预边界

管理端可以：

```text
暂停某策略
取消错误批次
从推荐池移除安全受限档案
设置全局曝光上限
启用经审批的探索策略
重建投影
```

普通运营人员不得：

```text
手工把特定两个人强行推荐给彼此
提高某个熟人的排名
绕过硬条件
绕过屏蔽
绕过安全限制
查看用户完整私密择偶条件
```

若未来需要人工婚介推荐，应建立独立的人工推荐流程、用户知情和审计，不能混入算法排序后台。

---

# 二十、Skill 14.7：`vav-explanation-generation`

## 目标

生成用户可理解、双向安全且不泄露他人偏好的推荐解释。

## 20.1 解释模型

```python
class RecommendationExplanation(BaseModel):
    summary: str

    mutual_strengths: list[ExplanationItem]
    relevant_preferences: list[ExplanationItem]
    topics_to_explore: list[ExplanationItem]
    information_gaps: list[ExplanationItem]

    caveat: str

    explanation_policy_version: str
```

## 20.2 Explanation Item

```python
class ExplanationItem(BaseModel):
    explanation_code: str
    display_text: str

    source_feature_codes: list[str]
    confidence_bps: int

    disclosure_level: str
```

## 20.3 可显示解释

```text
你们都重视稳定的教会生活
你们的关系目标较接近
你们都愿意在婚后继续参与教会群体
双方都接受跨城市认识
你们在作息和社交方式上较接近
你们有若干共同兴趣
```

## 20.4 需要进一步了解

```text
对方尚未填写某项家庭期待
双方对未来居住地的具体计划仍需沟通
双方在生活节奏上存在差异
```

## 20.5 不可显示

```text
对方把你的年龄设为最低可接受边缘
对方并不喜欢你的职业，只是其他分数较高
对方的完整硬条件清单
对方过去拒绝过某类人
内部评分权重
其他候选人的排名
```

## 20.6 规则优先解释

首版解释由规则和模板生成，不依赖自由生成模型。

如使用 AI 润色：

```text
输入只能是已批准 Explanation Items
不得加入新事实
不得显示隐藏偏好
输出经过 Schema 校验
失败时回退规则模板
```

---

# 二十一、推荐透明度页面

用户可以查看：

```text
推荐主要依据哪些资料类别
哪些是自己明确设置的偏好
哪些是平台默认软排序
哪些字段缺失
如何调整推荐条件
如何关闭反馈个性化
```

用户不能查看其他用户的偏好和内部安全信息。

---

# 二十二、Skill 14.8：`vav-recommendation-batches-exposure`

## 目标

实现推荐批次、曝光预算、重复控制、冷却期和热门档案保护。

## 22.1 曝光记录

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_exposures (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    recommendation_item_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES recommendation_items(id),

    viewer_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    exposed_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    exposure_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    exposure_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,

    source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    exposed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    duration_ms INTEGER,

    idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(viewer_user_id, idempotency_key)
);
```

## 22.2 Exposure Type

```python
class RecommendationExposureType(StrEnum):
    CARD_IMPRESSION = "card_impression"
    CARD_VISIBLE = "card_visible"
    PROFILE_OPENED = "profile_opened"
    PHOTO_VIEWED = "photo_viewed"
```

`CARD_IMPRESSION` 和真正可见必须区分，避免列表加载但用户未看到也计为有效曝光。

## 22.3 曝光预算

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_exposure_budgets (
    user_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id),

    daily_received_limit INTEGER NOT NULL,
    daily_shown_limit INTEGER NOT NULL,

    current_received_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    current_shown_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    budget_date DATE NOT NULL,

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

其中：

```text
received
用户今天能看到多少推荐

shown
某档案今天最多被多少人展示
```

## 22.4 默认限制

```dotenv
RECOMMENDATION_DAILY_BATCH_SIZE=10
RECOMMENDATION_MAX_DAILY_RECEIVED=20
RECOMMENDATION_MAX_DAILY_SHOWN_PER_PROFILE=50
RECOMMENDATION_REPEAT_EXPOSURE_COOLDOWN_DAYS=30
```

这些默认值应根据用户规模和运营数据调整。

## 22.5 曝光公平

系统应监控：

```text
有资格档案被展示次数分布
首次获得曝光所需时间
新用户曝光
长尾档案曝光
不同地区的曝光不足
不同档案完整度区间的曝光
```

不得为了平均曝光而把明显不符合条件的人推荐给用户。

## 22.6 热门档案保护

对短期曝光过多的档案：

```text
减少新曝光
保留已经形成的合法互动
避免通知轰炸
防止单一档案占据大量推荐位
```

热门抑制不等同于惩罚，且必须在相同适配候选范围内执行。

---

# 二十三、批次生成

## 定时批次

```text
读取用户当前推荐资格
→ 获取有效候选
→ 过滤硬条件
→ 计算/读取评分
→ 应用曝光预算
→ 多样化排序
→ 冻结可见档案快照
→ 创建 Batch
→ 原子激活
```

## 即时补充

用户已经处理完当前批次时：

```text
检查当天接收预算
→ 从未曝光合格候选中补充
→ 创建 SUPPLEMENTAL Batch
```

不得无限刷新以绕过每日限制。

## 批次快照

推荐项保存：

```text
当时批准档案版本
隐私版本
适配得分版本
解释版本
可见档案快照
```

用户打开旧推荐时仍需重新检查：

```text
目标档案是否仍 ACTIVE
是否出现屏蔽
是否出现安全限制
隐私是否撤回
```

---

# 二十四、Skill 14.9：`vav-cold-start-exploration`

## 目标

处理新用户、新档案、少数据地区和无行为历史场景。

## 24.1 用户冷启动类型

```python
class ColdStartType(StrEnum):
    NEW_USER = "new_user"
    NEW_PROFILE = "new_profile"
    SPARSE_PREFERENCES = "sparse_preferences"
    SPARSE_REGION = "sparse_region"
    NO_INTERACTION_HISTORY = "no_interaction_history"
```

## 24.2 新用户策略

优先使用：

```text
明确硬条件
用户标记的重要偏好
地区和迁居
关系目标
信仰与家庭价值观
多样化探索
```

不使用：

```text
其他相似用户秘密行为
外貌预测
消费金额
AI 对话
辅导内容
```

## 24.3 偏好引导

当偏好过少时，用户端提示：

```text
补充 3-5 个重要条件可改善推荐解释
你可以将条件设为“硬性”“重要”或“无偏好”
```

不能强迫用户填写所有敏感字段。

## 24.4 探索位

每批可保留有限探索位：

```dotenv
RECOMMENDATION_EXPLORATION_SLOT_COUNT=2
```

探索候选仍必须：

```text
通过双方硬条件
通过安全和隐私检查
达到最低双向得分
```

探索只是尝试不同的软条件组合，不是绕过资格。

## 24.5 新档案保护

新批准档案：

```text
在合格候选中获得最低必要曝光机会
受到每日最大曝光保护
不会因无历史反馈永久沉底
```

---

# 二十五、无候选处理

当硬条件后没有候选：

```text
明确说明当前没有符合全部硬条件的推荐
显示哪些条件造成较大候选缩减的聚合信息
允许用户手动调整条件
允许用户启用某些可放宽条件
推荐相关活动或课程作为替代服务
```

不得：

```text
静默绕过硬条件
制造虚假推荐
推荐被屏蔽用户
暗中修改用户偏好
```

---

# 二十六、Skill 14.10：`vav-feedback-learning-experiments`

## 目标

建立推荐反馈事件、聚合特征、受控策略学习和实验管理。

## 26.1 反馈事件

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_feedback_events (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    viewer_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    recommended_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    recommendation_item_id UUID REFERENCES recommendation_items(id),
    candidate_pair_id UUID REFERENCES recommendation_candidate_pairs(id),

    feedback_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    reason_code VARCHAR(128),
    reason_details_encrypted TEXT,

    source_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_event_id UUID,

    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    received_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(viewer_user_id, idempotency_key)
);
```

## 26.2 Feedback Type

```python
class RecommendationFeedbackType(StrEnum):
    IMPRESSION = "impression"
    VIEWED = "viewed"
    PROFILE_OPENED = "profile_opened"
    LIKED = "liked"
    SKIPPED = "skipped"
    NOT_RELEVANT = "not_relevant"
    WITHDRAWN = "withdrawn"
    MUTUAL_MATCHED = "mutual_matched"
    INTRODUCTION_ACCEPTED = "introduction_accepted"
    INTRODUCTION_DECLINED = "introduction_declined"
    RELATIONSHIP_STARTED = "relationship_started"
    RELATIONSHIP_ENDED = "relationship_ended"
    REPORTED = "reported"
    BLOCKED = "blocked"
```

Batch 15、16、18 通过事件提供后续反馈。

## 26.3 反馈原因

用户可选择：

```text
地区不合适
信仰期待不同
关系目标不同
家庭和生育期待不同
生活方式不合适
资料不足
暂时不想认识
不希望说明
其他
```

原因只用于改善当前用户推荐，不向被跳过用户展示。

## 26.4 负反馈优先保护

```text
BLOCKED / REPORTED
→ 立即移除候选
→ 通知安全模块
→ 不作为普通偏好学习数据

SKIPPED
→ 进入冷却期
→ 不等同永久拒绝

NOT_RELEVANT
→ 可用于调整偏好权重
→ 不能自动产生新的硬条件
```

## 26.5 学习层级

### 第一阶段

```text
规则权重
显式用户反馈
离线重新估计
人工批准后发布
```

### 后续阶段

可扩展：

```text
Learning-to-rank
Contextual bandit
Pairwise ranking
Calibration
```

但必须满足：

```text
特征白名单
离线评测
公平性评测
隐私审批
策略版本
可回滚
```

第一版不得让线上模型实时、不可控地直接修改用户推荐逻辑。

# 二十七、用户个性化偏好

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_user_tuning_profiles (
    user_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id),

    tuning_version INTEGER NOT NULL,

    feature_weight_adjustments JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    exploration_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'balanced',

    feedback_personalization_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    derived_from_feedback_through TIMESTAMPTZ,

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

用户可以：

```text
关闭行为反馈个性化
重置推荐调整
继续保留自己明确设置的择偶条件
```

关闭后不得继续使用新行为更新个性化权重。

# 二十八、策略实验

## 28.1 Experiment

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_experiments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    experiment_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,

    hypothesis TEXT NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    control_strategy_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES recommendation_strategies(id),
    treatment_strategy_ids JSONB NOT NULL,

    eligibility_definition JSONB NOT NULL,
    allocation_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    primary_metrics JSONB NOT NULL,
    guardrail_metrics JSONB NOT NULL,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 28.2 Experiment Assignment

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_experiment_assignments (
    experiment_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES recommendation_experiments(id),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    variant_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    assignment_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    assigned_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY(experiment_id, user_id)
);
```

## 28.3 护栏指标

```text
举报率
屏蔽率
严重负反馈率
跨用户隐私违规
硬条件违规
安全阻断违规
曝光极端不平衡
推荐空结果率
用户退出推荐池率
```

不得只以：

```text
点击率
喜欢率
停留时长
```

判断策略成功。

# 二十九、离线评测数据集

```sql
CREATE TABLE recommendation_evaluation_datasets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    dataset_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,

    fixture_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    privacy_review_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

评测使用：

```text
合成档案
明确授权的脱敏样本
固定策略版本
固定 Taxonomy
固定偏好版本
```

不得直接复制真实用户完整敏感档案到开发测试仓库。

# 三十、推荐评测指标

## 正确性

```text
Hard Constraint Violation Rate
Eligibility Violation Rate
Blocked-pair Leakage Rate
Profile-version Accuracy
Preference-version Accuracy
Explanation Consistency
```

## 排序质量

```text
NDCG@K
Precision@K
Pairwise Agreement
Bidirectional Minimum Score
Calibration
```

## 覆盖和多样化

```text
Candidate Coverage
Catalog Coverage
Profile Exposure Coverage
Intra-list Diversity
Repeat Exposure Rate
Cold-start First Exposure Time
```

## 公平与安全

```text
Exposure Distribution
Qualified Long-tail Exposure
Group-level Qualified Exposure Gap
Report Rate
Block Rate
Privacy Violation Rate
Safety Restriction Violation Rate
```

所谓公平评测应比较**在同等资格约束下的曝光差异**，不能为了指标好看而违反用户明确条件。

# 三十六、审计事件

# 四十、Makefile 新命令

```makefile
recommendation-migrate:
	docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head

recommendation-seed:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.seed_recommendations

	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.seed_recommendation_evaluations

recommendation-build-pool:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.build_recommendation_pool

recommendation-generate-fixtures:

recommendation-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/recommendations/unit tests/recommendations/integration -q

recommendation-concurrency-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/recommendations/concurrency -q

	docker compose exec api pytest tests/recommendations/fairness -q

	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.run_recommendation_evaluation

recommendation-verify:

	$(MAKE) recommendation-user-e2e
	$(MAKE) recommendation-admin-e2e
```
