# 六、核心状态机

## 6.1 会员账户状态

```python
class MembershipAccountStatus(StrEnum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    TRIALING = "trialing"
    GRACE_PERIOD = "grace_period"
    PAST_DUE = "past_due"
    PAUSED = "paused"
    CANCEL_SCHEDULED = "cancel_scheduled"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
    REVOKED = "revoked"
```

典型付费流程：

```text
PENDING
→ ACTIVE
→ CANCEL_SCHEDULED
→ CANCELLED
→ FREE_PLAN_FALLBACK
```

付款失败流程：

```text
ACTIVE
→ PAST_DUE
→ GRACE_PERIOD
├── ACTIVE
└── EXPIRED
```

## 6.2 会员周期状态

```python
class MembershipCycleStatus(StrEnum):
    SCHEDULED = "scheduled"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    CLOSED = "closed"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
    SUPERSEDED = "superseded"
```

## 6.3 计划变更状态

```python
class MembershipChangeStatus(StrEnum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    QUOTED = "quoted"
    CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED = "confirmation_required"
    CONFIRMED = "confirmed"
    SCHEDULED = "scheduled"
    PROCESSING = "processing"
    APPLIED = "applied"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"

# 七、Skill 17.1：`vav-membership-domain-model`

## 目标

建立会员计划、计划版本、会员账户、周期、权益授予和变更记录。

## 7.1 会员计划

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_plans (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    plan_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    internal_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,

    plan_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',

    default_locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    current_version_id UUID,

    display_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    featured BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    updated_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    archived_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 7.2 Plan Type

```python
class MembershipPlanType(StrEnum):
    FREE = "free"
    PAID = "paid"
    TRIAL = "trial"
    INTERNAL_GRANT = "internal_grant"
```

## 7.3 计划版本

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_plan_versions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    membership_plan_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES membership_plans(id),

    version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    benefit_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    access_policy_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
    quota_policy_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    activated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(membership_plan_id, version_number)
);
```

## 7.4 本地化

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_plan_localizations (
    membership_plan_version_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES membership_plan_versions(id),

    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    short_description VARCHAR(500),
    description_blocks JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    benefit_summary JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    limitation_summary JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    PRIMARY KEY(membership_plan_version_id, locale)
);
```

## 7.5 会员账户

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_accounts (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    membership_plan_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES membership_plans(id),
    membership_plan_version_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES membership_plan_versions(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    source_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    catalog_sku_id UUID REFERENCES product_skus(id),
    commerce_subscription_id UUID,
    entitlement_id UUID REFERENCES entitlements(id),

    current_cycle_id UUID,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    cancel_at_period_end BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    cancellation_effective_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    grace_period_ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(user_id, id)
);
```

建立一个付费/试用活动会员唯一索引：

```sql
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_current_active_membership
ON membership_accounts(user_id)
WHERE status IN (
    'active',
    'trialing',
    'grace_period',
    'past_due',
    'cancel_scheduled'
);
```

免费基础会员可以作为独立 Fallback 记录，也可以通过运行时计划解析实现；本批建议保留显式免费会员记录。

# 八、Skill 17.2：`vav-plan-benefit-registry`

## 目标

## 8.1 权益定义

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_benefit_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    benefit_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    benefit_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    value_schema JSONB NOT NULL,

    owning_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    sensitivity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'internal',

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(benefit_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 8.2 Benefit Type

```python
class MembershipBenefitType(StrEnum):
    CAPABILITY = "capability"
    RESOURCE_SCOPE = "resource_scope"
    QUOTA = "quota"
    LIMIT_OVERRIDE = "limit_override"
    PRICE_BENEFIT = "price_benefit"
    PRIORITY_ACCESS = "priority_access"
```

## 8.3 第一版权益代码

```text
platform.basic_access
ai.assistant.access
ai.message_quota

recommendation.daily_received_limit
recommendation.advanced_filters
recommendation.batch_frequency
recommendation.feedback_personalization

course.catalog_access
course.category_access
course.bundle_access

activity.priority_registration
activity.member_ticket_access

privacy.data_export_priority

```

`privacy.data_export_priority` 只能影响处理优先级，不能削弱用户的数据权利。

## 8.4 计划权益映射

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_plan_benefits (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    membership_plan_version_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES membership_plan_versions(id),

    benefit_definition_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES membership_benefit_definitions(id),

    benefit_value JSONB NOT NULL,

    valid_from_offset_days INTEGER,
    valid_until_offset_days INTEGER,

    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(
        membership_plan_version_id,
        benefit_definition_id
    )
);
```

## 8.5 Benefit Value 示例

AI 配额：

```json
{
  "limit": 100,
  "unit": "messages",
  "period": "membership_cycle",
  "rollover": false
}
```

课程范围：

```json
{
  "scope_type": "categories",
  "category_codes": [
    "relationship-foundations",
    "communication"
  ]
}
```

推荐上限：

```json
{
  "daily_received_limit": 30
}
```

## 8.6 权益注册原则

- 权益代码必须由所属模块批准。
- 管理员不能通过自由文本创建任意 Capability。
- 权益 Schema 变化必须发布新版本。
- 删除权益定义使用停用，不破坏历史会员。
- 权益不能修改安全或隐私政策。
- Price Benefit 必须交给 Batch 4 定价引擎执行。

# 九、会员计划发布

管理 API：

```http
GET  /api/v1/admin/memberships/plans
POST /api/v1/admin/memberships/plans
GET  /api/v1/admin/memberships/plans/{plan_id}
PATCH /api/v1/admin/memberships/plans/{plan_id}

POST /api/v1/admin/memberships/plans/{plan_id}/versions
POST /api/v1/admin/membership-plan-versions/{id}/submit-review
POST /api/v1/admin/membership-plan-versions/{id}/approve
POST /api/v1/admin/membership-plan-versions/{id}/activate
POST /api/v1/admin/membership-plan-versions/{id}/retire
```

发布前校验：

```text
存在完整本地化
权益代码全部有效
权益值符合 Schema
配额周期合法
收费计划关联有效 SKU
免费计划不需要支付
权益资源范围真实存在
没有安全绕过型权益
没有重复或冲突 Benefit
降级 Fallback 已定义
```

# 十、Skill 17.3：`vav-catalog-subscription-integration`

## 目标

连接 Membership Plan、Catalog SKU、Commerce Subscription 与 Entitlement。

## 10.1 SKU 映射

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_sku_mappings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    catalog_sku_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE
        REFERENCES product_skus(id),

    membership_plan_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES membership_plans(id),

        REFERENCES membership_plan_versions(id),

    grace_period_policy JSONB,

    valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,

);
```

## Billing Period

```python
class MembershipBillingPeriod(StrEnum):
    MONTHLY = "monthly"
    YEARLY = "yearly"
    CUSTOM = "custom"
    NONE = "none"
```

## 10.2 激活事件

消费：

```text
commerce.subscription.created
commerce.subscription.activated
commerce.subscription.updated
commerce.subscription.renewed
commerce.subscription.payment_failed
commerce.subscription.cancel_scheduled
commerce.subscription.cancelled
commerce.subscription.expired

entitlement.activated
entitlement.suspended
entitlement.revoked
entitlement.expired
```

## 10.3 Inbox

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_inbox_events (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    source_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_event_id UUID NOT NULL,

    event_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    event_version INTEGER NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    received_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    error_code VARCHAR(128),

    UNIQUE(source_module, source_event_id)
);
```

## 10.4 激活流程

```text
Subscription ACTIVE
＋
MEMBERSHIP_ACCESS Entitlement ACTIVE
→ 读取 SKU Mapping
→ 锁定用户会员账户
→ 创建或激活 Membership Account
→ 绑定 Plan Version
→ 创建当前 Cycle
→ 分配 Benefit Grants
→ 创建 Quota Buckets
→ 发出 membership.activated
```

## 10.5 不一致状态

例如：

```text
Subscription ACTIVE
但 Entitlement 尚未激活
```

会员账户保持：

```text
PENDING
```

并进入异步重试或 Reconciliation，不能直接认为会员已开通。

# 十一、会员周期

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_cycles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    membership_account_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES membership_accounts(id),

    cycle_number INTEGER NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    source_subscription_period_start TIMESTAMPTZ,
    source_subscription_period_end TIMESTAMPTZ,

    quota_allocated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    closed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(membership_account_id, cycle_number),
    CHECK (starts_at < ends_at)
);
```

周期时间必须优先使用 Commerce 已确认的订阅周期，不自行按本地月份推算。

# 十二、Skill 17.4：`vav-membership-account-lifecycle`

## 目标

实现会员账户、状态转换、用户会员摘要和付费到免费回退。

## 12.1 Source Type

```python
class MembershipSourceType(StrEnum):
    FREE_DEFAULT = "free_default"
    PAID_SUBSCRIPTION = "paid_subscription"
    TRIAL = "trial"
    ADMIN_GRANT = "admin_grant"
    COMPENSATION = "compensation"
    MIGRATION = "migration"
```

## 12.2 用户会员摘要

```python
class MembershipSummary(BaseModel):
    membership_account_id: UUID
    plan_code: str
    plan_name: str

    status: MembershipAccountStatus

    starts_at: datetime
    expires_at: datetime | None
    current_cycle_ends_at: datetime | None

    cancel_at_period_end: bool
    grace_period_ends_at: datetime | None

    benefits: list[MembershipBenefitSummary]
    quotas: list[MembershipQuotaSummary]
```

## 12.3 用户 API

```http
GET /api/v1/public/membership-plans
GET /api/v1/public/membership-plans/{plan_code}

GET /api/v1/account/membership
GET /api/v1/account/membership/benefits
GET /api/v1/account/membership/usage
GET /api/v1/account/membership/history
```

## 12.4 默认免费会员

注册成功后：

```text
创建 Free Membership Account
→ 绑定当前免费 Plan Version
→ 分配基础权益
→ 不创建支付订阅
```

付费会员激活后：

```text
Paid Membership 成为 Current Effective Membership
Free Membership 保留为 Fallback
```

付费到期：

```text
Paid Membership EXPIRED
→ 关闭付费配额
→ 恢复当前免费 Plan
→ 保留历史数据和已完成服务
```

## 12.5 多个会员账户

用户可以有：

```text
一个当前生效付费/试用会员
一个免费 Fallback
多个历史会员记录
```

不能同时激活两个冲突的付费计划，除非未来明确支持叠加计划。

# 十三、Skill 17.5：`vav-access-decision-engine`

## 目标

提供平台统一的会员访问判定。

## 13.1 Access Request

```python
class MembershipAccessRequest(BaseModel):
    user_id: UUID

    capability_code: str
    resource_type: str | None
    resource_id: UUID | None

    requested_quantity: int = 1

    purpose: str
    request_context: dict
```

## 13.2 Access Decision

```python
class MembershipAccessDecision(BaseModel):
    allowed: bool

    reason_code: str | None

    membership_account_id: UUID | None
    membership_plan_version_id: UUID | None

    benefit_code: str | None
    benefit_value: dict | None

    quota_required: bool
    quota_remaining: int | None

    valid_until: datetime | None

    decision_version: str
```

## 13.3 判定顺序

```text
账户是否 ACTIVE
→ 当前会员账户
→ Entitlement 是否有效
→ Plan Version 是否有效
→ Benefit 是否存在
→ Resource Scope 是否覆盖
→ 用户安全和隐私状态
→ 业务模块额外资格
→ 配额是否足够
→ 返回判定
```

## 13.4 内部 API

```http
POST /api/v1/internal/membership/access-decisions
POST /api/v1/internal/membership/quota-reservations
POST /api/v1/internal/membership/quota-consumptions
POST /api/v1/internal/membership/quota-releases
```

## 13.5 拒绝原因

```text
MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED
MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE
MEMBERSHIP_EXPIRED
BENEFIT_NOT_INCLUDED
RESOURCE_NOT_INCLUDED
QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED
SAFETY_RESTRICTED
ENTITLEMENT_INACTIVE
```

用户端只返回安全的可操作说明，不返回内部规则细节。

## 13.6 业务模块必须二次校验

会员判定 `allowed=true` 只表示：

```text
会员权益允许
```

业务模块仍需检查：

```text
课程是否发布
活动是否有名额
用户是否被屏蔽
推荐硬条件是否通过
辅导时段是否有效
```

# 十四、权限快照与缓存

```text
membership:access:
  {user_id}:{capability}:{resource}:{membership_version}:
  {entitlement_version}:{quota_version}:{restriction_version}
```

以下变化立即失效：

```text
会员计划变更
订阅状态变化
Entitlement 状态变化
配额消费
配额重置
账户暂停
安全限制
资源范围变化
计划版本迁移
```

对配额型访问不能长期缓存“允许”，消费时必须重新原子确认。

# 十五、Skill 17.6：`vav-quota-allocation-consumption`

## 目标

实现配额分配、预留、消费、释放和重置。

## 15.1 配额桶

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_quota_buckets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    membership_account_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES membership_accounts(id),

    membership_cycle_id UUID REFERENCES membership_cycles(id),

    benefit_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    period_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    period_starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    period_ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    allocated_quantity BIGINT NOT NULL,
    consumed_quantity BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reserved_quantity BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    rollover_quantity BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(
        membership_account_id,
        benefit_code,
        period_starts_at
    )
);
```

可用量：

```text
allocated
＋ rollover
－ consumed
－ reserved
```

## 15.2 Period Type

```python
class MembershipQuotaPeriodType(StrEnum):
    MEMBERSHIP_CYCLE = "membership_cycle"
    CALENDAR_DAY = "calendar_day"
    CALENDAR_WEEK = "calendar_week"
    CALENDAR_MONTH = "calendar_month"
    LIFETIME = "lifetime"
    ONE_TIME = "one_time"
```

## 15.3 配额流水

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_quota_ledger (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    quota_bucket_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES membership_quota_buckets(id),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    operation VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    quantity BIGINT NOT NULL,

    source_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_reference_id UUID,

    idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    before_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
    after_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(quota_bucket_id, idempotency_key)
);
```

## 15.4 配额预留

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_quota_reservations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    quota_bucket_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES membership_quota_buckets(id),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    source_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_reference_id UUID NOT NULL,

    quantity BIGINT NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    reserved_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    consumed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    released_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(quota_bucket_id, idempotency_key)
);
```

## 15.5 配额消费流程

```text
锁定 Quota Bucket
→ 检查状态和有效期
→ 计算剩余量
→ 剩余不足则拒绝
→ 增加 consumed 或 reserved
→ 写 Ledger
→ 更新版本
→ 提交
```

## 15.6 示例

AI 消息：

```text
发送前预留 1 次
→ Agent 成功生成有效回答
→ CONSUMED

模型故障且未提供有效回答
→ RELEASED
```

推荐查看：

```text
有效推荐卡片真正展示
→ 消费每日查看配额
```

页面预加载但用户未看到，不应消费配额。

---

# 十六、配额并发不变量

```text
配额不能消费成负数
多个 Worker 不能超卖配额
重复请求只消费一次
预留过期自动释放
会员到期阻止新预留
已完成消费不因重试重复增加
配额重置不能覆盖上一周期历史
```

数据库更新示例：

```sql
UPDATE membership_quota_buckets
SET
    reserved_quantity = reserved_quantity + :quantity,
    version = version + 1
WHERE id = :bucket_id
  AND status = 'active'
  AND allocated_quantity
      + rollover_quantity
      - consumed_quantity
      - reserved_quantity >= :quantity;
```

受影响行数为 0 时返回 `QUOTA_EXHAUSTED` 或状态错误。

---

# 十七、配额累计

默认：

```text
rollover = false
```

若计划允许累计：

```text
上周期未使用量
→ 按最大累计上限转入下一周期
```

必须配置：

```json
{
  "rollover": true,
  "maximum_rollover": 20,
  "rollover_expiry_cycles": 1
}
```

不能无限累计未使用配额，除非产品政策明确允许。

---

class MembershipChangeEffectivePolicy(StrEnum):

```

## 18.4 默认规则

```text
升级
→ 可立即生效
→ 金额和 Proration 由 Commerce 计算

降级
→ 默认下一周期生效

取消
→ 默认周期结束生效

立即取消
→ 仅明确政策或特殊处理
```

## 18.5 变更预览

用户必须看到：

```text
当前计划
目标计划
新价格
生效时间
当前周期费用处理
新增权益
失去的权益
配额变化

```

## 18.6 用户 API

```http
POST /api/v1/account/membership/change-preview
POST /api/v1/account/membership/change-requests

POST /api/v1/account/membership/change-requests/{id}/confirm
POST /api/v1/account/membership/change-requests/{id}/cancel
```

## 18.7 升级流程

```text
生成 Commerce Quote
→ 展示预览
→ 用户确认
→ Commerce 执行订阅变更
→ Webhook 确认
→ 新 Entitlement/Subscription 状态
→ Membership Plan Version 切换
→ 分配新增配额
→ 发出 membership.upgraded
```

## 18.8 降级流程

```text
生成下一周期变更
→ 当前周期保持原权益
→ 周期结束
→ Commerce 确认目标 SKU
→ 创建新 Cycle
→ 切换目标 Plan Version
→ 关闭旧周期未使用配额
```

不得在用户确认降级后立即剥夺本周期已付费权益。

# 十九、配额迁移规则

## 立即升级

可配置：

```text
保留已消费量
新增计划额度立即补差
或创建独立升级配额桶
```

示例：

```text
原额度 100，已消费 70
升级后额度 300
→ 新总可用 230
```

## 周期末降级

```text
本周期继续原额度
下一周期按低等级额度重新分配
```

## 已消费超过新计划额度

不回滚历史消费：

```text
下一周期使用新额度
当前周期不产生负配额债务
```

---

# 二十、Skill 17.8：`vav-renewal-expiry-grace`

## 目标

实现续费、付款失败、宽限期、到期和免费计划回退。

## 20.1 续费成功

```text
Commerce Subscription Renewed
→ 关闭旧 Cycle
→ 创建新 Cycle
→ 分配新周期配额
→ 更新 Membership expires_at
→ 发出 membership.renewed
```

## 20.2 付款失败

```text
payment_failed
→ Membership PAST_DUE
→ 根据计划进入 GRACE_PERIOD
→ 限制部分非必要权益
→ 保留必要账户访问
→ 通知用户
```

## 20.3 Grace Policy

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "duration_days": 3,
  "access_mode": "limited",
  "quota_mode": "no_new_allocation"
}
```

宽限期可以：

```text
保持当前课程只读访问
禁止新配额分配
限制高成本 AI 功能
保留用户数据和历史
```

具体范围必须按计划策略配置。

## 20.4 恢复付款

```text
Subscription ACTIVE
→ Membership ACTIVE
→ 恢复尚未过期权益
→ 是否补发配额按策略执行
```

不得因重复支付事件重复分配整周期配额。

## 20.5 到期

```text
Grace Period 结束
且无有效付款
→ Membership EXPIRED
→ 关闭付费 Benefit Grants
→ 关闭未使用 Quota Buckets
→ 回退 Free Membership
→ 发出 membership.expired
```

## 20.6 取消续费

```text
cancel_at_period_end = true
→ Membership CANCEL_SCHEDULED
→ 当前周期继续可用
→ 到期后 CANCELLED
→ 回退免费计划
```

---

# 二十一、Reconciliation

定时对账：

```text
Commerce Subscription
Entitlement
Membership Account
Current Cycle
Quota Buckets
```

检查：

```text
订阅 ACTIVE 但会员非 ACTIVE
会员 ACTIVE 但 Entitlement 无效
周期日期不一致
重复活动会员
配额桶缺失
计划版本映射缺失
已取消订阅仍分配新配额
```

异常进入：

```text
membership_reconciliation_issues
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_reconciliation_issues (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    membership_account_id UUID REFERENCES membership_accounts(id),

    issue_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    source_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    resolution_summary TEXT
);
```

## Grant Type

```python
class MembershipManualGrantType(StrEnum):
    CUSTOMER_SUPPORT = "customer_support"
    SERVICE_COMPENSATION = "service_compensation"
    PROMOTIONAL = "promotional"
    STAFF = "staff"
    MIGRATION = "migration"
```

## 22.4 人工操作保护

大额或长期赠送应：

```text
创建者与批准者分离
设置明确起止时间
填写原因
记录预计价值
可撤销
可审计
```

管理员不能创建永久无限会员，除非存在明确批准的内部计划。

---

# 二十三、补偿配额

服务故障补偿可以单独增加配额：

```sql
CREATE TABLE membership_quota_adjustments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    quota_bucket_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES membership_quota_buckets(id),

    adjustment_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    quantity BIGINT NOT NULL,

    reason_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    reason_encrypted TEXT,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(quota_bucket_id, idempotency_key)
);
```

禁止管理员直接修改 `consumed_quantity` 来“修复”配额。

# 二十四、Skill 17.10：`vav-events-notifications-integrations`

## 目标

定义会员事件并连接通知、课程、AI、推荐和辅导模块。

## 24.1 Outbox 事件

```text
membership.free_account.created
membership.trial.started
membership.activated
membership.renewed
membership.past_due
membership.grace_period.started
membership.grace_period.ended
membership.cancel_scheduled
membership.cancelled
membership.expired
membership.revoked

membership.upgrade.requested
membership.upgraded
membership.downgrade.scheduled
membership.downgraded
membership.change.failed

membership.cycle.started
membership.cycle.closed

membership.quota.allocated
membership.quota.reserved
membership.quota.consumed
membership.quota.released
membership.quota.exhausted
membership.quota.adjusted

membership.manual_grant.created
membership.manual_grant.revoked
```

## 24.2 通知

通知用户：

```text
会员开通
试用开始
续费成功
付款失败
宽限期
取消续费
会员即将到期
会员到期
升级完成
降级计划
配额即将用尽边界
```

不应高频发送：

```text
每次配额消费
每次访问判定
每次内部对账
```

## 24.3 课程模块

```text
course.access
→ Membership Access Decision
→ Course 继续校验课程状态和范围
```

## 24.4 AI 模块

```text
ai.assistant.access
＋
ai.message_quota
→ 预留配额
→ 有效回答后消费
```

风险和安全回应不应因普通配额耗尽而完全不可用；可保留有限安全响应通道。

## 24.5 推荐模块

会员可影响：

```text
推荐批次频率
每日接收上限
高级筛选入口
```

不能影响：

```text
对方硬条件
屏蔽
安全资格
联系方式隐私
```

## 24.6 辅导模块

会员可以提供：

```text
预约入口
会员价格资格
每周期辅导 Credit 边界
```

实际价格和次数仍由 Catalog、Commerce 与 Entitlement 决定。

# 三十四、必须通过的计划与权益场景

```text
管理员创建免费会员计划
管理员创建付费会员计划
计划具有不可变版本
权益值通过 Schema 验证
收费计划关联有效 SKU
免费计划不关联付费订阅
计划新版本不改变旧会员权益
停用权益仍能解释历史记录
安全绕过型权益不能发布
创建者不能单独批准自己的计划
```

---

# 三十五、必须通过的免费会员场景

```text
新注册用户获得免费会员
免费会员无需付款
免费会员获得基础权益
重复注册事件不创建重复免费会员
付费会员激活后免费会员成为 Fallback
付费会员到期后恢复免费会员
免费会员回退不删除历史课程和关系数据
```

---

# 三十六、必须通过的付费开通场景

```text
购买会员 SKU 创建 Subscription
支付返回页不能开通会员
Webhook 和 Entitlement 激活后开通
重复 Subscription 事件不重复开通
SKU 映射到正确 Plan Version
会员周期来自 Commerce 订阅周期
会员激活后分配正确权益
会员激活后分配正确配额
```

---

# 三十七、必须通过的访问控制场景

```text
包含 Capability 的会员获得访问
不包含 Capability 的会员被拒绝
资源范围不匹配时被拒绝
Entitlement 无效时被拒绝
会员过期时被拒绝
安全限制优先于会员权益
屏蔽优先于会员权益
推荐硬条件不被会员绕过
课程未发布时会员也不能访问
访问决定可追踪计划和权益版本
```

---

# 三十八、必须通过的配额场景

```text
周期开始分配配额
配额剩余量计算正确
预留后剩余量降低
消费后 reserved 转 consumed
释放后 reserved 恢复
重复消费只处理一次
两个 Worker 不能超用最后一个额度
配额耗尽返回明确错误
过期预留自动释放
会员到期不能新建预留
新周期创建新配额桶
旧周期使用流水保持不变
```

---

# 三十九、必须通过的升级场景

```text
用户可以预览升级
预览显示价格和权益变化
价格来自 Commerce Quote
用户确认后才执行升级
Webhook 确认后切换计划
升级不重复分配权益
立即升级正确处理新增配额
旧计划已消费量保留
升级失败保持原计划
重复确认返回原结果
```

---

# 四十、必须通过的降级场景

```text
用户可以预览降级
降级默认下一周期生效
当前周期权益保持
用户可以在生效前取消降级
周期结束后切换低等级计划
新周期使用低等级配额
历史消费不产生负额度
重复降级事件不重复切换
```

---

# 四十一、必须通过的续费与到期场景

```text
续费成功创建新周期
新周期配额只分配一次

# 四十四、Batch 17 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-17/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-17-membership-entitlements-quotas
description: Implement VAV membership plans, benefit packages, subscription projections, access decisions, quotas, upgrades, downgrades, renewal, expiry and membership administration.
---

# Goal

Build a production-oriented membership platform containing:

- free, paid, trial and internal membership plans;
- immutable plan versions;
- multilingual plan presentation;
- a versioned benefit registry;
- capability, resource-scope and quota benefits;
- Catalog SKU mappings;
- Commerce Subscription integration;
- MEMBERSHIP_ACCESS Entitlement integration;
- membership accounts and cycles;
- unified membership access decisions;
- quota allocation, reservation, consumption and release;
- upgrade and downgrade workflows;
- cancellation and reactivation;
- renewal, payment failure and grace periods;
- expiry and free-plan fallback;
- trials;
- manual grants and compensation;
- reconciliation;
- user-web membership management;
- admin-web membership operations;
- unit, integration, concurrency, security, reconciliation and E2E tests.

# Source requirements

The project plan requires a unified product, payment and service-access
platform for courses, activities, counseling and AI services.

Membership pricing, final tier names, quota values and benefit composition are
not fully defined. Implement all commercial rules as versioned configuration
rather than permanent hard-coded assumptions.

# Prerequisites

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 through Batch 16.
3. Verify Batch 16 with `make relationship-verify`.
4. Read every skill under `skills/batch-17`.
5. Inspect Catalog, Commerce, Entitlement, Course, Activity, Counseling, AI,
   Recommendation, Privacy, Moderation, Notification, RBAC, Audit, Outbox and
   Inbox contracts.
6. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-17-plan.md`.
7. Produce `docs/architecture/membership-entitlement-model.md`.
8. Produce `docs/architecture/membership-quota-ledger.md`.
9. Record unresolved tier, quota, grace, trial, rollover and upgrade policies
   in the decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. Membership plan and version domain.
2. Multilingual plan content.
3. Benefit registry.
4. Plan-benefit manifests.
5. Catalog SKU mappings.
6. Subscription and Entitlement Inbox projections.
7. Membership accounts and cycles.
8. Free membership creation.
9. Unified access-decision service.
10. Quota buckets and ledger.
11. Quota reservation and consumption.
12. Upgrade workflow.
13. Downgrade workflow.
14. Cancellation and reactivation.
15. Renewal and grace-period handling.
16. Expiry and free-plan fallback.
17. Trial and manual-grant workflows.
18. Reconciliation.
19. User-web membership experience.
20. Admin-web membership center.
21. Unit, integration, concurrency, security, reconciliation and E2E tests.

# Architecture constraints

- Catalog is the source of truth for products, SKUs and prices.
- Commerce is the source of truth for orders, subscriptions and payments.
- Entitlements are the source of truth for paid access rights.
- Membership is the source of truth for plan benefits, membership cycles and
  quota usage.
- Membership must not duplicate pricing or payment state.
- Payment-return pages do not activate membership.
- Membership activation requires verified Commerce and Entitlement state.
- Plan versions are immutable after activation.
- Existing members remain bound to their purchased plan version unless
  migrated explicitly.
- Baseline access decisions must not depend on AI availability.

# Plan and benefit invariants

- Every plan has explicit versions.
- Every benefit has a registered code and value schema.
- Paid plans map to valid Catalog SKUs.
- Free plans do not require a payment subscription.
- Benefits cannot bypass privacy, moderation, block, age or relationship
  eligibility policies.
- Benefit-definition removal does not destroy historical interpretation.
- Plan activation requires validation and approval.
- Plan creators cannot independently approve and activate their own release.

# Account invariants

- A user has at most one current conflicting paid or trial membership.
- A user may retain a free fallback membership.
- Membership status is projected from verified source events.
- Duplicate events cannot create duplicate membership accounts.
- Account changes preserve history.
- Membership expiry does not delete user data or separately purchased rights.
- Expired paid users fall back to the configured free plan.

# Access-decision invariants

- Access decisions use current membership, Entitlement and restriction state.
- Capability and resource-scope checks remain separate.
- Quota availability is checked for quota-bearing capabilities.
- Membership approval does not replace resource-specific authorization.
- Safety, privacy and business eligibility checks remain authoritative.
- Quota-backed decisions must be reconfirmed during reservation or
  consumption.
- Access decisions identify the benefit and plan version used.

# Quota invariants

- Quotas use integer quantities.
- Quota periods are explicit.
- Allocation, reservation, consumption, release and adjustment use an
  append-only ledger.
- Quotas cannot become negative.
- Concurrent workers cannot overconsume.
- Duplicate requests consume at most once.
- Expired reservations release capacity.
- New cycles create new quota buckets.
- Prior-cycle history remains immutable.
- Manual compensation uses adjustments, not direct counter modification.
- Rollover is disabled unless explicitly configured.

# Change invariants

- Upgrade and downgrade previews use Commerce quotes.
- Users confirm changes before execution.
- Immediate upgrades activate only after verified Commerce events.
- Downgrades default to the next cycle.
- Current paid-cycle rights are not silently removed by a future downgrade.
- Consumed quota is not erased.
- Failed changes preserve the original membership.
- Change operations are idempotent and auditable.

# Renewal and expiry invariants

- Renewal cycles come from verified Commerce subscription periods.
- Renewals allocate quotas exactly once.
- Payment failure does not invent a successful renewal.
- Grace-period rules are explicit and versioned.
- Safety and basic account access are not blocked by optional benefit
  exhaustion.
- Expiry closes paid benefits and activates the free fallback.
- Cancel-at-period-end preserves current-cycle rights.
- Cancellation and renewal races have one final source-backed result.

# Grant and trial invariants

- Trials use versioned eligibility policies.
- Repeated trial prevention is explicit.
- Manual grants require reasons and expiry.
- Long or high-value grants require approval.
- Grant creators and approvers are separated where required.
- Grants and trials cannot bypass safety or privacy policies.
- Revocation preserves audit history.

# Security invariants

- Users access only their own membership, usage and changes.
- Administrative sensitive reads require separate permissions.
- Membership cannot bypass another user's hard constraints or blocks.
- Administrators cannot mark subscriptions paid.
- Administrators cannot directly overwrite quota counters.
- Sensitive payment data is not copied into Membership.
- Caches include membership, Entitlement, quota and restriction versions.
- All plan, grant, quota, change and reconciliation operations are audited.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make membership-migrate
make membership-seed
make membership-seed-benefits
make membership-project-fixtures
make membership-test
make membership-concurrency-test
make membership-security-test
make membership-reconciliation-test
make membership-user-e2e
make membership-admin-e2e
make membership-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Administrators can create free and paid membership plans.
2. Plan versions are immutable.
3. Benefit definitions use schemas.
4. Paid plans map to valid Catalog SKUs.
5. New users receive free membership.
6. Verified subscriptions activate paid membership exactly once.
7. Invalid Entitlements cannot grant access.
8. Membership cycles follow Commerce periods.
9. Unified access decisions work.
10. Membership does not bypass safety or user conditions.
11. Quota allocation works.
12. Quota reservations are concurrency safe.
13. Quota consumption is idempotent.
14. Quota expiration and reset work.
15. Upgrade previews use Commerce quotes.
16. Immediate upgrades activate safely.
17. Downgrades apply at the next cycle.
18. Current-cycle rights remain intact during scheduled downgrade.
19. Cancel-at-period-end works.
20. Renewal creates one new cycle.
21. Payment failure and grace-period handling work.
22. Expiry activates the free fallback.
23. Trials work.
24. Manual grants require permission and reasons.
25. Compensation uses quota adjustments.
26. Reconciliation detects inconsistent states.
27. User membership E2E tests pass.
28. Admin membership E2E tests pass.
29. Membership concurrency tests pass.
30. Membership security tests pass.
31. Reconciliation tests pass.
32. `make relationship-verify` still succeeds.
33. `make interaction-verify` still succeeds.
34. `make recommendation-verify` still succeeds.
35. `make dating-profile-verify` still succeeds.
36. `make privacy-verify` still succeeds.
37. `make notification-verify` still succeeds.
38. `make ai-verify` still succeeds.
39. `make knowledge-verify` still succeeds.
40. `make counseling-verify` still succeeds.
41. `make course-verify` still succeeds.
42. `make activity-verify` still succeeds.
43. `make commerce-verify` still succeeds.
44. `make catalog-verify` still succeeds.
45. `make cms-verify` still succeeds.
46. `make auth-verify` still succeeds.
47. `make verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When membership tiers or quota values are unresolved:

1. record the unresolved policy;
2. use transparent baseline configuration;
3. keep plan and benefit versions immutable;
4. do not invent unlimited or guaranteed service claims;
5. continue implementing provider-independent membership capabilities.

When an access-security test fails:

1. stop the affected benefit;
2. invalidate related access caches;
3. identify the missing membership, Entitlement, resource or restriction
   check;
4. repair backend authorization;
5. add a regression test;
6. rerun Membership and owning-module security suites.

When quota concurrency fails:

1. stop quota-backed benefit delivery;
2. preserve competing ledger requests;
3. repair locking, atomic updates or idempotency;
4. reconcile affected buckets;
5. rerun all quota and business-module concurrency tests.

When subscription projection is inconsistent:

1. do not fabricate payment or subscription state;
2. preserve the source events;
3. mark the membership pending or restricted;
4. run reconciliation;
5. repair the projection idempotently.

When a membership plan accidentally bypasses safety policy:

1. deactivate the affected plan version;
2. invalidate related access decisions;
3. remove the prohibited benefit;
4. create a security incident;
5. add a release-blocking regression test.
```

# 三、核心架构原则

## 3.1 屏蔽是全平台安全边界

```text
A 屏蔽 B
→ 双方不再互相推荐
→ 已有未完成互动失效
→ 邀请失效
→ 联系方式 Grant 撤销
→ 关系旅程冻结或结束
→ 活动目录互相不可见
→ 非必要通知停止
```

不能只在前端隐藏对方卡片。

## 3.2 举报与屏蔽相互独立

```text
屏蔽
用户立即保护自己，不要求提交详细证据。

举报
请求平台审查潜在违规或风险。
```

用户可以只屏蔽不举报，也可以举报后不立即屏蔽。

## 3.3 自动模型不直接作高影响最终裁决

自动系统可以：

```text
隐藏高风险内容
临时冻结互动
提高案件优先级
要求人工复核
```

自动系统默认不能单独完成：

```text
永久封禁
认定诈骗犯罪
认定用户患有精神疾病
公开标注某人为危险人物
把疑似冒用直接定性为身份欺诈
```

## 3.4 安全决策与业务数据分离

其他模块调用：

```python
await moderation_gateway.evaluate_interaction(...)
```

只得到：

```text
允许
拒绝
冻结
需要复核
限制版本
安全原因代码
```

不获得完整举报内容、证据或调查笔记。

## 3.5 处置必须可解释、可回滚、可申诉

每个限制应记录：

```text
规则或案件依据
生效范围
开始时间
结束时间
执行者
是否可申诉
用户可见说明
内部证据
```

# 七、Skill 18.1：`vav-trust-safety-domain`

## 目标

建立举报、屏蔽、案件、证据、审核结果、限制和申诉领域模型。

## 7.1 举报表

```sql
CREATE TABLE safety_reports (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    report_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    reporter_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    reported_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    target_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    target_reference_id UUID,

    category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    severity_claim VARCHAR(32),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    description_encrypted TEXT,
    user_safety_state JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    block_requested BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    immediate_danger_claimed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    source_context JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    closed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(reporter_user_id, idempotency_key)
);
```

## 7.2 举报类别

```python
class SafetyReportCategory(StrEnum):
    HARASSMENT = "harassment"
    THREAT = "threat"
    ABUSE = "abuse"
    COERCIVE_CONTROL = "coercive_control"
    STALKING = "stalking"
    HATE_OR_DEGRADING_CONTENT = "hate_or_degrading_content"
    SEXUAL_CONTENT = "sexual_content"
    IMPERSONATION = "impersonation"
    FRAUD_OR_SCAM = "fraud_or_scam"
    MONEY_REQUEST = "money_request"
    OFF_PLATFORM_PAYMENT = "off_platform_payment"
    SPAM = "spam"
    FALSE_PROFILE = "false_profile"
    UNDERAGE_CONCERN = "underage_concern"
    PRIVACY_VIOLATION = "privacy_violation"
    SAFETY_CONCERN = "safety_concern"
    OTHER = "other"
```

## 7.3 安全案件

```sql
CREATE TABLE safety_cases (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    case_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    case_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    priority VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    subject_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    risk_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    primary_category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    source_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    rule_hit_manifest JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    assigned_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    closed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 7.4 案件与举报关联

```sql
CREATE TABLE safety_case_reports (
    safety_case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES safety_cases(id),
    report_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES safety_reports(id),

    linked_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY(safety_case_id, report_id)
);

# 九、Skill 18.2：`vav-user-reporting-blocking`

## 目标

实现用户举报、立即屏蔽、解除屏蔽和全平台传播。

## 9.1 屏蔽记录

```sql
CREATE TABLE user_blocks (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    blocker_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    blocked_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    source_report_id UUID REFERENCES safety_reports(id),

    reason_code VARCHAR(128),
    private_reason_encrypted TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    lifted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    CHECK (blocker_user_id <> blocked_user_id)
);
```

活动屏蔽唯一索引：

```sql
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_active_user_block
ON user_blocks(blocker_user_id, blocked_user_id)
WHERE status = 'active';
```

## 9.2 举报 API

```http
POST /api/v1/safety/reports
GET  /api/v1/account/safety/reports
GET  /api/v1/account/safety/reports/{report_id}
POST /api/v1/account/safety/reports/{report_id}/withdraw
```

请求示例：

```json
{
  "target_type": "introduction_invitation",
  "target_reference_id": "uuid",
  "category": "money_request",
  "description": "The user asked me to transfer money.",
  "block_user": true,
  "immediate_danger": false
}
```

## 9.3 屏蔽 API

```http
POST   /api/v1/safety/blocks/{user_id}
DELETE /api/v1/safety/blocks/{user_id}
GET    /api/v1/account/safety/blocks
```

## 9.4 屏蔽事务

```text
锁定用户对
→ 创建 Block
→ 更新 Pair Restriction Version
→ 失效推荐项
→ 失效 Like 和 Invitation
→ 冻结 Mutual Match
→ 撤销 Contact Grant
→ 冻结或结束 Relationship Journey
→ 取消非必要通知
→ 写 Outbox
```

屏蔽应立即成功，不等待举报案件处理。

## 9.5 解除屏蔽

解除屏蔽只表示：

```text
用户不再主动屏蔽对方
```

不表示：

```text
恢复旧互选
恢复联系方式 Grant
恢复旧邀请
恢复旧关系旅程
取消平台安全限制
```

旧状态需要独立重新建立。

## 9.6 举报者保护

被举报用户不得知道：

```text
举报者是谁
举报者提交的完整描述
举报者上传的证据
内部案件优先级
调查人员身份
```

---

# 十、举报限流与滥用防护

举报接口应限制：

```text
同一用户短时间大量重复举报
针对同一对象重复相同举报
自动化批量举报
恶意报复性举报
```

但不能因为限流让用户无法报告即时安全风险。

建议：

```dotenv
SAFETY_REPORT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR=20
SAFETY_REPORT_DUPLICATE_WINDOW_HOURS=24
SAFETY_IMMEDIATE_REPORT_RATE_LIMIT_BYPASS=true
```

疑似恶意举报应独立建案，不应自动处罚举报者。

# 十一、Skill 18.3：`vav-content-moderation-pipeline`

## 目标

实现档案、照片、邀请和平台内容的统一审核流水线。

## 11.1 审核对象

```python
class ModerationTargetType(StrEnum):
    DATING_PROFILE_FIELD = "dating_profile_field"
    DATING_PROFILE_PHOTO = "dating_profile_photo"
    DATING_PROFILE_NARRATIVE = "dating_profile_narrative"
    ACTIVITY_CONTENT = "activity_content"
    INVITATION_MESSAGE = "invitation_message"
    RELATIONSHIP_SHARED_CONTENT = "relationship_shared_content"
    TESTIMONIAL = "testimonial"
    AI_RESPONSE = "ai_response"
    CAMPAIGN_CONTENT = "campaign_content"
```

## 11.2 审核任务

```sql
CREATE TABLE moderation_tasks (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    target_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    target_reference_id UUID NOT NULL,
    target_version VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    priority VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    automated_result_id UUID,
    assigned_to UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(target_type, target_reference_id, target_version)
);
```

## 11.3 自动审核结果

```sql
CREATE TABLE moderation_automated_results (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    moderation_task_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES moderation_tasks(id),

    provider VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    model_name VARCHAR(200),
    model_revision VARCHAR(128),

    category_scores JSONB NOT NULL,
    detected_patterns JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    recommendation VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    confidence_basis_points INTEGER NOT NULL,

    input_checksum VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 11.4 人工审核结果

```sql
CREATE TABLE moderation_decisions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    moderation_task_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES moderation_tasks(id),

    decision VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    category_codes JSONB NOT NULL,
    reason_code VARCHAR(128),

    user_message_safe TEXT,
    internal_note_encrypted TEXT,

    decided_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    decided_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL
);
```

## 11.5 审核流程

```text
内容提交
→ 静态规则检查
→ 自动分类辅助
→ 低风险批准
→ 中风险人工审核
→ 高风险暂时隐藏并优先审核
→ 写决定
→ 通知来源模块
```

## 11.6 自动批准边界

可以自动批准：

```text
明确安全的格式化内容
无联系方式
无外部链接
低风险文本
```

不能仅靠模型自动批准：

```text
疑似未成年人
疑似身份冒用
威胁
诈骗资金请求
高风险安全内容
```

# 十三、Skill 18.4：`vav-anti-harassment-controls`

## 目标

识别并阻止重复接触、婉拒后继续骚扰、旁路接触和威胁行为。

## 13.1 行为信号

```text
短时间大量喜欢
短时间大量邀请
邀请被拒后重复尝试
关系结束后继续尝试接触
被屏蔽后通过活动目录接触
多个账号接触同一用户
频繁请求联系方式
重复发送相似消息
威胁、羞辱或控制性表达
大量举报集中指向同一账号
```

## 13.2 行为聚合

```sql
CREATE TABLE safety_behavior_aggregates (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    metric_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    window_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    window_starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    window_ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    event_count BIGINT NOT NULL,
    distinct_target_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    aggregation_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(user_id, metric_code, window_starts_at)
);
```

## 13.3 接触限制

```python
class ContactRestrictionType(StrEnum):
    LIKE_RATE_LIMIT = "like_rate_limit"
    INVITATION_RATE_LIMIT = "invitation_rate_limit"
    CONTACT_EXCHANGE_DISABLED = "contact_exchange_disabled"
    DIRECT_INTERACTION_DISABLED = "direct_interaction_disabled"
    TARGETED_CONTACT_BLOCK = "targeted_contact_block"
    RELATIONSHIP_CONTACT_FROZEN = "relationship_contact_frozen"
```

## 13.4 受害者优先

当用户报告骚扰时，平台应优先提供：

```text
立即屏蔽
撤销联系方式访问
停止通知
隐藏对方档案
安全支持入口
保存必要证据
```

不应要求用户先与对方沟通解决。

## 13.5 高频行为不等同骚扰

大量使用可能来自：

```text
正常高活跃
自动化
误操作
营销账号
骚扰
```

频率规则可以触发限速或人工复核，但不能单独证明恶意意图。

---

# 十四、Skill 18.5：`vav-anti-fraud-scam-detection`

## 目标

建立感情诈骗、资金诱导、冒充和账号接管风险识别。

## 14.1 欺诈信号

```text
邀请中要求转账
要求购买礼品卡
加密货币投资邀请
声称紧急医疗或家庭困难并借款
引导到未知外部网站付款
冒充 VAV 工作人员
冒充导师
批量使用相同自我介绍
多账号使用相同照片边界
短时间联系大量用户
登录地点或设备异常
联系信息频繁变更
退款或支付争议异常
```

## 14.2 欺诈信号表

```sql
CREATE TABLE fraud_signals (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    subject_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    signal_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    signal_source VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    confidence_basis_points INTEGER,

    source_reference_type VARCHAR(64),
    source_reference_id UUID,

    signal_snapshot_encrypted JSONB NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(
        subject_user_id,
        signal_code,
        signal_source,
        source_reference_id
    )
);
```

## 14.3 身份关联边界

可用于人工调查的信号：

```text
验证邮箱
验证手机号
支付身份关联摘要
设备风险标识
图片内容 Hash
登录异常摘要
```

不得默认实施：

```text
跨互联网人脸搜索
未经同意的生物识别
基于种族、国籍或宗教的风险评分
读取私人辅导内容进行诈骗评分
```

## 14.4 资金请求保护

检测到邀请或共享内容含资金请求：

```text
阻止发送
→ 显示平台安全提醒
→ 创建 Moderation Task
→ 高置信度时临时限制相关互动
→ 人工复核
```

不得仅靠关键词永久封禁，因为可能存在正常讨论财务价值观的内容。

---

# 十五、账号接管信号

消费 Batch 2 安全事件：

```text
auth.refresh_token.reuse_detected
auth.suspicious_login
auth.password.changed
auth.email.changed
```

高风险时：

```text
撤销会话
要求重新验证
临时冻结联系方式交换
暂停高风险写操作
创建安全案件
```

不能把账号接管受害者直接作为诈骗者处罚。

# 十六、Skill 18.6：`vav-risk-rule-decision-engine`

## 目标

建立版本化规则、风险信号融合和安全决策。

## 16.1 风险规则

```sql
CREATE TABLE safety_risk_rules (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    rule_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    rule_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    condition_schema JSONB NOT NULL,
    condition_definition JSONB NOT NULL,

    action_definition JSONB NOT NULL,

    severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    score_delta INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    applicable_modules JSONB NOT NULL,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(rule_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 16.2 Rule Type

```python
class SafetyRuleType(StrEnum):
    DETERMINISTIC = "deterministic"
    RATE = "rate"
    SEQUENCE = "sequence"
    CONTENT_CLASSIFIER = "content_classifier"
    AGGREGATE = "aggregate"
    MANUAL_FLAG = "manual_flag"
```

## 16.3 风险决策

```sql
CREATE TABLE safety_risk_decisions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    subject_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    target_type VARCHAR(64),
    target_reference_id UUID,

    decision_context VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    risk_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    risk_score INTEGER NOT NULL,

    rule_hits JSONB NOT NULL,
    model_signals JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    decision VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    reason_codes JSONB NOT NULL,

    policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 16.4 Risk Level

```python
class SafetyRiskLevel(StrEnum):
    NONE = "none"
    LOW = "low"
    MODERATE = "moderate"
    HIGH = "high"
    CRITICAL = "critical"
```

## 16.5 决策类型

```text
allow
allow_with_monitoring
rate_limit
content_hold
interaction_freeze
require_reverification
temporary_restriction
human_review_required
deny
```

## 16.6 规则执行顺序

```text
确定性禁止规则
→ 当前账号限制
→ Pair 屏蔽和定向限制
→ 频率规则
→ 内容规则
→ 聚合风险
→ 人工 Override
→ 输出决策
```

## 16.7 人工 Override

人工决定必须：

```text
明确范围
明确有效期
明确原因
引用案件
可审计
可申诉
```

不能直接修改风险规则历史结果。

# 十七、安全 Gateway

```python
class TrustSafetyDecision(BaseModel):
    allowed: bool

    action: str
    safe_reason_code: str | None

    restriction_version: int
    decision_id: UUID

    expires_at: datetime | None
    human_review_required: bool
```

POST /api/v1/internal/trust-safety/decisions/contact-exchange
POST /api/v1/internal/trust-safety/decisions/relationship
POST /api/v1/internal/trust-safety/decisions/activity
POST /api/v1/internal/trust-safety/decisions/ai
```

其他模块不得读取原始安全表自行判断。

# 十八、Skill 18.7：`vav-account-restrictions-enforcement`

## 目标

实现范围化、限时、可组合的账号和功能限制。

## 18.1 限制记录

```sql
CREATE TABLE account_restrictions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    restriction_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    scope_definition JSONB NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    source_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    source_reference_id UUID,

    reason_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    user_message_safe TEXT,
    internal_reason_encrypted TEXT,

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    appeal_allowed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    imposed_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    lifted_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    lifted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    lift_reason_encrypted TEXT,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 18.2 限制类型

```python
class AccountRestrictionType(StrEnum):
    PROFILE_HIDDEN = "profile_hidden"
    PROFILE_EDIT_REVIEW_REQUIRED = "profile_edit_review_required"
    RECOMMENDATION_DISABLED = "recommendation_disabled"
    LIKE_DISABLED = "like_disabled"
    INVITATION_DISABLED = "invitation_disabled"
    CONTACT_EXCHANGE_DISABLED = "contact_exchange_disabled"
    RELATIONSHIP_INTERACTION_FROZEN = "relationship_interaction_frozen"
    ACTIVITY_REGISTRATION_DISABLED = "activity_registration_disabled"
    AI_WRITE_ACTIONS_DISABLED = "ai_write_actions_disabled"
    COMMUNICATION_RATE_LIMITED = "communication_rate_limited"
    REVERIFICATION_REQUIRED = "reverification_required"
    ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_SUSPENDED = "account_temporarily_suspended"
    ACCOUNT_PERMANENTLY_DISABLED = "account_permanently_disabled"
```

## 18.3 最小范围原则

举报一张违规照片时，优先考虑：

```text
隐藏照片
要求修改档案
限制相关内容发布
```

而不是默认：

```text
永久封禁全部账户
```

对严重威胁、诈骗或多次违规可升级到账号级限制。

## 18.4 限制生效

```text
创建 Restriction
→ 增加 restriction_version
→ 发布 safety.restriction.created
→ 各模块消费
→ 清理权限缓存
→ 撤销不再允许的现有授权
→ 通知用户安全摘要
```

## 18.5 限制到期

到期 Worker：

```text
检查是否存在新的有效限制
→ 检查案件状态
→ 按政策自动到期或进入人工复核
```

永久限制不能通过普通到期 Worker 自动解除。

---

# 十九、限制组合

多个限制同时存在时：

```text
取所有有效限制的并集
```

例如：

```text
PROFILE_HIDDEN
＋
INVITATION_DISABLED
＋
CONTACT_EXCHANGE_DISABLED
```

解除一个限制不能误解除其他限制。

# 二十、Skill 18.8：`vav-case-management-human-review`

## 目标

建立安全案件分配、人工调查、证据查看和决策审批。

## 20.1 案件优先级

```python
class SafetyCasePriority(StrEnum):
    LOW = "low"
    NORMAL = "normal"
    HIGH = "high"
    URGENT = "urgent"
    CRITICAL = "critical"
```

建议：

```text
Critical
即时人身安全、可信严重威胁

Urgent
诈骗资金请求、疑似未成年人、高风险骚扰

High
重复骚扰、身份冒用、多次举报

Normal
普通内容违规、一般垃圾信息

Low
低影响资料格式问题
```

## 20.2 案件任务

```sql
CREATE TABLE safety_case_tasks (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    safety_case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES safety_cases(id),

    task_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    assigned_to UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    due_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    task_payload_encrypted JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 20.3 安全决策

```sql
CREATE TABLE safety_case_decisions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    safety_case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES safety_cases(id),

    decision_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    decision_scope JSONB NOT NULL,

    reason_codes JSONB NOT NULL,
    evidence_item_ids JSONB NOT NULL,

    user_message_safe TEXT,
    internal_rationale_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,

    restriction_manifest JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    decided_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    decided_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    appeal_allowed BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

    supersedes_decision_id UUID
        REFERENCES safety_case_decisions(id)
);
```

## 20.4 双人复核

以下处置建议要求第二人批准：

```text
永久停用账户
超过配置时长的账号暂停
疑似未成年人处置
重大诈骗认定
解除 Critical 安全限制
大范围批量处置
```

## 20.5 审核者隔离

审核员不能处理：

```text
自己的举报
涉及自己的案件
与自己存在密切关系的用户
自己创建并请求批准的高风险决定
```

# 二十一、案件 SLA

示例配置：

```dotenv
SAFETY_CASE_CRITICAL_SLA_MINUTES=15
SAFETY_CASE_URGENT_SLA_HOURS=2
SAFETY_CASE_HIGH_SLA_HOURS=12
SAFETY_CASE_NORMAL_SLA_HOURS=72
```

这是运营默认值，不等同法律承诺。

逾期：

```text
自动升级队列
通知值班负责人
记录 SLA 违约
```

# 二十二、Skill 18.9：`vav-appeals-remediation`

## 目标

实现用户申诉、独立复核和错误处置修复。

## 22.1 申诉表

```sql
CREATE TABLE safety_appeals (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    appeal_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    appellant_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    restriction_id UUID REFERENCES account_restrictions(id),
    safety_case_id UUID REFERENCES safety_cases(id),
    decision_id UUID REFERENCES safety_case_decisions(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    appeal_reason_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_manifest JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    review_due_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    assigned_to UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    outcome VARCHAR(32),
    outcome_message_safe TEXT,
    internal_review_encrypted TEXT,

    decided_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    decided_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 22.2 申诉资格

允许申诉：

```text
内容删除
档案暂停
功能限制
临时账号暂停
永久账号停用
人工诈骗处置
```

不允许通过申诉：

```text
要求查看举报者身份
要求访问内部安全规则
要求获取其他用户私人证据
取消另一个用户的屏蔽
```

## 22.3 独立复核

申诉审核员默认不能是：

```text
原决定执行者
原决定批准者
案件举报者
```

## 22.4 申诉结果

```python
class AppealOutcome(StrEnum):
    UPHELD = "upheld"
    MODIFIED = "modified"
    OVERTURNED = "overturned"
    INELIGIBLE = "ineligible"
```

## 22.5 撤销错误处置

申诉成功后：

```text
创建新 Decision supersede 原决定
→ 解除或修改限制
→ 重建档案/推荐投影
→ 恢复允许的互动
→ 不恢复已失效的用户同意或联系方式 Grant
→ 通知用户
→ 记录修复报告
```

不能通过直接删除原决定掩盖错误历史。

---

# 二十三、错误处置补救

根据影响可执行：

```text
恢复档案展示
恢复会员访问
补发合理配额
恢复推荐资格
撤销错误警告
发送更正通知
```

不得自动恢复：

```text
已被另一方主动屏蔽的关系
另一方已经婉拒的邀请
已结束的关系旅程
已经撤回的联系方式同意
```

# 二十四、Skill 18.10：`vav-events-integrations-notifications`

## 目标

定义信任与安全事件，并连接全部核心业务模块。

## 24.1 Outbox 事件

```text
safety.report.submitted
safety.report.triaged
safety.report.action_taken
safety.report.closed

safety.block.created
safety.block.lifted

safety.case.created
safety.case.assigned
safety.case.escalated
safety.case.resolved

safety.moderation.approved
safety.moderation.rejected
safety.moderation.removed

safety.risk.high_detected
safety.risk.critical_detected

safety.restriction.created
safety.restriction.updated
safety.restriction.expired
safety.restriction.lifted

safety.appeal.submitted
safety.appeal.upheld
safety.appeal.modified
safety.appeal.overturned
```

## 24.2 各模块行为

### 推荐

```text
Block/Restriction
→ 移除候选
→ 失效批次
→ 清理缓存
```

### 互动

```text
Block/High Risk
→ Like/Invitation 失效
→ Match 冻结
→ Contact Grant 撤销
```

### 关系

```text
Block/Critical Risk
→ Journey 安全冻结或结束
→ 停止提醒
```

### 活动

```text
活动行为限制
→ 阻止新报名
→ 按政策处理已报名资格
```

### AI

```text
高风险安全事件
→ 停止普通建议
→ 创建人工转介
```

### 会员

```text
账号安全限制
→ 会员不能绕过
→ 财务历史仍保留
```

## 24.3 通知策略

通知用户：

```text
举报已收到
案件状态有重要变化
内容需要修改
账号功能被限制
限制即将到期
申诉已收到
申诉结果
```

不通知：

```text
谁举报了你
具体举报证据
内部风险分数
规则阈值
调查人员身份
```

# 二十六、Skill 18.11：`vav-user-admin-trust-safety-web`

## 用户端路由

```text
/:locale/safety
/:locale/safety/report
/:locale/account/safety/reports
/:locale/account/safety/reports/:reportId
/:locale/account/safety/blocks
/:locale/account/safety/restrictions
/:locale/account/safety/appeals
/:locale/account/safety/appeals/:appealId
```

## 用户端目录

```text
apps/user-web/src/features/trust-safety/
├── api/
├── components/
│   ├── ReportButton.vue
│   ├── ReportTargetSummary.vue
│   ├── ReportCategorySelector.vue
│   ├── ReportEvidenceUploader.vue
│   ├── ImmediateSafetyNotice.vue
│   ├── BlockUserDialog.vue
│   ├── BlockedUserList.vue
│   ├── SafetyRestrictionCard.vue
│   ├── AppealForm.vue
│   ├── AppealStatus.vue
│   └── SafetySupportCard.vue
├── composables/
├── pages/
├── schemas/
└── types/
```

## 举报流程

```text
1. 选择举报对象
2. 选择类别
3. 填写可选说明
4. 上传必要证据
5. 选择是否立即屏蔽
6. 显示即时安全帮助
7. 提交
8. 查看处理状态
```

## 举报提交后

用户看到：

```text
举报已收到
是否已经屏蔽
当前安全建议
案件状态的有限摘要
```

不能看到：

```text
处理人员内部评论
被举报人的其他举报
风险评分
最终调查证据
```

## 账号限制页面

展示：

```text
受影响功能
生效时间
预计结束时间
用户可见原因
如何整改
是否可以申诉
申诉截止时间

# 三十三、缓存设计

```text
safety:block-decision:
  {user_low_id}:{user_high_id}:{block_version}

safety:user-restrictions:
  {user_id}:{restriction_version}

safety:interaction-decision:
  {actor_id}:{target_id}:{context}:{restriction_version}

safety:content-decision:
  {target_type}:{target_id}:{target_version}:{policy_version}
```

以下变化必须立即失效：

```text
屏蔽创建或解除
限制创建、更新、到期或解除
案件高风险升级
申诉推翻
规则回滚
账号状态变化
```

安全决定缓存默认短时，写操作必须进行实时重新检查。

# 三十四、环境变量

```dotenv
# Trust and safety
SAFETY_ENABLED=true
SAFETY_FAIL_CLOSED=true
SAFETY_DEFAULT_POLICY_VERSION=1.0.0

# Reports
SAFETY_REPORT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR=20
SAFETY_REPORT_DUPLICATE_WINDOW_HOURS=24
SAFETY_IMMEDIATE_REPORT_RATE_LIMIT_BYPASS=true

# Blocking
SAFETY_BLOCK_PROPAGATION_SYNCHRONOUS=true
SAFETY_BLOCK_REVOKE_CONTACT_GRANTS=true
SAFETY_BLOCK_FREEZE_RELATIONSHIP=true

# Moderation
SAFETY_AUTOMATED_MODERATION_ENABLED=true
SAFETY_AUTO_APPROVE_LOW_RISK=true
SAFETY_AUTO_PERMANENT_BAN_ENABLED=false
SAFETY_HIGH_RISK_CONTENT_HOLD=true

# Harassment
SAFETY_LIKE_RATE_WINDOW_MINUTES=60
SAFETY_INVITATION_RATE_WINDOW_HOURS=24
SAFETY_REPEATED_CONTACT_THRESHOLD=3
SAFETY_POST_DECLINE_CONTACT_RESTRICTION=true

# Fraud
SAFETY_MONEY_REQUEST_BLOCKING=true
SAFETY_EXTERNAL_PAYMENT_LINK_BLOCKING=true
SAFETY_FRAUD_AUTO_PERMANENT_BAN=false
SAFETY_ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER_REVERIFICATION=true

# Cases
SAFETY_CASE_CRITICAL_SLA_MINUTES=15
SAFETY_CASE_URGENT_SLA_HOURS=2
SAFETY_CASE_HIGH_SLA_HOURS=12
SAFETY_CASE_NORMAL_SLA_HOURS=72

# Restrictions
SAFETY_HIGH_IMPACT_SECOND_APPROVAL_REQUIRED=true
SAFETY_PERMANENT_RESTRICTION_APPEAL_ALLOWED=true
SAFETY_RESTRICTION_EXPIRY_JOB_INTERVAL_MINUTES=10

# Appeals
SAFETY_APPEAL_ENABLED=true
SAFETY_APPEAL_DEFAULT_DUE_DAYS=14
SAFETY_APPEAL_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_REQUIRED=true

# Red team
SAFETY_RED_TEAM_REQUIRED_FOR_RELEASE=true
SAFETY_RED_TEAM_REQUIRE_ZERO_BLOCK_BYPASS=true
SAFETY_RED_TEAM_REQUIRE_ZERO_CONTACT_LEAKAGE=true
```

# 三十五、Makefile 新命令

```makefile
safety-migrate:
	docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head

safety-seed:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.seed_trust_safety

	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.seed_safety_rules

safety-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/trust_safety/unit tests/trust_safety/integration -q

	docker compose exec api pytest tests/trust_safety/concurrency -q

safety-security-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/trust_safety/security -q

safety-privacy-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/trust_safety/privacy -q

safety-red-team:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/trust_safety/red_team -q

safety-user-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test e2e/user-trust-safety

safety-admin-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test e2e/admin-trust-safety

safety-verify:
	$(MAKE) safety-migrate
	$(MAKE) safety-seed
	$(MAKE) safety-seed-rules
	$(MAKE) safety-test
	$(MAKE) safety-concurrency-test
	$(MAKE) safety-security-test
	$(MAKE) safety-privacy-test
	$(MAKE) safety-red-team
	$(MAKE) safety-user-e2e
	$(MAKE) safety-admin-e2e
```

# 三十七、必须通过的举报场景

```text
用户可以举报用户
用户可以举报档案
用户可以举报照片
用户可以举报邀请消息
用户可以举报关系行为
用户可以举报 AI 回答

重复请求保持幂等
举报者只能查看自己的举报
被举报者不能查看举报者身份
举报说明被加密
举报可以同时创建屏蔽
Immediate Safety 举报进入最高优先级
撤回举报不自动解除已确认限制
恶意举报不会自动处罚，需人工复核
```

---

# 三十八、必须通过的屏蔽场景

```text
用户可以立即屏蔽另一用户
屏蔽不需要管理员批准
双方不再互相推荐
直接 URL 不能绕过屏蔽
活动目录不能绕过屏蔽
喜欢和邀请不能绕过屏蔽
Mutual Match 被冻结
联系方式 Grant 被撤销
关系旅程被冻结或结束
非必要通知停止
解除屏蔽不自动恢复历史互动
```

---

# 三十九、必须通过的内容审核场景

```text
档案叙述进入审核
照片进入审核
邀请消息进入审核
联系方式绕过内容被阻止
资金请求进入高风险审核
外部恶意链接被阻止
自动结果记录模型版本
低置信度结果进入人工审核
永久高影响处罚不由模型单独决定
审核决定具有用户说明
审核决定保留内部依据
新内容版本必须重新审核
```

---

# 四十、必须通过的反骚扰场景

```text
婉拒后重复邀请被识别
关系结束后重复接触被识别
被屏蔽后旁路访问失败
短时间大量邀请触发限速
高频行为只触发复核，不自动证明恶意
目标用户可以立即屏蔽
联系方式交换可以立即撤销
骚扰举报进入优先队列
系统不会要求受害者先联系对方
```

---

# 四十一、必须通过的反诈骗场景

```text
转账请求被阻止
礼品卡请求被识别
加密货币投资诱导被识别
站外付款链接被阻止
冒充工作人员被升级审核
冒充导师被升级审核
账号接管信号触发重新验证
账号接管受害者不被直接认定诈骗
相同文本和图片 Hash 可生成调查信号
不启用跨站人脸搜索
不基于宗教、国籍或种族评分风险
```

---

# 四十二、必须通过的风险规则场景

```text
规则具有版本
规则输入只能使用已注册信号
规则 DSL 不能执行代码
规则不能执行任意 SQL
相同输入和版本产生相同决定
规则命中保存解释代码
规则灰度发布可配置
规则回滚恢复旧版本
高影响规则需要审批
模型信号不能覆盖确定性安全规则
规则错误不会绕过当前屏蔽
```

---

# 四十三、必须通过的账号限制场景

```text
限制具有明确范围
限制具有起止时间
多个限制正确组合
解除一个限制不解除其他限制
限制立即传播到业务模块
推荐模块停止相关推荐
互动模块停止相关操作
联系方式 Grant 被撤销
会员不能绕过限制
永久账号停用需要高影响审批
用户收到安全且最小化的原因说明
```

---

# 四十四、必须通过的案件处置场景

```text
举报可以创建安全案件
多个相关举报可以合并
案件可以分配
案件具有 SLA
证据具有来源和 Hash
审核员不能伪造证据
高影响决定需要第二人批准
决定引用证据
决定产生限制
关闭案件保留历史
敏感证据访问产生审计
利益冲突审核员不能处理案件
```

---

# 四十五、必须通过的申诉场景

```text
受限制用户可以查看是否可申诉
用户可以提交申诉
申诉内容被加密
原决定人员不能独立审核申诉
申诉可以维持原决定
申诉可以修改限制
申诉可以撤销决定
撤销决定保留原历史
错误处置恢复允许的服务
申诉不能解除另一用户主动屏蔽
申诉不能公开举报者身份
```

---

# 四十六、红队验收矩阵

## 屏蔽绕过

```text
直接访问档案 URL
旧推荐快照
活动参与者目录
互选列表
邀请历史
关系时间线
联系方式 Reveal Token
浏览器缓存
后台错误投影
```

结果必须全部失败关闭。

## 联系方式绕过

测试：

```text
手机号数字分隔
手机号中文数字
邮箱使用空格或括号
微信号使用谐音
图片中嵌入联系方式
二维码
邀请消息中的外部链接
```

图片 OCR 检测可以作为独立高成本审核步骤，但不能反复自动 OCR 所有内容；可优先用于被举报或高风险内容。

## 诈骗语言变体

测试：

```text
投资
理财
加密货币
礼品卡
临时借款
代付
紧急医疗
海外包裹
账户冻结
冒充客服
```

## 规则对抗

```text
拆字
同音字
零宽字符
Unicode 混淆
Base64 式文本
多语言混合
Prompt Injection
伪造系统消息
```

---

# 四十七、生产发布门禁

候选安全 Release 不得上线，除非：

```text
屏蔽绕过率 = 0
联系方式越权泄漏 = 0
跨用户举报访问 = 0
Reporter Identity 泄漏 = 0
管理员伪造用户选择 = 0
规则 DSL 代码执行 = 0
安全限制缓存泄漏 = 0
Critical 案件漏路由 = 0
高影响决定审批绕过 = 0
```

自动分类准确率、误报率和召回率阈值由业务安全团队批准并版本化。

# 四十八、Batch 18 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-18/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-18-trust-safety-moderation
description: Implement VAV reporting, blocking, moderation, anti-harassment, anti-fraud, risk rules, account restrictions, human safety cases, appeals, the Trust & Safety administration center and red-team acceptance.
---

# Goal

Build a production-oriented Trust & Safety platform containing:

- user reports;
- immediate user blocking;
- platform-wide block propagation;
- content-moderation tasks;
- automated moderation assistance;
- human moderation decisions;
- anti-harassment controls;
- anti-fraud and scam signals;
- account-takeover safety integration;
- versioned safety-risk rules;
- explainable safety decisions;
- scoped account and capability restrictions;
- evidence preservation;
- human safety-case management;
- SLA and escalation;
- high-impact decision approval;
- user appeals;
- independent appeal review;
- remediation of incorrect enforcement;
- user-web safety tools;
- admin-web Trust & Safety operations;
- unit, integration, concurrency, security, privacy, red-team and E2E tests.

# Source requirements

The project plan requires:

- profile and photo review;
- reporting and blocking;
- user management;
- sensitive-data protection;
- human escalation for high-risk situations;
- no major security defect in the complete user journey.

This batch provides the platform-wide Trust & Safety control plane.

# Prerequisites

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 through Batch 17.
3. Verify Batch 17 with `make membership-verify`.
4. Read every skill under `skills/batch-18`.
5. Inspect Identity, Profile, Recommendation, Interaction, Relationship,
   Activity, Counseling, AI, Privacy, Notification, Membership, RBAC, Audit,
   Outbox and Inbox contracts.
6. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-18-plan.md`.
7. Produce `docs/architecture/trust-safety-control-plane.md`.
8. Produce `docs/security/block-propagation-matrix.md`.
9. Produce `docs/security/safety-red-team-plan.md`.
10. Record unresolved enforcement, appeal, evidence-retention, identity and
    jurisdiction-specific policies in the decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. Safety-report and block domain.
2. Platform-wide block propagation.
3. Safety cases and evidence.
4. Content-moderation tasks.
5. Automated moderation adapters.
6. Human moderation decisions.
7. Harassment behavior aggregation.
8. Fraud signals and investigations.
9. Risk-rule registry.
10. Safety-decision Gateway.
11. Account restrictions.
12. Restriction propagation and expiry.
13. Case assignment and SLA.
14. High-impact decision approval.
15. Appeals and independent review.
16. Remediation workflows.
17. User-web reporting and safety pages.
18. Admin-web Trust & Safety center.
19. Unit, integration, concurrency, security and privacy tests.
20. Complete red-team suite and release gates.

# Architecture constraints

- Trust & Safety is a shared control plane.
- Business modules request decisions through typed Gateways.
- Business modules do not read raw report or evidence tables.
- Blocks must propagate across all interaction paths.
- Block enforcement occurs on backend queries and writes.
- Frontend hiding is not block enforcement.
- Automated classifiers are advisory for high-impact decisions.
- Permanent high-impact restrictions require approved policy and human
  review.
- Trust & Safety failures fail closed for high-risk interaction operations.
- Core authentication and data-rights functions remain available where safe.

# Reporting invariants

- Users may report supported users and content.
- Reports are idempotent.
- Reporters may read only their own report status.
- Reporter identity is confidential.
- Report descriptions and evidence are encrypted.
- Immediate-safety reports receive priority treatment.
- Report withdrawal does not erase investigation history.
- Duplicate reports may be linked to one case.
- Suspected abusive reporting requires review rather than automatic
  retaliation.

# Blocking invariants

- Users can block immediately.
- Blocking does not require administrator approval.
- Blocks are directional records but enforce mutual invisibility where
  required for safety.
- Blocks invalidate recommendations, interactions, invitations, contact
  grants and relevant relationship access.
- Direct URLs, activity directories, cached projections and old tokens cannot
  bypass blocks.
- Unblocking does not restore historical consent or interaction state.
- Platform restrictions and user blocks remain distinct.

# Moderation invariants

- Moderation targets bind to exact content versions.
- New content versions require new decisions.
- Automated systems record provider and model versions.
- Low-confidence and high-risk results require human review.
- High-risk content may be temporarily hidden pending review.
- Automated models do not independently impose permanent bans.
- User-visible and internal decision reasons are separate.
- Moderation decisions are auditable.

# Harassment invariants

- Repeated contact after decline, ending or block is a safety signal.
- Rate limits and sequence rules may restrict contact.
- High activity alone does not prove malicious intent.
- Users do not need to confront a suspected harasser before blocking or
  reporting.
- Contact grants are revoked when block or safety policy requires it.
- Harassment reasons are not disclosed in a way that endangers the reporter.

# Fraud invariants

- Money requests, gift-card requests, investment solicitation and external
  payment links receive explicit checks.
- Staff and mentor impersonation receive priority review.
- Account-takeover victims are not automatically treated as scammers.
- Fraud decisions use multiple signals where possible.
- Religion, nationality, race and protected personal characteristics are not
  fraud features.
- Cross-site face search and unapproved biometric identification remain
  disabled.
- Private counseling and AI content are not general fraud-scoring inputs.

# Risk-rule invariants

- Rules are versioned.
- Rules use only registered signals and actions.
- Rule DSL cannot execute arbitrary code or SQL.
- Deterministic safety rules take precedence over model suggestions.
- Every decision records rule hits and policy version.
- High-impact rule activation requires approval and tests.
- Rules support rollback.
- Rule failures do not bypass active blocks or restrictions.

# Restriction invariants

- Restrictions declare exact scope.
- Restrictions declare duration or review status.
- Multiple active restrictions compose safely.
- Lifting one restriction does not lift others.
- Restrictions propagate through versioned events.
- Membership and payment cannot bypass safety restrictions.
- High-impact restrictions require reasons, evidence and appropriate
  approval.
- Users receive a safe summary and appeal information where applicable.

# Case-management invariants

- Cases preserve reports, evidence, decisions and history.
- Evidence has source identity and integrity hashes.
- Evidence collection follows data minimization.
- Sensitive evidence access requires purpose and audit.
- Investigators cannot fabricate or silently modify evidence.
- Conflicted investigators cannot decide the case.
- Critical and urgent cases use SLA and escalation.
- High-impact decisions support separation of duties.

# Appeal invariants

- Eligible restrictions support appeal.
- Appeal reviewers are independent from the original high-impact decision
  where required.
- Appeal evidence remains protected.
- Outcomes may uphold, modify or overturn.
- Overturned decisions are superseded, not deleted.
- Remediation restores only states that remain valid.
- Appeals cannot reveal reporter identity or remove another user's block.
- Appeal abuse may be rate limited without removing legitimate access.

# Privacy invariants

- Safety data is restricted or highly restricted.
- Reports, evidence and investigation notes are encrypted.
- Business modules receive only safe decision summaries.
- Counseling, AI and relationship-private content is not copied without
  specific case necessity.
- Logs, traces and metrics contain no evidence text.
- Sensitive access records use the Privacy control plane.
- Evidence retention follows approved policies and holds.

# Red-team invariants

- Block bypass tests cover every viewing and interaction path.
- Contact leakage tests cover old grants, tokens, caches and alternate routes.
- Harassment tests cover post-decline and post-ending contact.
- Fraud tests cover obfuscation and multilingual variants.
- Rule-injection and code-execution tests must pass.
- Reporter retaliation and identity-leakage tests must pass.
- Failed critical red-team gates block release.
- Red-team runs pin policy, rule, model and application versions.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make safety-migrate
make safety-seed
make safety-seed-rules
make safety-test
make safety-concurrency-test
make safety-security-test
make safety-privacy-test
make safety-red-team
make safety-user-e2e
make safety-admin-e2e
make safety-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Users can report supported targets.
2. Users can immediately block other users.
3. Blocks propagate to every interaction module.
4. Direct URLs and old tokens cannot bypass blocks.
5. Reports remain reporter-confidential.
6. Moderation binds to exact content versions.
7. High-risk moderation receives human review.
8. Automated systems cannot independently impose permanent bans.
9. Harassment rate and sequence rules work.
10. Fraud and money-request checks work.
11. Account-takeover signals create safe restrictions.
12. Risk rules are versioned and reversible.
13. Rule DSL cannot execute arbitrary code.
14. Safety Gateways return scoped decisions.
15. Restrictions compose correctly.
16. Restrictions propagate idempotently.
17. Cases preserve evidence and decisions.
18. High-impact decisions require appropriate approval.
19. Sensitive evidence access is audited.
20. Users can submit eligible appeals.
21. Appeal review independence works.
22. Overturned decisions trigger safe remediation.
23. Membership cannot bypass restrictions.
24. Recommendation and interaction blocks work.
25. Contact grants are revoked on block.
26. Relationship journeys freeze or end as required.
27. User safety E2E tests pass.
28. Admin Trust & Safety E2E tests pass.
29. Concurrency tests pass.
30. Security tests pass.
31. Privacy tests pass.
32. Red-team gates pass.
33. `make membership-verify` still succeeds.
34. `make relationship-verify` still succeeds.
35. `make interaction-verify` still succeeds.
36. `make recommendation-verify` still succeeds.
37. `make dating-profile-verify` still succeeds.
38. `make privacy-verify` still succeeds.
39. `make notification-verify` still succeeds.
40. `make ai-verify` still succeeds.
41. `make knowledge-verify` still succeeds.
42. `make counseling-verify` still succeeds.
43. `make course-verify` still succeeds.
44. `make activity-verify` still succeeds.
45. `make commerce-verify` still succeeds.
46. `make catalog-verify` still succeeds.
47. `make cms-verify` still succeeds.
48. `make auth-verify` still succeeds.
49. `make verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When a safety-enforcement policy is unresolved:

1. preserve user safety first;
2. use the smallest temporary restriction that prevents likely harm;
3. route the case to human review;
4. record the unresolved policy;
5. do not impose unsupported permanent conclusions.

When block propagation fails:

1. stop affected interaction delivery;
2. revoke contact grants and tokens;
3. invalidate recommendation, profile and relationship caches;
4. repair the missing integration;
5. add a release-blocking regression test;
6. rerun the complete block matrix.

When automated moderation produces a high-impact error:

1. suspend the affected automated decision path;
2. route affected content to human review;
3. preserve model and policy versions;
4. remediate affected users;
5. add the case to the red-team dataset.

When evidence privacy fails:

1. stop case access;
2. invalidate leaked caches and links;
3. record a privacy incident;
4. restrict affected evidence;
5. fix access and DTO boundaries;
6. rerun Privacy and Trust & Safety tests.

When an appeal overturns a decision:

1. supersede rather than delete the original decision;
2. remove or modify the restriction;
3. rebuild affected projections;
4. restore only still-valid access;
5. notify the user;
6. record the remediation result.

When a critical red-team gate fails:

1. block release;
2. preserve the exact test fixture and manifests;
3. identify the failed module and policy;
4. fix the root cause;
5. rerun the full Trust & Safety and dependent-module suites.

# 五、Skill 19.1：`vav-project-assembly-manifest`

## 目标

建立完整项目 Manifest，验证所有模块、迁移、事件、权限、配置和构建产物。

## 5.1 `project-manifest.yaml`

```yaml
project:
  code: vav-platform
  architecture_version: "1.0.0"
  minimum_supported_schema_version: 82

applications:
  - code: user-web
    type: vue-spa
    path: apps/user-web

  - code: admin-web
    type: vue-spa
    path: apps/admin-web

services:
  - code: api
    type: fastapi
    path: services/api
    health_endpoint: /health/live
    readiness_endpoint: /health/ready

  - code: worker
    type: celery
    path: services/worker

modules:
  - identity
  - cms
  - catalog
  - commerce
  - activities
  - courses
  - counseling
  - knowledge
  - ai_assistant
  - notifications
  - privacy
  - matchmaking_profiles
  - recommendations
  - matchmaking_interactions
  - relationships
  - memberships
  - trust_safety

infrastructure:
  postgres:
    required_extensions:
      - pgcrypto
      - vector
      - pg_trgm

  redis:
    required: true

  object_storage:
    required: true
    s3_compatible: true

acceptance:
  commands:
    - make verify
    - make verify-all
    - make complete-e2e
    - make production-readiness
```

## 5.2 模块 Manifest

每个模块必须提供：

```text
module.yaml
```

示例：

```yaml
module:
  code: recommendations
  owner: matchmaking
  version: "1.0.0"

dependencies:
  required:
    - identity
    - privacy
    - matchmaking_profiles
    - trust_safety

database:
  migrations:
    from: 0054
    to: 0059

events:
  publishes:
    - recommendation.batch.generated.v1
  consumes:
    - dating_profile.approved.v1
    - safety.block.created.v1

permissions:
  manifest: permissions.yaml

configuration:
  schema: config.schema.json

health:
  checks:
    - recommendation_pool
    - trust_safety_gateway
```

## 5.3 完整性检查器

实现：

```text
scripts/diagnostics/validate_project_manifest.py
```

检查：

```text
每个模块有 Manifest
迁移编号无冲突
事件类型和版本有定义
消费者引用的事件存在
权限代码有注册
环境变量有 Schema
前端路由有权限映射
OpenAPI 路径无冲突
Seed 顺序合法
Docker 服务覆盖必需组件
```

## 命令

```bash
make manifest-check
```

# 六、发布 Manifest

```yaml
release:
  version: "2026.07.31-rc.1"
  git_commit: "${GIT_COMMIT}"
  built_at: "${BUILD_TIME}"

images:
  api:
    digest: "${API_IMAGE_DIGEST}"
  worker:
    digest: "${WORKER_IMAGE_DIGEST}"
  user_web:
    digest: "${USER_WEB_IMAGE_DIGEST}"
  admin_web:
    digest: "${ADMIN_WEB_IMAGE_DIGEST}"

database:
  target_revision: "head"
  minimum_revision: "0077"
  maximum_revision: "0082"

contracts:
  openapi_checksum: "${OPENAPI_CHECKSUM}"
  event_manifest_checksum: "${EVENT_MANIFEST_CHECKSUM}"

configuration:
  schema_version: "1.0.0"

quality:
  unit_tests_passed: true
  integration_tests_passed: true
  security_tests_passed: true
  complete_e2e_passed: true
  red_team_passed: true
```

生产部署只使用不可变镜像 Digest，不使用 `latest`。

# 七、Skill 19.2：`vav-environment-secrets-configuration`

## 目标

实现环境变量 Schema、启动校验、Secret 分离和配置漂移检测。

## 7.1 环境矩阵

```text
development
本地开发，Mailpit、Fake Provider、测试支付

test
隔离测试数据库、Fake Provider、确定性时间

ci
无交互、短生命周期、完整测试

staging
接近生产，使用测试支付和受限外部 Provider

production
真实业务环境

dr
灾难恢复环境
```

## 7.2 配置文件

```text
.env.example
.env.local                    # gitignored
config/env/development.yaml
config/env/test.yaml
config/env/ci.yaml
config/env/staging.yaml
config/env/production.template.yaml
```

生产 Secret 不得存入：

```text
Git
Docker Image
前端构建变量
普通配置文件
CI 日志
```

## 7.3 配置分类

```python
class ConfigurationSensitivity(StrEnum):
    PUBLIC_BUILD = "public_build"
    INTERNAL = "internal"
    SECRET = "secret"
    HIGHLY_RESTRICTED = "highly_restricted"
```

### Public Build

```text
PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL
PUBLIC_APP_NAME
PUBLIC_DEFAULT_LOCALE
```

### Secret

```text
DATABASE_PASSWORD
JWT_PRIVATE_KEY
EMAIL_PROVIDER_SECRET
PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET
AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY
```

### Highly Restricted

```text
FIELD_ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY
PRIVACY_SEARCH_HMAC_PEPPER
BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY
```

## 7.4 Pydantic Settings

```python
class ApplicationSettings(BaseSettings):
    environment: Literal[
        "development",
        "test",
        "ci",
        "staging",
        "production",
        "dr",
    ]

    database: DatabaseSettings
    redis: RedisSettings
    object_storage: ObjectStorageSettings
    security: SecuritySettings
    observability: ObservabilitySettings

    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_nested_delimiter="__",
        extra="forbid",
    )
```

## 7.5 启动校验

生产环境必须拒绝：

```text
默认密码
空 JWT Key
HTTP Cookie
宽泛 CORS
未配置 Webhook Secret
Fake Payment Provider
Mailpit
Fake AI Provider
DEBUG=true
公开 MinIO Bucket
未启用字段加密
```

## 7.6 Secret Provider

接口：

```python
class SecretProvider(Protocol):
    async def get_secret(self, reference: str) -> SecretValue:
        ...
```

实现边界：

```text
Environment Secret
Docker Secret
Kubernetes Secret
Cloud Secret Manager
Encrypted SOPS File，用于受控自部署
```

# 八、配置漂移

生成配置指纹：

```text
environment
config_schema_version
non_secret_configuration_hash
secret_reference_hash
feature_flag_version
```

保存到部署记录，但不得保存 Secret 明文。

```bash
make config-check
make config-diff ENVIRONMENT=staging
```

生产配置修改必须通过版本控制和审批。

# 九、Feature Flag

```sql
CREATE TABLE system_feature_flags (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    flag_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    targeting_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    default_value JSONB NOT NULL,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

Feature Flag 可控制：

```text
模块入口
新推荐策略
新 AI 路由
运营实验
非关键新功能
```

不能用于绕过：

```text
安全检查
隐私同意
支付确认
权限检查
数据加密
```
