# 十、Skill 19.3：`vav-docker-compose-local-runtime`

## 目标

提供开发、测试、完整联调和可观测性 Compose Profiles。

## 10.1 服务清单

```text
reverse-proxy
user-web
admin-web
api
worker-default
worker-ai
worker-notifications
worker-media
worker-privacy
worker-safety
scheduler
postgres
redis
minio
minio-init
mailpit
otel-collector
prometheus
grafana
loki
tempo
```

## 10.2 根 `docker-compose.yml`

```yaml
include:
  - deploy/compose/docker-compose.base.yml
  - deploy/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml
```

## 10.3 Compose Profile

```text
core
web
workers
mail
observability
test
full
```

启动：

```bash
docker compose --profile full up -d
```

## 10.4 API 容器

```yaml
services:
  api:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: services/api/Dockerfile
      target: development
    command:
      - uvicorn
      - vav.main:app
      - --host=0.0.0.0
      - --port=8000
      - --reload
    environment:
      APP_ENVIRONMENT: development
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
```

## 10.5 健康检查

每个服务必须有真实 Health Check。

### API

```http
GET /health/live
GET /health/ready
GET /health/startup
```

### Ready 检查

```text
数据库连接
数据库迁移版本
Redis
对象存储
关键配置
Outbox 写入能力
```

外部 AI、邮件、支付 Provider 短暂失败不应使核心 API 永久不 Ready，可单独报告为 degraded。

## 10.6 Worker 健康

```text
Worker Heartbeat
Queue Lag
Last Successful Task
Active Task Count
```

Scheduler 必须是单实例或使用分布式锁。

---

# 十一、容器安全

生产镜像必须：

```text
非 root 用户
只读根文件系统
临时目录单独挂载
drop ALL capabilities
no-new-privileges
最小基础镜像
不包含开发依赖
不包含源码 Secret
不开放调试端口
```

示例：

```yaml
security_opt:
  - no-new-privileges:true
cap_drop:
  - ALL
read_only: true
tmpfs:
  - /tmp
```

数据库和 Redis 不向公共网络暴露。

---

# 十二、Compose 开发数据卷

```text
vav-postgres-data
vav-redis-data
vav-minio-data
vav-grafana-data
```

命令：

```bash
make up
make down
make restart
make logs
make ps
make reset-local
```

`make reset-local` 必须要求显式确认，避免误删开发数据。

# 十三、Skill 19.4：`vav-production-deployment`

## 目标

建立小规模单机生产和可扩展多节点部署方案。

## 13.1 小规模生产拓扑

```text
Internet
  ↓
CDN / WAF
  ↓
Reverse Proxy + TLS
  ├── User Web Static
  ├── Admin Web Static
  └── FastAPI API
        ├── Worker Pools
        ├── Scheduler
        ├── PostgreSQL
        ├── Redis
        └── Object Storage
```

适用于：

```text
早期验证
有限用户规模
单区域部署
受控运维团队
```

## 13.2 推荐生产拓扑

```text
CDN / WAF
    ↓
Load Balancer
    ↓
API Replicas
    ├── PostgreSQL HA / Managed
    ├── Redis HA / Managed
    ├── S3-compatible Object Storage
    ├── Worker Pools
    ├── Scheduler Leader
    └── OpenTelemetry Collector
```

User Web 和 Admin Web 使用独立构建产物和访问策略。

## 13.3 Worker 队列隔离

```text
default
commerce
activities
courses
counseling
ai
knowledge
notifications
privacy
recommendations
safety
media
```

高成本 AI、文档解析和隐私导出不能阻塞支付 Webhook 或安全屏蔽传播。

## 13.4 部署单位

```text
api
worker-default
worker-commerce
worker-ai
worker-notifications
worker-privacy
worker-safety
scheduler
user-web
admin-web
```

## 13.5 Kubernetes Reference

```text
deploy/kubernetes/base/
├── api-deployment.yaml
├── api-service.yaml
├── worker-deployments.yaml
├── scheduler-deployment.yaml
├── user-web-deployment.yaml
├── admin-web-deployment.yaml
├── ingress.yaml
├── configmap.yaml
├── secrets-reference.yaml
├── network-policies.yaml
├── pod-disruption-budgets.yaml
├── horizontal-pod-autoscalers.yaml
└── migration-job.yaml
```

## 13.6 Network Policy

```text
Web → API
API → PostgreSQL/Redis/Object Storage
Worker → PostgreSQL/Redis/Object Storage
Scheduler → PostgreSQL/Redis
Observability → Metrics Endpoints
```

禁止：

```text
User Web 直连数据库
Admin Web 直连数据库
互联网直连 Redis
互联网直连 MinIO 管理端
```

# 十四、生产发布流程

```text
构建镜像
→ 安全扫描
→ 签名
→ 部署 Migration Job
→ 验证 Migration
→ 部署 API Canary
→ Smoke Test
→ 扩大 API
→ 部署 Worker
→ 部署 Web
→ 完整生产验证
→ 标记 Release Active
```

## 14.1 Migration 顺序

```text
向后兼容数据库迁移
→ 新代码部署
→ 后台回填
→ 切换 Feature
→ 后续清理旧字段
```

禁止在同一个部署中：

```text
删除旧列
并立即部署仍可能读取旧列的滚动实例
```

## 14.2 Maintenance Mode

仅用于必须短暂停机的迁移：

```text
公共内容继续可读
登录用户写操作暂停
支付 Webhook 继续持久化到 Inbox
维护结束后重放
```

---

# 十五、部署回滚

应用回滚：

```text
将服务镜像切回上一 Digest
→ 验证数据库向后兼容
→ 运行 Smoke Test
```

数据库迁移回滚：

```text
优先 Forward Fix
```

只有经过验证的可逆迁移才使用 `downgrade`。

数据破坏类迁移必须先完成：

```text
备份
迁移 Dry Run
数据校验
恢复演练
```

---

# 十六、Skill 19.5：`vav-database-migrations-release`

## 目标

保证 82 个以上迁移顺序一致、可重放、可升级、可校验。

## 16.1 Migration 规则

每个迁移必须声明：

```text
revision
down_revision
module_code
risk_level
estimated_lock_time
backfill_required
rollback_policy
```

示例 Docstring：

```python
"""
Module: trust_safety
Risk: medium
Estimated lock: under 5 seconds
Backfill: no
Rollback: forward-fix preferred
"""
```

## 16.2 Migration Gate

```bash
make migration-check
```

检查：

```text
Migration Graph 单一 Head
编号无冲突
空数据库可升级到 Head
旧生产快照可升级到 Head
Downgrade 边界明确
迁移没有未受控长事务
新增非空列有安全默认或回填过程
索引创建策略适合生产
```

## 16.3 Expand-Migrate-Contract

```text
Release A
新增兼容字段

Background Job
回填数据

Release B
应用切换到新字段

Release C
验证无旧字段读取

Release D
删除旧字段
```

## 16.4 数据回填任务

```sql
CREATE TABLE system_backfill_jobs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    job_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    release_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    cursor_snapshot JSONB,
    processed_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    failed_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(job_code, release_version)
);
```

回填必须：

```text
可暂停
可恢复
幂等
分批
有限速
可观测
```

# 二十、Skill 19.7：`vav-observability-slo-alerting`

## 目标

建立日志、指标、Trace、SLO、告警和 Runbook。

## 20.1 OpenTelemetry

所有服务统一输出：

```text
Trace
Metric
Structured Log Correlation
```

传播：

```text
traceparent
request_id
user_session_hash
source_event_id
job_id
```

不得传播用户敏感明文。

## 20.2 日志格式

```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-07-31T05:00:00Z",
  "level": "INFO",
  "service": "api",
  "module": "commerce",
  "event": "payment_webhook_processed",
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "trace_id": "hex",
  "duration_ms": 83,
  "status": "success"
}
```

禁止记录：

```text
密码
Access Token
Refresh Token
支付卡信息
联系方式明文
婚恋档案正文
辅导内容
AI 对话
举报证据
下载 Token
```

## 20.3 标准指标

```text
http_requests_total
http_request_duration_seconds
http_errors_total

celery_tasks_total
celery_task_duration_seconds
celery_task_failures_total
celery_queue_depth

database_connections
database_query_duration_seconds
database_deadlocks_total

redis_operation_duration_seconds
object_storage_errors_total

outbox_pending_events
inbox_failed_events
dead_letters_open
```

各业务模块继续暴露其 Batch 指标。

# 二十一、SLO

以下为初始工程目标，正式值需根据业务规模和预算批准：

| 服务 | 初始目标 |
|---|---:|
| 核心 API 月度可用性 | 99.9% |
| 公共页面月度可用性 | 99.9% |
| 核心非 AI API P95 | ≤ 500 ms |
| 推荐列表读取 P95 | ≤ 1 s |
| 支付 Webhook 接收 P95 | ≤ 500 ms |
| 站内通知创建 P95 | ≤ 2 s |
| 高优先级屏蔽传播 | ≤ 5 s |
| AI Turn P95 | 配置化，初始 ≤ 45 s |
| 异步关键任务成功率 | ≥ 99.5% |

这些不是对外法律承诺，而是内部运营目标。

公共首页

受控生产 Smoke 用户：

不得在生产合成监控中：

真实付款
真实发送大量邮件

```

# 二十三、告警分级

## Critical

```text
数据库不可用
支付 Webhook 全部失败
屏蔽传播失败
跨用户访问检测
Secret 泄漏
备份连续失败
生产迁移失败
```

## High

```text
API 错误率异常
队列严重积压
AI Provider 全部失败
通知大量失败
推荐批次持续失败
隐私删除任务失败
```

## Warning

```text
容量逼近阈值
单个 Provider 延迟增加
部分 Worker 队列积压
备份时间增加
```

每条告警必须链接到对应 Runbook。

# 二十五、Skill 19.8：`vav-backup-restore`

## 目标

建立可验证的 PostgreSQL、对象存储、配置和审计备份。

## 25.1 PostgreSQL

推荐：

```text
每日全量备份
＋
持续 WAL 归档
＋
Point-in-Time Recovery
```

备份内容：

```text
应用数据库
pgvector 数据
迁移版本
角色和必要权限定义
```

## 25.2 对象存储

备份：

```text
用户上传文件
课程附件
知识库原文件
隐私导出包的短时数据边界
照片处理文件
授权证据
```

推荐启用：

```text
版本控制
生命周期策略
跨存储复制边界
对象完整性校验
```

## 25.3 Redis

Redis 不得成为唯一业务真源。

可备份：

```text
队列状态
临时缓存
限流状态
```

但灾难恢复应允许：

```text
清空缓存
从 PostgreSQL 和 Outbox 重建
```

## 25.4 配置

备份：

```text
非 Secret 配置
环境 Manifest
Feature Flag
Provider 引用
部署 Manifest
```

Secret 由 Secret Manager 独立恢复，普通备份中不保存明文。

---

# 二十六、备份记录

备份状态主要保存在外部备份系统和对象存储 Manifest；应用可保存只读镜像：

```sql
CREATE TABLE system_backup_records (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    backup_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    environment VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    backup_reference_encrypted TEXT,
    checksum_manifest JSONB,

    source_release_version VARCHAR(64),
    source_database_revision VARCHAR(64),

    verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

该表不是备份本身。

---

# 二十七、备份加密和完整性

每个备份：

```text
服务端加密
独立 Backup Key
Manifest Hash
对象数量
数据库 Revision
Release Version
创建时间
保留时间
```

恢复前验证：

```text
备份存在
解密成功
Checksum 匹配
数据库版本受支持
对象 Manifest 完整
```

# 二十八、恢复演练

## 恢复类型

```text
数据库完整恢复
指定时间点恢复
对象存储恢复
单个 Bucket 恢复
应用配置恢复
完整新环境恢复
```

## 演练流程

```text
创建隔离恢复环境
→ 恢复 PostgreSQL
→ 恢复对象存储
→ 注入测试 Secret
→ 部署对应 Release
→ 运行迁移兼容检查
→ 运行完整性检查
→ 运行 Smoke Test
→ 生成恢复报告
→ 销毁演练环境
```

## 命令

```bash
make backup
make backup-verify
make restore-drill
make restore-smoke
```

# 二十九、初始 RPO/RTO

正式值需业务批准，初始建议：

| 资产 | RPO | RTO |
|---|---:|---:|
| PostgreSQL 核心数据 | 15 分钟 | 4 小时 |
| 对象存储 | 24 小时 | 8 小时 |
| 配置和 Manifest | 24 小时 | 4 小时 |
| Redis 缓存 | 可重建 | 1 小时 |
| 静态前端 | 0，来自 Artifact | 1 小时 |

安全、隐私和财务数据应采用更严格恢复验证。

# 三十一、压测阶段

```text

1-5 并发

Baseline
预期平均负载

Peak
预期峰值

Stress
逐渐超过预期峰值

Soak
持续数小时

Recovery
停止压力后恢复验证

# 三十二、容量基线

```text
Release Version
数据库规格

请求速率
P50/P95/P99
错误率
数据库 CPU
锁等待
队列延迟
成本估算
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE system_capacity_baselines (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    release_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    environment VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    scenario_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    infrastructure_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
    load_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
    result_metrics JSONB NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    tested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

数据库死锁

Worker 队列无法恢复
内存持续增长
推荐曝光重复
配额超卖

```

性能问题不得通过关闭安全或隐私检查来解决。

# 三十四、Skill 19.10：`vav-disaster-recovery-chaos`

## 目标

验证系统在基础设施、Provider、部署和数据错误下的恢复能力。

## 34.1 故障场景

```text
API 实例退出
Worker 实例退出
Scheduler 重启
PostgreSQL 短时不可用
Redis 清空
Redis 网络中断
MinIO 暂时不可用
邮件 Provider 失败
支付 Provider 延迟
AI Provider 失败
错误 Feature Flag
错误应用部署
迁移失败
队列积压
单个 Bucket 数据损坏
```

## 34.2 预期行为

### API 实例退出

```text
其他实例继续服务
负载均衡移除故障实例
无 Session 丢失
```

### Redis 清空

```text
缓存重新生成
业务真源不丢失
Outbox/数据库任务可重新投递
```

### AI Provider 失败

```text
核心业务继续可用
Agent 使用兼容 Fallback
无 Fallback 时安全降级
风险检查不能跳过
```

### 邮件失败

```text
业务交易不回滚
通知任务重试
站内通知继续
```

### 支付 Provider 延迟

```text
订单保持待确认
不提前激活服务
Webhook 后正确投影
```

```text
docs/runbooks/
├── database-unavailable.md
├── redis-unavailable.md
├── object-storage-unavailable.md
├── payment-provider-failure.md
├── email-provider-failure.md

症状
影响

验证命令
回滚步骤
沟通模板
事后复盘
```

# 三十六、错误发布恢复

```text
停止继续扩量
→ 切回上一镜像 Digest
→ 保留错误 Release 日志
→ 检查数据库兼容性
→ 重新运行 Smoke
→ 重新启用流量
→ 创建 Incident
```

不得删除错误 Release 的审计证据。

---

# 三十七、密钥泄漏响应

```text
立即禁用泄漏 Secret
→ 轮换
→ 撤销相关 Session 或 Token
→ 扫描使用范围
→ 检查访问日志
→ 重新部署
→ 验证旧 Secret 失效
→ 记录安全事件
```

字段加密主密钥轮换必须使用版本化 Envelope Encryption，不应直接重写全部数据而无恢复计划。

# 四十六、完整用户旅程 H：安全

```text
用户 A 举报并屏蔽用户 B
→ 举报创建
→ Block 创建
→ 推荐失效

# 四十八、E2E 测试数据

只使用：

```text
合成用户
合成档案
Fake Payment Provider
Mailpit
Fake AI Provider
固定时间
固定随机种子
```

不同测试用户：

```text
free-user-a
paid-user-b
profile-user-a
profile-user-b
mentor-user
admin-reviewer
safety-investigator
appeal-reviewer
```

不得依赖真实用户数据。

# 四十九、测试稳定性

必须控制：

```text
时间
随机数
异步任务完成
Provider 响应
邮件到达
Webhook 顺序
推荐批次
时区
```

实现：

```text
Test Clock
Deterministic UUID 边界
Fake Provider Fixtures
Job Await Helper
Database Fixture Isolation
```

禁止大量 `sleep(10)` 等不稳定测试。

# 五十、Skill 19.12：`vav-one-click-acceptance-runbooks`

## 目标

建立从空机器到完整可运行平台的一键流程。

## 50.1 `vavctl`

```bash
./scripts/vavctl doctor
./scripts/vavctl bootstrap
./scripts/vavctl up
./scripts/vavctl seed
./scripts/vavctl smoke
./scripts/vavctl verify
./scripts/vavctl backup
./scripts/vavctl down
```

## 50.2 `doctor`

检查：

```text
操作系统
CPU 架构
Docker
Docker Compose
磁盘空间
内存
端口占用
Git
Node/pnpm
Python/uv
网络
证书
```

输出：

```text
PASS
WARNING
FAIL
```

Fail 时给出具体修复方法。

## 50.3 `bootstrap`

```text
复制 .env.example
→ 生成本地随机 Secret
→ 创建 Docker 网络
→ 创建数据目录
→ 拉取或构建镜像
→ 启动基础设施
→ 等待健康
→ 执行迁移
→ 执行 System Seed
→ 执行 Reference Seed
→ 生成 API Client
```

## 50.4 `up`

```text
启动 PostgreSQL
启动 Redis
启动 MinIO
启动 Mailpit
启动 API
启动 Worker
启动 Scheduler
启动 User Web
启动 Admin Web
启动 Reverse Proxy
```

## 50.5 `smoke`

检查：

```text
API Live
API Ready
数据库 Revision
Redis
MinIO
User Web
Admin Web
登录
创建测试通知
上传测试文件
```

# 五十一、Makefile 最终命令

```makefile
doctor:
	./scripts/vavctl doctor

bootstrap:
	./scripts/vavctl bootstrap

up:
	./scripts/vavctl up

down:
	./scripts/vavctl down

seed:
	./scripts/vavctl seed

smoke:
	./scripts/vavctl smoke

manifest-check:
	python scripts/diagnostics/validate_project_manifest.py

migration-check:
	./scripts/database/check-migrations.sh

contract-test:
	pytest tests/contract -q

system-test:
	pytest tests/system -q

complete-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test tests/complete-e2e

performance-smoke:
	k6 run tests/performance/smoke.js

performance-baseline:
	k6 run tests/performance/baseline.js

backup:
	./scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

backup-verify:
	./scripts/backup/verify-backups.sh

restore-drill:
	./scripts/restore/run-restore-drill.sh

production-readiness:
	./scripts/release/production-readiness.sh

verify-all:
	$(MAKE) manifest-check
	$(MAKE) migration-check
	$(MAKE) verify
	$(MAKE) auth-verify
	$(MAKE) cms-verify

# 五十六、Batch 19 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-19/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-19-production-assembly
description: Assemble, configure, containerize, deploy, observe, back up, restore, performance-test and fully accept the complete VAV platform.
---

# Goal

Build the final production assembly for the complete VAV platform containing:

- a validated project manifest;
- final monorepo assembly;
- module, migration, event, permission and configuration manifests;
- development, test, CI, staging, production and DR environments;
- typed configuration validation;
- secret-provider boundaries;
- Docker Compose development and production profiles;
- a scalable production deployment reference;
- reverse proxy, TLS and network policy;
- safe database migration orchestration;
- complete CI/CD;
- dependency locking;
- SBOM generation;
- vulnerability scanning;
- image signing;
- OpenTelemetry logs, metrics and traces;
- SLOs and alert rules;
- backup and restore workflows;
- PostgreSQL PITR;
- object-storage backup;
- restore drills;
- performance and capacity tests;
- disaster-recovery and chaos scenarios;
- complete cross-module E2E tests;
- one-command bootstrap, verification and acceptance;
- complete deployment and operations runbooks.

# Source requirements

The project plan requires:

- separated Vue user and administration applications;
- Python/FastAPI backend services;
- PostgreSQL and pgvector;
- Redis and asynchronous jobs;
- object storage;
- independently deployable AI capabilities;
- complete implementation, testing, deployment and documentation;
- real-user journeys from registration through service delivery and
  matchmaking;
- no major security defect in sensitive workflows.

This batch does not add a new product domain. It integrates and validates
Batches 1 through 18 as one deployable system.

# Prerequisites

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batch 1 through Batch 18.
3. Verify Batch 18 with `make safety-verify`.
4. Read every skill under `skills/batch-19`.
5. Inspect every module manifest, migration, permission and event contract.
6. Produce `docs/implementation/batch-19-plan.md`.
7. Produce `docs/architecture/final-system-topology.md`.
8. Produce `docs/acceptance/complete-e2e-matrix.md`.
9. Produce `docs/disaster-recovery/restore-procedure.md`.
10. Record unresolved production hosting, RPO, RTO, SLO, scaling and
    operational-ownership decisions in the decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. Final project manifest.
2. Module-manifest validation.
3. Environment-schema validation.
4. Secret-provider abstraction.
5. Docker Compose base services.
6. Development and test profiles.
7. Observability profile.
8. Production Compose.
9. Kubernetes deployment reference.
10. Network and container security.
11. Migration and backfill orchestration.
12. CI quality gates.
13. Image build, SBOM, scan and signing.
14. Staging deployment workflow.
15. Production deployment workflow.
16. OpenTelemetry instrumentation.
17. Metrics, dashboards and alert rules.
18. Backup automation.
19. Restore automation and drills.
20. Performance and capacity testing.
21. Disaster-recovery scenarios.
22. Complete cross-module E2E.
23. One-command bootstrap and acceptance.
24. Deployment and operations documentation.

# Architecture constraints

- Business modules remain independently testable.
- Configuration is typed and environment specific.
- Secrets never enter source control or frontend artifacts.
- Production images are immutable and digest pinned.
- Core business state remains in PostgreSQL or approved durable storage.
- Redis is not the sole source of truth for business data.
- AI, email and other provider outages must not disable unrelated core
  services.
- High-cost queues remain isolated from payment and safety queues.
- Production deployment supports rollback.
- Database migrations use backward-compatible release patterns.
- Baseline operation does not require manual modification of containers.

# Configuration invariants

- Every environment variable is registered.
- Unknown production configuration is rejected.
- Default development credentials are rejected in production.
- Fake providers and Mailpit are rejected in production.
- Security and privacy checks cannot be disabled by ordinary feature flags.
- Configuration changes are versioned and auditable.
- Secret values do not appear in configuration diffs.

# Container invariants

- Production containers run as non-root.
- Unnecessary capabilities are removed.
- Root filesystems are read only where possible.
- Databases, Redis and object-storage administration are not publicly
  exposed.
- Images contain only production dependencies.
- Image tags are resolved to immutable digests.
- Service health checks represent real readiness.

# Deployment invariants

- Database migration succeeds before incompatible application code receives
  traffic.
- Rolling deployments preserve backward compatibility.
- Failed canaries stop rollout.
- Webhook intake remains durable during maintenance where feasible.
- Application rollback does not silently downgrade incompatible data.
- Release records preserve image, migration and contract identities.
- Production deployment requires explicit approval.

# Migration invariants

- Migration graphs have one head.
- Empty databases and supported production snapshots upgrade to head.
- Destructive changes use expand-migrate-contract.
- Backfills are resumable and idempotent.
- Long-running backfills do not hold blocking transactions.
- Irreversible migrations require backup and restore validation.
- Failed migrations prevent deployment.

# CI/CD invariants

- Pull requests run lint, type, unit, migration and secret checks.
- Main runs full integration, security and E2E suites.
- Critical security failures block image publication.
- Production images include SBOMs.
- Production images are scanned and signed.
- Deployments verify image signatures.
- Staging smoke tests pass before production approval.
- CI logs do not expose secrets.

# Observability invariants

- Logs are structured.
- Requests, jobs and events use correlation identifiers.
- Sensitive content does not enter logs, traces or metrics.
- Core services expose liveness and readiness.
- Critical user journeys have metrics.
- Alerts link to runbooks.
- SLO targets are versioned and reviewed.
- Monitoring failure does not expose application secrets.

# Backup and restore invariants

- PostgreSQL backups are encrypted.
- Point-in-time recovery is supported where configured.
- Object-storage backups use integrity manifests.
- Backups are verified.
- Backup success alone is insufficient; restore drills are required.
- Restore environments are isolated.
- Restores verify database revision and application compatibility.
- Redis loss must not destroy authoritative business data.
- Backup references and encryption keys remain separately protected.

# Performance invariants

- Performance tests use reproducible scenarios.
- Baselines pin release and infrastructure versions.
- Performance gates cannot be passed by disabling security or privacy checks.
- Payment, block propagation, quota and interaction concurrency receive
  dedicated load tests.
- Stress tests do not run destructively in production.
- Memory, database locks, queue lag and error recovery are measured.
- Performance regressions require investigation or approved exceptions.

# Disaster-recovery invariants

- Every critical dependency has a runbook.
- Provider failures degrade safely.
- Bad releases support application rollback.
- Data corruption uses verified backups.
- Secret leakage triggers immediate rotation and incident response.
- Block-propagation failures stop affected interaction delivery.
- Recovery procedures include verification, not only service startup.
- Disaster-recovery exercises preserve reports and corrective actions.

# Complete-E2E invariants

- Tests use synthetic users and fake providers.
- Tests cover the full commercial and matchmaking journeys.
- Payment return pages cannot activate access.
- Webhook processing is idempotent.
- One-sided likes remain private.
- Contact exchange requires mutual consent.
- Relationship stages require mutual confirmation.
- Users may end a relationship unilaterally.
- Membership never bypasses safety restrictions.
- Blocks invalidate every viewing and interaction path.
- Privacy export and erasure complete across modules.

# One-click invariants

- A supported developer machine can run `make bootstrap`.
- Bootstrap validates prerequisites before modifying state.
- Local secrets are generated securely.
- Infrastructure health is awaited, not assumed.
- Migrations and seeds are idempotent.
- `make smoke` verifies actual service behavior.
- `make acceptance` runs the complete acceptance path.
- Destructive reset commands require explicit confirmation.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make doctor
make bootstrap
make up
make down
make seed
make smoke
make manifest-check
make migration-check
make contract-test
make system-test
make complete-e2e
make performance-smoke
make performance-baseline
make backup
make backup-verify
make restore-drill
make production-readiness
make verify-all
make acceptance
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. The final project manifest validates.
2. Every module has a valid manifest.
3. Migration numbering and dependencies are valid.
4. Environment configuration is typed.
5. Production rejects insecure defaults.
6. Local Docker Compose starts every required service.
7. Development Mailpit and fake providers work.
8. Production Compose excludes development-only services.
9. Production containers run with reduced privileges.
10. A scalable deployment reference exists.
11. Network policies isolate internal services.
12. Database migrations support safe deployment.
13. Backfills are resumable.
14. PR CI gates work.
15. Main-branch full tests work.
16. SBOMs are generated.
17. Images are scanned and signed.
18. Staging deployment and smoke tests work.
19. Production deployment has approval gates.
20. Application rollback works.
21. OpenTelemetry traces work.
22. Structured logs exclude sensitive content.
23. Metrics and dashboards work.
24. Critical alerts link to runbooks.
25. PostgreSQL backup works.
26. Object-storage backup works.
27. Backup verification works.
28. Restore drill works.
29. Performance smoke tests pass.
30. Capacity baselines are recorded.
31. Disaster-recovery scenarios are documented and tested.
32. Complete commercial E2E passes.
33. Complete activity E2E passes.
34. Complete course E2E passes.
35. Complete counseling E2E passes.
36. Complete AI E2E passes.
37. Complete matchmaking E2E passes.
38. Complete membership E2E passes.
39. Complete safety E2E passes.
40. Complete privacy export and erasure E2E passes.
41. `make bootstrap` works from a clean environment.
42. `make smoke` works.
43. `make verify-all` works.
44. `make production-readiness` works.
45. `make acceptance` works.
46. `make safety-verify` still succeeds.
47. `make membership-verify` still succeeds.
48. `make relationship-verify` still succeeds.
49. `make interaction-verify` still succeeds.
50. `make recommendation-verify` still succeeds.
51. `make dating-profile-verify` still succeeds.
52. `make privacy-verify` still succeeds.
53. `make notification-verify` still succeeds.
54. `make ai-verify` still succeeds.
55. `make knowledge-verify` still succeeds.
56. `make counseling-verify` still succeeds.
57. `make course-verify` still succeeds.
58. `make activity-verify` still succeeds.
59. `make commerce-verify` still succeeds.
60. `make catalog-verify` still succeeds.
61. `make cms-verify` still succeeds.
62. `make auth-verify` still succeeds.
63. `make verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When production hosting or scaling policy is unresolved:

1. preserve the provider-neutral deployment model;
2. keep production Compose and Kubernetes references;
3. record the unresolved decision;
4. do not hard-code one cloud vendor;
5. continue implementing portable deployment capabilities.

When migration validation fails:

1. stop deployment;
2. preserve the failed migration logs;
3. restore or retain the previous database state;
4. repair the migration or use a forward fix;
5. rerun snapshot-upgrade and application compatibility tests.

When a critical CI security gate fails:

1. block image publication;
2. preserve the scan and test reports;
3. remediate the defect;
4. rotate exposed secrets where applicable;
5. rerun the complete security suite.

When a backup fails:

1. alert operations;
2. preserve the last known valid backup;
3. retry using the approved policy;
4. investigate capacity, credentials and integrity;
5. do not report recoverability until verification succeeds.

When a restore drill fails:

1. mark disaster recovery as not ready;
2. block production-readiness approval where required;
3. preserve the exact backup and release manifests;
4. repair the restore process;
5. rerun the complete drill.

When a complete E2E journey fails:

1. block release;
2. identify the first failing domain boundary;
3. preserve browser, API, event and database traces;
4. repair the root cause;
5. rerun the journey and all dependent regression suites.

When one-click bootstrap fails:

1. stop before destructive operations;
2. report the exact failed prerequisite or service;
3. preserve useful diagnostic output without secrets;
4. make the operation safely rerunnable;
5. add a clean-environment regression test.
```

# 二、Batch 20 与 Batch 1-19 的关系

## Batch 1-19 提供

```text
业务模块
领域服务
管理后台
数据模型
测试
生产部署
权限
事件
可观测性
```

## Batch 20 提供

```text
把既有能力封装成标准 Skill
为新 Skill 提供统一开发方法
为运行时提供权限和隔离
为 Skill 提供版本和依赖治理
为组织提供私有 Registry
为第三方提供受控 Marketplace
```

## 不应做的事情

Batch 20 不应：

```text
重新实现前面 18 个业务域
把所有模块改造成自由插件
允许第三方直接访问业务数据库
允许 Skill 绕过现有权限体系
允许 Skill 动态执行任意 Python
允许 Marketplace 包绕过生产安全门禁
```

# 三、Skill 的最终定义

一个 Skill 是：

> 一个具有明确用途、输入输出契约、依赖关系、权限边界、执行策略、版本、测试和供应链身份的可安装能力单元。

Skill 可以封装：

```text
领域查询
领域命令
工作流
Agent Tool
后台任务
事件处理器
数据导入器
报告生成器
管理端扩展
Provider Adapter
完整 Domain Pack
```

Skill 不是：

```text
任意 Prompt 文件
无 Schema 的 Python 函数
可访问全部数据的超级插件
一段不可审计的 Agent 指令
可以跳过业务规则的快捷脚本
```

# 六、Skill 类型

```python
class SkillType(StrEnum):
    QUERY = "query"
    COMMAND = "command"
    WORKFLOW = "workflow"
    AGENT_TOOL = "agent_tool"
    EVENT_HANDLER = "event_handler"
    SCHEDULED_JOB = "scheduled_job"
    IMPORTER = "importer"
    EXPORTER = "exporter"
    PROVIDER_ADAPTER = "provider_adapter"
    UI_EXTENSION = "ui_extension"
    DOMAIN_PACK = "domain_pack"
```

## Query Skill

```text
只读
无业务副作用
可缓存
```

## Command Skill

```text
产生业务写操作
要求幂等键
可能需要用户确认
```

## Workflow Skill

```text
由多个步骤组成
支持暂停、恢复、取消和补偿
```

## Agent Tool Skill

```text
供 Batch 10 Agent 使用
必须声明风险等级
必须通过 Tool Registry
```

## Event Handler Skill

```text
消费版本化事件
必须 Inbox 去重
```

## Domain Pack

```text
多个 Skill
Schema
配置
权限
UI 扩展
迁移
文档
测试
```

# 七、Skill Manifest

每个 Skill 必须包含：

```text
skill.yaml
README.md
CHANGELOG.md
LICENSE
schemas/
tests/
migrations/
assets/
signatures/
```

## `skill.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: skills.vav.io/v1
kind: Skill

metadata:
  name: vav.counseling.search-available-mentors
  displayName: Search Available Mentors
  version: 1.2.0
  publisher: vav-official
  description: Search currently available counseling mentors.
  license: Proprietary
  categories:
    - counseling
    - scheduling

spec:
  type: query
  runtime: python
  entrypoint: vav_skill.main:SearchAvailableMentorsSkill

  runtimeApiVersion: "1.0"
  manifestVersion: "1.0"

  inputs:
    schema: schemas/input.schema.json

  outputs:
    schema: schemas/output.schema.json

  errors:
    schema: schemas/error.schema.json

  permissions:
    - counseling.services.read
    - counseling.mentors.read
    - counseling.availability.read

  capabilities:
    provides:
      - counseling.mentor_search.v1
    requires:
      - counseling.availability.v1

  dependencies:
    skills: []
    modules:
      - identity: ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0"
      - counseling: ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0"

  execution:
    timeoutSeconds: 10
    retryPolicy: read_safe
    idempotency: not_required
    concurrencyLimit: 20

  data:
    reads:
      - counseling.public_mentor_profile
      - counseling.availability_projection
    writes: []

  security:
    networkAccess: none
    filesystemAccess: none
    secretAccess: []
    riskLevel: low
    userConfirmationRequired: false

  compatibility:
    minimumPlatformVersion: "1.0.0"
    maximumPlatformVersion: "<2.0.0"

  observability:
    tracing: true
    metrics: true
    auditLevel: metadata

  tests:
    command: pytest -q
```

---

# 八、Manifest 不变量

```text
Skill 名称全局唯一
版本使用 SemVer
Entry Point 明确
输入输出 Schema 必须存在
权限必须在平台权限注册表中存在
Capability 必须有版本
依赖必须声明版本范围
执行超时必须有限
副作用 Skill 必须声明幂等策略
网络、文件和 Secret 权限默认关闭
风险等级必须声明
兼容范围必须声明
```

Manifest 不允许：

```text
任意 Shell Command
任意 Docker Socket
任意数据库连接字符串
内嵌 Secret
未注册权限
通配符访问所有数据
```

---

# 九、Skill Package

建议包格式：

```text
<skill-name>-<version>.vavskill
```

本质为确定性归档：

```text
skill.yaml
schemas/
runtime/
migrations/
ui/
docs/
tests/
SBOM
provenance.json
checksums.json
signature.sig
```

## 确定性构建

同一源码和锁定依赖必须产生：

```text
相同内容清单
可验证的 Package Hash
```

构建时间等非确定数据放入独立 Provenance，不影响核心内容 Hash。

# 十一、Python Skill 接口

```python
InputT = TypeVar("InputT", bound=BaseModel)
OutputT = TypeVar("OutputT", bound=BaseModel)

class SkillContext(BaseModel):
    execution_id: UUID
    installation_id: UUID

    actor_user_id: UUID | None
    principal: SkillPrincipal

    locale: str
    timezone: str

    idempotency_key: str | None
    deadline: datetime

    permissions: frozenset[str]
    capability_grants: frozenset[str]

    request_id: UUID
    trace_id: str

class Skill(Protocol[InputT, OutputT]):
    metadata: SkillMetadata

    async def execute(
        self,
        input_data: InputT,
        context: SkillContext,
    ) -> OutputT:
        ...
```

## Command Skill

```python
class CommandSkill(Skill[InputT, OutputT], Protocol):
    idempotency_required: Literal[True]

    async def compensate(
        self,
        execution: SkillExecutionSnapshot,
        context: SkillContext,
    ) -> CompensationResult:
        ...
```

只有明确支持补偿的 Skill 才实现 `compensate`。

---

# 十二、Skill Result

```python
class SkillResult(BaseModel, Generic[OutputT]):
    status: Literal[
        "succeeded",
        "partially_succeeded",
        "failed",
        "cancelled",
    ]

    data: OutputT | None

    warnings: list[SkillWarning]
    side_effects: list[SkillSideEffect]
    emitted_events: list[SkillEventReference]

    execution_metadata: SkillExecutionMetadata
```

## 统一 Error

```python
class SkillError(BaseModel):
    code: str
    category: Literal[
        "validation",
        "authorization",
        "dependency",
        "conflict",
        "rate_limit",
        "timeout",
        "provider",
        "business",
        "internal",
    ]

    message_safe: str
    retryable: bool

    field_errors: list[FieldError] = []
    correlation_id: UUID
```

禁止将数据库异常、Secret 或内部堆栈直接返回调用者。

# 十四、Skill Test Kit

提供：

Fake SkillContext

```python
async def test_search_skill_denies_missing_permission():
    context = fake_skill_context(
        permissions=set(),

        await skill.execute(
            SearchMentorsInput(locale="zh-CN"),

# 十五、Skill Schema Contracts

## 输入 Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "skills://vav.counseling.search-available-mentors/1.2.0/input",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["locale"],
  "properties": {
    "locale": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["zh-CN", "zh-TW", "en"]
    },
    "city": {
      "type": ["string", "null"],
      "maxLength": 128
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 20,
      "default": 5
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

## 输出 Schema

```json
{
  "$id": "skills://vav.counseling.search-available-mentors/1.2.0/output",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["items"],
  "properties": {
    "items": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 20,
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/MentorSummary"
      }
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

# 十七、Schema 代码生成

```text
JSON Schema
→ Pydantic Models
→ TypeScript Types
→ OpenAPI Components
→ Web Form Types
→ Test Fixtures
```

命令：

```bash
vav skill schema generate

vav skill schema diff --from 1.1.0 --to 1.2.0
```

# 十八、Schema 兼容规则

兼容变更：

```text
新增可选字段
扩大允许输出字段边界，且旧消费者可忽略
新增 Error Code
```

可能破坏兼容：

```text
删除字段
字段从可选变必填
缩小枚举
更改字段类型
更改字段语义
改变敏感分类
```

破坏性变更必须提升 Major Version。

# 十九、Skill Runtime 架构

```text
Caller
  ↓
Skill Gateway
  ↓
Installation Resolver
  ↓
Version Resolver
  ↓
Permission Guard
  ↓
Schema Validator
  ↓
Execution Planner
  ↓
Runtime Adapter
  ├── In-process Runtime
  ├── Worker Runtime
  ├── HTTP Runtime
  └── Sandbox Runtime
  ↓
Output Validator
  ↓
Audit + Trace + Metrics
```

---

# 二十、Skill Runtime 服务结构

```text
services/skill-runtime/
├── src/vav_skill_runtime/
│   ├── api/
│   ├── registry/
│   ├── resolver/
│   ├── planner/
│   ├── execution/
│   ├── runtimes/
│   ├── permissions/
│   ├── schemas/
│   ├── idempotency/
│   ├── cancellation/
│   ├── secrets/
│   ├── observability/
│   └── persistence/
├── tests/
├── Dockerfile
└── pyproject.toml
```

---

# 二十一、Runtime 类型

## In-process

仅允许：

```text
官方内置
同版本发布
经过代码评审
低风险
```

优点：

```text
低延迟
简单
```

风险：

```text
故障可能影响主进程
隔离有限
```

## Worker Runtime

适用于：

```text
后台任务
长耗时任务
文档处理
报表
批量工作
```

## HTTP Runtime

适用于：

```text
独立服务
外部组织 Skill
Provider Adapter
```

## Sandbox Runtime

适用于：

```text
第三方代码
高风险数据转换
待认证插件
```

生产不得在主 API 进程中加载未经信任的第三方代码。

# 二十四、Skill 执行流程

```text
解析 Skill 名称
→ 解析安装实例
→ 选择有效版本
→ 检查 Skill 状态
→ 检查依赖
→ 检查调用者权限
→ 检查 Skill 自身授权
→ 校验 Input Schema
→ 检查用户确认
→ 创建 Execution
→ 执行
→ 校验 Output Schema
→ 写副作用和事件
→ 写 Trace 与审计
→ 返回结果
```

# 二十五、调用来源

```python
class SkillInvocationSource(StrEnum):
    USER_API = "user_api"
    ADMIN_API = "admin_api"
    AGENT = "agent"
    EVENT = "event"
    SCHEDULE = "schedule"
    WORKFLOW = "workflow"
    CLI = "cli"
    IDE = "ide"
    INTERNAL_SERVICE = "internal_service"
```

不同来源使用不同权限和确认规则。

Agent 调用不能继承管理员权限。

# 二十六、取消与 Deadline

Runtime 必须支持：

```text
Deadline 传播
取消请求
Provider Timeout
Worker Revocation 边界
补偿边界
```

```python
context.deadline
context.cancellation_token
```

Skill 不能忽略平台 Deadline 无限执行。

# 二十七、Skill Registry 数据模型

## Skill

```sql
CREATE TABLE registered_skills (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    skill_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    publisher_id UUID NOT NULL,

    display_name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,

    skill_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    visibility VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    trust_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    current_stable_version_id UUID,
    latest_version_id UUID,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## Skill Version

```sql
CREATE TABLE registered_skill_versions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    registered_skill_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES registered_skills(id),

    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    manifest_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    runtime_api_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    manifest_checksum VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    package_reference_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_checksum VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    sbom_reference_encrypted TEXT,
    provenance_reference_encrypted TEXT,

    signature_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    security_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    review_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    compatibility_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    deprecated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(registered_skill_id, semantic_version)
);
```

# 二十八、Registry 类型

```python
class SkillVisibility(StrEnum):
    BUILTIN = "builtin"
    ORGANIZATION_PRIVATE = "organization_private"
    MARKETPLACE_UNLISTED = "marketplace_unlisted"
    MARKETPLACE_PUBLIC = "marketplace_public"
```

## Trust Level

```python
class SkillTrustLevel(StrEnum):
    BUILTIN_TRUSTED = "builtin_trusted"
    OFFICIAL_SIGNED = "official_signed"
    VERIFIED_PUBLISHER = "verified_publisher"
    COMMUNITY_REVIEWED = "community_reviewed"
    UNVERIFIED = "unverified"

# 二十九、依赖图

```sql
CREATE TABLE skill_dependencies (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    skill_version_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES registered_skill_versions(id),

    dependency_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    dependency_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    version_constraint VARCHAR(128),

    optional BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    peer BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    resolution_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## Dependency Type

```text
skill
module
capability
provider
runtime
platform
```

---

# 三十、依赖解析

安装时执行：

```text
读取目标 Skill
→ 解析版本范围
→ 加载现有安装
→ 计算依赖闭包
→ 检测循环
→ 检测版本冲突
→ 检测权限扩大
→ 生成 Install Plan
```

冲突示例：

```text
Skill A 需要 runtime-api >=1 <2
Skill B 需要 runtime-api >=2 <3
当前平台只支持 1.x
```

安装必须失败并明确说明。

---

# 三十一、循环依赖检测

```text
Skill A → Skill B
Skill B → Skill C
Skill C → Skill A
```

必须在发布和安装阶段拒绝。

事件上的逻辑循环可允许，但必须通过：

```text
事件版本
幂等
防回环 Header
最大处理深度
```

控制。

---

# 三十二、依赖影响分析

升级前展示：

```text
直接依赖者
间接依赖者
使用该 Capability 的 Skill
依赖旧 Schema 的工作流
受影响的安装实例
受影响的生产环境
```

CLI：

```bash
vav skill dependency graph vav.ai.hanna-agent
vav skill dependency impact vav.knowledge.search@2.0.0
```

---

# 三十三、Skill 权限模型

Skill 权限分四层：

```text
调用者权限
安装实例权限
Skill Manifest 权限
运行时资源权限
```

最终可用权限为交集：

```text
Caller Grants
∩ Installation Grants
∩ Manifest Requested Permissions
∩ Runtime Policy
```

不能由 Skill 自行提权。

---

# 三十四、Permission Scope

```python
class SkillPermissionScope(StrEnum):
    USER_DATA = "user_data"
    DOMAIN_DATA = "domain_data"
    ADMIN_OPERATION = "admin_operation"
    NETWORK = "network"
    FILESYSTEM = "filesystem"
    SECRET = "secret"
    TOOL = "tool"
    EVENT = "event"
    SCHEDULE = "schedule"
```

## 示例

```text
profiles.self.read
profiles.approved.read
counseling.availability.read
commerce.orders.create
notifications.send.transactional
privacy.exports.create
```

禁止：

```text
database.*
all_user_data.*
admin.*
secret.*
```

这样的无限制通配符。

---

# 三十五、安装授权

安装向导必须显示：

```text
Skill 用途
发布者
版本
签名状态
读取的数据
写入的数据
调用的 Provider
网络目标
需要的 Secret
后台任务
定时任务
事件订阅
管理员权限
用户确认要求
```

高风险权限：

```text
读取 Restricted 数据
执行支付相关命令
导出用户数据
发送外部邮件
创建安全限制
读取 Secret
访问互联网
```

需要独立审批。

---

# 三十六、动态权限申请

Skill 不能在执行时自由扩大权限。

允许：

```text
安装版本声明新权限
→ 安装升级进入权限审查
→ 管理员批准
→ 新版本激活
```

不允许：

```text
Skill 运行到一半临时要求 all_user_data.read
```

用户级动作确认与平台安装权限必须分开。

---

# 三十七、Sandbox

第三方 Skill 默认运行于：

```text
独立进程或容器
只读文件系统
无主机网络
无 Docker Socket
无数据库直连
有限 CPU
有限内存
有限执行时间
临时工作目录
受控出站网络
受控 Secret Broker
```

## 默认资源限制

```dotenv
SKILL_SANDBOX_CPU_LIMIT=1
SKILL_SANDBOX_MEMORY_MB=512
SKILL_SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=30
SKILL_SANDBOX_MAX_OUTPUT_MB=10
SKILL_SANDBOX_NETWORK_DEFAULT=deny
```

---

# 三十八、Network Egress Policy

```yaml
network:
  mode: allowlist
  destinations:
    - host: api.example-provider.com
      ports: [443]
      protocols: [https]
```

禁止：

```text
任意 IP
内网地址
Metadata Service
数据库地址
localhost 管理端口
```

需防止 SSRF：

```text
DNS Rebinding
重定向到内网
IPv6 内网
混淆 IP
```

---

# 三十九、Secret Broker

Skill 不直接获得永久 Secret 明文。

```text
Skill 请求 secret reference
→ Runtime 检查权限
→ Broker 生成短时凭证或代理调用
→ 记录使用审计
```

接口：

```python
class SkillSecretBroker(Protocol):
    async def issue(
        self,
        reference: str,
        context: SkillContext,
    ) -> TemporarySecretHandle:
        ...
```

优先使用：

```text
代理调用
短时 Token
最小范围凭证
```

---

# 四十、Skill 签名

每个包需要：

```text
Package Hash
Publisher Key ID
Signature Algorithm
Signature
Signing Time
Provenance Reference
```

## Trust Root

```json
{
  "publisher": "vav-official",
  "key_id": "vav-release-2026-01",
  "algorithm": "ed25519",
  "status": "active",
  "valid_from": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

---

# 四十一、签名流程

```text
验证源码状态
→ 运行测试
→ 锁定依赖
→ 构建确定性 Package
→ 生成 SBOM
→ 生成 Provenance
→ 计算 Hash
→ 使用发布密钥签名
→ 上传 Registry
→ Registry 再验证
```

CLI：

```bash
vav skill build
vav skill sbom
vav skill sign --key-ref release-key
vav skill verify-signature
vav skill publish
```

---

# 四十二、Provenance

记录：

```text
源码仓库
Commit
构建工作流
构建环境
依赖 Lock Hash
测试结果
SBOM Hash
Package Hash
发布者
签名 Key
```

不能将 CI Secret 写入 Provenance。

---

# 四十三、签名撤销

```sql
CREATE TABLE skill_signature_revocations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    publisher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    key_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    package_checksum VARCHAR(128),

    reason_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    reason_encrypted TEXT,

    revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    revoked_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)
);
```

发生：

```text
发布密钥泄漏
恶意包
供应链污染
严重安全缺陷
```

时可撤销。

运行时发现撤销包：

```text
阻止新执行
进入 QUARANTINED
通知管理员
保留审计
按策略回滚
```

---

# 四十四、SBOM 与漏洞扫描

Skill Package 必须提供：

```text
Python Dependencies
Node Dependencies
Native Libraries
Base Image 边界
Licenses
```

扫描结果：

```python
class SkillSecurityStatus(StrEnum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    PASSED = "passed"
    PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS = "passed_with_warnings"
    FAILED = "failed"
    QUARANTINED = "quarantined"
    REVOKED = "revoked"
```

Critical 漏洞默认阻止公开发布和生产安装。

---

# 四十五、版本兼容

Skill 使用 SemVer：

```text
Major
破坏性契约变化

Minor
向后兼容能力增加

Patch
兼容修复
```

同时维护：

```text
Manifest Version
Runtime API Version
Input Schema Version
Output Schema Version
State Schema Version
```

---

# 四十六、Compatibility Matrix

```sql
CREATE TABLE skill_compatibility_records (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    skill_version_id UUID NOT NULL,

    platform_version_range VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    runtime_api_version_range VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    compatible BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

    test_report JSONB NOT NULL,

    verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

---

# 四十七、Breaking-change 检测

发布时自动比较：

```text
Manifest
Input Schema
Output Schema
Errors
Permissions
Capabilities
Dependencies
Configuration
Database Migrations
Events
```

以下变化强制 Major：

```text
新增高风险权限
删除输出字段
改变命令副作用
改变幂等语义
改变数据敏感等级
删除 Capability
```

新增权限即使技术上向后兼容，也必须重新审批安装。

---

# 四十八、Deprecation

```text
Active
→ Deprecated
→ End-of-support
→ Disabled for new installs
→ Revoked
```

发布者必须提供：

```text
替代版本
迁移说明
结束支持日期
风险说明
```

不能无预警删除仍在运行的 Skill。

---

# 四十九、Skill State Migration

有持久化状态的 Skill 必须声明：

```yaml
state:
  schemaVersion: 3
  migrations:
    - from: 1
      to: 2
      entrypoint: migrations.v1_to_v2:run
    - from: 2
      to: 3
      entrypoint: migrations.v2_to_v3:run
```

迁移必须：

```text
幂等
可 Dry Run
可备份
可验证
可暂停
有回滚策略
```

---

# 五十、插件机制

## Provider Adapter

```text
Embedding Provider
Email Provider
Payment Provider
Storage Provider
AI Model Provider
Moderation Provider
```

实现统一接口，不能改变核心领域规则。

## UI Extension

仅允许挂载到注册好的 Extension Point：

```text
admin.dashboard.widget
admin.entity.detail.tab
user.account.settings.card
skill.execution.result.renderer
```

禁止：

```text
覆盖登录页面
注入任意全局脚本
读取所有前端状态
绕过后端权限
```

---

# 五十一、UI Extension Manifest

```yaml
ui:
  extensions:
    - extensionPoint: admin.dashboard.widget
      component: ui/dist/SkillStatusWidget.js
      permissions:
        - skills.analytics.read
      sandbox: iframe
      contentSecurityPolicy:
        connectSrc:
          - self
```

第三方 UI 默认使用：

```text
Sandboxed iframe
受控 PostMessage
独立 CSP
签名静态资源
```

---

# 五十二、安装状态机

```python
class SkillInstallationStatus(StrEnum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    PLANNING = "planning"
    APPROVAL_REQUIRED = "approval_required"
    INSTALLING = "installing"
    VALIDATING = "validating"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    DISABLED = "disabled"
    UPGRADE_PENDING = "upgrade_pending"
    ROLLBACK_PENDING = "rollback_pending"
    FAILED = "failed"
    QUARANTINED = "quarantined"
    UNINSTALLING = "uninstalling"
    UNINSTALLED = "uninstalled"
```

---

# 五十三、Skill Installation

```sql
CREATE TABLE skill_installations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    registered_skill_id UUID NOT NULL,
    installed_version_id UUID NOT NULL,

    environment VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    configuration_encrypted JSONB NOT NULL,
    configuration_version INTEGER NOT NULL,

    granted_permissions JSONB NOT NULL,
    granted_capabilities JSONB NOT NULL,

    installed_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    installed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    activated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    previous_version_id UUID,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(registered_skill_id, environment)
);
```

---

# 五十四、Install Plan

```python
class SkillInstallPlan(BaseModel):
    target_skill: SkillVersionSummary

    dependency_actions: list[DependencyAction]
    permission_changes: list[PermissionChange]
    configuration_requirements: list[ConfigurationRequirement]

    database_migrations: list[MigrationSummary]
    scheduled_jobs: list[ScheduledJobSummary]
    event_subscriptions: list[EventSubscriptionSummary]
    ui_extensions: list[UiExtensionSummary]

    security_warnings: list[SecurityWarning]

    rollback_supported: bool
    approval_required: bool
```

---

# 五十五、安装流程

```text
选择 Skill Version
→ 验证签名
→ 验证安全状态
→ 解析依赖
→ 生成 Install Plan
→ 显示权限和配置
→ 审批
→ 备份必要状态
→ 安装依赖
→ 运行迁移
→ 注册事件和计划任务
→ 部署 Runtime
→ 健康检查
→ 激活
```

任一步失败：

```text
停止激活
→ 尝试回滚
→ 保留安装报告
→ 状态 FAILED
```

---

# 五十六、升级流程

```text
检查新版本
→ Compatibility Diff
→ Permission Diff
→ Schema Diff
→ Migration Dry Run
→ Upgrade Plan
→ 审批
→ Canary Installation
→ Contract Tests
→ 健康检查
→ 切换版本
→ 观察期
→ 标记 Stable
```

生产升级不能直接覆盖正在运行版本而无回退点。

---

# 五十七、回滚

回滚要求：

```text
旧 Package 仍可获取
旧配置仍可解释
状态 Schema 可兼容
数据库变化可 Forward-compatible
```

若数据迁移不可逆：

```text
禁止自动回滚
→ 需要 Forward Fix
或从安装前备份恢复
```

---

# 五十八、卸载

卸载前显示：

```text
哪些工作流依赖该 Skill
哪些事件订阅会停止
哪些数据由 Skill 创建
哪些配置和 Secret 会删除
哪些数据按政策保留
是否可重新安装恢复
```

卸载不能默认删除：

```text
财务记录
审计记录
用户拥有的数据
安全证据
法定保留数据
```

# 七十三、Marketplace 审核

## 自动审核

```text
Manifest
Schema
依赖
许可证
签名
SBOM
漏洞
Secret
恶意代码模式
网络目的地
权限
兼容性
测试报告
```

## 人工审核

```text
功能说明是否真实
权限是否与功能匹配
用户数据用途是否清晰
是否存在误导性营销
是否绕过安全或隐私
是否有合理支持政策
是否有卸载和数据处理说明
```

# 七十四、禁止 Marketplace 内容

```text
绕过平台权限
批量抓取私人婚恋资料
推断敏感特征
未经同意的人脸识别
跨站身份搜索
账号接管
恶意监控
间谍软件
任意代码执行
凭证窃取
支付绕过
举报者身份泄漏
绕过屏蔽
骚扰自动化
诈骗辅助
```

---

# 七十五、数据使用披露

Listing 必须说明：

```text
读取哪些数据
写入哪些数据
发送到哪些外部 Provider
保存多久
如何删除
是否用于模型训练
是否进行自动决策
```

未披露的外部数据传输属于严重违规。

---

# 七十六、Marketplace 定价边界

可预留：

```python
class MarketplacePricingModel(StrEnum):
    FREE = "free"
    ONE_TIME = "one_time"
    SUBSCRIPTION = "subscription"
    USAGE_BASED = "usage_based"
    PRIVATE_CONTRACT = "private_contract"
```

第一版可仅实现：

```text
Free
Private Contract
```

先完成安全和治理，再开放自动收费。

Marketplace 收费不能使用 Skill 绕过 Batch 4 和 Batch 5 的商品、订单和支付系统。

---

# 七十七、评分与评价

评价仅来自：

```text
已安装组织
有足够执行历史的用户
```

评价不能泄露：

```text
用户输入
敏感执行结果
内部配置
```

质量信号：

```text
安装成功率
执行成功率
兼容性
安全事件
支持响应
文档完整度
```

不能把安装数量等同于安全或质量保证。

---

# 七十八、Marketplace 违规处置

```text
警告
要求修复
暂停新安装
暂停执行
隔离
撤下 Listing
撤销版本
暂停发布者
撤销签名 Key
```

高风险恶意包：

```text
立即 Quarantine
→ 阻止执行
→ 通知所有安装组织
→ 提供安全升级或卸载路径
→ 创建供应链事件
```

---

# 七十九、发布者申诉

发布者可以针对：

```text
Listing 拒绝
版本撤回
发布者暂停
```

提出申诉。

申诉不能要求：

```text
查看其他发布者私有包
查看安全检测的全部规避细节
绕过恶意代码规则
```

# 八十四、环境变量

```dotenv
# Skill platform
SKILLS_ENABLED=true
SKILL_RUNTIME_API_VERSION=1.0
SKILL_MANIFEST_VERSION=1.0

# Registry
SKILL_REGISTRY_MODE=private
SKILL_REGISTRY_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE=true
SKILL_REGISTRY_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED=false

# Runtime
SKILL_RUNTIME_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=30
SKILL_RUNTIME_MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=900
SKILL_RUNTIME_MAX_RETRIES=3
SKILL_RUNTIME_MAX_CONCURRENT_EXECUTIONS=100

# Sandbox
SKILL_SANDBOX_ENABLED=true
SKILL_SANDBOX_NETWORK_DEFAULT=deny
SKILL_SANDBOX_MEMORY_MB=512
SKILL_SANDBOX_CPU_LIMIT=1
SKILL_SANDBOX_MAX_OUTPUT_MB=10

# Permissions
SKILL_HIGH_RISK_PERMISSION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED=true
SKILL_DYNAMIC_PERMISSION_ESCALATION_DISABLED=true

# Signing
SKILL_SIGNATURE_ALGORITHM=ed25519
SKILL_TRUST_ROOTS_PATH=registry/trust-roots.json
SKILL_REVOCATION_LIST_PATH=registry/revoked-signatures.json

# Security
SKILL_SBOM_REQUIRED=true
SKILL_VULNERABILITY_SCAN_REQUIRED=true
SKILL_CRITICAL_VULNERABILITY_BLOCK=true
SKILL_SECRET_SCAN_REQUIRED=true

# Marketplace
SKILL_MARKETPLACE_ENABLED=true
SKILL_MARKETPLACE_PUBLIC_INSTALLS_ENABLED=false
SKILL_MARKETPLACE_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED=true
SKILL_MARKETPLACE_AUTOMATED_PRICING_ENABLED=false
```

生产初期建议：

```text
Private Registry
Official/Organization Skills
Public Marketplace 浏览
Public Marketplace 自动安装关闭
```

# 八十五、Makefile

```makefile
skill-sdk-test:
	pytest packages/skill-sdk-python/tests -q
	pnpm --filter skill-sdk-typescript test

skill-schema-test:
	python scripts/skill/validate_all_schemas.py

skill-runtime-test:
	pytest tests/skill-runtime -q

skill-registry-test:
	pytest tests/skill-registry -q

skill-security-test:
	pytest tests/skill-security -q

skill-marketplace-test:
	pytest tests/skill-marketplace -q

skill-complete-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test tests/skill-complete-e2e

skill-sign-fixtures:
	./scripts/signing/sign-fixtures.sh

skill-verify:
	$(MAKE) skill-sdk-test
	$(MAKE) skill-schema-test
	$(MAKE) skill-runtime-test
	$(MAKE) skill-registry-test
	$(MAKE) skill-security-test
	$(MAKE) skill-marketplace-test
	$(MAKE) skill-complete-e2e

final-release:
	$(MAKE) acceptance
	$(MAKE) skill-verify
	$(MAKE) final-certification
```

# 九十七、Batch 20 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-20/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-20-skill-platform
description: Implement the VAV Skill SDK, runtime, registry, schemas, dependencies, permissions, signing, compatibility, plugin lifecycle, CLI, APIs, IDE integration, Web console, Marketplace governance and final certification.
---

# Goal

Build the final VAV extensibility and developer platform containing:

- a canonical Skill specification;
- Python and TypeScript Skill SDKs;
- strict input, output, error and configuration schemas;
- code generation;
- Skill manifests;
- deterministic Skill packages;
- runtime discovery and version resolution;
- dependency graphs;
- typed execution contexts;
- timeout, cancellation and idempotency;
- permission and capability enforcement;
- isolated third-party execution;
- restricted network and secret access;
- digital signatures;
- provenance and SBOMs;
- version compatibility;
- state migrations;
- installation, upgrade, rollback and uninstall;
- a Skill CLI;
- Registry, Installation and Execution APIs;
- IDE integration;
- a Web-based Skill console;
- private and public Marketplace boundaries;
- publisher verification;
- automated and human reviews;
- Marketplace enforcement and appeals;
- security red-team tests;
- final project and Skill certification.

# Source and product boundary

The original project plan requires a modular, maintainable, testable and
deployable platform with unified APIs and administration.

It does not explicitly define a Skill Marketplace or plugin SDK. This batch
is the proposed productization layer built on top of the completed platform.
It must not weaken any business, privacy, payment, safety or authorization
boundary established by Batches 1 through 19.

# Prerequisites

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Read `release-manifest.yaml`.
3. Verify Batch 1 through Batch 19.
4. Run `make acceptance`.
5. Read every skill under `skills/batch-20`.
6. Inspect module manifests, permission registries, event manifests and
   provider interfaces.
7. Produce `docs/architecture/skill-platform.md`.
8. Produce `docs/security/skill-sandbox.md`.
9. Produce `docs/security/skill-supply-chain.md`.
10. Produce `docs/marketplace/governance.md`.
11. Record unresolved public-Marketplace, billing, publisher-verification and
    third-party-code policies in the decision register.

# Required implementation order

1. Canonical Skill specification.
2. Manifest JSON Schema.
3. Input, output, error and configuration contracts.
4. Python SDK.
5. TypeScript SDK.
6. Skill Test Kit.
7. Deterministic package builder.
8. Runtime execution service.
9. Timeout, cancellation and idempotency.
10. Skill Registry.
11. Dependency graph and resolver.
12. Permission and capability engine.
13. Sandbox runtimes.
14. Secret Broker and egress policy.
15. Signing, provenance and SBOM.
16. Compatibility and migration framework.
17. Installation, upgrade and rollback.
18. CLI.
19. Registry, Installation and Execution APIs.
20. IDE extension.
21. Web Skill console.
22. Publisher and Marketplace models.
23. Automated Marketplace review.
24. Human Marketplace review.
25. Enforcement, revocation and appeals.
26. Security and supply-chain red team.
27. Final project certification.

# Architecture constraints

- Skills are capability units, not arbitrary executable scripts.
- Every Skill has an immutable versioned manifest.
- Every Skill has strict input and output schemas.
- Skills do not directly access business databases.
- Skills call approved domain services and Gateways.
- Third-party code does not execute inside the primary API process.
- Permissions are denied by default.
- Network, filesystem and Secret access are denied by default.
- Runtime versions and Skill versions remain independently explicit.
- Skill failure must not corrupt core platform services.

# Manifest invariants

- Skill names are globally unique within a Registry.
- Skill versions use Semantic Versioning.
- Inputs, outputs and errors have schemas.
- Permissions and capabilities are registered identifiers.
- Dependencies use explicit version ranges.
- Execution timeouts are finite.
- Side-effecting Skills declare idempotency.
- Network, filesystem and Secret requirements are explicit.
- Compatibility ranges are declared.
- Manifests contain no Secrets or arbitrary shell commands.

# Schema invariants

- Input and output data is validated at runtime.
- Unknown fields are rejected unless explicitly allowed.
- Sensitive fields have classification annotations.
- Schema changes are compatibility checked.
- Breaking schema changes require a major version.
- Generated Python and TypeScript types derive from the same schemas.
- Generated code is not manually edited.

# Runtime invariants

- Every execution resolves one concrete Skill version.
- Permission checks occur before execution.
- Input validation occurs before execution.
- Output validation occurs before delivery.
- Deadlines and cancellation propagate.
- Side-effecting calls use idempotency.
- Runtime errors return safe error contracts.
- Execution traces identify Skill, installation and version.
- Third-party Skills use isolated runtimes.
- Revoked Skills cannot begin new executions.

# Dependency invariants

- Dependency resolution is deterministic.
- Cyclic Skill dependencies are rejected.
- Missing required capabilities block activation.
- Conflicting version ranges block installation.
- Optional and peer dependencies are explicit.
- Upgrade plans include transitive impact.
- Revoked dependencies make affected installations unhealthy.

# Permission invariants

- Effective permissions are intersections, not unions.
- Skills cannot elevate caller permissions.
- Installation permission and user action confirmation remain separate.
- New permissions in upgrades require review.
- Agent calls never inherit administrator permissions.
- High-risk permissions require explicit approval.
- Permission decisions are audited.

# Sandbox invariants

- Third-party Skills run with resource limits.
- Network egress uses allowlists.
- Internal network and metadata services are blocked.
- Host filesystems and Docker sockets are inaccessible.
- Secrets are obtained through a scoped Broker.
- Sandbox time and output size are limited.
- Sandbox failure cannot crash the core API.

# Supply-chain invariants

- Production packages require signatures.
- Packages include SBOMs and provenance.
- Package hashes are verified before installation.
- Modified packages fail verification.
- Revoked keys and packages cannot execute.
- Critical vulnerabilities block publication by default.
- Secret-scan failures block builds.
- Malicious packages are quarantined.
- Signing keys are rotatable and revocable.

# Version invariants

- Active Skill versions are immutable.
- Breaking changes require major versions.
- Permission expansion requires renewed approval.
- State migrations are explicit and idempotent.
- Upgrades support Dry Run and compatibility analysis.
- Incompatible upgrades cannot activate automatically.
- Rollback support is declared honestly.
- Deprecated versions provide migration guidance.

# Installation invariants

- Install plans show dependencies, permissions, configuration, migrations,
  jobs and event subscriptions.
- Dry Runs do not mutate state.
- High-risk installations require approval.
- Installations perform health validation before activation.
- Failed installations do not appear active.
- Upgrades use canary validation where required.
- Uninstall preserves required user, financial, safety and audit data.

# Marketplace invariants

- Publishers have verified identities and signing keys.
- Listings disclose data access and external processing.
- Unreviewed packages are not public.
- High-risk permissions require human review.
- Marketplace packages cannot bypass core security rules.
- Listing reviews do not modify submitted package contents.
- Malicious or unsafe packages can be suspended and revoked.
- Publishers can appeal enforcement.
- Appeals do not automatically restore unsafe packages.
- Marketplace billing, when enabled, uses Catalog and Commerce.

# Security invariants

- Skills cannot access another user's data without valid scope.
- Skills cannot invoke unregistered tools.
- Skills cannot access Secrets outside declared references.
- Skill logs, traces and metrics exclude sensitive data.
- Execution and installation caches include version and permission scope.
- Administrators cannot bypass signature or security gates without a
  separately audited emergency policy.
- Critical red-team failures block release.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make skill-sdk-test
make skill-schema-test
make skill-runtime-test
make skill-registry-test
make skill-security-test
make skill-marketplace-test
make skill-complete-e2e
make skill-verify
make final-release
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Developers can scaffold a Skill.
2. Manifests validate.
3. Schemas generate Python and TypeScript types.
4. Skill Test Kit works.
5. Skill packages build deterministically.
6. Runtime resolves concrete versions.
7. Runtime validates input and output.
8. Runtime enforces timeout, cancellation and idempotency.
9. Dependency graphs resolve.
10. Cycles and version conflicts are rejected.
11. Skills cannot elevate permissions.
12. Third-party Skills run in isolation.
13. Secret Broker and egress policies work.
14. Package signatures verify.
15. Tampered and revoked packages are rejected.
16. SBOM and provenance are generated.
17. Compatibility checks work.
18. Upgrade and rollback plans work.
19. CLI lifecycle commands work.
20. Registry and execution APIs work.
21. IDE schema and test features work.
22. Web Skill console works.
23. Publisher verification works.
24. Marketplace review works.
25. Unsafe listings can be suspended.
26. Publisher appeals work.
27. Security red-team gates pass.
28. `make skill-verify` succeeds.
29. `make acceptance` still succeeds.
30. `make final-release` succeeds.

# Failure policy

When a Skill requests an unresolved permission:

1. deny the permission;
2. keep the installation inactive;
3. record the unresolved request;
4. require platform-owner review;
5. do not infer that functional necessity implies authorization.

When package signature verification fails:

1. reject installation and execution;
2. quarantine the package;
3. preserve the package hash and evidence;
4. notify the Registry and publisher;
5. create a supply-chain incident.

When a dependency conflict is unresolved:

1. do not choose a version arbitrarily;
2. show the complete conflict path;
3. preserve the current active installation;
4. require a compatible release or explicit isolation;
5. rerun compatibility tests.

When an upgrade adds permissions:

1. stop automatic activation;
2. show the permission difference;
3. require renewed approval;
4. preserve the old active version;
5. activate only after approval and tests.

When sandbox isolation fails:

1. disable the affected runtime class;
2. quarantine affected Skills;
3. rotate exposed credentials;
4. create a critical security incident;
5. block final release;
6. rerun the complete sandbox red-team suite.

When a Marketplace package is malicious:

1. remove the listing;
2. revoke the affected version and signature where necessary;
3. stop new executions;
4. notify all installations;
5. provide rollback or uninstall guidance;
6. preserve evidence for review and appeal.
```

Batch 13-18
婚恋档案、推荐、互动、关系、会员、安全

Batch 19
生产装配与最终运行验收

Batch 20
Skill 产品化、扩展生态与最终发布
```

## Prompt:
各个页面UI友好布局合理，整体逻辑闭环，各个业务线的功能逻辑闭环，数据流完整性闭环，管理端各功能完整度，项目各个功能可用性，整体回归测试高可用，一定并发量，安全性，这些要确保。还需要哪些skills,请分批列给我

## Response:
# 还需要追加 12 个“质量闭环 Batch”

现有 Batch 1-20 已覆盖业务能力、生产部署和 Skill 平台，但**功能存在并不等于质量已得到保证**。计划书要求完整业务流程能够验收、管理端可运营、敏感流程不存在重大安全问题，并具备部署、测试、文档与运行保障。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

要真正确保：

```text
页面友好
布局合理
业务闭环
数据闭环
管理端完整
功能真实可用
回归稳定
支持并发
安全可靠
高可用
```

建议追加 **Batch 21-32**。这些不是继续堆业务功能，而是建立独立、可量化、可阻断发布的质量保障体系。

---

# 总体对应关系

| 需要确保的内容 | 对应 Batch |
|---|---|
| 页面 UI、布局、交互一致性 | Batch 22 |
| 页面间路径、用户旅程完整 | Batch 23 |
| 各业务线功能逻辑闭环 | Batch 24 |
| 数据流与状态一致性闭环 | Batch 25 |
| 管理端功能完整度 | Batch 26 |
| 项目功能真实可用性 | Batch 27 |
| 全量自动回归稳定性 | Batch 28 |
| 并发量、性能和容量 | Batch 29 |
| 安全、隐私、AI 与供应链安全 | Batch 30 |
| 高可用、故障恢复、灾备 | Batch 31 |
| 需求追踪和质量门禁 | Batch 21 |
| 最终生产认证 | Batch 32 |

所有 Batch 都必须进入：

```bash
make verify-all
make production-readiness
make final-certification
```

任一阻断级检查失败，不得发布。

屏蔽绕过
联系方式越权
隐私删除严重遗漏
数据库无法恢复
关键业务状态无法修复
Critical 安全漏洞
```

## Go/No-Go 输入

```text
需求追踪报告
UI 视觉与可访问性报告
业务闭环报告
数据对账报告
管理端完整度报告
UAT 签字
自动回归报告
性能容量报告
渗透测试报告
红队报告
备份恢复演练报告
灾难恢复报告
回滚演练报告
```

## 上线后稳定性观察

建议设置：

```text
24 小时
7 天
30 天
```

观察：

```text
错误率
队列积压
支付对账差异
权限拒绝异常
数据一致性异常
用户投诉
安全案件
性能回归
备份状态
```

30 天观察通过后，才标记：

```text
PRODUCTION_STABLE
```

# 三、核心质量原则

## 3.1 实现不等于完成

一个功能只有在以下项目全部具备时，才算完成：

```text
需求明确
→ 用户或管理员有入口
→ 后端 API 可用
→ 业务规则完整
→ 数据状态可持久化
→ 领域事件完整
→ 权限正确
→ 异常路径可处理
→ 日志、指标、审计存在
→ 自动测试通过
→ 真实验收证据存在
```

## 3.2 页面存在不等于功能可用

不能将以下情况标记为完成：

```text
页面只有静态按钮
按钮调用 Mock API
成功提示但数据没有改变
数据改变但刷新后丢失
用户操作完成但管理端无法处理
异常时只能联系开发人员改数据库
```

## 3.3 业务闭环必须有最终状态

每条业务必须有：

```text
开始入口
处理中状态
成功终态
失败终态
取消终态
过期终态
人工处理状态
恢复或补偿路径
用户可见状态
管理员可处理状态
```

## 3.4 关键失败不能被总分掩盖

即使项目完整度达到 95 分，只要存在以下任一项，仍然不得发布：

```text
跨用户数据泄漏
屏蔽绕过
联系方式越权
支付未确认即开通权益
关键数据无法恢复
用户删除严重遗漏
关键业务状态无法修复
Critical 安全漏洞
```

# 六、Skill 21.1：`vav-product-quality-constitution`

## 目标

建立所有团队共同遵循的质量宪章。

保存为：

```text
docs/quality/quality-constitution.md
quality-manifest.yaml
```

## 6.1 质量维度

```yaml
quality_dimensions:
  functional_correctness:
    description: 功能是否按照需求正确运行
    critical: true

  business_closure:
    description: 业务是否具有完整生命周期和异常路径
    critical: true

  data_integrity:
    description: 跨模块数据是否一致、可恢复、可追踪
    critical: true

  usability:
    description: 用户是否能够理解并完成任务
    critical: false

  admin_operability:
    description: 运营和支持人员能否管理完整业务
    critical: true

  security_privacy:
    description: 权限、隐私、安全和数据保护
    critical: true

  performance:
    description: 在目标负载下正确运行
    critical: true

  resilience:
    description: 故障时能否降级和恢复
    critical: true

  observability:
    description: 是否能够发现、定位和处理问题
    critical: true
```

```text
需求 ID

前置条件

代码
迁移
API

权限
审计
指标

文档
验收证据

    node_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    version VARCHAR(64),
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(node_type, node_code, version)
);
```

## 12.3 关系表

```sql
CREATE TABLE quality_trace_links (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

        source_node_id,
        target_node_id,
        relationship_type
    )
);

# 十三、标准追踪链

关键业务需求必须形成：

```text
Requirement
→ Capability
→ Business Flow
→ Page/API
→ Application Service
→ Domain State Machine
→ Database
→ Event
→ Permission
→ Metric
→ Test
→ Evidence
```

任何关键节点缺失都生成 Gap。

## 反向查询

必须能够回答：

```text
修改这个数据库表影响哪些需求？
这个 API 被哪些页面调用？
这个事件有哪些消费者？
这个权限保护哪些用户能力？
这个测试验证哪些需求？
这个发布门禁由哪些证据支持？
```

# 十五、孤立项检测

## 孤立页面

```text
存在 Route
但没有导航入口、业务跳转或深层链接
```

## 孤立 API

```text
存在生产 API
但没有调用者、事件消费者或明确内部用途
```

## 孤立数据库表

```text
存在表
但没有 Repository、保留策略或数据所有者
```

## 孤立事件

```text
事件已发布
但没有消费者或明确审计用途
```

## 孤立权限

```text
权限已注册
但没有任何路由或服务引用
```

# 二十、关键异常矩阵

## Commerce

```text
支付页面返回成功但 Webhook 未到
重复 Webhook
Webhook 乱序
支付成功但权益激活失败
退款成功但权益撤销失败
```

## Matchmaking

```text
喜欢与屏蔽并发
双方同时喜欢
邀请接受与取消并发
邀请接受与过期并发
联系方式查看与撤回并发
关系恢复与结束并发
```

## Membership

```text
续费与取消并发
升级与续费并发
最后一个配额并发消费
订阅 Active 但 Entitlement 无效
```

## Privacy

```text
删除申请与订单退款冲突
删除任务部分失败
导出任务部分失败
Legal Hold 与自动删除并发
```

## Safety

```text
屏蔽传播部分失败
限制到期与人工解除并发
申诉推翻与限制执行并发
```

# 二十一、覆盖规则

对于 Blocker/Critical 需求：

```text
成功路径测试必须存在
至少一个业务失败路径测试
至少一个权限失败测试
至少一个重复/幂等测试
涉及共享状态时必须有并发测试
涉及外部 Provider 时必须有超时测试
涉及敏感数据时必须有隐私测试
```

# 二十六、Gate 条件 DSL

只允许受控条件：

```yaml
condition:
  metric: blocker_requirement_trace_coverage
  operator: eq
  expected: 1.0
```

支持：

```text
eq
neq
gt
gte
lt
lte
contains
all_passed
none_open
```

不允许：

```text
任意 Python
任意 SQL
任意 Shell
```

---

# 二十七、发布判定

```python
class ReleaseQualityDecision(StrEnum):
    GO = "go"
    CONDITIONAL_GO = "conditional_go"
    NO_GO = "no_go"
```

判定规则：

```text
任一 Blocker Gate FAILED
→ NO_GO

无 Blocker 失败，但 Required Gate 有有效 Waiver
→ CONDITIONAL_GO

所有 Blocker 和 Required Gate 通过
→ GO
```

生产正式发布默认不接受 `CONDITIONAL_GO`，除非发布治理政策明确批准。

```text

├── manifest.json

├── tests/

Manifest：

```json
{
  "release_version": "2026.08.0-rc.1",

# 三十、中间完整度评分

Batch 21 提供的是**结构完整度评分**，不替代 Batch 32 的最终生产认证。

建议：

| 维度 | 权重 |
|---|---:|
| 需求追踪覆盖 | 20 |
| 能力实现映射 | 15 |
| 业务闭环 | 20 |
| 异常路径 | 15 |
| 管理端支持 | 10 |
| 测试和证据 | 15 |
| 负责人和文档 | 5 |

## 计算限制

以下情况不计分：

```text
只有声明，没有可验证 Artifact
只有测试名称，没有测试结果
只有页面截图，没有后端状态证据
只有 API，但没有权限和异常行为
```

## 一票否决

即使结构分数高于阈值，只要 Blocker Gate 失败仍然为 `NO_GO`。

```text
每个 Blocker 需求有唯一编号
每个需求有来源和负责人
需求可以关联多个能力
每个 Critical 能力关联测试
每个需求可以反向查找实现
未实现需求被自动识别
实现但未验证的需求不标记 Verified
被 Superseded 的需求保留历史
新 Release 不复用过期证据

每个核心页面有路由

每个写按钮有关联 Command API
每个 API 有权限或明确公共属性
每个写 API 有错误契约
高风险写 API 有审计
孤立页面被识别
孤立 API 被识别
Mock-only 页面被识别

```text
每条 Critical 业务流有开始状态
每条 Critical 业务流有成功终态
每条 Critical 业务流有失败终态
取消和过期路径已定义
跨模块失败有补偿或人工处理
用户能够查询当前状态

流程事件和通知完整

# 四十九、必须通过的 Gap 检测场景

```text
缺少测试的 Critical 需求被发现
缺少权限的敏感 API 被发现
缺少管理端的异常处理被发现
缺少指标的异步任务被发现
没有消费者的关键事件被发现
没有保留策略的数据表被发现
没有 Inbox 去重的消费者被发现
没有审计的管理员操作被发现
```

# 五十、必须通过的 Waiver 场景

```text
普通 Gap 可以申请 Waiver
Waiver 有明确范围和期限
Waiver 到期自动失效
请求者不能批准自己申请
Blocker 安全问题不能 Waive
屏蔽绕过不能 Waive
支付未确认开通不能 Waive
Waiver 失效后 Gate 重新失败
```

---

# 五十一、必须通过的发布门禁场景

```text
所有 Blocker Gate 通过时允许 GO
任一 Blocker Gate 失败时 NO_GO
Required Gate 有合法 Waiver 时可 Conditional Go
过期证据不能使 Gate 通过
不同 Release 的证据不能混用
Gate DSL 不能执行代码
Gate 结果可重现
Gate 执行有审计
```

# 五十二、Batch 21 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-21/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-21-quality-governance-traceability
description: Implement the VAV quality constitution, requirement registry, capability inventory, traceability graph, business-closure matrix, quality gaps, evidence, risks, waivers and release gates.
---

# Goal

Build the platform-wide quality control plane containing:

- a product-quality constitution;
- Definition of Ready and Definition of Done;
- versioned requirement registration;
- capability inventories;
- bidirectional requirement traceability;
- page, API, service, data, event, permission and test mappings;
- complete business-flow matrices;
- exception-path coverage;
- orphan and gap detection;
- quality risks;
- controlled and expiring waivers;
- quality evidence;
- release-gate definitions;
- reproducible gate executions;
- release Go, Conditional-Go and No-Go decisions;
- a quality administration center;
- automated quality checks and release reports.

# Product boundary

This batch does not replace business, UI, performance, security or
resilience testing.

It registers their requirements and evidence, detects missing coverage and
prevents release when critical quality conditions are not met.

# Prerequisites

1. Read the project plan and `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Read `release-manifest.yaml`.
3. Verify Batches 1 through 20.
4. Run `make acceptance`.
5. Run `make skill-verify`.
6. Inspect module manifests, routes, OpenAPI, migrations, permissions,
   events, metrics and test reports.
7. Produce `docs/quality/quality-constitution.md`.
8. Produce `docs/quality/requirement-taxonomy.md`.
9. Produce `docs/quality/business-closure-matrix.md`.
10. Produce `docs/quality/release-gates.md`.

# Required implementation order

1. Quality constitution.
2. Requirement taxonomy and registry.
3. Capability registry.
4. Artifact node registry.
5. Traceability relationships.
6. Route, API, permission, event and test scanners.
7. Business-flow registry.
8. Exception-scenario registry.
9. Gap and orphan detection.
10. Quality-risk registry.
11. Waiver workflows.
12. Evidence registry.
13. Release-gate definitions.
14. Gate execution engine.
15. Release-quality reports.
16. Quality administration pages.
17. Unit, integration, security, gate and E2E tests.

# Requirement invariants

- Every requirement has a stable identifier.
- Every requirement has a source.
- Source-derived requirements and proposed engineering requirements remain
  distinguishable.
- Every critical requirement has an owner.
- Implemented and verified are separate states.
- Requirements are versioned rather than overwritten.
- Superseded requirements preserve history.
- Blocker requirements require full verification.

# Traceability invariants

- Critical requirements trace to capabilities.
- Critical capabilities trace to implementation artifacts.
- Write capabilities trace to permissions and audit.
- Async capabilities trace to events, workers, retries and metrics.
- Every critical requirement traces to tests and evidence.
- Traceability is queryable in both directions.
- Orphan pages, APIs, events and permissions are detected.
- Trace links carry versions.

# Business-closure invariants

- Critical flows declare starts and final states.
- Success, failure, cancellation and expiry paths are explicit.
- Cross-module failures declare compensation or manual intervention.
- User-visible and administrator-visible states are defined.
- Unrecoverable critical intermediate states are release blockers.
- Business-flow closure is supported by executable tests.

# Exception invariants

- Critical flows include business-failure tests.
- Sensitive operations include authorization and privacy tests.
- Shared-state operations include concurrency tests.
- Provider-dependent operations include timeout and retry tests.
- Duplicate requests include idempotency tests.
- Security restrictions include invalidation tests.

# Gap invariants

- Gaps are generated from deterministic rules.
- Gaps have severity and ownership.
- Gap closure requires evidence.
- Deleting a gap record does not count as resolving it.
- Critical gaps block release unless explicitly classified as non-waivable
  engineering errors are fixed.
- Gap detection itself is tested.

# Waiver invariants

- Waivers have explicit scope.
- Waivers expire.
- Waivers require mitigation and ownership.
- Requesters do not approve their own waivers.
- Blocker privacy, safety, payment-integrity and recovery failures cannot be
  waived.
- Expired and revoked waivers no longer satisfy gates.

# Evidence invariants

- Evidence binds to a release and environment.
- Evidence has integrity checksums.
- Evidence has a validation status.
- Expired evidence cannot certify new releases.
- Test names without test results are not evidence.
- Screenshots alone do not prove backend-state correctness.
- Sensitive evidence requires restricted access.
- Evidence modification invalidates certification.

# Gate invariants

- Gate definitions are versioned.
- Gate conditions use a restricted declarative DSL.
- Blocker gate failures produce No-Go.
- Required gate failures require valid waivers or produce No-Go.
- Advisory gates never hide Blocker failures.
- Gate runs preserve inputs, outputs and evidence.
- Gate results are reproducible.
- Release certification is auditable.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make quality-migrate
make quality-seed
make quality-sync
make quality-manifest-check
make quality-trace-check
make quality-closure-check
make quality-gap-check
make quality-test
make quality-gate-test
make quality-security-test
make quality-admin-e2e
make quality-evidence-build
make quality-release-report
make quality-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. The quality constitution exists.
2. Requirements from the project plan are registered.
3. Requirements from Batches 1-20 are registered separately.
4. Every Blocker requirement has an owner.
5. Capability inventories exist.
6. Pages, APIs, services, data, events, permissions and tests are scanned.
7. Bidirectional traceability works.
8. Critical requirements have full trace paths.
9. Critical business flows have final states.
10. Critical exception scenarios are registered.
11. Orphan pages and APIs are detected.
12. Missing admin capabilities are detected.
13. Missing permissions and audit are detected.
14. Quality risks can be managed.
15. Waivers expire and use separation of duties.
16. Non-waivable failures cannot be waived.
17. Evidence binds to releases.
18. Evidence integrity is verified.
19. Release gates execute reproducibly.
20. Blocker gate failures produce No-Go.
21. Quality administration E2E tests pass.
22. Quality security tests pass.
23. `make quality-verify` succeeds.
24. `make acceptance` still succeeds.
25. `make skill-verify` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When a requirement cannot be traced:

1. mark it unverified;
2. create a quality gap;
3. assign an owner;
4. block critical release certification;
5. do not infer implementation from similarly named files.

When a business flow lacks a final or recovery state:

1. mark the flow incomplete;
2. identify the stuck state;
3. define compensation or manual intervention;
4. add executable tests;
5. block release for critical flows.

When evidence integrity fails:

1. reject the evidence;
2. invalidate affected gate results;
3. preserve the failed checksum record;
4. regenerate evidence from the authoritative source;
5. rerun release gates.

When a non-waivable gate fails:

1. produce No-Go;
2. prohibit waiver creation;
3. preserve the gate evidence;
4. assign remediation ownership;
5. rerun the gate after correction.

When the quality scanner produces a false result:

1. preserve the scanner output;
2. correct the scanner or manifest;
3. add a regression fixture;
4. rerun the complete quality scan;
5. do not permanently suppress the rule without governance approval.
```

# 三、核心 UI 原则

## 3.1 用户端与管理端共享基础，不共享全部视觉密度

共享：

```text
Design Tokens
基础组件
可访问性规则
交互状态
错误表达
图标
国际化
视觉测试
```

用户端侧重：

```text
信任
清晰
低压力
易理解
内容可读性
情感安全
较低信息密度
```

管理端侧重：

```text
效率
高信息密度
筛选与批量处理
状态可追踪
异常诊断
权限和审计
```

不能把管理端高密度表格直接复制到用户端。

## 3.2 设计系统不覆盖业务语义

设计系统负责：

```text
按钮怎么显示
表单错误怎么表达
状态标签怎么布局
模态框怎么交互
```

业务模块负责：

```text
按钮是否允许点击
状态是否可转换
用户是否有权限
操作是否需要确认
```

前端组件不能自行推断业务权限。

## 3.3 颜色不是唯一信息通道

例如：

```text
红色 + 错误图标 + 错误文本
绿色 + 成功图标 + 成功文本
```

不能只用红色和绿色区分：

```text
通过/失败
启用/停用
已付款/未付款
高风险/低风险
```

## 3.4 关键操作必须有明确结果

用户执行写操作后必须获得：

```text
处理中
成功
部分成功
失败
重试
下一步
```

不能只关闭弹窗而没有任何反馈。

## 3.5 响应式不是缩小桌面页面

移动端必须重新组织：

```text
导航
操作顺序
表格
详情分组
底部操作
筛选器
长表单
```

# 六、Skill 22.1：`vav-design-language-tokens`

## 目标

建立版本化、机器可读、可自动生成的设计 Token。

## 6.1 Token 层级

```text
Primitive Token
→ Semantic Token
→ Component Token
```

示例：

```text
Primitive:
color.blue.600

Semantic:
color.action.primary

Component:
button.primary.background
```

业务组件不得直接使用：

```css
color: #1677ff;
```

应使用：

```css
color: var(--vav-color-action-primary);
```

## 6.2 Token Manifest

```yaml
apiVersion: design.vav.io/v1
kind: DesignTokenManifest

metadata:
  version: 1.0.0

tokens:
  primitive:
    source: src/primitive

  semantic:
    source: src/semantic

  component:
    source: src/component

outputs:
  - css
  - typescript
  - json
```

## 6.3 Primitive Tokens

```text
color
font-family
font-size
font-weight
line-height
spacing
radius
shadow
border-width
opacity
duration
easing
z-index
breakpoint
```

## 6.4 Semantic Color Tokens

```text
color.background.canvas
color.background.surface
color.background.subtle
color.background.inverse

color.text.primary
color.text.secondary
color.text.muted
color.text.inverse
color.text.link

color.border.default
color.border.strong
color.border.focus

color.action.primary
color.action.primary-hover
color.action.primary-active

color.status.info
color.status.success
color.status.warning
color.status.danger

color.data.neutral
color.data.positive
color.data.negative
```

## 6.5 敏感业务状态

以下状态必须拥有明确语义 Token：

```text
pending
review
approved
active
paused
expired
cancelled
restricted
suspended
high-risk
```

但状态组件还必须包含：

```text
图标
标签文本
可访问名称
```

---

# 七、字体与排版

## 7.1 字体层级

```text
display
heading-1
heading-2
heading-3
heading-4
body-large
body
body-small
label
caption
code
```

每个层级定义：

```text
font-size
line-height
font-weight
letter-spacing
responsive behavior
```

## 7.2 可读性规则

```text
正文不使用过低行高
长内容控制每行长度
表单 Label 不用 Placeholder 代替
按钮文字使用清晰动词
错误信息直接说明问题
```

避免：

```text
“操作失败”
```

优先：

```text
“预约时间已被占用，请选择其他时段。”
```

## 7.3 长文本与多语言

所有组件必须测试：

```text
中文
繁体中文
英文
长名称
长地址
长状态说明
无空格英文字符串
```

不得使用固定高度裁掉重要文本。

# 八、间距和尺寸系统

建议使用统一基础单位：

```text
2
4
8
12
16
20
24
32
40
48
64
```

语义间距：

```text
space.inline.xs
space.inline.sm
space.inline.md

space.stack.xs
space.stack.sm
space.stack.md
space.stack.lg

space.section
space.page
```

组件不得随意使用：

```css
margin-top: 17px;
```

除非存在明确例外并记录。
