# 九、Skill 22.2：`vav-theme-density-brand`

## 目标

实现主题、品牌、用户端/管理端密度及高对比度模式。

## 9.1 Theme

第一版支持：

```python
class UiTheme(StrEnum):
    LIGHT = "light"
    DARK = "dark"
    HIGH_CONTRAST = "high_contrast"
    SYSTEM = "system"
```

生产首发至少完整支持：

```text
Light
System
```

Dark 和 High Contrast 若未完成全部组件，不得在设置中暴露为正式选项。

## 9.2 Density

```python
class UiDensity(StrEnum):
    COMFORTABLE = "comfortable"
    COMPACT = "compact"
```

用户端默认：

```text
comfortable
```

管理端默认：

```text
compact
```

但 Compact 不能降低：

```text
可点击区域
键盘可操作性
错误可读性
```

## 9.3 品牌与业务状态分离

品牌主色不能同时承担：

```text
成功
危险
警告
审核中
```

这些状态必须使用独立语义色。

## 9.4 Theme Provider

```typescript
export interface ThemeContext {
  theme: "light" | "dark" | "high_contrast";
  density: "comfortable" | "compact";
  reducedMotion: boolean;
  locale: string;
}
```

# 十、Skill 22.3：`vav-layout-grid-application-shell`

## 目标

建立统一页面骨架、Grid、导航区域和页面模板。

## 10.1 User Application Shell

```text
Desktop
┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Global Header                            │
├──────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Optional Context Navigation              │
├──────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Main Content                             │
│                                          │
├──────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Footer                                   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

移动端：

```text
Top App Bar
Main Content
Optional Sticky Bottom Actions
Mobile Navigation
```

## 10.2 Admin Application Shell

```text
┌──────────────┬───────────────────────────┐
│ Sidebar      │ Top Bar                   │
│ Navigation   ├───────────────────────────┤
│              │ Breadcrumb / Context      │
│              ├───────────────────────────┤
│              │ Page Header               │
│              ├───────────────────────────┤
│              │ Main Workspace            │
└──────────────┴───────────────────────────┘
```

支持：

```text
Sidebar Expanded
Sidebar Collapsed
Mobile Drawer
Full-screen Review Mode
Split-pane Workbench
```

## 10.3 页面宽度

定义：

```text
layout.content.narrow
layout.content.reading
layout.content.standard
layout.content.wide
layout.content.full
```

示例用途：

```text
narrow
登录、重置密码

reading
文章、政策、课程内容

standard
用户资料、订单详情

wide
管理端列表、Dashboard

full
审核工作台、数据诊断
```

## 10.4 Grid

默认：

```text
Mobile: 4 columns
Tablet: 8 columns
Desktop: 12 columns
```

使用 CSS Grid，禁止用大量绝对定位构建业务页面。

```

# 十二、Page Header

统一结构：

```typescript
interface PageHeaderProps {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  status?: StatusDescriptor;
  breadcrumbs?: BreadcrumbItem[];
  primaryAction?: ActionDescriptor;
  secondaryActions?: ActionDescriptor[];
  metadata?: MetadataItem[];
}
```

规则：

```text
每页只有一个视觉主标题
主要操作最多一个
危险操作不作为默认 Primary Action
移动端操作折叠但必须可发现
```

---

# 十三、Skill 22.4：`vav-foundation-component-library`

## 目标

建立所有业务模块使用的统一基础组件。

## 13.1 Button

Variant：

```text
primary
secondary
tertiary
danger
ghost
link
```

状态：

```text
idle
hover
focus-visible
active
loading
disabled
```

规则：

```text
Loading 时保留原宽度
Loading 时阻止重复点击
Danger 操作需要清晰文案
图标按钮必须有可访问名称
```

## 13.2 Link

区分：

```text
内部导航
外部链接
文件下载
触发操作
```

触发操作不得伪装成普通链接。

## 13.3 Status Badge

```typescript
interface StatusDescriptor {
  code: string;
  tone:
    | "neutral"
    | "info"
    | "success"
    | "warning"
    | "danger";
  label: string;
  icon?: IconName;
  description?: string;
}
```

业务状态与 Tone 映射集中维护，不能由各页面自行决定。

## 13.4 Modal 与 Drawer

Modal 用于：

```text
短任务
明确确认
高风险操作
```

Drawer 用于：

```text
辅助详情
筛选器
非阻断编辑
```

不得在 Modal 中放入超长、多步骤复杂表单。

## 13.5 Toast 与 Alert

Toast：

```text
短期操作反馈
```

Alert：

```text
页面内持续重要信息
```

关键错误不能仅显示短时 Toast。

---

# 十四、图标系统

```text
ui-icons/
├── navigation
├── action
├── status
├── object
├── security
└── communication
```

每个图标包含：

```text
name
category
directionality
default aria behavior
mirrored in RTL boundary
deprecated aliases
```

纯装饰图标：

```text
aria-hidden=true
```

表达含义的图标：

```text
必须有文本或 accessible label
```

---

# 十五、Skill 22.5：`vav-form-validation-workflow`

## 目标

统一复杂表单、校验、草稿、提交、错误恢复和敏感字段交互。

## 15.1 Form Field

```typescript
interface FormFieldState {
  touched: boolean;
  dirty: boolean;
  validating: boolean;
  valid: boolean | null;
  errors: FieldError[];
  warnings: FieldWarning[];
}
```

## 15.2 表单状态

```python
class FormWorkflowStatus(StrEnum):
    PRISTINE = "pristine"
    EDITING = "editing"
    AUTOSAVING = "autosaving"
    SAVED = "saved"
    VALIDATING = "validating"
    INVALID = "invalid"
    SUBMITTING = "submitting"
    SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
    FAILED = "failed"
    CONFLICTED = "conflicted"
```

## 15.3 错误显示

同时支持：

```text
字段下方错误
页面顶部错误摘要
聚焦第一个错误字段
Screen Reader Live Announcement
```

错误必须：

```text
说明哪里错
说明如何修复
不泄露系统内部异常
```

## 15.4 异步校验

例如：

```text
邮箱是否已注册
优惠码是否有效
档案字段是否合法
预约时段是否仍可用
```

必须支持：

```text
debounce
cancel previous request
loading indicator
stale result rejection
```

## 15.5 Autosave

适用于：

```text
婚恋档案
辅导 Intake
课程作业
关系私人复盘
复杂后台配置
```

Autosave 必须：

```text
显示保存状态
处理版本冲突
页面离开前处理未保存修改
失败时保留本地输入
```

## 15.6 敏感字段

敏感字段应支持：

```text
掩码
按需显示
显示目的说明
隐私等级
谁可查看
是否进入 AI
```

---

# 十六、多步骤流程

统一 Stepper：

```text
当前步骤
已完成步骤
可返回步骤
不可跳过步骤
错误步骤
最终确认
```

适用于：

```text
建档
Checkout
活动报名
辅导预约
隐私导出
举报
Skill 安装
```

步骤变化不能仅依赖 URL 前端状态，重要进度必须后端持久化。

---

# 十七、确认对话框

高影响操作必须包含：

```text
操作对象
影响范围
是否可撤销
生效时间
后续结果
```

例如结束关系：

```text
结束将立即生效
不需要对方批准
未来关系提醒会停止
联系方式访问会按政策撤销
```

禁止使用模糊按钮：

```text
确定
确认
```

优先：

```text
结束认识
撤销联系方式
取消续费
删除照片
```

---

# 十八、Skill 22.6：`vav-data-display-admin-patterns`

## 目标

统一列表、表格、详情、时间线、审核和配置工作台。

## 18.1 Data Table

必须支持：

```text
排序
筛选
分页
列宽
固定列
行选择
批量操作
加载
空状态
错误状态
权限列隐藏
字段脱敏
导出边界
```

## 18.2 表格响应式

桌面：

```text
标准表格
```

窄屏：

```text
优先列保留
次要列折叠
行转卡片
操作进入菜单
```

禁止移动端直接出现不可操作的超宽表格。

## 18.3 批量操作

流程：

```text
选择对象
→ 选择操作
→ 预览影响
→ 权限检查
→ 二次确认
→ 执行
→ 显示逐项结果
```

不得只显示：

```text
“批量操作成功”
```

而不说明：

```text
成功多少
失败多少
为何失败
是否可以重试
```

## 18.4 Entity Detail

管理端详情页统一采用：

```text
Summary Header
Status
Primary Metadata
Tabs
Timeline
Related Entities
Audit
Actions
```

## 18.5 Timeline

事件条目包含：

```text
时间
操作者
事件类型
状态变化
安全摘要
相关对象
```

敏感正文不应默认展示。

## 18.6 Review Workbench

```text
Source Version
Target Version
Field Diff
Media Preview
Automated Signals
User-visible Reason
Internal Note
Decision Actions
Audit History
```

适用于：

```text
档案审核
照片审核
内容审核
安全案件
申诉
会员计划
Skill 发布
质量证据
```

---

# 十九、Dashboard 模式

每个 Dashboard 必须区分：

```text
状态指标
趋势指标
待处理任务
异常
快捷入口
```

不得只堆积数字卡片。

指标卡需提供：

```text
指标名称
当前值
统计周期
变化方向
定义说明
详情入口
```

统计为空时显示：

```text
暂无数据
```

不能显示误导性的 `0%`。

---

# 二十、Skill 22.7：`vav-interaction-page-states`

## 目标

统一所有组件和页面的状态行为。

## 20.1 Async Data State

```typescript
type AsyncDataState<T> =
  | { status: "idle" }
  | { status: "loading"; previousData?: T }
  | { status: "success"; data: T; stale?: boolean }
  | { status: "partial"; data: T; warnings: UiWarning[] }
  | { status: "error"; error: UiError; previousData?: T }
  | { status: "offline"; cachedData?: T };
```

## 20.2 Loading

使用：

```text
Skeleton
Progress Indicator
Button Spinner
Inline Spinner
```

避免：

```text
整个页面长期只显示空白 Spinner
布局加载后大幅跳动
```

## 20.3 Empty State 类型

```python
class EmptyStateType(StrEnum):
    FIRST_USE = "first_use"
    NO_DATA = "no_data"
    FILTERED_EMPTY = "filtered_empty"
    SEARCH_EMPTY = "search_empty"
    PERMISSION_LIMITED = "permission_limited"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
```

每种 Empty State 需要不同文案和动作。

例如：

```text
没有课程
≠
当前筛选条件没有课程
```

## 20.4 Error State

错误分类：

```text
Validation
Authorization
Not Found
Conflict
Rate Limit
Provider Failure
Network
Server
Maintenance
```

可恢复错误必须提供：

```text
重试
修改输入
返回
联系支持
查看状态
```

## 20.5 Partial Failure

例如管理 Dashboard：

```text
会员指标加载成功
通知指标加载失败
```

应展示可用部分并明确失败区块，不能让整个页面失败。

---

# 二十一、离线与网络不稳定

关键长表单需要：

```text
本地临时草稿
重新联网后提示
冲突处理
```

涉及支付、关系状态、安全操作时：

```text
不得离线假定成功
```

必须显示：

```text
尚未确认，请重新检查状态
```

---

# 二十二、权限和限制状态

统一组件：

```text
AccessDeniedState
FeatureUnavailableState
MembershipRequiredState
SafetyRestrictedState
ProfileReviewPendingState
ExpiredState
```

不同原因不能统一显示为：

```text
“无权限”
```

用户应知道安全范围内的下一步：

```text
升级会员
完成资料审核
等待审批
重新验证
提交申诉
联系支持
```

---

# 二十三、Skill 22.8：`vav-responsive-adaptive-layout`

## 目标

确保用户端和管理端在不同尺寸和输入设备下可操作。

## 23.1 Breakpoint Tokens

建议初始值：

```text
sm: 640px
md: 768px
lg: 1024px
xl: 1280px
2xl: 1536px
```

这些是工程默认值，保存在 Token 中，不散落在业务 CSS。

## 23.2 Viewport 测试矩阵

```text
360 × 800
390 × 844
768 × 1024
1024 × 768
1280 × 800
1440 × 900
1920 × 1080
```

## 23.3 Mobile Navigation

用户端可采用：

```text
Top Bar
Bottom Navigation
More Menu
```

底部导航只放最高频入口，不能放全部模块。

管理端移动端：

```text
Drawer Navigation
Compact Page Header
Filter Drawer
Card-based Table Rows
```

## 23.4 Sticky Actions

长表单移动端可以使用：

```text
Sticky Bottom Action Bar
```

必须处理：

```text
安全区
键盘弹出
滚动遮挡
错误提示
```

## 23.5 Filter 响应式

桌面：

```text
Inline Filter Bar
```

移动端：

```text
Filter Button
→ Drawer
→ Active Filter Summary
```

## 23.6 Detail 响应式

桌面双栏：

```text
主内容 + 侧栏
```

移动端：

```text
主内容
→ 元数据折叠
→ 相关操作
```

---

# 二十四、容器查询

业务组件优先基于组件容器适配，而不只依赖全局 Viewport。

例如同一个卡片在：

```text
Dashboard 主区
侧栏
Modal
```

中应根据容器宽度调整。

---

# 二十五、极端内容测试

响应式测试必须包含：

```text
超长姓名
超长课程标题
超长组织名称
长邮箱
长错误消息
10 个状态标签
无图片
超大图片
100 个表格字段
多语言
200% Zoom
```

---

# 二十六、Skill 22.9：`vav-accessibility-compliance`

## 目标

以项目规定的无障碍质量基线实施键盘、语义、对比度和辅助技术支持。

建议项目目标：

```text
WCAG 2.2 AA 级工程验收基线
```

该目标应作为本项目质量政策，不表示自动测试可以完全替代人工无障碍评审。

## 26.1 键盘

所有主要操作必须支持：

```text
Tab
Shift+Tab
Enter
Space
Escape
Arrow Keys
Home/End 边界
```

不得存在：

```text
鼠标才能展开
Hover 才能看到关键操作
键盘无法关闭弹窗
Focus 陷入页面
```

## 26.2 Focus

必须具备：

```text
清晰 Focus Ring
Modal 打开后 Focus 进入
Modal 关闭后 Focus 返回触发元素
路由变化后 Focus 到页面标题或主内容
错误提交后 Focus 到错误摘要
```

## 26.3 页面 Landmark

```text
header
nav
main
aside
footer
```

每页只能有一个主要 `main`。

## 26.4 表单

```text
Label 与 Input 绑定
Required 可被辅助技术识别
Error 与字段关联
Help Text 与字段关联
```

Placeholder 不能代替 Label。

## 26.5 Live Region

用于：

```text
表单提交结果
异步校验
批量操作完成
上传进度
推荐批次更新
```

不得把频繁变化的装饰性数字放入 Live Region。

## 26.6 对比度

自动检查：

```text
正文
次要文字
按钮
边框
Focus Ring
状态组件
图表
```

禁用状态也必须保持可辨认，但不应看起来可操作。

## 26.7 Reduced Motion

用户启用减少动效时：

```text
关闭非必要位移动画
关闭自动滚动动画
缩短过渡
保留必要状态变化
```

## 26.8 Zoom 与 Reflow

必须验证：

```text
200% Zoom
400% Text Reflow 边界
```

核心操作不能因为放大而消失。

---

# 二十七、可访问性组件

提供：

```text
VisuallyHidden
SkipLink
FocusTrap
FocusReturn
LiveRegion
AccessibleDialog
AccessibleMenu
AccessibleTabs
AccessibleTooltip
AccessibleDataTable
ErrorSummary
```

业务模块不应重复实现 Focus Trap。

---

# 二十八、无障碍人工评审

自动检查之外，关键流程必须人工验证：

```text
键盘完整完成
屏幕阅读器主要路径
Focus 顺序
错误理解
状态变化通知
复杂表格
拖拽替代操作
```

关键旅程：

```text
注册
Checkout
活动报名
婚恋建档
举报和屏蔽
关系结束
会员取消
隐私删除
```

---

# 二十九、Skill 22.10：`vav-storybook-component-documentation`

## 目标

让设计系统成为可浏览、可测试、可复用的产品，而不是散落组件集合。

## 29.1 Story 分类

```text
Foundations
├── Colors
├── Typography
├── Spacing
├── Icons
├── Motion
└── Layout

Components
├── Inputs
├── Navigation
├── Feedback
├── Data Display
├── Overlay
└── Forms

Patterns
├── Page Header
├── Filter Bar
├── Review Workbench
├── Timeline
├── Empty State
└── Error State

Pages
├── User Web
├── Admin Web
└── Skill Console
```

## 29.2 每个组件 Story

必须包含：

```text
Default
All Variants
All Sizes
Loading
Disabled
Error
Long Text
Mobile
Keyboard
Screen Reader Notes
High Contrast
Reduced Motion
```

## 29.3 业务组件 Story

例如：

```text
MembershipPlanCard
RecommendationCard
DatingProfileCompleteness
SafetyRestrictionCard
OrderStatusTimeline
ReviewFeedback
```

必须使用合成数据，不能使用真实用户资料。

## 29.4 Story 文档

每个组件说明：

```text
用途
何时使用
何时不使用
Props
Slots
Events
状态
可访问性
响应式行为
测试要求
已知限制
```

---

# 三十、Storybook Interaction Tests

测试：

```text
点击
键盘导航
表单输入
菜单打开关闭
Modal Focus
Tabs
Tooltip
批量操作
异步状态
```

Story 不应仅用于人工查看。

---

# 三十一、Storybook 发布

CI 生成不可变 Storybook Artifact：

```text
release
git commit
design token version
component library version
visual baseline version
```

生产 Storybook 若公开访问，不能包含：

```text
Secret
内部 API
真实用户数据
受限管理功能凭证
```

---

# 三十二、Skill 22.11：`vav-visual-regression-page-audit`

## 目标

对组件和关键页面建立多尺寸、多语言、多主题视觉回归。

## 32.1 视觉测试矩阵

```text
Component
× Variant
× State
× Viewport
× Theme
× Locale
× Density
```

不能对所有组合做笛卡尔积导致测试不可维护，应定义：

```text
Minimum Required Matrix
Risk-based Extended Matrix
```

## 32.2 最低组件矩阵

```text
Light Theme
Comfortable Density
zh-CN
Desktop
Mobile
Default
Error
Disabled
Loading
```

## 32.3 关键页面矩阵

必须覆盖：

```text
首页
登录
注册
商品详情
Checkout
订单详情
活动详情
课程学习
辅导预约
AI 对话
通知中心
隐私中心
婚恋档案编辑
推荐列表
互选详情
关系旅程
会员中心
举报页面
管理端 Dashboard
审核工作台
安全案件
质量 Dashboard
Skill 安装向导
```

## 32.4 动态内容处理

视觉测试不得通过删除大量内容掩盖问题。

允许稳定化：

```text
固定时间
固定 UUID
固定随机种子
固定图片 Fixture
固定动画时间
屏蔽真正动态的时间戳
```

不允许：

```text
屏蔽整个表格
屏蔽整个状态区域
屏蔽所有错误信息
```

## 32.5 Baseline 状态

```python
class VisualBaselineStatus(StrEnum):
    PROPOSED = "proposed"
    REVIEW_REQUIRED = "review_required"
    APPROVED = "approved"
    SUPERSEDED = "superseded"
    REJECTED = "rejected"
```

## 32.6 Baseline 审批

视觉变化必须关联：

```text
需求或设计变更
修改说明
影响页面
截图差异
批准者
Release
```

开发者不能通过批量接受所有截图掩盖回归。

---

# 三十三、视觉差异等级

```python
class VisualDifferenceSeverity(StrEnum):
    BLOCKER = "blocker"
    MAJOR = "major"
    EXPECTED = "expected"
    MINOR = "minor"
```

Blocker 示例：

```text
按钮不可见
内容重叠
表单超出屏幕
错误文本被裁切
Modal 无法关闭
敏感数据意外显示
管理操作按钮丢失
```

Major 示例：

```text
布局明显错位
间距严重异常
表格列不可读
错误颜色不符合语义
```

---

# 三十四、UI 页面审计

Batch 21 的 Page Inventory 每个页面增加 UI 元数据：

```yaml
page:
  code: PAGE-USER-DATING-PROFILE
  layout: UserFormLayout
  responsive: required
  accessibility: critical
  visualRegression: required

  requiredStates:
    - loading
    - empty
    - error
    - success
    - review_pending
    - restricted
```

扫描器检查：

```text
页面是否使用注册布局
页面是否注册 Loading/Empty/Error
页面是否存在视觉测试
页面是否存在可访问性测试
```

---

# 三十五、UI 质量证据

向 Batch 21 注册：

```text
Storybook Build
Component Test Report
Accessibility Report
Visual Regression Report
Responsive Audit Report
Critical Page Screenshot Bundle
Manual Accessibility Review
```

每个证据绑定：

# 三十六、可选 UI 质量数据表

使用 Quality 模块扩展表，不在业务模块重复建库。

```sql
CREATE TABLE ui_audit_runs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    release_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    application_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    audit_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    browser_matrix JSONB NOT NULL,
    viewport_matrix JSONB NOT NULL,
    locale_matrix JSONB NOT NULL,
    theme_matrix JSONB NOT NULL,

    result_summary JSONB NOT NULL,
    evidence_id UUID,

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE ui_visual_differences (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    ui_audit_run_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES ui_audit_runs(id),

    page_or_story_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    viewport_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    theme VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    baseline_checksum VARCHAR(128),
    current_checksum VARCHAR(128),

    diff_reference_encrypted TEXT,
    decision_summary TEXT,

    reviewed_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

Alembic 使用当前项目的下一个可用 Revision，不硬编码编号。

# 四十一、UI 发布门禁

## Token Gate

```text
GATE-UI-UNREGISTERED-TOKENS
生产页面直接硬编码颜色数量 = 0

GATE-UI-TOKEN-COMPATIBILITY
破坏性 Token 变化均有迁移计划
```

## Component Gate

```text
GATE-UI-CRITICAL-COMPONENT-STORIES
关键组件 Story 覆盖率 = 100%

GATE-UI-COMPONENT-INTERACTION
关键组件 Interaction Test 通过率 = 100%
```

## Accessibility Gate

```text
GATE-UI-CRITICAL-A11Y
Critical Accessibility Findings = 0

GATE-UI-KEYBOARD-JOURNEYS
关键用户旅程键盘完成率 = 100%
```

## Responsive Gate

```text
GATE-UI-CRITICAL-RESPONSIVE
关键页面响应式失败 = 0

GATE-UI-HORIZONTAL-OVERFLOW
关键 Viewport 横向溢出 = 0
```

## Visual Gate

```text
GATE-UI-VISUAL-BLOCKERS
未解决 Blocker Visual Differences = 0

GATE-UI-BASELINE-APPROVAL
所有预期 Major 变化均经审批
```

# 四十三、Makefile

```makefile
ui-token-build:
	pnpm --filter design-tokens build

ui-token-check:
	pnpm --filter design-tokens test
	pnpm exec node scripts/ui/check-hardcoded-tokens.mjs

ui-component-test:
	pnpm --filter ui-core test
	pnpm --filter ui-user test
	pnpm --filter ui-admin test

ui-storybook-build:
	pnpm --filter design-system build-storybook

ui-storybook-test:
	pnpm --filter design-system test-storybook

ui-accessibility-test:
	pnpm exec playwright test tests/ui/accessibility

ui-responsive-test:
	pnpm exec playwright test tests/ui/responsive

ui-visual-test:
	pnpm exec playwright test tests/ui/visual

ui-page-audit:
	pnpm exec node scripts/ui/audit-pages.mjs

ui-evidence-build:
	./scripts/ui/build-ui-evidence.sh

ui-admin-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test e2e/admin-design-system

ui-verify:
	$(MAKE) ui-token-build
	$(MAKE) ui-token-check
	$(MAKE) ui-component-test
	$(MAKE) ui-storybook-build
	$(MAKE) ui-storybook-test
	$(MAKE) ui-accessibility-test
	$(MAKE) ui-responsive-test
	$(MAKE) ui-visual-test
	$(MAKE) ui-page-audit
	$(MAKE) ui-admin-e2e
	$(MAKE) ui-evidence-build
```

主题切换不改变业务含义

破坏性 Token 变化产生 Diff
Token 构建可重现

每个关键组件有 Story
每个交互组件支持键盘

Disabled 状态不可触发
图标按钮具有可访问名称

每个 Critical 页面有 Loading 状态
每个列表页面有 Empty 状态

颜色不是唯一信息表达

# 五十三、Batch 22 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-22/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-22-design-system-accessibility-visual-quality
description: Implement the VAV design system, tokens, layouts, responsive behavior, accessible components, Storybook documentation, interaction states, visual regression and UI quality gates.
---

# Goal

Build the platform-wide UI quality system containing:

- versioned design tokens;
- semantic themes;
- user and administrator density modes;
- shared application shells;
- responsive grid and layout templates;
- accessible foundation components;
- form and validation workflows;
- administrative table and review patterns;
- complete loading, empty, error, restricted and offline states;
- mobile, tablet and desktop adaptations;
- keyboard and screen-reader support;
- reduced-motion and zoom support;
- Storybook component documentation;
- Storybook interaction tests;
- visual regression across viewports, themes and locales;
- visual baseline governance;
- page-level UI audits;
- UI quality evidence;
- release-blocking UI gates.

# Product boundary

This batch defines how interfaces look, behave and adapt.

It does not replace business authorization, state machines, information
architecture, usability UAT or business completeness. UI components must
consume authoritative backend state rather than infer business permissions.

# Prerequisites

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batches 1 through 21.
3. Run `make quality-verify`.
4. Inspect every route in User Web, Admin Web and Skill Console.
5. Inspect current components, styles and layout implementations.
6. Produce `docs/design/design-principles.md`.
7. Produce `docs/design/design-token-model.md`.
8. Produce `docs/design/component-inventory.md`.
9. Produce `docs/design/page-layout-patterns.md`.
10. Produce `docs/accessibility/accessibility-standard.md`.
11. Produce `docs/testing/visual-regression-policy.md`.

# Required implementation order

1. Design principles.
2. Primitive tokens.
3. Semantic tokens.
4. Component tokens.
5. Theme and density providers.
6. Application shells.
7. Responsive grid and layouts.
8. Foundation components.
9. Form and validation components.
10. Data-display and administrative patterns.
11. Interaction and page states.
12. Accessibility utilities.
13. Responsive adaptations.
14. Storybook foundations.
15. Component stories.
16. Business-pattern stories.
17. Storybook interaction tests.
18. Accessibility automation.
19. Responsive page audits.
20. Visual regression.
21. Baseline governance.
22. UI quality gates and evidence.

# Token invariants

- Business components use semantic tokens.
- Hard-coded production colors are rejected unless explicitly approved.
- State colors have text or icon equivalents.
- Token releases are versioned.
- Breaking token changes include migration guidance.
- Generated token files derive from one source.
- Theme switching does not change business meaning.

# Layout invariants

- Pages use registered layout templates.
- Critical pages have one primary heading.
- Primary actions are visually identifiable.
- Dangerous actions are not default primary actions.
- Main content remains operable at supported viewports.
- Business pages do not depend on absolute positioning.
- User and administrator applications share foundations but may use
  different density defaults.

# Component invariants

- Components expose all supported states.
- Loading actions prevent duplicate submission.
- Disabled components do not emit actions.
- Icon-only controls have accessible names.
- Modal and menu focus behavior is correct.
- Critical errors are not represented only by transient notifications.
- Component semantics do not depend only on color.
- Deprecated components produce build warnings.

# Form invariants

- Labels are explicit.
- Validation errors identify fields and remediation.
- Page-level error summaries support focus and announcement.
- Async validation ignores stale results.
- Long forms preserve draft state where required.
- Autosave failures preserve user input.
- Sensitive fields use masking and purpose information.
- High-impact actions use explicit confirmation language.

# State invariants

- Critical pages implement loading, success and error states.
- List pages implement appropriate empty states.
- Filtered-empty and no-data states remain distinct.
- Partial failure preserves available content.
- Offline operations do not claim unconfirmed success.
- Restricted, expired and pending-review states provide safe next steps.
- Backend authorization remains authoritative.

# Responsive invariants

- Supported mobile viewports have no critical horizontal overflow.
- Touch targets remain operable.
- Tables adapt instead of becoming unusable.
- Filters remain discoverable on small screens.
- Sticky actions respect safe areas and virtual keyboards.
- Text zoom does not hide critical controls.
- Long localized strings remain readable.

# Accessibility invariants

- Critical flows are keyboard operable.
- Focus is visible.
- Dialogs manage and restore focus.
- Route changes move focus appropriately.
- Form errors are programmatically associated.
- Dynamic status changes use controlled live regions.
- Color is not the only means of communication.
- Reduced-motion preferences are honored.
- Accessibility automation is supplemented by manual reviews.

# Storybook invariants

- Every critical shared component has stories.
- Stories include supported variants and states.
- Stories use synthetic data.
- Stories document appropriate and inappropriate usage.
- Interaction tests run against interactive stories.
- Accessibility checks run in Storybook.
- Storybook artifacts bind to release and component versions.

# Visual-regression invariants

- Critical components and pages have approved baselines.
- Required viewport, locale and theme matrices are defined.
- Dynamic data is stabilized rather than hiding meaningful regions.
- Blocker differences fail release.
- Expected differences require review.
- Baselines are versioned and auditable.
- Sensitive user data does not enter screenshots.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make ui-token-build
make ui-token-check
make ui-component-test
make ui-storybook-build
make ui-storybook-test
make ui-accessibility-test
make ui-responsive-test
make ui-visual-test
make ui-page-audit
make ui-admin-e2e
make ui-evidence-build
make ui-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Design principles are documented.
2. Tokens are versioned and generated.
3. User, Admin and Skill applications consume shared tokens.
4. Registered application shells exist.
5. Critical pages use approved layout templates.
6. Foundation components support all required states.
7. Forms support accessible validation.
8. Long forms support required recovery behavior.
9. Administrative tables adapt responsively.
10. Loading, empty, error and restriction states exist.
11. Critical mobile pages have no blocking overflow.
12. Keyboard navigation works.
13. Focus management works.
14. Automated accessibility tests pass.
15. Manual accessibility reviews cover critical journeys.
16. Storybook contains critical shared components.
17. Storybook interaction tests pass.
18. Critical pages have visual baselines.
19. Blocker visual differences are zero.
20. Expected baseline changes are approved.
21. UI evidence is registered in Batch 21.
22. UI quality gates pass.
23. `make ui-verify` succeeds.
24. `make quality-verify` still succeeds.
25. `make acceptance` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When a page does not fit the design system:

1. identify whether the missing capability belongs in the shared system or
   the business module;
2. create or extend a semantic pattern;
3. add stories and tests;
4. migrate the page;
5. avoid one-off styling that cannot be reused or audited.

When a critical accessibility test fails:

1. block UI release;
2. identify the affected interaction;
3. repair semantics, focus, labels or contrast;
4. add a regression test;
5. rerun automated and manual accessibility checks.

When a visual difference is unexpected:

1. do not accept the baseline automatically;
2. identify the responsible code or token change;
3. determine whether the change is a defect or approved design change;
4. fix or obtain review;
5. preserve the diff evidence.

When responsive behavior fails:

1. preserve the failing viewport fixture;
2. fix layout, overflow or interaction behavior;
3. test adjacent viewports;
4. add a regression case;
5. rerun the critical-page viewport matrix.

When UI state disagrees with backend state:

1. treat the backend as authoritative;
2. prevent the unsafe or misleading action;
3. correct the frontend projection;
4. invalidate stale UI caches;
5. add an integration and E2E regression test.
```

# 三、核心架构原则

## 3.1 导航应围绕用户任务，而不是围绕内部服务名

不推荐用户端主菜单：

```text
CMS
Commerce
Entitlements
Recommendations
Interactions
Privacy
```

用户端应使用：

```text
首页
活动
课程
辅导
AI 助手
婚恋
我的服务
消息
账户
```

管理端可以按业务领域组织，但仍需避免直接暴露底层技术模块名称。

## 3.2 页面权限不能只依赖菜单隐藏

```text
菜单隐藏
≠
权限控制
```

用户直接访问 URL 时，后端仍必须执行：

```text
身份
权限
会员
隐私
业务状态
安全限制
```

的完整检查。

## 3.3 通知必须回到可处理页面

每条需要用户行动的通知必须提供：

```text
目标页面
目标实体
当前可执行操作
状态失效后的安全回退页面
```

不能出现：

```text
点击通知
→ 404
```

或：

```text
点击通知
→ 首页
→ 用户不知道要做什么
```

## 3.4 跨模块跳转不能通过 URL 携带敏感数据

禁止：

```text
/contact-exchange?phone=138...
/appeal?evidence=...
/checkout?price=...
```

允许：

```text
/contact-exchanges/{exchange_id}
/appeals/{appeal_id}
/checkout/{checkout_session_id}
```

后端根据实体 ID 和当前用户重新生成授权视图。

## 3.5 用户首页不能成为“广告墙”

用户首页优先顺序：

```text
必须处理事项
→ 已购买或正在使用的服务
→ 当前关系和安全状态
→ 建议下一步
→ 新服务发现
→ 营销内容
```

商业推荐不能覆盖重要的退款、审核、邀请、安全和隐私事项。

## 3.6 系统不能暗中替用户推进旅程

旅程系统可以：

```text
展示当前步骤
提示下一步
提醒即将到期
```

不能：

```text
自动接受邀请
自动确认关系阶段
自动放宽择偶条件
自动购买会员
自动分享隐私资料
```

# 七、Skill 23.1：`vav-information-architecture-registry`

## 目标

建立统一的信息架构节点、领域、层级和内容归属。

## 7.1 信息架构空间

```python
class InformationArchitectureSpace(StrEnum):
    PUBLIC = "public"
    USER_ACCOUNT = "user_account"
    USER_SERVICES = "user_services"
    MATCHMAKING = "matchmaking"
    SAFETY_PRIVACY = "safety_privacy"
    ADMIN = "admin"
    SKILL_CONSOLE = "skill_console"
```

## 7.2 IA 节点

```sql
CREATE TABLE experience_ia_nodes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    node_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    parent_node_id UUID REFERENCES experience_ia_nodes(id),

    space VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    node_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    module_code VARCHAR(64),
    route_code VARCHAR(128),

    default_label_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    description_key VARCHAR(255),

    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    introduced_version VARCHAR(64),
    retired_version VARCHAR(64),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 7.3 Node Type

```python
class IaNodeType(StrEnum):
    DOMAIN = "domain"
    SECTION = "section"
    DESTINATION = "destination"
    TASK_ENTRY = "task_entry"
    HELP_ENTRY = "help_entry"
    EXTERNAL_DESTINATION = "external_destination"
```

## 7.4 第一版用户端 IA

```text
PUBLIC
├── 首页
├── 关于 VAV

USER_ACCOUNT

```text

## 7.6 IA 原则

- 同一能力只能有一个主要归属。
- 可以有多个快捷入口，但必须指向同一权威页面。
- 管理端模块名应使用业务语言。
- 已停用 IA 节点不能直接删除，应保留重定向或迁移信息。
- IA 变化必须版本化并进入视觉和导航回归测试。

apiVersion: experience.vav.io/v1

# 九、Skill 23.2：`vav-route-navigation-manifest`

## 目标

建立所有页面的统一路由、导航、权限、前置条件和回退规则。

## 9.1 路由注册表

```sql
CREATE TABLE experience_routes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    route_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    application_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    route_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    route_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,

    page_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    route_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    navigation_visibility VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    required_authentication BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    required_permissions JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    required_capabilities JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    feature_flag_code VARCHAR(128),

    prerequisite_policy JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    fallback_route_code VARCHAR(128),

    breadcrumb_policy JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    help_context_code VARCHAR(128),

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    source_location VARCHAR(1000),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(application_code, route_name)
);
```

## 9.2 Route Type

```python
class ExperienceRouteType(StrEnum):
    PUBLIC = "public"
    AUTHENTICATED = "authenticated"
    ADMIN = "admin"
    DEEP_LINK = "deep_link"
    CALLBACK = "callback"
    EMBEDDED = "embedded"
    ERROR = "error"
```

## 9.3 导航可见性

```python
class NavigationVisibility(StrEnum):
    PRIMARY = "primary"
    SECONDARY = "secondary"
    CONTEXTUAL = "contextual"
    TASK_ONLY = "task_only"
    DEEP_LINK_ONLY = "deep_link_only"
    HIDDEN = "hidden"
```

## 9.4 路由前置条件

示例：

```json
{
  "all": [
    {
      "type": "authenticated"
    },
    {
      "type": "dating_profile_status",
      "operator": "in",
      "value": ["approved", "active"]
    }
  ]
}
```

前置条件不满足时必须返回：

```text
安全说明
可执行下一步
Fallback Route
```

例如推荐页面前置条件失败：

```text
档案未完成
→ 转到档案完整度页面

档案审核中
→ 转到审核状态页

档案被安全暂停
→ 转到安全限制页
```

---

# 十、路由 Manifest

```yaml
routes:
  - code: ROUTE-USER-RECOMMENDATIONS
    application: user-web
    path: /:locale/recommendations
    page: PAGE-USER-RECOMMENDATIONS

    authentication: required

    prerequisites:
      - capability: matchmaking.recommendations.access
      - profileStatus:
          in:
            - active

    fallback:
      incompleteProfile: ROUTE-USER-DATING-PROFILE
      reviewPending: ROUTE-USER-DATING-REVIEW
      restricted: ROUTE-USER-SAFETY-RESTRICTIONS

    helpContext: HELP-RECOMMENDATIONS
```

---

# 十一、路由解析

前端路由守卫不得独立决定全部条件。

正确流程：

```text
前端识别需要检查
→ 调用 Route Eligibility API
→ 后端返回 allowed / redirect / unavailable
→ 前端执行导航
```

接口：

```http
POST /api/v1/experience/routes/{route_code}/eligibility
```

响应：

```json
{
  "allowed": false,
  "reason_code": "DATING_PROFILE_REVIEW_PENDING",
  "fallback": {
    "route_code": "ROUTE-USER-DATING-REVIEW",
    "params": {}
  }
}
```

---

# 十二、Skill 23.3：`vav-role-state-aware-navigation`

## 目标

根据身份、角色、权限、业务状态和设备生成当前用户可见导航。

## 12.1 Navigation Request

```python
class NavigationRequest(BaseModel):
    application_code: str
    locale: str
    viewport_class: str
    current_route_code: str | None
```

## 12.2 Navigation Response

```python
class NavigationModel(BaseModel):
    primary_items: list[NavigationItem]
    secondary_items: list[NavigationItem]
    contextual_items: list[NavigationItem]

    utility_items: list[NavigationItem]
    account_items: list[NavigationItem]

    version: str
```

## 12.3 Navigation Item

```python
class NavigationItem(BaseModel):
    code: str
    label: str
    icon: str | None

    route_code: str
    route_params: dict

    selected: bool
    disabled: bool

    badge: NavigationBadge | None
    children: list["NavigationItem"]
```

## 12.4 导航过滤顺序

```text
IA 节点
→ 应用类型
→ 用户身份
→ 角色
→ 权限
→ Feature Flag
→ 会员能力
→ 业务状态
→ 安全限制
→ 设备布局
```

安全受限用户仍需保留：

```text
账户
限制说明
申诉
隐私权利
退出登录
```

不能因为账号受限而让用户无法申诉或访问数据权利。

## 12.5 Badge

可显示：

```text
未读通知
待办数量
待审核数量
即将到期数量
```

不得显示：

```text
有多少人单向喜欢你
有多少人跳过你
他人举报数量
内部风险分数
```

```text
experience:navigation:

```

角色变化

## 目标

    due_policy JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    completion_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

);
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE experience_user_tasks (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

        REFERENCES experience_task_definitions(id),

    source_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_entity_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_entity_id UUID NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    priority VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    title_snapshot VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    description_snapshot TEXT,

    action_route_code VARCHAR(128),
    action_route_params_encrypted JSONB,

    available_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    due_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    deduplication_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    dismissed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(user_id, deduplication_key)
);
```

## 14.3 Task Status

```python
class UserTaskStatus(StrEnum):
    AVAILABLE = "available"
    IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
    WAITING_FOR_USER = "waiting_for_user"
    WAITING_FOR_OTHER_PARTY = "waiting_for_other_party"
    WAITING_FOR_PLATFORM = "waiting_for_platform"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    INVALIDATED = "invalidated"
```

## 14.4 Task Priority

```python
class UserTaskPriority(StrEnum):
    CRITICAL = "critical"
    HIGH = "high"
    NORMAL = "normal"
    LOW = "low"
```

Critical 仅用于：

```text
账户安全
付款问题
隐私请求即将过期
需要立即处理的安全事项
```

不能把营销活动标为 Critical。

# 十六、模块任务提供者接口

每个业务模块实现：

```python
class ExperienceTaskProvider(Protocol):
    module_code: str

    async def list_tasks(
        self,
        user_id: UUID,
        context: TaskQueryContext,
    ) -> list[ExperienceTaskCandidate]:
        ...

    async def verify_completion(
        self,
        task: ExperienceUserTask,
    ) -> TaskCompletionDecision:
        ...
```

任务中心不能根据前端页面是否访问过来判定完成。

完成状态必须来源于业务真源。

## 示例：活动旅程

```text
浏览活动
→ 查看活动详情
→ 选择票种
→ 创建订单
→ 支付确认

→ 活动后互选

Journey Step

```text
Order Status
Registration Status
Payment Status
```

系统需要区分：

需要你处理

→ 找到当前可执行步骤
→ 返回正确页面
```

不能依赖浏览器内存保持旅程进度。

# 二十四、第一版 Handoff

```text
AI → Catalog

商品和 SKU

Checkout → Commerce
报价、订单、支付会话

Commerce → Service

导出或删除前重新认证

Membership → Commerce
升级、降级和续费

# 二十八、Skill 23.7：`vav-global-search-command-palette`

## 目标

建立权限安全、隐私安全、可解释的全局搜索和快捷命令。

## 28.1 搜索范围

用户端：

```text
文章
公开活动
公开课程
公开导师服务
会员计划
帮助内容
自己的订单
自己的活动
自己的课程
自己的辅导预约
自己的任务
自己的关系旅程摘要
```

管理端：

```text
用户
订单
活动报名
课程注册
辅导预约
档案审核
推荐批次
互选
关系旅程
会员
安全案件
隐私请求
Skill
质量需求
```

## 28.2 禁止普通搜索

```text
他人的完整婚恋档案
单向喜欢
他人的择偶条件
私人关系复盘
举报者身份
安全证据
支付敏感信息
AI 私人对话
辅导私密记录
```

## 28.3 Search Document

```sql
CREATE TABLE experience_search_documents (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    document_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_entity_id UUID NOT NULL,

    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    summary TEXT,

    locale VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,

    search_text TSVECTOR,
    embedding VECTOR,

    visibility_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    permission_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    owner_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    source_version VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    indexed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(
        document_type,
        source_entity_id,
        locale,
        source_version
    )
);
```

向量搜索可选；首版必须具备可靠的 PostgreSQL 全文搜索。

## 28.4 搜索流程

```text
解析 Query
→ 识别 Search Scope
→ 生成候选
→ 权限过滤
→ 所有权过滤
→ 隐私过滤
→ 安全过滤
→ 状态过滤
→ 排序
→ 返回安全摘要
```

不能先返回全部结果，再让前端隐藏。

## 28.5 Search Result

```python
class GlobalSearchResult(BaseModel):
    result_type: str
    result_id: UUID

    title: str
    summary: str | None

    route: RouteTarget
    status: StatusDescriptor | None

    matched_terms: list[str]
```

GET /api/v1/search?q=...&scope=...
GET /api/v1/admin/search?q=...&scope=...
GET /api/v1/search/suggestions?q=...
```

用户端和管理端使用独立 API Audience。

## 29.1 Command Palette

可提供：

```text
前往订单
前往我的课程
新建活动边界
查找用户
查找安全案件
运行质量检查

# 三十一、Skill 23.8：`vav-contextual-help-support`

## 目标

建立帮助中心、上下文帮助、状态说明和支持升级路径。

## 31.1 Help Article

可复用 Batch 3 CMS，但增加帮助元数据：

```sql
CREATE TABLE experience_help_articles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    article_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    content_entry_id UUID NOT NULL,

    category_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    applicable_route_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    applicable_status_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    applicable_actor_types JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(article_code)
);
```

## 31.2 帮助分类

```text
账户与登录
订单与付款
活动
课程
辅导
AI 助手
婚恋档案
推荐与互选
关系旅程
会员
隐私与数据权利
安全与举报
Skill 平台
管理端操作
```

## 31.3 Context Help

每个页面可注册：

```text
页面说明
当前状态说明
常见问题
相关政策
操作教程
联系支持
```

API：

```http
GET /api/v1/help/context/{help_context_code}
GET /api/v1/help/articles
GET /api/v1/help/articles/{article_code}
```

## 31.4 状态解释

例如：

```text
订单待确认
表示平台仍在等待支付渠道确认，不代表支付失败。

档案审核中
表示档案已经提交，当前不能进入推荐池。

邀请已过期
表示这次邀请已不能接受，不代表你被屏蔽。
```

帮助说明必须与真实业务状态版本对应。

---

# 三十二、支持请求

为形成帮助闭环，增加轻量支持请求：

```sql
CREATE TABLE experience_support_requests (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    request_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    category_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    source_route_code VARCHAR(128),
    source_entity_type VARCHAR(64),
    source_entity_id UUID,

    subject VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    description_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    priority VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    assigned_team VARCHAR(128),
    assigned_to UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

支持请求不应替代：

```text
安全举报
隐私请求
支付争议
辅导安全转介
```

系统必须根据类别引导到正确专业流程。

---

# 三十三、问题反馈

用户可以对页面反馈：

```text
找不到下一步
说明不清楚
页面无法操作
状态不正确
链接失效
帮助无用
```

反馈记录：

```sql
CREATE TABLE experience_feedback (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    feedback_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    route_code VARCHAR(128),
    journey_code VARCHAR(128),

    description_encrypted TEXT,

    context_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

上下文不能包含敏感表单明文。

# 三十四、Skill 23.9：`vav-deep-link-notification-resolution`

## 目标

确保通知、邮件、任务和外部返回链接能安全到达当前有效页面。

## 34.1 Deep Link

```sql
CREATE TABLE experience_deep_links (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    link_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    target_route_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    route_params_encrypted JSONB NOT NULL,

    purpose VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    token_hash VARCHAR(128),
    single_use BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    consumed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 34.2 Deep Link 类型

```text
登录后跳转
邮箱验证
密码重置
订单详情
活动签到
课程继续学习
辅导预约
隐私导出下载
认识邀请
阶段建议
申诉状态
Skill 安装审批
```

## 34.3 Link Resolution

```http
POST /api/v1/experience/deep-links/resolve
```

流程：

```text
验证 Token
→ 验证 Purpose
→ 验证用户
→ 验证有效期
→ 验证实体
→ 重新检查权限
→ 重新检查安全
→ 返回有效 Route 或 Fallback
```

## 34.4 失效链接回退

```text
资源仍存在但状态已变化
→ 当前状态页

资源已删除
→ 安全说明页

用户无权限
→ 无权限页

链接过期
→ 可重新发起流程或返回任务中心
```

---

# 三十五、通知模板要求

每个 Actionable Notification 必须声明：

```yaml
action:
  routeCode: ROUTE-USER-INTRODUCTION-DETAIL
  entityReferenceField: invitation_id
  fallbackRouteCode: ROUTE-USER-INVITATIONS
```

Batch 11 模板发布校验中增加：

```text
目标 Route 存在
Route 与接收者角色兼容
Fallback 存在
实体参数 Schema 正确
```

# 三十六、Skill 23.10：`vav-dead-end-route-detection`

## 目标

自动发现不可达、不可返回、无后续、无恢复和状态断链页面。

## 36.1 Route Graph

节点：

```text
Page
Task
Notification
Handoff
Journey Step
Help Article
```

边：

```text
navigation
redirect
action
success
error
cancel
return
help
notification
handoff
```

## 36.2 Dead End Finding

```sql
CREATE TABLE experience_dead_end_findings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    finding_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    finding_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    application_code VARCHAR(64),
    route_code VARCHAR(128),

    source_location VARCHAR(1000),

    detection_rule_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    evidence_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    owner_team VARCHAR(128),
    owner_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    resolution_summary TEXT
);
```

## 36.3 Finding Type

```python
class DeadEndFindingType(StrEnum):
    UNREACHABLE_ROUTE = "unreachable_route"
    NO_OUTBOUND_ACTION = "no_outbound_action"
    BROKEN_LINK = "broken_link"
    BROKEN_NOTIFICATION_LINK = "broken_notification_link"
    MISSING_FALLBACK = "missing_fallback"
    ERROR_WITHOUT_RECOVERY = "error_without_recovery"
    TASK_WITHOUT_STATUS_PAGE = "task_without_status_page"
    JOURNEY_WITHOUT_NEXT_STEP = "journey_without_next_step"
    HANDOFF_WITHOUT_RETURN = "handoff_without_return"
    PERMISSION_REDIRECT_LOOP = "permission_redirect_loop"
    FEATURE_FLAG_ISLAND = "feature_flag_island"
```

---

# 三十七、死路规则

## 页面入口

关键页面至少有一个合法入口：

```text
导航
任务中心
通知
业务页面跳转
可记录的深层链接
```

## 页面出口

非终态页面必须至少有：

```text
下一步
返回
取消
帮助
状态页
```

## 错误恢复

可恢复错误必须至少有：

```text
重试
修改输入
返回上一步
查看状态
联系支持
```

## 等待状态

每个：

```text
审核中
付款待确认
等待对方
处理中
```

必须有可再次访问的状态页面。

# 三十八、静态检测

```text
扫描 Vue Router
扫描导航 Manifest
扫描 Router Push
扫描 Notification Action
扫描 Task Action
扫描 Handoff Definition
扫描 Help Context
```

命令：

```bash
vav experience dead-ends scan
vav experience route-graph build
vav experience route-graph validate
```

# 三十九、运行时检测

记录：

```text
404
权限重定向循环
重复返回同一路由
通知链接失效
任务点击失败
Handoff 失败
错误页退出率
```

不能仅凭高退出率断言页面是死路，需要结合路由和用户操作分析。

# 四十、Skill 23.11：`vav-journey-analytics-experience-closure`

## 目标

测量用户能否顺利完成旅程，并发现阻塞、退出和重复操作。

## 40.1 旅程分析事件

```text
journey.started
journey.step.viewed
journey.step.started
journey.step.completed
journey.step.failed
journey.step.abandoned
journey.blocked
journey.resumed
journey.completed
journey.cancelled
```

## 40.2 事件数据

```sql
CREATE TABLE experience_journey_events (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    journey_instance_id UUID
        REFERENCES experience_journey_instances(id),

    user_id_hash VARCHAR(128),

    journey_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    step_code VARCHAR(128),

    event_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    route_code VARCHAR(128),
    source_type VARCHAR(64),

    safe_context JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

不得保存：

```text
表单正文
婚恋敏感字段
辅导记录
举报证据
AI 对话
联系方式
```

## 40.3 指标

```text
Journey Start Rate
Journey Completion Rate
Step Completion Rate
Step Failure Rate
Median Completion Time
Return-after-wait Rate
Dead-end Rate
Help-use Rate
Support-escalation Rate
```

## 40.4 分析原则

指标用于发现体验问题，不用于：

```text
处罚用户
推断用户人格
推断关系质量
推断属灵成熟度
```

---

# 四十一、体验闭环定义

一项用户能力只有满足以下全部条件才算体验闭环：

```text
存在可发现入口
存在清晰页面
存在真实业务操作
操作结果可查询
存在下一步
存在返回路径
存在失败恢复
存在帮助
存在管理端处理
存在通知回链
存在自动测试
存在体验证据
```

## Experience Closure Record

```sql
CREATE TABLE experience_closure_records (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    capability_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    release_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    entry_complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    action_complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    status_complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    next_step_complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    recovery_complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    help_complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    admin_complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    notification_complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    testing_complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

    closure_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    evidence_ids JSONB NOT NULL,

    evaluated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(capability_code, release_version)
);
```

# 五十二、Makefile

```makefile
experience-migrate:
	docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head

experience-seed:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.seed_experience

experience-sync:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.sync_experience_manifests

experience-ia-check:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.check_information_architecture

experience-route-check:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.check_routes

experience-task-check:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.check_task_providers

experience-journey-check:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.check_journeys

experience-handoff-check:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.check_handoffs

experience-search-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/experience/search -q

experience-dead-end-scan:
	pnpm exec node scripts/experience/scan-dead-ends.mjs

experience-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/experience/unit tests/experience/integration -q

experience-security-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/experience/security -q

experience-user-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test e2e/user-experience

experience-admin-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test e2e/admin-experience

experience-evidence-build:
	./scripts/experience/build-experience-evidence.sh

experience-verify:
	$(MAKE) experience-migrate
	$(MAKE) experience-seed
	$(MAKE) experience-sync
	$(MAKE) experience-ia-check
	$(MAKE) experience-route-check
	$(MAKE) experience-task-check
	$(MAKE) experience-journey-check
	$(MAKE) experience-handoff-check
	$(MAKE) experience-search-test
	$(MAKE) experience-dead-end-scan
	$(MAKE) experience-test
	$(MAKE) experience-security-test
	$(MAKE) experience-user-e2e
	$(MAKE) experience-admin-e2e
	$(MAKE) experience-evidence-build
```

```text
每个核心页面有唯一 Page Code
每个核心页面属于明确 IA 节点
每个 IA 节点有负责人
用户端使用用户语言而非技术模块名
管理端业务领域层级一致
停用节点保留迁移信息
IA 版本差异可查看
不存在重复主要归属

公共用户看到公共导航

安全受限用户仍可访问申诉和隐私页面

移动端导航保留主要任务
当前路由高亮正确

不同模块任务正确聚合

等待用户和等待平台状态不同

过期任务正确失效
用户只能查看自己的任务
任务 Action 指向有效页面
任务状态变化及时更新

取消和过期有安全终态
被安全限制后旅程进入正确状态

# 六十四、Batch 23 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-23/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-23-information-architecture-user-journeys
description: Implement VAV information architecture, navigation, user home, task center, journey orchestration, cross-module handoffs, global search, contextual help, deep-link resolution, dead-end detection and experience-closure gates.
---

# Goal

Build the platform-wide experience orchestration layer containing:

- a versioned information-architecture registry;
- route and navigation manifests;
- role-, permission-, state- and safety-aware navigation;
- user and administrator navigation models;
- a task-oriented user home;
- cross-module task aggregation;
- user-journey definitions and instances;
- authoritative next-step resolution;
- cross-module handoff contracts;
- safe deep links;
- permission-aware global search;
- contextual help;
- support-request routing;
- dead-end and broken-link detection;
- journey analytics;
- experience-closure certification;
- user and administrator E2E tests;
- release-blocking experience gates.

# Product boundary

This batch coordinates navigation and experience state.

It does not replace domain state machines, backend authorization, business
transactions, UI visual design, usability UAT or administrative business
operations.

Journey, task and navigation projections must derive from authoritative
business state.

# Prerequisites

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batches 1 through 22.
3. Run `make quality-verify`.
4. Run `make ui-verify`.
5. Inspect every User Web, Admin Web and Skill Console route.
6. Inspect notification actions and deep links.
7. Inspect every module's user tasks, states and handoff points.
8. Produce `docs/experience/information-architecture.md`.
9. Produce `docs/experience/navigation-model.md`.
10. Produce `docs/experience/journey-registry.md`.
11. Produce `docs/experience/handoff-contracts.md`.
12. Produce `docs/experience/dead-end-policy.md`.

# Required implementation order

1. Information-architecture taxonomy.
2. IA manifest.
3. Route registry.
4. Route eligibility service.
5. User and administrator navigation models.
6. Business-state-aware navigation.
7. User-home projection.
8. Task-provider contracts.
9. Task aggregation and deduplication.
10. Journey definitions.
11. Journey instances and steps.
12. Next-step resolution.
13. Handoff definitions and instances.
14. Safe deep-link resolution.
15. Search-document projections.
16. Permission-, privacy- and safety-aware search.
17. Contextual-help registry.
18. Support-request routing.
19. Static route-graph analysis.
20. Runtime dead-end detection.
21. Journey analytics.
22. Experience-closure evaluation.
23. User and administrator E2E tests.
24. Experience release gates and evidence.

# Information-architecture invariants

- Every critical page has a stable page and route code.
- Every critical page belongs to an IA node.
- User-facing IA uses user language rather than internal technical names.
- A capability has one primary destination.
- Secondary shortcuts resolve to the primary authoritative destination.
- Retired nodes preserve redirects or migration guidance.
- IA versions are immutable after activation.

# Route invariants

- Routes declare authentication, permission and prerequisite requirements.
- Route eligibility is backend authoritative.
- Hidden navigation never grants or removes permission.
- Failed prerequisites produce a safe fallback and next step.
- Sensitive values are not placed in route query strings.
- Critical routes have error and fallback destinations.
- Route manifests bind to source pages and tests.

# Navigation invariants

- Navigation derives from IA, roles, permissions, capabilities, features,
  business state and restrictions.
- Restricted users retain access to appeals, privacy rights and account
  security where safe.
- Mobile navigation preserves high-frequency tasks.
- Navigation badges do not reveal private interest, report or risk data.
- Navigation caches include permission, feature and restriction versions.

# Task invariants

- Tasks derive from authoritative module state.
- Tasks use stable deduplication keys.
- Waiting for the user, another user, the platform and a provider remain
  distinguishable.
- Critical safety or payment tasks outrank promotional content.
- Task completion is verified by the owning module.
- Expired and invalidated tasks do not remain actionable.
- Users access only their own tasks.
- Every actionable task has a valid route and fallback.

# Journey invariants

- Journey definitions are versioned.
- Journey instances are projections of business state.
- Journey steps do not modify domain state directly.
- Users can resume active journeys after a new session.
- Waiting and blocked states have safe explanations.
- Success, cancellation and expiry have final states.
- Critical journeys provide next-step, return, help and recovery paths.
- Journey analytics exclude sensitive content.

# Handoff invariants

- Handoffs declare source, target, context and completion policies.
- Handoff contexts use identifiers, not sensitive raw data.
- Acceptance rechecks identity, permission, privacy, safety and target state.
- Expired handoffs cannot execute.
- Failed handoffs have source or fallback destinations.
- Cross-user handoff access is rejected.
- Handoff execution is auditable.

# Search invariants

- Search indexes only approved projections.
- Search filtering occurs on the backend.
- Personal search returns only the current user's entities.
- Administrative search respects RBAC and field masking.
- One-sided likes, hidden preferences, private reflections, evidence and
  sensitive payment data are not generally searchable.
- Blocks, restrictions and erasure remove or hide results.
- Search results link to valid authorized routes.

# Help invariants

- Critical pages have contextual help.
- Help content binds to route and state versions.
- Help distinguishes normal support, safety reporting and privacy rights.
- Help content is multilingual.
- Retired policies and instructions are not shown as current.
- Support requests preserve source context without copying sensitive form
  contents.

# Deep-link invariants

- Actionable notifications declare target and fallback routes.
- Deep links use short-lived or scoped references where required.
- Token purpose, user, entity and expiry are verified.
- Consumed single-use tokens cannot be reused.
- Permission or safety changes invalidate old links.
- Missing or changed resources resolve to safe status pages rather than raw
  errors.

# Dead-end invariants

- Critical routes are reachable.
- Non-terminal pages have a next action, return path, status path or help
  path.
- Recoverable errors expose recovery.
- Pending operations have durable status pages.
- Journey steps have next or terminal states.
- Handoffs have return or fallback routes.
- Permission redirects do not loop.
- Critical dead ends block release.

# Experience-closure invariants

- Critical capabilities have discoverable entry points.
- Operations have visible results and status pages.
- Users receive a safe next step.
- Errors have recovery paths.
- Notifications link back to current state.
- Help and support paths exist.
- Required administrative handling exists.
- Closure is backed by automated evidence.
- Experience closure cannot override business, security or data failures.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make experience-migrate
make experience-seed
make experience-sync
make experience-ia-check
make experience-route-check
make experience-task-check
make experience-journey-check
make experience-handoff-check
make experience-search-test
make experience-dead-end-scan
make experience-test
make experience-security-test
make experience-user-e2e
make experience-admin-e2e
make experience-evidence-build
make experience-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. IA manifests exist.
2. Critical pages belong to valid IA nodes.
3. Route manifests include permissions and fallbacks.
4. Navigation is role and state aware.
5. Restricted users retain safe rights and appeal routes.
6. The user home aggregates authoritative tasks.
7. Tasks are deduplicated.
8. Task actions resolve to valid pages.
9. Critical journeys are versioned.
10. Users can resume journeys after login.
11. Journey next steps reflect business truth.
12. Critical handoffs work.
13. Handoffs contain no sensitive raw data.
14. Deep links revalidate access.
15. Global search respects permissions and privacy.
16. Erasure and blocks remove search visibility.
17. Critical pages have contextual help.
18. Support requests route correctly.
19. Static dead-end scans work.
20. Runtime broken-link monitoring works.
21. Critical dead ends are zero.
22. Broken critical notification links are zero.
23. Experience closure evidence is registered with Batch 21.
24. User experience E2E tests pass.
25. Admin experience E2E tests pass.
26. Experience security tests pass.
27. Experience release gates pass.
28. `make experience-verify` succeeds.
29. `make ui-verify` still succeeds.
30. `make quality-verify` still succeeds.
31. `make acceptance` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When a critical page is unreachable:

1. create a critical dead-end finding;
2. identify the missing navigation, task, notification or handoff edge;
3. add a valid entry path;
4. add an E2E regression test;
5. block release until the route graph passes.

When a task disagrees with business state:

1. treat the owning module as authoritative;
2. invalidate the stale task;
3. repair the provider or event projection;
4. rebuild affected tasks;
5. add an integration regression test.

When a handoff leaks sensitive context:

1. invalidate the handoff;
2. revoke related deep-link tokens;
3. remove the raw values;
4. replace them with authorized entity references;
5. record a privacy incident where required;
6. rerun Handoff and Privacy tests.

When search exposes unauthorized data:

1. disable the affected search scope;
2. remove affected index documents;
3. invalidate search caches;
4. repair backend filtering and projection;
5. add a release-blocking security test;
6. rerun search, privacy and block-propagation suites.

When a notification link breaks:

1. preserve the template and route versions;
2. route users to a safe fallback;
3. repair the action contract;
4. add notification-to-route contract tests;
5. rerun the affected user journey.

When journey analytics contains sensitive data:

1. stop affected event collection;
2. delete or restrict unsafe analytical records under policy;
3. replace raw content with approved safe codes;
4. add analytics-schema tests;
5. rerun Privacy verification.
```

# 三、核心架构原则

## 3.1 领域状态机是权威，流程注册表是验证与编排层

```text
Domain State Machine
决定一个业务实体能否改变状态。

Business Process
描述多个实体、模块和步骤如何完成一个业务目标。

Saga
协调跨事务边界的步骤、重试和补偿。
```

例如购买会员：

```text
Order State Machine
管理订单状态。

Subscription State Machine
管理订阅状态。

Entitlement State Machine
管理权益状态。

Membership State Machine
管理会员状态。

Membership Purchase Saga
协调以上四个领域的完整闭环。
```

## 3.2 跨模块操作不能伪装成单数据库事务

以下流程无法由一个普通数据库事务完整覆盖：

```text
支付 Provider
→ Webhook
→ Order
→ Entitlement
→ Membership
→ Notification
```

应采用：

```text
本地事务
＋ Transactional Outbox
＋ Inbox 去重
＋ Saga 状态
＋ 对账
＋ 必要补偿
```

## 3.3 补偿不等于数据库回滚

例如支付已经成功：

```text
不能通过删除 Payment 记录来“回滚”
```

正确补偿可能是：

```text
创建退款
撤销未使用权益
保留财务流水
通知用户
```

## 3.4 不可逆事实必须保留

不得删除或覆盖：

```text
已确认支付
已发送退款
已完成签到
已消费会员配额
已发送安全举报
已发生的用户同意
已执行的安全限制
```

只能创建新的反向或修正事实。

## 3.5 任一长流程都必须支持查询和恢复

每个长流程实例必须能够回答：

```text
当前在哪里？
等待谁？
最后一个成功步骤是什么？
失败在哪里？
是否正在重试？
是否可以取消？
是否正在补偿？
需要管理员做什么？
```

# 四、流程类型

```python
class BusinessProcessType(StrEnum):
    LOCAL_TRANSACTION = "local_transaction"
    ORCHESTRATED_SAGA = "orchestrated_saga"
    CHOREOGRAPHED_PROCESS = "choreographed_process"
    HUMAN_WORKFLOW = "human_workflow"
    SCHEDULED_LIFECYCLE = "scheduled_lifecycle"
    HYBRID = "hybrid"
```

## Local Transaction

适用于：

```text
单数据库
单模块
短时间
可以原子提交
```

## Orchestrated Saga

适用于：

```text
步骤顺序明确
需要集中超时和补偿控制
涉及多个模块
```

例如：

```text
辅导预约
会员升级
隐私导出
Skill 安装
```

## Choreographed Process

适用于：

```text
模块通过领域事件自然协作
无必要中央命令
```

例如：

```text
档案批准
→ 推荐投影更新
→ 推荐池加入
```

## Human Workflow

适用于：

```text
档案审核
安全案件
申诉
辅导人工确认
```

## Scheduled Lifecycle

适用于：

```text
订单过期
邀请过期
会员续费
配额重置
证据保留到期
```

# 八、Skill 24.1：`vav-business-process-registry`

## 目标

注册所有关键业务流程及其参与者、步骤、终态、SLA 和补偿策略。

## 8.1 流程定义

```sql
CREATE TABLE process_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    process_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,

    process_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    business_domain VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    owner_team VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    participant_modules JSONB NOT NULL,
    actor_types JSONB NOT NULL,

    start_condition JSONB NOT NULL,
    success_terminal_states JSONB NOT NULL,
    failure_terminal_states JSONB NOT NULL,
    cancellation_terminal_states JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    expiry_terminal_states JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    process_sla_seconds BIGINT,
    stuck_detection_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    cancellation_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    compensation_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    manual_intervention_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(process_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 8.2 流程步骤定义

```sql
CREATE TABLE process_step_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    process_definition_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES process_definitions(id),

    step_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    step_order INTEGER NOT NULL,

    owning_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    step_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    command_code VARCHAR(128),
    expected_event_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    precondition_definition JSONB NOT NULL,
    postcondition_definition JSONB NOT NULL,

    timeout_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    retry_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    idempotency_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    compensation_step_code VARCHAR(128),
    manual_action_code VARCHAR(128),

    required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    UNIQUE(process_definition_id, step_code)
);
```

## 8.3 Step Type

```python
class ProcessStepType(StrEnum):
    COMMAND = "command"
    EVENT_WAIT = "event_wait"
    HUMAN_TASK = "human_task"
    PROVIDER_CALL = "provider_call"
    TIMER = "timer"
    CONDITION = "condition"
    PARALLEL_GROUP = "parallel_group"
    SUBPROCESS = "subprocess"
    COMPENSATION = "compensation"
```

# 九、流程 Manifest

```yaml
apiVersion: process.vav.io/v1
kind: BusinessProcess

metadata:
  code: FLOW-MEMBERSHIP-PURCHASE
  version: 1.0.0

spec:
  type: orchestrated_saga
  domain: memberships
  criticality: blocker
  owner: commerce-membership-team

  participants:
    - catalog
    - commerce
    - entitlements
    - memberships
    - notifications

  start:
    command: commerce.checkout.confirmed

  success:
    - membership_active

  failure:
    - payment_failed
    - activation_failed
    - manual_intervention

  steps:
    - code: verify-payment
      owner: commerce
      type: event_wait
      expects:
        - commerce.payment.confirmed.v1
      timeout: PT24H

    - code: activate-entitlement
      owner: entitlements
      type: command
      command: entitlement.activate_membership
      compensation: revoke-entitlement

    - code: activate-membership
      owner: memberships
      type: command
      command: membership.activate
      compensation: expire-membership

    - code: notify-user
      owner: notifications
      type: command
      command: notification.send_membership_activated
      required: false
```

# 十、流程注册规则

每个 Blocker/Critical 流程必须声明：

```text
业务负责人
参与模块
业务起点
所有合法终态
每个步骤的所属模块
每个步骤的前置与后置条件
超时
重试

```

# 十四、Skill 24.3：`vav-state-machine-verification`

## 目标

静态和动态验证领域状态机的完整性。

## 14.1 静态验证

检查：

```text
Initial State 是否存在
所有转换引用的状态是否存在
是否存在不可达状态
是否存在无出口非终态
是否存在没有权限声明的转换
是否存在没有幂等策略的高风险命令
是否存在没有并发策略的共享资源转换
是否存在没有超时的等待状态
是否存在没有最终处理的 Manual Review
```

## 14.2 图验证

建立有向图：

```text
State
→ Transition
→ State
```

检测：

```text
Reachability
Strongly Connected Components
Terminal Reachability
Dead-end States
Unbounded Cycles
Unsafe Backward Transitions
```

合法循环示例：

```text
ACTIVE
→ PAUSED
→ ACTIVE
```

危险循环示例：

```text
RETRYING
→ FAILED
→ RETRYING
```

如果没有：

```text
最大重试次数
Backoff
人工处理终态
```

则应阻断发布。

## 14.3 动态验证

使用合成实例执行：

```text
所有合法转换
所有非法转换
重复转换
并发转换
超时转换
安全限制转换
```

## 14.4 状态机验证结果

```sql
CREATE TABLE state_machine_verification_runs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    state_machine_definition_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES state_machine_definitions(id),

    release_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    reachable_states JSONB NOT NULL,
    unreachable_states JSONB NOT NULL,
    dead_end_states JSONB NOT NULL,
    unsafe_cycles JSONB NOT NULL,

    invariant_results JSONB NOT NULL,
    transition_test_results JSONB NOT NULL,

    evidence_id UUID,

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

# 十五、状态不变量

状态机必须支持声明：

```yaml
invariants:
  - code: ORDER-PAID-REQUIRES-CONFIRMED-PAYMENT
    when:
      state: paid
    assert:
      paymentStatus: confirmed

  - code: CONTACT-GRANT-REQUIRES-MUTUAL-CONSENT
    when:
      state: active
    assert:
      bothUsersConsented: true

  - code: BLOCKED-PAIR-HAS-NO-ACTIVE-CONTACT-GRANT
    when:
      pairBlocked: true
    assert:
      activeContactGrantCount: 0
```

Batch 25 将使用这些不变量执行跨模块数据验证。

# 十八、Skill 24.5：`vav-cross-module-saga-runtime`

## 目标

提供数据库持久化、可重试、可恢复的 Saga Runtime。

不引入新的外部工作流产品依赖，第一版基于：

```text
PostgreSQL
Transactional Outbox
Redis/Celery
Distributed Lock
Scheduler
```

实现。

## 18.1 Saga 定义

```sql
CREATE TABLE saga_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    saga_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

        REFERENCES process_definitions(id),

    retry_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    cancellation_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    compensation_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(saga_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 18.2 Saga 实例

```sql
CREATE TABLE saga_instances (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    saga_definition_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES saga_definitions(id),

    process_instance_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE
        REFERENCES process_instances(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    current_step_code VARCHAR(128),

    context_encrypted JSONB NOT NULL,
    context_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    deadline TIMESTAMPTZ,

    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    last_progress_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

```

## 18.3 Saga 步骤执行

```sql
CREATE TABLE saga_step_executions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    saga_instance_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES saga_instances(id),

    step_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    execution_number INTEGER NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    command_code VARCHAR(128),
    command_execution_id UUID,

    expected_event_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    received_event_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    input_hash VARCHAR(128),
    output_snapshot_encrypted JSONB,

    next_retry_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

        saga_instance_id,

    )

# 十九、Saga 执行原则

```text
每个步骤只调用拥有该领域的模块
每个步骤有稳定 Idempotency Key
步骤结果可重放
等待事件使用 Inbox 去重
步骤成功后持久化再推进
步骤失败不覆盖已成功步骤
补偿按已完成步骤逆序执行
```

## Idempotency Key

```text
saga:{saga_instance_id}:step:{step_code}:execution:{n}
```

---

# 二十、Saga 编排示例：辅导预约

```text
创建预约请求
→ 预留导师时段
→ 创建付款邀请
→ 等待支付确认
→ 消费辅导 Entitlement/Credit
→ 确认预约
→ 创建会议链接
→ 创建提醒
```

失败补偿：

```text
支付前取消
→ 释放时段

支付已确认但预约确认失败
→ 保留支付事实
→ 重试预约确认
→ 超过阈值进入人工处理
→ 必要时走退款流程
```

不能直接把已确认支付改回未支付。

---

# 二十一、Saga 编排示例：隐私删除

```text
重新认证
→ 生成删除影响计划
→ 用户确认
→ 检查退款/争议/Legal Hold
→ 禁止新业务写入
→ 各模块执行删除或匿名化
→ 清除缓存
→ 清除搜索和向量
→ 清除对象存储
→ 验证
→ 完成
```

部分失败：

```text
已完成模块不重复破坏
失败模块可重试
Legal Hold 数据保持
所有结果进入删除报告
```

---

# 二十二、Saga 编排示例：Skill 安装

```text
验证签名
→ 解析依赖
→ 权限审批
→ 配置校验
→ 备份旧状态
→ 安装依赖
→ 运行迁移
→ 注册事件
→ 注册定时任务
→ 部署 Runtime
→ 健康检查
→ 激活
```

失败：

```text
撤销新事件订阅
停止新 Runtime
恢复旧版本
保留不可逆迁移说明
状态 FAILED 或 MANUAL_INTERVENTION
```

## 目标

统一错误分类、重试、超时、过期和取消语义。

## 23.1 异常分类

```python
class ProcessFailureCategory(StrEnum):
    VALIDATION = "validation"
    AUTHORIZATION = "authorization"
    BUSINESS_CONFLICT = "business_conflict"
    DUPLICATE = "duplicate"
    CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT = "concurrency_conflict"
    DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE = "dependency_unavailable"
    PROVIDER_FAILURE = "provider_failure"
    TIMEOUT = "timeout"
    EVENT_MISSING = "event_missing"
    EVENT_OUT_OF_ORDER = "event_out_of_order"
    DATA_INCONSISTENCY = "data_inconsistency"
    SECURITY_RESTRICTION = "security_restriction"
    PRIVACY_RESTRICTION = "privacy_restriction"

```

## 23.2 重试策略

```python
class ProcessRetryMode(StrEnum):
    NEVER = "never"
    IMMEDIATE = "immediate"
    EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF = "exponential_backoff"
    FIXED_DELAY = "fixed_delay"
    MANUAL = "manual"
```

不得重试：

```text
权限失败
校验失败
明确业务冲突
已生效安全限制
不可重放外部副作用
```

可以重试：

```text
临时 Provider 超时
数据库短暂连接失败
幂等事件发布失败
幂等通知发送失败
```

## 23.3 Timeout Policy

```json
{
  "timeout_seconds": 300,
  "on_timeout": "compensate",
  "maximum_extension_count": 0,
  "safe_user_message_code": "PROCESS_TIMED_OUT"
}
```

# 二十四、取消模型

## 24.1 Cancel Request

```sql
CREATE TABLE process_cancellation_requests (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    process_instance_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES process_instances(id),

    requested_by_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    requested_by_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    reason_code VARCHAR(128),
    private_reason_encrypted TEXT,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    expected_process_version INTEGER NOT NULL,

    requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    rejected_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    rejection_code VARCHAR(128),

    idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(process_instance_id, idempotency_key)
);
```

## 24.2 取消规则

```text
尚未执行副作用
→ 直接取消

已执行可补偿副作用
→ 进入补偿

已发生不可逆事实
→ 创建相应业务反向流程

安全取消
→ 可以跳过普通确认
→ 立即停止危险接触
```

## 24.3 并发优先级

建议：

```text
安全冻结
优先于普通操作

已确认支付
优先于用户页面取消显示

已完成关系结束
优先于并发恢复

已创建屏蔽
优先于并发互动
```

具体优先级必须由所属领域状态机声明。

# 二十六、补偿原则

## 可自动补偿

```text
释放库存预留
释放预约时段
释放配额预留
撤销尚未使用的临时 Token
取消尚未发送的通知
撤销未使用权益
```

## 需要领域反向流程

```text
已确认支付
→ 退款流程

已完成签到
→ 保留签到事实，记录纠正

已发送联系方式
→ 撤销未来访问，无法保证删除线下保存内容

已发送邮件
→ 无法撤回，发送更正通知
```

## 需要人工审核

```text
部分退款
安全错误处置补偿
数据删除错误恢复
不可逆数据库迁移
第三方 Provider 状态不明
```

---

# 二十七、补偿失败

```text
COMPENSATING
→ COMPENSATION_FAILED
→ MANUAL_INTERVENTION
```

不得：

```text
无限自动重试
静默忽略
把原始流程标记为成功
```

补偿失败必须生成：

```text
管理端任务
告警
审计
用户安全状态说明边界
```

---

# 二十八、Skill 24.8：`vav-idempotency-concurrency-ordering`

## 目标

统一跨流程的幂等、并发控制和事件顺序策略。

## 28.1 Idempotency Policy

```python
class ProcessIdempotencyScope(StrEnum):
    USER_OPERATION = "user_operation"
    BUSINESS_ENTITY = "business_entity"
    SAGA_STEP = "saga_step"
    EVENT_CONSUMER = "event_consumer"
    PROVIDER_CALLBACK = "provider_callback"
```

每个 Command 必须声明：

```text
Idempotency Key 来源
有效期

重复返回行为

```

## 28.2 并发控制模式

```python
class ProcessConcurrencyMode(StrEnum):
    OPTIMISTIC_LOCK = "optimistic_lock"
    PESSIMISTIC_LOCK = "pessimistic_lock"
    UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT = "unique_constraint"
    ATOMIC_COUNTER = "atomic_counter"
    ADVISORY_LOCK = "advisory_lock"
    SERIALIZED_QUEUE = "serialized_queue"
```

## 28.3 典型选择

```text
档案编辑
→ Optimistic Lock

双方同时喜欢
→ Canonical Pair Lock + Unique Constraint

最后一个配额
→ Atomic Conditional Update

单个 Scheduler
→ Advisory Lock

同一订单 Provider Webhook
→ Inbox Dedupe + Order Lock
```

## 28.4 事件顺序

事件 Envelope：

```python
class OrderedDomainEventEnvelope(BaseModel):
    event_id: UUID
    event_type: str
    event_version: int

    aggregate_type: str
    aggregate_id: UUID
    aggregate_version: int

    sequence_number: int
    occurred_at: datetime
```

消费者处理：

```text
重复 Sequence
→ 忽略

下一 Sequence
→ 应用

未来 Sequence
→ 暂存并等待缺失事件

旧版本事件
→ 按兼容策略处理
```

不能假设消息队列始终严格有序。

# 三十、Skill 24.9：`vav-stuck-state-manual-intervention`

## 目标

发现超过 SLA、缺失事件、循环重试、补偿失败和状态漂移流程。

## 30.1 卡死发现

```sql
CREATE TABLE stuck_process_findings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    process_instance_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES process_instances(id),

    saga_instance_id UUID REFERENCES saga_instances(id),

    finding_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    expected_progress_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    evidence_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    auto_recovery_action VARCHAR(128),
    manual_action_code VARCHAR(128),

    assigned_to UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    resolution_summary TEXT,

    UNIQUE(
        process_instance_id,
        finding_type,
        detected_at
    )
);
```

## 30.2 Finding Type

```python
class StuckProcessFindingType(StrEnum):
    STATE_SLA_EXCEEDED = "state_sla_exceeded"
    PROCESS_SLA_EXCEEDED = "process_sla_exceeded"
    EXPECTED_EVENT_MISSING = "expected_event_missing"
    REPEATED_RETRY = "repeated_retry"
    DEAD_LETTER_PRESENT = "dead_letter_present"
    COMPENSATION_FAILED = "compensation_failed"
    MANUAL_TASK_OVERDUE = "manual_task_overdue"
    ORPHAN_PROCESS = "orphan_process"
    BUSINESS_STATE_DRIFT = "business_state_drift"
    PROVIDER_STATE_UNKNOWN = "provider_state_unknown"
```

## 30.3 卡死检测规则

```text
当前步骤超过 timeout_at
流程超过 process_deadline
last_progress_at 超过阈值
预期事件未收到
重试次数超过限制
存在关联 Dead Letter
Saga 与领域状态不一致
人工任务超过 SLA
补偿长时间未完成
```

---

# 三十一、自动恢复边界

允许自动：

```text
重新投递幂等事件
重新运行只读校验
释放过期预留
重新同步投影
重试幂等通知
```

不允许自动：

```text
伪造支付成功
代用户接受邀请
代用户同意联系方式
解除安全限制
确认关系阶段
删除用户数据
```

---

CREATE TABLE process_manual_intervention_tasks (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    process_instance_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES process_instances(id),

    stuck_finding_id UUID REFERENCES stuck_process_findings(id),

    action_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    priority VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    safe_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    internal_context_encrypted JSONB NOT NULL,

    allowed_resolution_commands JSONB NOT NULL,

    assigned_team VARCHAR(128),
    assigned_to UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    due_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    resolution_command_code VARCHAR(128),
    resolution_reference_id UUID
);
```

管理人员只能执行预注册的修复命令，不能在页面输入任意 SQL。

# 三十四、Skill 24.10：`vav-business-process-simulator`

## 目标

使用合成数据和虚拟时间验证流程、状态机、Saga、超时与补偿。

## 34.1 Simulation Definition

```sql
CREATE TABLE process_simulation_scenarios (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    scenario_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    process_definition_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES process_definitions(id),

    initial_fixture JSONB NOT NULL,
    action_sequence JSONB NOT NULL,
    fault_injections JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    expected_terminal_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    expected_invariants JSONB NOT NULL,
    expected_compensations JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(scenario_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 34.2 Fault Injection

```python
class ProcessFaultInjectionType(StrEnum):
    COMMAND_FAILURE = "command_failure"
    EVENT_DUPLICATE = "event_duplicate"
    EVENT_DELAY = "event_delay"
    EVENT_DROP = "event_drop"
    EVENT_OUT_OF_ORDER = "event_out_of_order"
    PROVIDER_TIMEOUT = "provider_timeout"
    WORKER_CRASH = "worker_crash"
    CONCURRENCY_RACE = "concurrency_race"
    SECURITY_RESTRICTION = "security_restriction"
    PRIVACY_ERASURE = "privacy_erasure"
    CLOCK_ADVANCE = "clock_advance"
```

## 34.3 Test Clock

模拟必须支持：

```text
订单过期
邀请过期
会员周期结束
配额重置
人工任务 SLA
证据保留到期
```

不使用真实等待时间。

## 34.4 模型化测试

从状态机 Manifest 自动生成：

```text
合法转换序列
非法转换序列
重复转换
终态后转换
暂停/恢复循环
取消竞争
```

# 三十五、属性测试

关键不变量：

```text
支付未确认时权益永不 ACTIVE
屏蔽存在时 Contact Grant 永不 ACTIVE
互选只创建一条
配额永不为负数
关系结束后不能恢复原 Journey
