# 四十七、Skill 27.10：`vav-support-knowledge-base`

## 目标

建立用户自助帮助和客服操作知识库。

Batch 23 已建立帮助文章与支持请求，本 Skill 在此基础上增加：

```text
客服 Playbook
诊断决策树
升级规则
已知问题
临时解决方案
版本适用范围
```

## 47.1 Support Playbook

```sql
CREATE TABLE support_playbooks (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    playbook_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    category_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    applicable_product_versions JSONB NOT NULL,
    applicable_status_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    diagnostic_steps JSONB NOT NULL,
    resolution_steps JSONB NOT NULL,
    escalation_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    required_admin_capabilities JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    sensitivity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    review_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    owner_team VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    next_review_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(playbook_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 47.2 Known Issue

```sql
CREATE TABLE support_known_issues (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    issue_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,

    affected_versions JSONB NOT NULL,
    affected_modules JSONB NOT NULL,

    severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    user_safe_description TEXT NOT NULL,
    internal_diagnostic_summary_encrypted TEXT,

    workaround TEXT,
    resolution_release VARCHAR(64),

    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

---

# 四十八、支持知识类型

```text
用户帮助文章
客服问题判断
后台诊断步骤
已知问题
临时解决方案
升级模板
Runbook 链接
状态说明
```

## 支持升级路径

```text
普通使用问题
→ 客服

支付和退款
→ Commerce Operations

隐私请求
→ Privacy Team

举报和安全
→ Trust & Safety

流程卡死
→ Process Operations

数据差异
→ Data Operations

生产故障
→ System Operations
```

客服不得使用普通支持工单代替安全举报或隐私权利请求。

---

# 四十九、知识库质量要求

每篇内容必须具备：

```text
适用版本
适用角色
适用状态
负责人
最后复核时间
下一次复核时间
关联页面
关联业务能力
关联升级路径
```

过期内容自动标记：

```text
review_required
```

高风险过期内容停止作为推荐答案。

# 五十、Skill 27.11：`vav-functional-usability-certification`

## 目标

为每个业务域生成真实功能可用性认证。

## 50.1 Certification

```sql
CREATE TABLE functional_usability_certifications (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    business_domain VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    release_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    environment VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    required_role_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    verified_role_count INTEGER NOT NULL,

    critical_uat_pass_ratio NUMERIC(6,5) NOT NULL,
    compatibility_pass_ratio NUMERIC(6,5) NOT NULL,
    localization_pass_ratio NUMERIC(6,5) NOT NULL,

    draft_recovery_passed BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    notification_validation_passed BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    import_export_validation_passed BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    support_coverage_passed BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

    open_blocker_usability_issues INTEGER NOT NULL,
    open_major_usability_issues INTEGER NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    evidence_ids JSONB NOT NULL,

    certified_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    certified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(
        business_domain,
        release_version,
        environment
    )
);
```

---

# 五十一、认证维度

```text
目标角色存在
角色权限正确
Critical UAT 通过
核心浏览器通过
核心设备通过
目标语言通过
草稿和恢复通过
通知内容和链接通过
导入导出通过
帮助和客服路径通过
Blocker 易用性问题为零
```

# 五十二、可用性认证状态

```python
class FunctionalUsabilityStatus(StrEnum):
    NOT_EVALUATED = "not_evaluated"
    FAILED = "failed"
    PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS = "passed_with_warnings"
    PASSED = "passed"
```

以下只能判为 `FAILED`：

```text
任一 Critical UAT 失败
核心浏览器无法完成关键任务
核心移动设备无法完成关键任务
支付或安全文案产生误导
草稿恢复导致敏感数据泄漏
通知链接进入错误用户或错误实体
导入静默破坏数据
帮助系统错误引导安全或隐私请求
```

# 六十一、Makefile

```makefile
usability-migrate:
	docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head

usability-seed:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.seed_usability

usability-sync:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.sync_usability_manifests

uat-scenario-check:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.check_uat_scenarios

synthetic-data-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/usability/synthetic_data -q

demo-environment-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/usability/demo -q

compatibility-test:
	pnpm exec playwright test tests/usability/compatibility

localization-qa:
	pnpm exec node scripts/usability/localization-qa.mjs

draft-recovery-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/usability/drafts -q
	pnpm exec playwright test tests/usability/draft-recovery

notification-content-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/usability/notifications -q

import-export-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/usability/import_export -q

uat-user-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test e2e/uat-user

uat-admin-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test e2e/uat-admin

usability-security-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/usability/security -q

usability-evidence-build:
	./scripts/usability/build-usability-evidence.sh

functional-usability-verify:
	$(MAKE) usability-migrate
	$(MAKE) usability-seed
	$(MAKE) usability-sync
	$(MAKE) uat-scenario-check
	$(MAKE) synthetic-data-test
	$(MAKE) demo-environment-test
	$(MAKE) compatibility-test
	$(MAKE) localization-qa
	$(MAKE) draft-recovery-test
	$(MAKE) notification-content-test
	$(MAKE) import-export-test
	$(MAKE) uat-user-e2e
	$(MAKE) uat-admin-e2e
	$(MAKE) usability-security-test
	$(MAKE) usability-evidence-build
```

# 六十三、必须通过的角色化 UAT 场景

```text
每个 Critical 用户角色有 UAT 场景
每个 Critical 管理角色有 UAT 场景
场景具有明确前置条件
场景使用合成数据
每个步骤有 UI 与业务状态期望
失败步骤产生问题记录
UAT 通过需要独立复核
Release 变化可以使旧 UAT 失效
```

---

# 六十四、必须通过的合成数据场景

```text
相同 Seed 生成相同关系结构
所有实体引用完整
不使用真实用户数据
不生成可投递真实联系方式
包含长文本和边界值
包含异常状态
包含多语言用户
数据可以完整清理
合成数据不会进入生产
```

---

# 六十五、必须通过的 Demo 环境场景

```text
Demo 与生产网络隔离
Fake Payment 不产生真实扣款
通知不真实外发
所有页面显示 Demo 标识
演示账号可正常登录
场景启动器生成合法领域状态
一键重置可重复执行
Demo 数据按 TTL 清理
```

---

# 六十六、必须通过的兼容性场景

```text
核心桌面浏览器可以完成 Critical 旅程
核心移动浏览器可以完成 Critical 旅程
触摸设备可以完成表单
键盘可以完成关键流程
浏览器前进后退不破坏状态
网络中断有明确反馈
恢复联网后可以继续允许的流程
浏览器差异不会绕过安全检查
```

---

# 六十七、必须通过的本地化场景

```text
所有 Required Locale 无缺失 Key
所有 Placeholder 完整
支付金额与币种正确
日期和时间按用户时区显示
繁体和简体内容不混用
英文长文本不截断关键操作
安全和隐私文案经人工复核
Fallback 不泄漏内部 Key
伪本地化页面无关键溢出
```

---

# 六十八、必须通过的草稿恢复场景

```text
Autosave 显示保存状态
页面刷新后草稿可以恢复
重新登录后允许的草稿可以恢复
跨设备草稿按政策可恢复
离线期间输入不静默丢失
版本冲突不自动覆盖
旧 Schema 草稿可迁移或安全提示
密码和支付敏感字段不保存
草稿过期后正确清理
用户可以主动删除草稿
```

---

# 六十九、必须通过的通知内容场景

```text
模板变量完整
多语言渲染正确
金额、日期和状态正确
Deep Link 指向正确实体
跨用户链接被拒绝
过期操作进入安全 Fallback
状态变化后显示当前事实
安全通知不泄露举报者
渠道文案语义一致
Critical 失效链接数量为零
```

---

# 七十、必须通过的导入导出场景

```text
模板版本可识别
上传后可以预览
未知列有明确处理
Dry Run 不写入数据
行级错误可以定位
部分成功结果清楚
重复导入保持幂等
导入可暂停和恢复
导出范围可预览
敏感字段正确脱敏
下载链接短时有效
过期文件自动删除
CSV Formula Injection 被处理
```

---

# 七十一、必须通过的支持知识库场景

```text
关键用户旅程有帮助文章
关键异常有客服 Playbook
文章与产品版本匹配
过期内容进入复核
支付问题正确升级

# 七十三、Batch 27 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-27/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-27-uat-usability-certification
description: Implement role-based UAT, synthetic test data, safe demo environments, browser and device compatibility, localization QA, draft recovery, notification validation, import/export usability, support knowledge and functional-usability certification.
---

# Goal

Build the platform-wide functional-usability and UAT layer containing:

- versioned UAT roles;
- role-specific UAT scenarios;
- step-level UI, business, data and notification expectations;
- reproducible synthetic-data blueprints;
- edge-case and abnormal-state fixtures;
- isolated demonstration environments;
- safe fake external providers;
- browser, device, viewport and network compatibility matrices;
- multilingual and locale-specific QA;
- high-risk content review;
- secure form drafts;
- Autosave, conflict handling and draft migration;
- notification-content and action validation;
- user-friendly data imports and exports;
- guided usability studies;
- user and support-agent knowledge bases;
- known-issue management;
- functional-usability certification;
- UAT, compatibility and usability release gates.

# Product boundary

This batch validates whether target roles can use the implemented platform.

It does not replace domain-state validation, security testing, performance
testing or legal review. It must use synthetic data and must not introduce
real external side effects into Demo or UAT environments.

# Prerequisites

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batches 1 through 26.
3. Run `make quality-verify`.
4. Run `make ui-verify`.
5. Run `make experience-verify`.
6. Run `make process-verify`.
7. Run `make data-integrity-verify`.
8. Run `make admin-completeness-verify`.
9. Inventory all critical user and administrator roles.
10. Inventory all critical journeys and error paths.
11. Produce `docs/usability/uat-standard.md`.
12. Produce `docs/usability/synthetic-data-standard.md`.
13. Produce `docs/usability/browser-support-policy.md`.
14. Produce `docs/usability/localization-qa-standard.md`.
15. Produce `docs/usability/draft-recovery-policy.md`.
16. Produce `docs/usability/import-export-standard.md`.
17. Produce `docs/usability/support-knowledge-standard.md`.

# Required implementation order

1. UAT-role taxonomy.
2. UAT-scenario registry.
3. UAT-step contracts.
4. UAT execution and review.
5. Synthetic-data blueprints.
6. Deterministic fixture generation.
7. Real-PII detection.
8. Demo-environment isolation.
9. Demo scenario launcher.
10. Browser and device matrices.
11. Compatibility automation.
12. Localization registry.
13. Translation and placeholder checks.
14. High-risk localization review.
15. Draft definitions.
16. Autosave and recovery.
17. Draft conflict and schema migration.
18. Notification QA cases.
19. Notification action and current-state checks.
20. Import templates and Dry Runs.
21. Import row-level results.
22. Controlled exports.
23. Guided usability studies.
24. Support playbooks and known issues.
25. Domain usability certification.
26. Administration center and release gates.

# UAT invariants

- Critical roles have versioned UAT scenarios.
- Scenarios use synthetic fixtures.
- Steps define UI and authoritative business expectations.
- Critical failures create tracked issues.
- UAT execution and review are separate where required.
- Evidence binds to release, environment, browser and fixture versions.
- Old UAT results do not certify materially changed releases.

# Synthetic-data invariants

- Synthetic data contains no real user records.
- Deterministic seeds reproduce relationship structures.
- Canonical references remain valid.
- Edge, error and multilingual cases are represented.
- Generated contact details are non-deliverable.
- Synthetic data is namespace isolated.
- Cleanup is complete and verifiable.
- Synthetic data never enters production.

# Demo-environment invariants

- Demo environments are isolated from production.
- External providers are fake or capture-only.
- Real payments and real notifications are disabled.
- Demo UI is visibly identified.
- Scenario setup uses registered fixture or domain commands.
- Demo reset is repeatable.
- Demo environments expire and clean up.

# Compatibility invariants

- Support policies are versioned.
- Critical journeys run in supported desktop and mobile browsers.
- Touch, keyboard, zoom and network-interruption behavior is verified.
- Browser-specific behavior cannot bypass backend security.
- Blocker browser failures prevent certification.
- Browser and device evidence binds to concrete versions.

# Localization invariants

- Required locales have complete keys.
- Variables and placeholders remain consistent.
- Dates, times, currencies and numbers use locale-aware formatting.
- High-risk financial, privacy, safety and legal-policy content receives
  human review.
- Fallbacks do not display internal keys.
- Long and pseudo-localized content does not hide critical actions.
- Translation changes are versioned.

# Draft invariants

- Drafts have schemas and retention policies.
- Sensitive drafts are encrypted.
- Highly restricted values are not persisted in ordinary browser storage.
- Autosave reports actual save state.
- Draft conflicts do not silently overwrite newer data.
- Schema changes support migration or safe re-entry.
- Submitted, discarded and expired drafts are not restored as active.
- Users can remove eligible drafts.

# Notification invariants

- Template variables validate.
- Notification facts match authoritative state at send time.
- Actions revalidate current state when opened.
- Expired actions resolve safely.
- Links bind to the intended user and entity.
- Safety and privacy content is minimized.
- Channel-specific text may differ in length but not in meaning.
- Broken critical notification actions block release.

# Import invariants

- Templates are versioned.
- Imports provide previews and Dry Runs.
- Unknown or invalid fields are explicit.
- Row-level failures are visible.
- Duplicate handling is declared.
- Imports are idempotent.
- Partial success is reported honestly.
- Production imports are resumable and auditable.
- Import files cannot execute spreadsheet formulas unexpectedly.

# Export invariants

- Export scope and fields are previewed.
- Permissions and purposes are rechecked.
- Sensitive fields follow masking and approval policies.
- Exports preserve locale and timezone metadata.
- Restricted exports are encrypted.
- Download links expire.
- Export artifacts are automatically deleted.
- Downloads are audited.

# Usability-study invariants

- Studies have explicit objectives and tasks.
- Participants use appropriate synthetic or isolated data.
- Recording requires explicit policy and consent.
- Sensitive inputs are not captured unnecessarily.
- Task completion, errors and assistance are recorded.
- Blocker usability issues require repair and retest.
- Study findings do not infer private personality or relationship traits.

# Support-knowledge invariants

- Critical journeys have help content.
- Critical exceptions have support playbooks.
- Playbooks bind to product versions and states.
- Safety, privacy and payment issues route to specialist workflows.
- Expired content is reviewed or withdrawn.
- Support content cannot expand agent permissions.
- Known issues provide safe user communication.

# Certification invariants

- Critical domains have usability certifications.
- Certifications include roles, UAT, compatibility, localization, drafts,
  notifications, import/export and support evidence.
- Critical UAT failures fail certification.
- Core-browser blockers fail certification.
- Sensitive draft leakage fails certification.
- Notification misrouting fails certification.
- Unauthorized exports fail certification.
- Evidence binds to release and environment.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make usability-migrate
make usability-seed
make usability-sync
make uat-scenario-check
make synthetic-data-test
make demo-environment-test
make compatibility-test
make localization-qa
make draft-recovery-test
make notification-content-test
make import-export-test
make uat-user-e2e
make uat-admin-e2e
make usability-security-test
make usability-evidence-build
make functional-usability-verify
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Critical user and administrator roles are registered.
2. Critical UAT scenarios exist.
3. UAT scenarios use synthetic data.
4. UAT steps include UI and business expectations.
5. Synthetic data is deterministic and privacy safe.
6. Demo environments cannot reach production data or providers.
7. Demo reset and scenario launching work.
8. Core browser journeys pass.
9. Core mobile journeys pass.
10. Required locales pass QA.
11. High-risk translated content is reviewed.
12. Draft Autosave and recovery work.
13. Draft conflicts and schema migration work.
14. Sensitive draft leakage is zero.
15. Notification content and actions pass.
16. Cross-user notification misrouting is zero.
17. Import Dry Run and row-level errors work.
18. Export scope, masking and expiry work.
19. Usability studies can be conducted safely.
20. Critical support playbooks exist.
21. Known issues are versioned.
22. Every critical domain has usability certification.
23. User UAT E2E passes.
24. Administrator UAT E2E passes.
25. Usability security tests pass.
26. Release gates pass.
27. Evidence is registered with Batch 21.
28. `make functional-usability-verify` succeeds.
29. `make admin-completeness-verify` still succeeds.
30. `make data-integrity-verify` still succeeds.
31. `make process-verify` still succeeds.
32. `make experience-verify` still succeeds.
33. `make ui-verify` still succeeds.
34. `make quality-verify` still succeeds.
35. `make acceptance` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When a critical UAT scenario fails:

1. mark the domain certification failed;
2. preserve the exact role, fixture, browser and step evidence;
3. create a tracked usability issue;
4. repair the underlying UI, business or content defect;
5. rerun the entire affected journey;
6. do not accept a screenshot-only workaround.

When synthetic data contains suspected real PII:

1. stop the data run;
2. quarantine generated fixtures;
3. identify the generator or source;
4. delete affected data;
5. repair the generator;
6. rerun privacy validation.

When a Demo environment reaches a real provider:

1. disable the environment;
2. revoke its credentials;
3. stop pending external actions;
4. record a security incident;
5. repair provider isolation;
6. rerun Demo safety tests.

When a draft recovery conflict occurs:

1. preserve both versions;
2. prevent silent overwrite;
3. show a safe comparison;
4. require an explicit user choice where needed;
5. add a conflict regression test.

When notification content is incorrect or misrouted:

1. stop the affected template or action;
2. invalidate unsafe links;
3. identify affected recipients;
4. repair the template, state check or route;
5. add a notification QA fixture;
6. rerun channel and journey validation.

When import processing corrupts or ambiguously changes data:

1. stop the import;
2. preserve the source file and row results securely;
3. identify affected domain commands;
4. compensate or repair through registered operations;
5. strengthen preview and validation;
6. rerun the import scenario.

When support content is unsafe or outdated:

1. withdraw the content;
2. route users to the correct specialist workflow;
3. publish a corrected version;
4. identify impacted cases;
5. add a review-expiry rule.
```

# Batch 28：自动化回归平台、测试金字塔、契约测试、模型化测试、属性测试、视觉回归、Mutation Testing、Flaky Test 治理、测试数据隔离、影响分析与回归发布门禁 Skills

项目计划书要求完成前后端联调、测试、部署、文档和最终验收，并验证注册、购买、活动、课程、辅导、AI 与婚恋等完整业务流程。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

最终验收不能只运行一次手工流程，而应持续证明各模块功能可用、管理端可运营、敏感数据受保护，且完整用户旅程不存在重大安全和功能缺陷。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

Batch 21-27 已分别建立质量追踪、UI、用户旅程、业务流程、数据完整性、管理端完整性和 UAT。Batch 28 将这些分散测试统一成一个可以持续运行、自动选测、全量回归、收集证据并阻断发布的 **Regression Assurance Control Plane**。

它重点解决：

```text
测试是否真正覆盖需求、状态和异常？
修改一处代码后应该运行哪些测试？
自动选测会不会漏掉受影响模块？
重复运行是否稳定？
测试失败是产品问题还是测试本身不稳定？
测试代码能否发现真实缺陷，而不是只提高覆盖率？
并行运行时测试数据是否相互污染？
视觉快照是否被无审查地批量接受？
所有关键回归是否在发布前完整通过？
```

# 三、核心回归原则

## 3.1 测试覆盖率不是质量证明

以下指标单独都不足以证明质量：

```text
代码行覆盖率
分支覆盖率
测试数量
快照数量
通过率
```

必须结合：

```text
需求覆盖
业务状态覆盖
异常路径覆盖
并发热点覆盖
数据不变量覆盖
Mutation Score
真实旅程覆盖
```

## 3.2 重试只用于诊断，不能把失败变成通过

错误做法：

```text
测试第一次失败
第二次通过
→ CI 标记通过
```

正确做法：

```text
第一次失败
→ 当前 Run 仍标记不稳定或失败
→ 可自动重跑以收集 Flaky 证据
→ 创建 Flaky Finding
```

Critical 测试首次失败不得通过自动重试掩盖。

## 3.3 自动选测不能替代完整 Release 回归

推荐策略：

```text
Pull Request
影响测试＋强制核心 Smoke

Main Branch
全 Critical Suite

Nightly
完整测试＋浏览器矩阵＋Flaky 检测

Release Candidate
全量回归＋Mutation＋视觉＋UAT 证据

Production
非破坏性 Smoke
```

## 3.4 测试环境必须可重现

测试结果必须绑定：

```text
Git Commit
Release Version
Database Revision
Dependency Lock
Test Manifest Version
Fixture Version
Random Seed
Clock
Browser Version
Provider Fixture Version
```

## 3.5 测试失败必须可诊断

Critical 失败至少自动收集：

```text
测试日志
API Trace
浏览器截图
浏览器 Console
网络请求
相关领域事件
数据库安全摘要
Worker 日志
Fixture Seed
```

# 七、Skill 28.1：`vav-regression-test-registry`

## 目标

建立所有自动化测试的机器可读注册表，关联需求、能力、状态、风险和执行策略。

## 7.1 Test Suite

```sql
CREATE TABLE regression_test_suites (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    suite_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    display_name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    owning_team VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    test_level VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    default_criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    runner_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_location VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,

    execution_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    resource_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    evidence_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(suite_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 7.2 Test Case

```sql
CREATE TABLE regression_test_cases (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    test_case_code VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    suite_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES regression_test_suites(id),

    display_name VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,

    test_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    owning_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    owner_team VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    source_location VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
    test_selector VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,

    timeout_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,
    deterministic_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

    isolation_profile_code VARCHAR(128),
    fixture_blueprint_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    tags JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 7.3 Test Mapping

```sql
CREATE TABLE regression_test_mappings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    test_case_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES regression_test_cases(id),

    target_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    target_code VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,

    mapping_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(test_case_id, target_type, target_code, mapping_type)
);
```

Target Type：

```text
requirement
capability
business_flow
state
transition
api
event
permission
data_invariant
page
risk
incident
```

# 八、测试 Manifest

每个测试 Suite 提供：

```text
test-manifest.yaml
```

示例：

```yaml
apiVersion: regression.vav.io/v1
kind: TestSuite

metadata:
  code: commerce-payment-regression
  version: 1.0.0

spec:
  level: module_integration
  owner: commerce-team
  runner: pytest

  source:
    path: services/api/tests/commerce/payment

  defaults:
    criticality: blocker
    timeoutSeconds: 120
    isolationProfile: postgres-redis-provider

  mappings:
    requirements:
      - REQ-VAV-COMMERCE-PAYMENT-CONFIRMATION

    capabilities:
      - CAP-COMMERCE-CONFIRM-PAYMENT

    invariants:
      - PAYMENT-CONFIRMED-BACKS-ENTITLEMENT

  execution:
    pr: impacted
    main: always
    release: always
```

# 九、测试注册不变量

每个 Critical Test 必须声明：

```text
稳定 Test Case Code
负责人
所属模块
Criticality
超时
测试数据 Profile
隔离 Profile
需求或风险映射
执行策略
失败证据策略
```

禁止：

```text
没有 Owner 的 Critical Test
仅靠文件名推断测试目的
同一测试代码重复注册
测试被删除但需求映射仍存在
```

class RegressionTestLifecycleStatus(StrEnum):

# 十一、Skill 28.2：`vav-test-pyramid-governance`

## 目标

定义各层测试职责，避免全部依赖慢速 E2E，也避免只有 Unit Test。

## 11.1 Static Checks

覆盖：

```text
Format
Lint
Type Check
Manifest Validation
Migration Graph
Secret Scan
Contract Schema
Dependency Rules
```

## 11.2 Domain Unit Tests

覆盖：

```text
领域规则
值对象
状态转换
价格计算
配额计算
推荐约束
权限纯函数
补偿选择
```

要求：

```text
快速
无网络
无真实数据库
确定性
```

## 11.3 Application Service Tests

覆盖：

```text
命令编排
Repository 调用
Outbox 写入
权限调用
错误映射
```

使用 Fake Repository 或明确测试替身。

## 11.4 Vue Component Tests

覆盖：

```text
Props
Slots
Events
表单交互
Loading
Error
Disabled
权限视图
可访问性
```

## 11.5 Contract Tests

验证模块边界，不验证完整业务旅程。

## 11.6 Integration Tests

验证：

```text
真实 PostgreSQL
真实 Redis
真实 MinIO
Outbox/Inbox
Repository
Worker
```

外部 Provider 默认使用受控 Fake。

## 11.7 E2E

仅用于证明：

```text
浏览器
前端
API
数据
事件
Worker
最终用户可见结果
```

形成真实闭环。

---

# 十二、测试比例不是固定百分比

不强制：

```text
70% Unit
20% Integration
10% E2E
```

而是要求每种风险在最合适层得到验证。

例如：

```text
价格计算
主要由 Unit 验证

支付 Webhook 幂等
由 Integration 验证

付款到权益开通
由 Cross-module E2E 验证

页面布局
由 Component 和 Visual 验证
```

---

# 十三、测试层缺口检测

自动检查：

```text
Critical 领域规则没有 Unit Test
Critical API 没有 Contract Test
Critical Event 没有 Producer/Consumer Test
Critical 业务流没有 E2E
Critical 状态转换没有模型化测试
Critical 并发热点没有并发测试
```

检测结果写入 Batch 21 Quality Gap。

CREATE TABLE regression_contract_test_definitions (

    verification_command VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,

    criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(
        contract_code,
        contract_version,
        producer_code,
        consumer_code
    )
);
```

## 14.2 OpenAPI Contract

验证：

```text
Operation ID 稳定
Request Schema
Response Schema
Error Schema
权限 Metadata
Idempotency Header
Pagination Contract
Sensitive-field Annotation
```

## 14.3 Breaking Change

阻断：

```text
删除 Endpoint
删除 Response 字段
可选字段变必填
错误代码含义改变
分页语义改变
敏感字段新增但未分类
```

# 十五、Consumer-driven Contract

Consumer 提供：

```yaml
consumer:
  code: user-web-order-detail

provider:
  code: commerce-api

interactions:
  - description: read paid order
    request:
      method: GET
      path: /api/v1/orders/{order_id}

    expected:
      status: 200
      body:
        status: paid
        currency: CNY
```

Provider CI 必须验证当前实现仍满足活跃 Consumer 契约。

Consumer 契约不能要求访问未经授权字段。

---

# 十六、事件契约测试

验证：

```text
Producer Payload 符合 Schema
Consumer 支持当前版本
新增可选字段不破坏旧 Consumer
Aggregate Version 正确
Sequence Number 正确
敏感内容没有进入 Metadata
```

Producer 和 Consumer Fixture 必须来自同一契约版本。

---

# 十七、Command Contract Test

验证 Batch 24 Command：

```text
Input Schema
Precondition
Postcondition
Idempotency
Expected Events
Safe Error Codes
Authorization
```

例如：

```text
commerce.confirm_payment

重复执行
→ 返回 already_applied
→ 不产生第二个 Entitlement
```

---

# 十八、Notification Contract Test

验证：

```text
模板需要的变量
领域事件实际提供的字段
目标 Route
Route 参数
Fallback
当前状态重解析
```

防止业务事件改字段后通知模板运行时才失败。

---

# 十九、Import/Export Contract

验证：

```text
模板 Schema
列名
数据类型
错误代码
导出字段
脱敏状态
文件版本
```

---

# 二十、Skill 28.4：`vav-integration-test-harness`

## 目标

提供统一、可并行、可重置、可注入故障的集成测试环境。

## 20.1 Isolation Profile

```sql
CREATE TABLE regression_isolation_profiles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    profile_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    redis_strategy VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    clock_strategy VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

);

## 20.2 推荐 Profile

```text
unit-isolated
component-browser
postgres-transaction
postgres-schema
postgres-container
postgres-redis
postgres-redis-minio
full-module
complete-platform
```

## 20.3 Database Isolation

支持：

```text
Transaction Rollback
Schema per Worker
Database per Run
Container per Suite
```

选择原则：

```text
快速 Repository Test
→ Transaction Rollback

并发测试
→ 独立 Schema 或 Database

Migration 测试
→ 独立 Database

完整 E2E
→ 独立 Namespace
```

# 二十一、Test Run Namespace

```python
class TestRunNamespace(BaseModel):

    worker_id: str

    redis_prefix: str
    object_prefix: str

```

test_run_4f8a_shard_03_worker_02

统一实现：

Fake Payment

成功

部分成功

# 二十五、清理验证

测试结束后检查：

```text
数据库 Schema 已删除

Fake Provider 队列为空
测试用户已清理
测试任务无残留

发现残留时，当前 Suite 标记：

```text
passed_with_isolation_failure
```

Release 仍不得通过。

# 二十六、Skill 28.5：`vav-model-based-state-machine-testing`

## 目标

从 Batch 24 状态机 Manifest 自动生成合法、非法、异常和并发测试路径。

## 26.1 Model Test Definition

```sql
CREATE TABLE regression_model_test_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    model_test_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    state_machine_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    state_machine_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    generation_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    invariant_codes JSONB NOT NULL,

    maximum_path_length INTEGER NOT NULL,
    maximum_generated_cases INTEGER NOT NULL,

    criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(model_test_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 26.2 生成路径

```text
Initial → Success Terminal
Initial → Failure Terminal
Initial → Cancelled Terminal
Initial → Expired Terminal
Pause → Resume
Waiting → Timeout
Allowed Transition 重复执行
Terminal → Illegal Transition
```

## 26.3 并发路径

生成：

```text
Accept Invitation || Expire Invitation
Resume Relationship || End Relationship
Consume Last Quota || Consume Last Quota
Block Pair || Create Contact Grant
Refund || Entitlement Consume
```

---

# 二十七、Model Adapter

每个领域提供：

```python
class StateMachineTestAdapter(Protocol):
    machine_code: str

    async def create_initial_fixture(
        self,
        context: ModelTestContext,
    ) -> ModelFixture:
        ...

    async def execute_transition(
        self,
        transition_code: str,
        fixture: ModelFixture,
    ) -> TransitionObservation:
        ...

    async def read_state(
        self,
        fixture: ModelFixture,
    ) -> str:
        ...
```

Process Governance 不能直接修改领域表。

---

# 二十八、模型覆盖

区别于代码覆盖：

```text
State Coverage
Transition Coverage
Terminal-state Coverage
Invalid-transition Coverage
Concurrent-transition Coverage
Timeout-path Coverage
Compensation-path Coverage
```

Critical 状态机要求：

```text
State Coverage = 100%
Transition Coverage = 100%
Critical Invalid-transition Coverage = 100%
```

---

# 二十九、反例提升

模型化测试发现最短失败路径：

```text
PENDING
→ ACCEPTED
→ EXPIRED
```

应保存为固定 Regression Fixture：

```text
tests/regression-corpus/state-machines/
```

以后不依赖随机生成才能再次发现。

# 三十、Skill 28.6：`vav-property-based-testing`

## 目标

使用生成数据验证系统不变量，并自动缩小失败案例。

Python 使用：

```text
Hypothesis 边界
```

TypeScript 使用：

```text
fast-check 边界
```

具体工具可替换，但 Test Manifest 和结果格式保持稳定。

## 30.1 Property Definition

```sql
CREATE TABLE regression_property_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    property_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    owning_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    generator_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    invariant_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,

    example_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    deadline_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,

    criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(property_code, semantic_version)
);
```

---

# 三十一、关键属性

## Commerce

```text
订单金额永不因行顺序变化
重复 Webhook 不增加权益数量
Refund 总额不超过可退款金额
```

## Capacity

```text
Confirmed Registration ≤ Capacity
Reserved Slot 不出现重复占用
```

## Matchmaking

```text
Canonical Pair 顺序稳定
同一 Pair 最多一个 Mutual Match
单向 Like 不产生 Match
Active Block 时 Contact Grant 不存在
```

## Membership

```text
Quota Available 永不为负
重复消费幂等
```

## Privacy

```text
删除完成后所有 Required Asset 均有结果
```

## Security

```text
会员权限永远不能覆盖安全限制
```

---

# 三十二、属性测试示例

```python
@given(
    allocated=st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=10_000),
    consumed=st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=10_000),
    reserved=st.integers(min_value=0, max_value=10_000),
)
def test_quota_never_reports_negative_available(
    allocated: int,
    consumed: int,
    reserved: int,
) -> None:
    state = calculate_quota_state(
        allocated=allocated,
        consumed=consumed,
        reserved=reserved,
    )

    assert state.available >= 0
```

领域实现还应拒绝：

```text
consumed + reserved > allocated + rollover
```

而不是仅在展示层将负数截为零。

---

```text
Seed
最小输入
领域版本
依赖版本
失败不变量
```

路径：

```text
tests/regression-corpus/properties/
```

Critical Counterexample 必须转为固定测试。

# 三十五、Baseline 保护

不允许：

```text
测试失败
→ 自动更新全部 Baseline
→ CI 通过

```text
关联需求或设计变更
→ 生成 Diff
→ 指定影响页面
→ UI Reviewer 审核
→ 批准新 Baseline
```

Critical 页面不能由提交代码的同一人单独批准全部 Baseline。

时间
随机数据

动画

禁止屏蔽：

```text
主要内容
操作按钮
状态标签
错误区域
表格数据
权限提示
```

# 三十七、Visual Matrix 分层

## PR 最小矩阵

```text
受影响组件
受影响页面
主语言
Desktop
Mobile
Light Theme
```

## Nightly 扩展矩阵

```text
全部 Critical 页面
所有目标语言
支持 Viewport

全部 Required Visual Cases

# 三十八、Skill 28.8：`vav-mutation-testing`

## 目标

验证测试是否能够发现实现被故意破坏后的错误。

## 38.1 Mutation Campaign

```sql
CREATE TABLE mutation_campaigns (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    campaign_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    release_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    target_paths JSONB NOT NULL,
    mutation_operator_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    total_mutants INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    killed_mutants INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    invalid_mutants INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    mutation_score NUMERIC(6,5),

);
```

## 38.2 Mutant Result

```sql
CREATE TABLE mutation_results (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    campaign_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES mutation_campaigns(id),

    operator_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    detecting_test_case_codes JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    review_status VARCHAR(32),
    reviewer_comment TEXT,

    UNIQUE(campaign_id, mutant_code)
);
```

---

# 三十九、Mutation Operators

```text
Boolean Negation
Comparison Boundary
Arithmetic Operator
Conditional Removal
Return-value Replacement
Exception Removal
Authorization Check Removal
Validation Check Removal
State Transition Replacement
Event Publish Removal
Idempotency Check Removal
```

高风险定制 Mutation：

```text
删除支付确认检查
删除双方 Consent 检查
删除 Block 检查
删除权限检查
删除配额非负检查
删除 Outbox 写入
```

---

# 四十、Mutation 运行范围

不要求每个 PR 对全仓执行完整 Mutation。

建议：

```text
PR
受影响 Critical Rule 的轻量 Mutation

Nightly
主要领域增量 Mutation

Weekly
完整 Critical Domain Campaign

Release Candidate
所有 Blocker/Critical 核心规则
```

---

# 四十一、Mutation Score

```text
Mutation Score =
Killed Mutants /
(Total Mutants - Invalid Mutants - Approved Equivalent Mutants)
```

不能通过大量标记 Equivalent 提高分数。

Equivalent Mutant 必须：

```text
有理由
有 Reviewer
有源代码位置
有到期复核边界
```

---

# 四十二、建议门槛

工程初始建议：

```text
Blocker Domain Critical Rules ≥ 90%
Critical Domain Overall ≥ 80%
Normal Domain ≥ 70%
```

更重要的门禁：

```text
任何涉及支付确认、权限、屏蔽、同意、配额非负的 Surviving Mutant = 0
```

---

# 四十三、Skill 28.9：`vav-flaky-test-governance`

## 目标

识别、分类和修复不稳定测试，避免回归体系逐渐失去可信度。

## 43.1 Flaky Finding

```sql
CREATE TABLE flaky_test_findings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    test_case_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES regression_test_cases(id),

    first_detected_run_id UUID NOT NULL,
    latest_detected_run_id UUID NOT NULL,

    failure_signature VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    flake_category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    observed_failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    observed_pass_count INTEGER NOT NULL,

    reliability_ratio NUMERIC(6,5) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    owner_team VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    assigned_to UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    remediation_due_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 43.2 Flake Category

```python
class FlakyTestCategory(StrEnum):
    TIMING = "timing"
    ORDER_DEPENDENCY = "order_dependency"
    SHARED_STATE = "shared_state"
    RANDOMNESS = "randomness"
    EXTERNAL_PROVIDER = "external_provider"
    BROWSER_RENDERING = "browser_rendering"
    RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION = "resource_exhaustion"
    CLOCK_TIMEZONE = "clock_timezone"
    EVENTUAL_CONSISTENCY = "eventual_consistency"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"
```

---

# 四十四、Flaky 检测

通过：

```text
相同 Commit 重复运行
不同顺序运行
单独运行
并行运行
不同 Shard 运行
不同时间运行
```

检测。

建议 Nightly 对历史可疑测试执行：

```text
10-30 次重复
```

Critical 测试第一次出现不一致即创建 Finding。

---

# 四十五、Quarantine 政策

允许临时 Quarantine：

```text
Normal 或低风险测试
已有替代测试
不阻断关键需求验证
有 Owner
有 SLA
```

不允许普通 Quarantine：

```text
支付
权限
隐私删除
屏蔽
联系方式
关系决定
安全限制
数据一致性
恢复
```

Critical 测试不稳定时，应修复测试或产品竞态，而不是从 Gate 移除。

---

# 四十六、测试重试规则

```text
首次执行结果
决定当前 Test Result

诊断重试
只用于判断 Flaky
```

例如：

```text
第一次 FAILED，第二次 PASSED
→ Test Result = FAILED_UNSTABLE
→ Gate 失败
```

---

# 四十七、Flaky 修复 SLA

建议：

```text
Blocker：当前 Release 前
Critical：24 小时
Major：3 个工作日
Normal：下一个迭代
```

---

# 四十八、Skill 28.10：`vav-test-data-isolation`

## 目标

确保并发测试、不同 Suite、不同 Shard 和不同 Release 之间数据完全隔离。

## 48.1 Isolation Context

```python
class TestIsolationContext(BaseModel):
    run_id: UUID
    suite_code: str
    shard_id: str
    worker_id: str

    namespace: str

    database_schema: str
    redis_prefix: str
    object_prefix: str
    email_domain: str

    clock_id: UUID
    random_seed: int
```

## 48.2 Isolation Rules

所有测试资源名称必须包含 Namespace：

```text
数据库 Schema
Redis Key
对象存储 Prefix
Fake Provider Reference
测试邮箱
事件 Correlation ID
测试文件
```

---

# 四十九、跨测试泄漏检测

测试 A 完成后检测：

```text
测试 B 能否读取 A 的用户
测试 B 能否读取 A 的 Redis
测试 B 能否读取 A 的对象
测试 B 是否收到 A 的事件
测试 B 是否收到 A 的邮件
```

任何 Cross-run Leak 均为 Blocker。

---

# 五十、测试时间

统一 Test Clock：

```python
class TestClock(Protocol):
    def now(self) -> datetime:
        ...

    def advance(self, delta: timedelta) -> None:
        ...
```

禁止核心测试直接依赖：

```python
datetime.now()
time.sleep(60)
```

应通过注入 Clock 和 Await Helper。

---

# 五十一、测试随机性

所有随机测试必须记录：

```text
Seed
Generator Version
Shrunk Counterexample
```

失败日志中给出：

```bash
TEST_RANDOM_SEED=281337 make regression-property-test
```

---

# 五十二、测试数据构建方式

优先顺序：

```text
Domain Factory
→ Synthetic Blueprint
→ Fixture API
→ Database Fixture Boundary
```

避免直接复制完整生产风格 SQL Dump。

---

运行：
受影响组件
全部 Critical Visual Matrix 边界
```

---

# 五十五、强制全量回归条件

出现以下变化时不得只运行影响测试：

```text
核心权限框架
身份与 Session
事件基础设施
数据库公共库
Outbox/Inbox
全局序列化
字段加密
隐私删除
安全 Gateway
Design Token Major
基础 Vue 组件
共享 API Client
Release 配置
```

自动升级为：

```text
Full Critical Regression
```

---

# 五十六、选测解释

CI 必须输出：

```text
为何选择这个测试
为何没有选择其他测试
哪些测试是强制项
是否升级为全量
```

避免自动选测成为不可解释黑箱。

---

# 五十七、选测安全策略

影响分析失败或依赖图不完整时：

```text
Fail Open Testing
```

即：

```text
增加测试范围
```

不能减少测试范围。

---

# 五十八、Skill 28.12：`vav-regression-orchestration-gates`

## 目标

统一创建测试计划、执行、分片、聚合、证据和发布认证。

## 58.1 Test Plan

```sql
CREATE TABLE regression_test_plans (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    plan_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    release_version VARCHAR(64),
    commit_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    trigger_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    selected_suite_ids JSONB NOT NULL,
    selected_test_case_codes JSONB NOT NULL,

    impact_snapshot_id UUID,

    environment_profile_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    execution_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## 58.2 Test Run

```sql
CREATE TABLE regression_test_runs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    test_plan_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES regression_test_plans(id),

    suite_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES regression_test_suites(id),

    shard_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    shard_count INTEGER NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    environment_namespace VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    fixture_seed BIGINT,

    total_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    passed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    failed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    skipped_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    unstable_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(test_plan_id, suite_id, shard_number)
);
```

## 58.3 Case Result

```sql
CREATE TABLE regression_test_case_results (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    test_run_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES regression_test_runs(id),

    test_case_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES regression_test_cases(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    duration_ms BIGINT,

    failure_signature VARCHAR(255),
    error_code VARCHAR(128),

    random_seed BIGINT,

    artifact_manifest JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(test_run_id, test_case_id)
);
```

# 五十九、结果状态

```python
class RegressionTestResultStatus(StrEnum):
    PASSED = "passed"
    FAILED = "failed"
    FAILED_UNSTABLE = "failed_unstable"
    SKIPPED = "skipped"
    BLOCKED = "blocked"
    TIMED_OUT = "timed_out"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR = "infrastructure_error"
    ISOLATION_FAILURE = "isolation_failure"
```

`INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR` 不等于测试通过，也不能自动忽略。

---

# 六十、测试分片

分片依据：

```text
历史执行时间
资源需求
Test Level
数据库隔离需求
浏览器类型
```

避免简单按文件数量平均，造成一个 Shard 运行 5 分钟，另一个运行 50 分钟。

---

# 六十一、Fail Fast 策略

允许：

```text
PR 非关键 Suite
明显编译错误
Manifest 错误
```

尽早停止。

Release 回归应尽量：

```text
继续执行独立 Suite
```

以一次收集更多缺陷，但 Blocker 失败仍标记最终 `NO_GO`。

# 七十三、Makefile

```makefile
regression-migrate:
	docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head

regression-seed:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.seed_regression

regression-sync:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.sync_test_manifests

regression-registry-check:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.check_test_registry

regression-pyramid-check:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.check_test_pyramid

regression-contract-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/regression/contracts -q

regression-integration-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/regression/integration -q

regression-model-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/regression/model_based -q

regression-property-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/regression/properties -q

regression-visual-test:
	pnpm exec playwright test tests/regression/visual

regression-mutation-test:
	./scripts/regression/run-mutation-campaign.sh

regression-flaky-test:
	./scripts/regression/run-flaky-detection.sh

regression-isolation-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/regression/isolation -q

regression-impact-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/regression/impact -q

regression-critical:
	./scripts/regression/run-critical-regression.sh

regression-full:
	./scripts/regression/run-full-regression.sh

regression-admin-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test e2e/admin-regression

regression-evidence-build:
	./scripts/regression/build-regression-evidence.sh

regression-verify:
	$(MAKE) regression-migrate
	$(MAKE) regression-seed
	$(MAKE) regression-sync
	$(MAKE) regression-registry-check
	$(MAKE) regression-pyramid-check
	$(MAKE) regression-contract-test
	$(MAKE) regression-integration-test
	$(MAKE) regression-model-test
	$(MAKE) regression-property-test
	$(MAKE) regression-visual-test
	$(MAKE) regression-flaky-test
	$(MAKE) regression-isolation-test
	$(MAKE) regression-impact-test
	$(MAKE) regression-critical
	$(MAKE) regression-admin-e2e
	$(MAKE) regression-evidence-build

regression-release:
	$(MAKE) regression-full
	$(MAKE) regression-mutation-test
	$(MAKE) regression-evidence-build
```

# 七十五、必须通过的 Test Registry 场景

```text
所有 Critical Test 有稳定代码
所有 Critical Test 有 Owner
所有 Critical Test 关联 Requirement 或 Risk
所有测试声明 Level 和 Type
测试被删除后映射被识别
重复 Test Code 被拒绝
未映射 Critical Requirement 被发现
测试 Manifest 与源文件一致
```

---

# 七十六、必须通过的测试金字塔场景

```text
Critical 领域规则有 Unit Test
Critical API 有 Contract Test
Critical Event 有 Producer/Consumer Test
Critical 状态机有模型化测试
Critical 业务旅程有 E2E
Critical 并发热点有并发测试
不能只依赖完整 E2E
不能只依赖行覆盖率
```

---

# 七十七、必须通过的契约测试场景

```text
OpenAPI Request/Response Schema 可验证
Breaking API Change 被发现
Event Producer 符合 Schema
Consumer 支持当前 Event Version
新增可选字段保持兼容
Command Error Contract 稳定
Notification Route Contract 正确
Import/Export Schema 版本正确
```

---

# 七十八、必须通过的模型化测试场景

```text
所有 Critical State 可达
所有 Critical Transition 被执行
非法转换被拒绝
终态后非法命令被拒绝
等待状态有超时测试
取消和完成竞态被验证
补偿路径被验证
最短 Counterexample 被保存
```

---

# 七十九、必须通过的属性测试场景

```text
配额永不为负
容量不超卖
同一 Pair 最多一个 Mutual Match
单向喜欢不产生 Match
Block 存在时无 Active Contact Grant
Payment 未确认时无 Active Entitlement
重复 Webhook 不重复产生副作用
失败 Seed 可重现
失败输入可以 Shrink
```

---

# 八十、必须通过的视觉回归场景

```text
Critical Component 有 Baseline
Critical Page 有 Desktop Baseline
Critical Page 有 Mobile Baseline
主要 Locale 有 Baseline
动态数据可重现
敏感数据不进入截图
Blocker Difference 阻断
Baseline 变化需要独立审核
批量无审查接受被禁止
```

---

# 八十一、必须通过的 Mutation 场景

```text
删除支付确认检查被测试捕获
删除权限检查被测试捕获
删除 Block 检查被测试捕获
删除双方 Consent 检查被捕获
删除配额非负检查被捕获
删除 Outbox 发布被捕获
Critical Surviving Mutant 为零
Equivalent Mutant 有独立审核
```

---

# 八十二、必须通过的 Flaky 治理场景

```text
同一 Commit 重复运行可检测不稳定
顺序依赖可检测
共享状态污染可检测
首次失败后重试不能变为通过
Critical Flaky Test 数量为零
Quarantine 需要 Owner 和到期时间
Critical 测试不能普通 Quarantine
修复后需要重复稳定性验证
```

---

# 八十三、必须通过的测试隔离场景

```text
不同 Worker 使用不同数据库 Schema
不同 Run 使用不同 Redis Prefix
不同 Run 使用不同对象 Prefix
事件不会跨 Run 消费
Fake Email 不跨 Run
清理后无残留数据
Cross-run 数据泄漏为零
固定 Seed 和 Clock 可重现
```

---

# 八十四、必须通过的影响分析场景

```text
代码变更选择正确 Unit Test
API 变更选择所有 Consumer Contract
Event 变更选择所有 Consumer
迁移变更选择 Data 和 Migration Tests
权限变更选择安全和页面测试
Design Token 变更选择视觉测试
核心基础设施变更升级为全量回归
影响图不完整时扩大测试范围
选测原因可解释
```

---

# 八十六、Regression Certification

```sql
CREATE TABLE regression_domain_certifications (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    business_domain VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    release_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    environment VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    certified_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    UNIQUE(
        business_domain,
        release_version,
        environment

# 八十七、Batch 28 主控 `SKILL.md`

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-28-regression-assurance
description: Implement the VAV automated regression platform, test pyramid, contracts, integration harness, model-based and property tests, visual regression, mutation testing, flaky-test governance, data isolation, impact analysis and release gates.
---

# Goal

Build the platform-wide regression-assurance control plane containing:

- a versioned test registry;
- stable test identifiers and ownership;
- requirement, capability, state and risk mappings;
- test-pyramid governance;
- API, event, command, Skill, notification and file contract tests;
- isolated PostgreSQL, Redis, object-storage and provider test harnesses;
- deterministic time and random inputs;
- model-based state-machine testing;
- property-based invariant testing;
- counterexample promotion;
- visual-regression orchestration;
- controlled visual baselines;
- Python and TypeScript mutation testing;
- flaky-test detection and remediation;
- test-data and resource isolation;
- Git and dependency impact analysis;
- safe impacted-test selection;
- mandatory full-suite escalation;
- sharded regression execution;
- failure-artifact collection;
- domain regression certification;
- release-blocking regression gates.

# Product boundary

This batch coordinates and governs automated verification.

It does not replace manual UAT, penetration testing, load testing or
disaster-recovery exercises. Retries, quarantines and baselines must never
be used to conceal product defects.

# Prerequisites

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batches 1 through 27.
3. Run `make quality-verify`.
4. Run `make ui-verify`.
5. Run `make experience-verify`.
6. Run `make process-verify`.
7. Run `make data-integrity-verify`.
8. Run `make admin-completeness-verify`.
9. Run `make functional-usability-verify`.
10. Inventory every existing automated test.
11. Import requirements, capabilities, states, contracts, invariants and
    risks from Batches 21 through 27.
12. Produce `docs/testing/regression-standard.md`.
13. Produce `docs/testing/test-pyramid.md`.
14. Produce `docs/testing/contract-testing.md`.
15. Produce `docs/testing/model-property-testing.md`.
16. Produce `docs/testing/mutation-policy.md`.
17. Produce `docs/testing/flaky-test-policy.md`.
18. Produce `docs/testing/test-isolation.md`.
19. Produce `docs/testing/impact-analysis.md`.

# Required implementation order

1. Test taxonomy.
2. Test-suite and test-case registry.
3. Requirement and risk mappings.
4. Test-manifest scanners.
5. Test-pyramid checks.
6. OpenAPI contract tests.
7. Event and command contract tests.
8. Integration-test Harness.
9. Fake Provider standards.
10. Test-environment leases.

13. Property generators and invariants.

27. Artifact collection.
28. Domain certification.
29. Administration center.
30. Evidence and release gates.

# Registry invariants

- Critical tests have stable identifiers.
- Critical tests have owners.
- Critical tests map to requirements, risks or business invariants.
- Test deletion preserves history and exposes missing coverage.
- Test manifests match executable selectors.
- Critical requirements without tests create quality gaps.
- Tests have explicit timeouts and isolation profiles.

# Pyramid invariants

- Domain rules have unit-level verification.
- Public module boundaries have contract tests.
- Real persistence and event behavior have integration tests.
- Critical user journeys have E2E tests.
- Critical state machines have model-based tests.
- Critical invariants have property tests.
- The system does not depend exclusively on slow E2E tests.
- Code coverage alone does not satisfy requirement coverage.

# Contract invariants

- API request, response and error contracts are versioned.
- Event producers and consumers share registered schemas.
- Command contracts validate preconditions, postconditions and idempotency.
- Breaking changes are detected before deployment.
- Consumer-driven contracts cannot request unauthorized data.
- Notification, import and export contracts remain version compatible.

# Harness invariants

- Tests use isolated namespaces.
- Database, Redis, object and provider resources are isolated.
- Fake Providers support success, failure, delay and duplicate scenarios.
- Test time and random inputs are controllable.
- Environment cleanup is verified.
- Infrastructure failures are not reported as passing product tests.
- Test fixtures contain no real user data.

# Model-testing invariants

- Models derive from active state-machine manifests.
- Critical states and transitions are covered.
- Illegal transitions are tested.
- Terminal-state behavior is tested.
- Timeout, cancellation and concurrency paths are generated.
- Counterexamples are minimized and promoted to fixed regression tests.
- Process Governance never directly mutates domain state for testing.

# Property-testing invariants

- Critical business invariants have generators.
- Property runs use reproducible seeds.
- Failures shrink to minimal examples.
- Minimal counterexamples enter the permanent corpus.
- Tests cover idempotency, uniqueness, capacity, quota, consent, block and
  payment invariants.
- Generators do not produce unsafe real-world external effects.

# Visual-regression invariants

- Critical components and pages have approved baselines.
- Baselines bind to viewports, locales, themes and fixtures.
- Dynamic data is stabilized without hiding meaningful regions.
- Sensitive data does not enter screenshots.
- Blocker differences fail the release.
- Baseline changes require review.
- Authors cannot silently mass-approve their own critical baseline changes.

# Mutation invariants

- Mutation campaigns target critical domain and security rules.
- Surviving authorization, payment, consent, block and quota mutants are not
  allowed.
- Equivalent-mutant claims require review.
- Mutation scores exclude only validated invalid or equivalent mutants.
- Mutation failures identify missing tests or untestable design.
- Full mutation campaigns run for release candidates.

# Flaky-test invariants

- First-run failures remain failures.
- Diagnostic retries do not convert failure into success.
- Flaky tests are detected across repeated and reordered runs.
- Critical flaky tests block release.
- Quarantines have owners, reasons and expiry.
- Critical privacy, safety, payment and integrity tests cannot be ordinarily
  quarantined.
- Resolved flaky tests pass repeated stability verification.

# Isolation invariants

- Runs, shards and workers use unique namespaces.
- Database, Redis, objects, providers and events cannot leak across runs.
- Cleanup is verifiable.
- Cross-run data leakage is a release blocker.
- Time and randomness are explicit.
- Test data comes from domain factories or synthetic blueprints.

# Impact-analysis invariants

- Impact analysis uses code and product traceability.
- API changes select consumer contracts.
- Event changes select producers and all consumers.
- Migration changes select data and persistence suites.
- Permission changes select security and UI authorization suites.
- Core-platform changes escalate to full regression.
- Missing impact information increases rather than decreases test scope.
- Selected tests have human-readable explanations.
- Release candidates always run the required full suite.

# Orchestration invariants

- Test plans bind to commits and environments.
- Shards preserve test identities.
- Results distinguish product failure, instability, timeout, infrastructure
  error and isolation failure.
- Critical failures collect diagnostic artifacts.
- Artifacts are minimized and protected.
- Test results and evidence are reproducible.
- Regression certification cannot override security, data, process or UAT
  failures.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make regression-migrate
make regression-seed
make regression-sync
make regression-registry-check
make regression-pyramid-check
make regression-contract-test
make regression-integration-test
make regression-model-test
make regression-property-test
make regression-visual-test
make regression-mutation-test
make regression-flaky-test
make regression-isolation-test
make regression-impact-test
make regression-critical
make regression-full
make regression-admin-e2e
make regression-evidence-build
make regression-verify
make regression-release
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Critical tests are registered.
2. Critical requirements map to executable tests.
3. Test-pyramid gaps are detected.
4. API and event contracts are verified.
5. Breaking contracts are blocked.
6. Integration Harness provides real infrastructure boundaries.
7. Test environments are isolated.
8. State-machine model tests work.
9. Critical transition coverage is complete.
10. Property tests validate critical invariants.
11. Counterexamples are reproducible.
12. Critical visual baselines exist.
13. Visual baseline governance works.
14. Mutation campaigns run.
15. Critical surviving mutants are zero.
16. Flaky tests are detected.
17. Critical flaky tests are zero.
18. Diagnostic retries do not hide failures.
19. Cross-run data leaks are zero.
20. Impact analysis selects relevant tests.
21. Core changes escalate to full regression.
22. Release candidates run full regression.
23. Failure artifacts are collected.
24. Domain regression certifications are generated.
25. Regression administration E2E passes.
26. Regression release gates pass.
27. Evidence is registered with Batch 21.
28. `make regression-verify` succeeds.
29. `make regression-release` succeeds.
30. `make functional-usability-verify` still succeeds.
31. `make admin-completeness-verify` still succeeds.
32. `make data-integrity-verify` still succeeds.
33. `make process-verify` still succeeds.
34. `make experience-verify` still succeeds.
35. `make ui-verify` still succeeds.
36. `make quality-verify` still succeeds.
37. `make acceptance` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When a critical requirement has no executable test:

1. create a critical quality gap;
2. identify the appropriate test level;
3. add the test and mapping;
4. prevent regression certification;
5. do not count similarly named tests as evidence.

When a contract test fails:

1. stop incompatible publication;
2. identify producers and consumers;
3. preserve the old contract;
4. provide migration or compatibility handling;
5. rerun all consumer contracts.

When model or property testing finds a counterexample:

1. preserve the seed and minimal input;
2. classify whether the product, model or generator is wrong;
3. repair the underlying defect;
4. promote the counterexample to the fixed regression corpus;
5. rerun the affected model and property suites.

When a critical mutant survives:

1. classify the missing assertion or untestable design;
2. add or strengthen tests;
3. avoid marking it equivalent without review;
4. rerun the campaign;
5. block release until the critical survivor is killed or legitimately
   classified.

When a test is flaky:

1. keep the first-run result visible;
2. create a flaky finding;
3. preserve timing, order, environment and seed evidence;
4. fix shared state, time, eventual consistency or provider behavior;
5. verify stability across repeated runs;
6. do not hide critical flakiness with retries.

When test-data isolation fails:

1. stop affected parallel execution;
2. preserve both run namespaces;
3. clean leaked resources;
4. repair namespace or cleanup logic;
5. add a cross-run leak regression test;
6. block release until isolation succeeds.

When impact analysis is uncertain:

1. expand the selected test scope;
2. record the missing dependency or trace link;
3. run the full relevant domain suite;
4. repair the impact graph;
5. never omit tests based on an incomplete graph.

# 二、Batch 29 职责边界

## 本批负责

```text
生产负载模型
性能预算
性能测试 Harness
并发和竞态验证
数据库查询性能治理
Redis 和缓存治理
队列背压和优先级隔离
限流和容量保护
水平扩缩容验证
容量与成本预测
性能回归和发布门禁
```

## 本批不负责

```text
替代业务正确性测试
通过关闭权限检查提升性能
通过减少审计提升性能
替代完整安全测试
替代灾备演练
直接决定生产硬件采购
```

## 与前序 Batch 的关系

```text
Batch 24
定义并发热点、状态机、Saga 与补偿

Batch 25
定义数据一致性、Outbox/Inbox 和对账

Batch 28
提供回归编排、数据隔离和自动选测

Batch 29
在生产型负载和并发下验证正确性、性能与成本
```

# 三、核心性能原则

## 3.1 性能优化不能削弱业务不变量

不得为了降低延迟而：

```text
跳过权限检查
跳过屏蔽检查
跳过隐私过滤
跳过支付确认
跳过幂等检查
关闭审计
关闭 Schema 验证
```

## 3.2 关键业务正确性优先于吞吐

例如最后一个活动名额：

```text
允许部分请求得到“名额已满”
```

但不允许：

```text
为了高吞吐产生超卖
```

## 3.3 P95 不是唯一指标

还必须观察：

```text
P99
错误率
超时率
队列等待
数据库锁等待
内存
连接池
恢复时间
```

平均值不能掩盖长尾问题。

## 3.4 缓存不是业务真源

缓存不可用时：

```text
系统可以变慢
```

但不能：

```text
错误授权
错误展示联系方式
错误允许推荐
错误开通权益
```

## 3.5 降级必须有明确业务顺序

推荐降级顺序：

```text
营销推荐
→ 非关键统计
→ AI 增强功能
→ 非实时通知
```

不能优先降级：

```text
支付确认
屏蔽传播
隐私删除
安全限制
```

# 六、Skill 29.1：`vav-production-workload-model`

## 目标

把“预计会有一些用户”转化为机器可执行的生产负载模型。

## 6.1 Workload Model

```sql
CREATE TABLE performance_workload_models (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    workload_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    display_name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,

    environment_profile VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    user_distribution JSONB NOT NULL,
    traffic_distribution JSONB NOT NULL,

    concurrency_profile JSONB NOT NULL,
    background_job_profile JSONB NOT NULL,
    provider_profile JSONB NOT NULL,

    growth_assumptions JSONB NOT NULL,
    peak_event_manifest JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(workload_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 6.2 负载层级

```python
class WorkloadScale(StrEnum):
    DEVELOPMENT = "development"
    PILOT = "pilot"
    SMALL_PRODUCTION = "small_production"
    MEDIUM_PRODUCTION = "medium_production"
    LARGE_PRODUCTION = "large_production"
    STRESS_BOUNDARY = "stress_boundary"
```

## 6.3 建议首版容量场景

这些是工程初始假设，必须在真实运营数据出现后校准：

```text
Pilot
├── 1,000 注册用户
├── 100 日活
├── 20 同时在线
└── 10 RPS 峰值

Small Production
├── 20,000 注册用户
├── 2,000 日活
├── 200 同时在线
└── 100 RPS 峰值

Medium Production
├── 200,000 注册用户
├── 20,000 日活
├── 2,000 同时在线
└── 1,000 RPS 峰值
```

正式目标必须由产品和运营批准，不应把这些初始值伪装为计划书要求。

# 十、建议初始接口预算

以下属于工程初始预算，后续应按真实环境校准。

## 普通读取接口

```text
P50 ≤ 150 ms
P95 ≤ 500 ms
P99 ≤ 1,000 ms
错误率 < 0.5%
```

## 普通写接口

```text
P50 ≤ 250 ms
P95 ≤ 800 ms
P99 ≤ 1,500 ms
```

## 搜索与推荐

```text
P95 ≤ 1,500 ms
P99 ≤ 3,000 ms
```

## Checkout 创建

```text
P95 ≤ 2,000 ms
```

## AI 首 Token

```text
P95 ≤ 4,000 ms
```

AI 完整响应单独记录，不与普通 API 相同预算。

## 管理复杂查询

```text
P95 ≤ 2,000 ms
```

超过预算应采用：

```text
异步查询
分页
预计算 Projection
```

---

# 十一、旅程级预算

不仅测单接口，还测完整体验：

```text
登录完成
商品详情打开
Checkout 创建
订单状态确认
活动报名完成
辅导预约提交
婚恋档案保存
推荐列表加载
邀请接受
屏蔽生效
```

例如屏蔽：

```text
用户点击屏蔽
→ API 确认 P95 ≤ 1 秒
→ 关键访问撤销 P95 ≤ 2 秒
→ 所有异步 Projection 最终一致 ≤ 30 秒
```

安全要求应高于普通营销缓存刷新。

---

# 十二、浏览器性能预算

```text
首屏关键内容
交互可用时间
JavaScript Bundle
图片体积
路由切换
长列表渲染
```

建议初始门槛：

```text
主应用首屏压缩 JS
应分包，禁止所有后台模块进入用户端首包

关键图片
使用响应式尺寸和延迟加载

长列表
使用分页或虚拟化边界
```

具体数值由 Batch 22 UI 证据和真实设备测试校准。

# 十四、核心竞态测试

## 最后一个活动名额

```text
100 个请求同时抢 1 个名额
```

必须满足：

```text
成功 = 1
候补或失败 = 99
Confirmed Registration 不超过 Capacity
无重复付款权益
```

## 最后一个预约时段

```text
20 个用户同时预留同一 Slot
```

必须满足：

```text
Active Hold ≤ 1
其余得到明确冲突
```

## 双方同时喜欢

```text
User A Like B
User B Like A
同时到达
```

必须满足：

```text
Mutual Match = 1
通知不重复
```

## 邀请接受与过期

必须有唯一最终状态：

```text
ACCEPTED
或 EXPIRED
```

不能同时成立。

## 联系方式 Reveal 与 Block

Block 优先后：

```text
Reveal Token 必须失效
Active Contact Grant = 0
```

---

# 十五、并发断言

每个竞态测试验证：

```text
数据库最终状态
领域事件数量
Outbox 数量
Inbox 副作用
通知数量
审计数量
用户可见结果
```

只检查 HTTP 200/409 不足以证明并发正确。

# 十六、Skill 29.4：`vav-load-spike-stress-soak`

## 目标

建立不同压力模式的性能测试套件。

## 16.1 Load Test Definition

```sql
CREATE TABLE performance_test_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    test_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    test_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    workload_model_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    scenario_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    traffic_profile JSONB NOT NULL,

    pass_condition JSONB NOT NULL,
    abort_condition JSONB NOT NULL,

    environment_requirements JSONB NOT NULL,

    criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(test_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 16.2 类型

```python
class PerformanceTestType(StrEnum):
    BASELINE = "baseline"
    LOAD = "load"
    SPIKE = "spike"
    STRESS = "stress"
    SOAK = "soak"
    FAILOVER_LOAD = "failover_load"
    RECOVERY_LOAD = "recovery_load"
```

---

# 十七、测试定义

## Baseline

目标：

```text
单用户和低并发下建立性能基线
```

## Load

目标：

```text
验证目标生产负载
```

## Spike

示例：

```text
30 秒内从 50 RPS 升至 500 RPS
持续 5 分钟
```

观察：

```text
延迟
错误率
扩容时间
队列积压
恢复速度
```

## Stress

持续提高负载，找到：

```text
最大稳定吞吐
饱和点
失效点
```

Stress 允许测试环境出现失败，但必须观察是否：

```text
可控降级
无数据损坏
无安全绕过
可恢复
```

## Soak

建议：

```text
8-24 小时
```

观察：

```text
内存泄漏
连接泄漏
队列累积
缓存膨胀
数据库 Bloat
Token/成本漂移
```

---

```text

# 二十、Skill 29.5：`vav-database-query-performance`

## 目标

## 20.1 Query Definition

```sql
CREATE TABLE performance_query_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    query_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

## 20.2 Query Run

```sql
CREATE TABLE performance_query_runs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    query_definition_id UUID NOT NULL

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    executed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

# 二十一、数据库检查

自动检测：

```text
Seq Scan on Large Table
缺失 Index
重复 Index
N+1
高 Rows Removed by Filter
高排序内存
磁盘排序
锁等待
死锁
连接池耗尽
长事务
```

Critical 查询必须使用接近生产规模的合成数据验证。

---

# 二十二、核心查询治理

必须重点优化：

```text
用户首页聚合
管理端用户搜索
订单列表
通知列表
活动报名
课程进度
导师可用时段
推荐候选生成
推荐批次读取
互动 Pair 查询
关系时间线
会员配额
安全 Block 查询
隐私资产查询
管理 360° 视图
```

---

# 二十三、分页

大列表禁止无限 Offset：

```text
OFFSET 1,000,000
```

应优先：

```text
Keyset/Cursor Pagination
```

Cursor 必须包含稳定排序字段：

```text
created_at + id
```

---

# 二十四、连接池

每个服务必须定义：

```text
Pool Size
Max Overflow
Connection Timeout
Idle Lifetime
Transaction Timeout
```

总连接数必须满足：

```text
API Replicas
＋ Worker Replicas
＋ Admin Jobs
＋ Migration Jobs
```

不超过数据库承载能力。

---

# 二十五、Migration 性能

数据库迁移必须测试：

```text
锁表时间
索引创建时间
Backfill 时间
磁盘增长
回滚边界
```

大型索引优先采用：

```text
Concurrent Build 边界
```

并遵循 Batch 19 的 Expand-Migrate-Contract。

---

# 二十六、Skill 29.6：`vav-cache-hot-key-stampede`

## 目标

管理缓存命中率、Hot Key、击穿、雪崩和失效正确性。

## 26.1 Cache Definition

```sql
CREATE TABLE performance_cache_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    cache_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    owning_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    key_pattern VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
    source_asset_codes JSONB NOT NULL,

    ttl_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    invalidation_event_codes JSONB NOT NULL,

    stampede_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    maximum_value_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL,

    criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(cache_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 26.2 Stampede 策略

支持：

```text
Single Flight
Distributed Lock
Stale-while-revalidate
TTL Jitter
Request Coalescing
```

---

# 二十七、Critical Cache

```text
导航
用户首页
Catalog
活动详情
课程详情
帮助内容
推荐读取
权限 Projection 边界
```

## 不得长期缓存

```text
联系方式 Reveal
即时 Block 状态
一次性 Token
支付确认真源
安全证据
```

---

# 二十八、安全失效优先级

以下事件必须立即失效：

```text
safety.block.created
safety.restriction.created
privacy.erasure.started
contact_exchange.revoked
membership.access_changed
permission.changed
```

不能只等待 TTL。

---

# 二十九、Hot Key 检测

检测：

```text
单 Key QPS
单 Key 带宽
大 Value
高争用 Lock
```

例如首页公共配置可能形成 Hot Key，应采用：

```text
本地只读缓存
Redis
CDN 边界
```

分层，但需有版本失效。

---

# 三十、Skill 29.7：`vav-queue-backpressure-priority`

## 目标

防止生产者无限产生任务，导致 Worker、数据库和 Provider 被压垮。

## 30.1 Queue Definition

```sql
CREATE TABLE performance_queue_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    queue_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    workload_class VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    priority INTEGER NOT NULL,

    consumer_pool_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    concurrency_limit INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rate_limit_per_second NUMERIC(14,3),

    backlog_warning_threshold BIGINT NOT NULL,
    backlog_critical_threshold BIGINT NOT NULL,

    maximum_task_age_seconds BIGINT NOT NULL,

    load_shedding_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    retry_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
);
```

## 30.2 Queue Class

```python
class QueueWorkloadClass(StrEnum):
    SAFETY_CRITICAL = "safety_critical"
    PRIVACY_CRITICAL = "privacy_critical"
    COMMERCE_CRITICAL = "commerce_critical"
    USER_INTERACTIVE = "user_interactive"
    NOTIFICATION = "notification"
    AI = "ai"
    BACKFILL = "backfill"
    ANALYTICS = "analytics"
```

---

# 三十一、优先级隔离

建议独立 Worker Pool：

```text
Safety
Privacy
Commerce
Interactive
Notifications
AI
Backfill/Analytics
```

禁止：

```text
AI Embedding 大任务
```

阻塞：

```text
屏蔽传播
隐私删除
支付确认
```

---

# 三十二、背压策略

当队列超过阈值：

```text
降低非关键生产速度
暂停低优先级 Backfill
拒绝新非关键批量任务
降低 AI 并发
延迟营销通知
```

不能：

```text
丢弃安全事件
丢弃支付事件
丢弃删除任务
```

---

# 三十三、任务年龄

不仅看 Queue Length，还看：

```text
Oldest Message Age
```

队列长度不高，但任务长期不处理仍属于故障。

---

# 三十四、Drain

部署和维护前：

```text
停止接收新低优先级任务
→ 完成当前任务
→ 保存 Checkpoint
→ Graceful Shutdown
```

长任务必须支持 Batch 24 的暂停/恢复或幂等重试。

---

# 三十五、Skill 29.8：`vav-rate-limit-admission-control`

## 目标

保护 API、业务资源、Provider 和成本预算。

## 35.1 Rate-limit Policy

```sql
CREATE TABLE performance_rate_limit_policies (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    policy_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    target_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    target_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    subject_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    algorithm VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    sustained_rate NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL,
    burst_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,

    response_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    bypass_policy JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(policy_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 35.2 Subject

```text
ip
user
session
admin_user
api_key
provider
resource
capability
```

## 35.3 算法

```text
Token Bucket
Sliding Window
Fixed Window 边界
Concurrency Limit
Cost-weighted Token Bucket
```

---

# 三十六、业务限流

## 登录

```text
IP
＋ 账号标识 Hash
```

避免：

```text
只按账号限流导致攻击者锁死用户
```

## AI

按：

```text
用户
会员计划
Token Cost
并发会话
Provider Capacity
```

限流。

## 搜索

按：

```text
用户/IP
查询复杂度
```

## 管理导出

按：

```text
管理员
组织
并发导出任务
```

---

# 三十七、Admission Control

当系统接近饱和时：

```text
保护已有事务完成
限制新长任务进入
```

优先拒绝：

```text
低优先级 AI 请求
大导出
大 Backfill
非关键分析
```

而不是让所有请求一起超时。

---

# 三十八、429 响应

必须包含：

```text
安全错误代码
Retry-After
用户可理解说明
```

不能泄露内部容量和安全阈值细节。

---

# 三十九、Skill 29.9：`vav-horizontal-scaling-validation`

## 目标

验证多 API、多 Worker、多实例 Scheduler 边界下系统行为正确。

## 39.1 Scaling Profile

```sql
CREATE TABLE performance_scaling_profiles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    profile_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    service_replica_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    worker_pool_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,

    autoscaling_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    graceful_shutdown_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    expected_capacity JSONB NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(profile_code, semantic_version)
);
```

---

# 四十、API 扩容不变量

API 必须：

```text
无本地 Session 真源
无本地唯一任务状态
无单实例内存锁作为最终并发保障
无本地文件依赖
```

以下可以存在本地缓存，但必须可失效和重建：

```text
配置缓存
公共内容缓存
Schema 缓存
```

---

# 四十一、Scheduler

必须保证：

```text
多副本部署时只有一个有效调度执行者
```

通过：

```text
PostgreSQL Advisory Lock
或 Leader Election
```

实现。

但实际任务本身仍需幂等，不能只依赖 Scheduler 单例。

---

# 四十二、Worker 扩容

验证：

```text
任务不会重复产生业务副作用
任务不会永久丢失
高优先级任务得到独立容量
Scale-down 时任务安全结束或重试
```

---

# 四十三、Auto-scaling 指标

可使用：

```text
CPU
Memory
Request Concurrency
P95 Latency
Queue Length
Oldest Task Age
Worker Busy Ratio
```

不能只看 CPU。

例如 AI Worker 可能等待 Provider，CPU 很低但并发已经饱和。

---

# 四十四、扩容测试

```text
1 → 2 → 4 → 8 API Replicas
```

验证：

```text
吞吐接近增长
数据库未提前成为瓶颈
Redis 无 Hot Key 崩溃
无重复副作用
无 Session 丢失
```

若吞吐不再线性增长，应记录实际瓶颈。

---

# 四十五、Graceful Shutdown

服务终止时：

```text
停止接收新请求
→ 完成短请求
→ 取消或交接长请求
→ Flush Trace
→ 关闭连接
```

支付 Webhook 和安全命令不能因滚动发布丢失。

---

# 四十六、Skill 29.10：`vav-capacity-cost-model`

## 目标

把技术容量与基础设施、Provider 和 AI 成本关联。

## 46.1 Capacity Model

```sql
CREATE TABLE performance_capacity_models (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    model_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    workload_model_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    scaling_profile_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    capacity_assumptions JSONB NOT NULL,
    measured_capacity JSONB NOT NULL,
    bottleneck_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,

    growth_forecast JSONB NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(model_code, semantic_version)
);
```

## 46.2 Cost Model

```sql
CREATE TABLE performance_cost_models (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    model_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    currency VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,

    compute_cost_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    database_cost_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    cache_cost_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    storage_cost_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    network_cost_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    provider_cost_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    observability_cost_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,

    unit_costs JSONB NOT NULL,

    effective_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(model_code, semantic_version)
);
```

---

# 四十七、单位成本

计算：

```text
Cost per Active User
Cost per Paid Member
Cost per Order
Cost per Activity Registration
Cost per Course Learner
Cost per Counseling Booking
Cost per AI Conversation
Cost per Recommendation Batch
Cost per Data Export
Cost per Backfill Million Rows
```

AI 成本需细分：

```text
Prompt Tokens
Completion Tokens
Embedding
Rerank
Moderation
Fallback Model
```

---

# 四十八、成本保护

当预算异常增长时：

```text
告警
降低非关键 AI 上下文
降低低优先级重试
暂停批量 Embedding
切换经批准的低成本模型
```

不能：

```text
绕过安全模型
降低隐私保护
取消支付对账
```

---

# 四十九、容量报告

报告必须回答：

```text
当前稳定最大 RPS
当前稳定同时在线
数据库最大连接
Worker 最大吞吐
队列最大安全积压
对象存储增长率
AI 日/月预算
预计达到瓶颈时间
下一步扩容动作
```

容量报告必须明确：

```text
测量值
假设值
推断值
```

不能混为一谈。

---

CREATE TABLE performance_certifications (

performance-migrate:

	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.seed_performance

performance-load:

performance-spike:
	k6 run tests/performance/scenarios/spike.js

	k6 run tests/performance/scenarios/stress.js

performance-soak:
	k6 run tests/performance/scenarios/soak.js

performance-database-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/performance/database -q

performance-cache-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/performance/cache -q

	docker compose exec api pytest tests/performance/queues -q

performance-scaling-test:

performance-cost-report:

performance-admin-e2e:

	$(MAKE) performance-admin-e2e

	$(MAKE) performance-evidence-build

performance-release:

	$(MAKE) performance-soak

# 六十三、必须通过的生产负载模型场景

```text
负载模型包含用户角色分布
包含读写比例
包含后台任务
包含 Provider 调用
包含峰值事件
包含增长假设
负载模型版本可追踪
假设值和实测值明确区分
```

---

# 六十四、必须通过的性能预算场景

```text
所有 Critical API 有性能预算
所有 Critical Journey 有性能预算
预算包含 P95 和 P99
预算包含错误率和超时率
Worker 和队列有完成预算
预算绑定负载模型
性能回归可以自动识别
```

---

# 六十五、必须通过的竞态场景

```text
最后活动名额不超卖
最后预约时段不重复占用
最后配额不为负
重复 Webhook 不重复产生副作用
双方同时喜欢只创建一个 Match
邀请接受/过期只有一个终态
Block 与 Reveal 并发时 Block 生效
关系恢复/结束只有一个合法结果
续费/取消保持订阅和会员一致
```

---

# 六十六、必须通过的 Load/Spike/Stress/Soak 场景

```text
目标 Load 下 Critical Budget 通过
Spike 后系统能够扩容或有序降级
Stress 到失效点无数据损坏
Soak 无持续内存泄漏
Soak 无连接泄漏
队列高峰后可以恢复
缓存冷启动不击穿数据库
Provider 降级不破坏业务状态
```

---

# 六十七、必须通过的数据库场景

```text
Critical 查询无未批准全表扫描
管理列表使用稳定分页
不存在 Critical N+1
连接池不会在目标副本数下耗尽
锁等待处于预算内
竞态测试无未处理死锁
大型迁移有性能验证
查询计划绑定生产型数据规模
```

---

# 六十八、必须通过的缓存场景

```text
Critical Cache 有明确所有者
Cache 有失效事件
安全和隐私失效不只依赖 TTL
Stampede 有保护
Hot Key 可检测
缓存失效时业务正确
缓存冷启动可以恢复
缓存 Value 不包含无必要敏感数据
```

---

# 六十九、必须通过的队列场景

```text
安全、隐私和支付队列优先级明确
AI 和 Backfill 不阻塞 Critical 队列
Backpressure 能暂停低优先级生产
Oldest Message Age 有告警
Scale-down 不丢任务
任务重试保持幂等
队列积压后能够恢复
```

---

# 七十、必须通过的限流场景

```text
登录限流不能被简单绕过
用户限流不会错误影响其他用户
AI 限流考虑 Token 成本
管理导出有限制
Provider 调用有限制
429 包含安全 Retry-After
限流不能绕过权限
Critical 内部事件不被普通用户限流丢弃
```

---

# 七十一、必须通过的扩缩容场景

```text
API 多副本不丢 Session
API 多副本不重复产生业务状态
Worker 扩容提高吞吐
Scheduler 多副本只有一个有效 Leader
Scale-down 时任务安全结束
滚动发布不丢 Webhook
扩容指标不仅依赖 CPU
达到最大副本后触发 Admission Control
```

---

# 七十二、必须通过的容量与成本场景

```text
容量模型包含测量和假设
可以估计用户和请求容量
可以识别数据库和队列瓶颈
可以估计 AI 成本
可以计算单位旅程成本
成本异常触发告警
成本优化不能削弱安全和隐私
容量报告给出下一步扩容条件
```
