# 七十四、Batch 29 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-29/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-29-performance-capacity-concurrency
description: Implement VAV production workload models, performance budgets, race testing, load and soak tests, database and cache optimization, queue backpressure, rate limits, scaling validation, capacity cost models and performance release gates.
---

# Goal

Build the platform-wide performance, capacity and concurrency-assurance
control plane containing:

- versioned production workload models;
- role and traffic distributions;
- peak-event profiles;
- endpoint and journey performance budgets;
- P50, P95, P99, throughput, error and timeout budgets;
- concurrency-hotspot testing;
- deterministic race-condition scenarios;
- Baseline, Load, Spike, Stress and Soak tests;
- failover and recovery under load;
- database-query registration and execution-plan analysis;
- index, lock, connection-pool and migration performance checks;
- cache-hit, Hot-key and Stampede analysis;
- queue priorities, backpressure and load shedding;
- API and business-resource rate limits;
- admission control;
- stateless API and Worker horizontal scaling;
- scheduler leadership;
- graceful shutdown;
- capacity forecasts;
- unit-cost and AI-cost models;
- domain performance certification;
- administration, evidence and release gates.

# Product boundary

This batch verifies performance without weakening correctness, privacy,
security, consent, payment or safety rules.

Caching, load shedding and rate limiting must not become authorization or
business-state sources. Production-destructive Stress tests are prohibited
unless explicitly governed in an isolated environment.

# Prerequisites

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batches 1 through 28.
3. Run `make quality-verify`.
4. Run `make ui-verify`.
5. Run `make experience-verify`.
6. Run `make process-verify`.
7. Run `make data-integrity-verify`.
8. Run `make admin-completeness-verify`.
9. Run `make functional-usability-verify`.
10. Run `make regression-release`.
11. Inventory Critical APIs, journeys, queries, queues, caches and Providers.
12. Inventory all concurrency hotspots from Batch 24.
13. Produce `docs/performance/workload-model.md`.
14. Produce `docs/performance/performance-budgets.md`.
15. Produce `docs/performance/concurrency-testing.md`.
16. Produce `docs/performance/database-performance.md`.
17. Produce `docs/performance/cache-queue-policy.md`.
18. Produce `docs/performance/scaling-capacity.md`.
19. Produce `docs/performance/cost-model.md`.

# Required implementation order

1. Workload taxonomy.
2. Workload-model registry.
3. Role and traffic profiles.
4. Peak-event definitions.
5. Endpoint budgets.
6. Journey budgets.
7. Concurrency-scenario registry.
8. Race-condition Harness.
9. Baseline tests.
10. Target Load tests.
11. Spike tests.
12. Stress-test boundary.
13. Soak tests.
14. Database-query registry.
15. Execution-plan analysis.
16. Connection-pool and lock tests.
17. Cache registry and analysis.
18. Stampede and Hot-key tests.
19. Queue priority and backpressure.
20. Rate limits and admission control.
21. Scaling profiles.
22. API and Worker scaling tests.
23. Graceful-shutdown tests.
24. Capacity model.
25. Cost model.
26. Domain certification.
27. Administration center.
28. Evidence and release gates.

# Workload invariants

- Workload assumptions are explicit and versioned.
- Assumptions and measured values remain distinguishable.
- Workload models include user, API, Worker, event and Provider traffic.
- Peak events are represented.
- Growth assumptions are reviewable.
- Release tests bind to one approved workload model.

# Budget invariants

- Critical endpoints have latency and error budgets.
- Critical journeys have end-to-end budgets.
- Budgets include long-tail latency.
- Worker and queue waits have budgets.
- Budgets bind to workloads and environments.
- Performance regressions are compared against approved baselines.
- Averages do not replace percentile measurements.

# Concurrency invariants

- Critical hotspots have deterministic race tests.
- Tests validate final domain state and emitted events.
- Capacity, slot and quota invariants remain valid.
- Duplicate callbacks do not duplicate side effects.
- Block and safety operations win according to domain policy.
- Concurrent operations produce one legal outcome.
- Concurrency correctness is more important than maximum throughput.

# Load-test invariants

- Load tests use synthetic or isolated identities.
- Real external payments and notifications are disabled.
- Baseline, Load, Spike and Soak profiles are distinct.
- Stress tests run only in governed capacity environments.
- Failure under Stress does not corrupt data.
- Recovery after load is measured.
- Load tests collect business, infrastructure and queue metrics.

# Database invariants

- Critical queries are registered.
- Query plans are evaluated against representative data volumes.
- Critical N+1 patterns are rejected.
- Pagination is stable.
- Connection budgets account for all replicas and Workers.
- Lock and deadlock behavior is tested.
- Large migrations have performance evidence.
- Database optimization preserves correctness.

# Cache invariants

- Caches have owners, sources and invalidation events.
- Safety and privacy invalidation is immediate.
- Stampede protection exists for critical shared caches.
- Hot keys are measurable.
- Cache failures degrade performance, not authorization correctness.
- Cache values do not contain unnecessary restricted data.
- Cold-start recovery is tested.

# Queue invariants

- Safety, privacy and commerce workloads have protected priority.
- AI, analytics and Backfill workloads cannot starve critical queues.
- Backpressure activates before uncontrolled saturation.
- Oldest-task age is monitored.
- Load shedding affects only approved noncritical work.
- Retries remain bounded and idempotent.
- Scale-down and draining do not lose tasks.

# Rate-limit invariants

- Rate limits are scoped and versioned.
- Limits do not grant permissions.
- Login limits resist trivial bypass and account lockout abuse.
- AI limits account for cost and concurrency.
- Internal critical events are not silently discarded by user-facing limits.
- Admission control protects in-flight critical work.
- Denials return safe retry guidance.

# Scaling invariants

- APIs are stateless for authoritative session and process data.
- Worker tasks are idempotent.
- Scheduler leadership is controlled.
- Scale-up and scale-down are measurable.
- Rolling deployments preserve Webhooks and events.
- Scaling metrics include queue age and concurrency, not only CPU.
- Maximum-capacity saturation triggers controlled admission.

# Capacity and cost invariants

- Capacity models include measured bottlenecks.
- Forecasts identify scaling thresholds.
- Costs are normalized per useful business unit.
- AI costs are itemized by token and operation.
- Cost controls do not weaken privacy or safety.
- Reports distinguish measurement, assumption and inference.
- Cost and capacity evidence binds to release and workload versions.

# Certification invariants

- Critical domains receive performance certifications.
- Certifications include budgets, concurrency, load, database, cache, queue
  and scaling evidence.
- Critical concurrency corruption fails certification.
- Critical endpoint-budget failures fail certification.
- Unrecovered queue backlogs fail certification.
- Persistent Soak leaks fail certification.
- Performance certification cannot override regression, security or data
  failures.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make performance-migrate
make performance-seed
make performance-sync
make performance-workload-check
make performance-budget-check
make performance-concurrency-test
make performance-baseline
make performance-load
make performance-spike
make performance-stress
make performance-soak
make performance-database-test
make performance-cache-test
make performance-queue-test
make performance-scaling-test
make performance-cost-report
make performance-security-test
make performance-admin-e2e
make performance-evidence-build
make performance-verify
make performance-release
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Approved workload models exist.
2. Critical endpoints have budgets.
3. Critical journeys have budgets.
4. All Batch-24 Critical concurrency hotspots have tests.
5. Duplicate critical side effects are zero.
6. Target Load tests pass.
7. Spike recovery meets the approved budget.
8. Soak tests show no critical persistent leaks.
9. Critical queues recover after load.
10. Critical queries meet budgets.
11. Connection pools remain within capacity.
12. Critical caches have safe invalidation.
13. Stampede and Hot-key protections work.
14. Queue priority isolation works.
15. Backpressure and admission control work.
16. Rate limits do not bypass authorization.
17. API horizontal scaling works.
18. Worker scaling preserves idempotency.
19. Scheduler leadership works.
20. Graceful shutdown works.
21. Capacity and cost models are generated.
22. Critical domains have performance certifications.
23. Performance administration E2E passes.
24. Performance security tests pass.
25. Performance release gates pass.
26. Evidence is registered with Batch 21.
27. `make performance-verify` succeeds.
28. `make performance-release` succeeds.
29. `make regression-release` still succeeds.
30. `make functional-usability-verify` still succeeds.
31. `make admin-completeness-verify` still succeeds.
32. `make data-integrity-verify` still succeeds.
33. `make process-verify` still succeeds.
34. `make experience-verify` still succeeds.
35. `make ui-verify` still succeeds.
36. `make quality-verify` still succeeds.
37. `make acceptance` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When a critical endpoint exceeds its budget:

1. preserve the workload, release and trace evidence;
2. identify application, database, cache, queue or Provider contribution;
3. fix the bottleneck without removing security or correctness controls;
4. add a regression threshold;
5. rerun the full affected journey.

When a concurrency invariant fails:

1. stop performance certification;
2. preserve the exact synchronization schedule;
3. inspect database constraints, locks and event effects;
4. repair the domain concurrency policy;
5. promote the schedule to a fixed regression test;
6. rerun process, data and regression suites.

When load causes queue saturation:

1. protect critical queues;
2. activate approved backpressure;
3. pause noncritical workloads;
4. verify no critical event was lost;
5. drain and reconcile;
6. update the capacity model.

When cache optimization changes business behavior:

1. disable the affected cache;
2. treat the authoritative domain as correct;
3. invalidate unsafe cache entries;
4. repair keying or invalidation;
5. add correctness-under-cache tests;
6. rerun privacy and safety checks.

When scaling introduces duplicate effects:

1. stop further scaling;
2. identify missing idempotency or shared-state control;
3. repair the task, command or Scheduler design;
4. reconcile affected data;
5. add multi-replica regression tests;
6. block release until duplication is eliminated.

When Soak testing reveals resource leakage:

1. preserve time-series evidence;
2. identify memory, connection, file, queue or cache leakage;
3. repair lifecycle cleanup;
4. rerun an equivalent-duration Soak;
5. block release until the leak no longer accumulates.

When cost exceeds the approved guardrail:

1. identify the cost driver;
2. separate expected growth from regression;
3. optimize routing, caching, batching or model choice;
4. retain safety and privacy controls;
5. update the capacity and cost report;
6. require approval for materially higher production cost.

项目计划书要求平台保护用户身份、支付、婚恋档案、辅导资料、AI 会话、文件资产和管理端操作，并在最终验收时确保关键流程没有重大安全问题。`Copy of VAV完整婚恋智能服务平台_项目计划书.docx`

Batch 18 重点解决用户之间的举报、屏蔽、骚扰、诈骗与平台信任安全；Batch 30 解决的是平台自身的技术安全：

```text
攻击者能否越权读取数据？
能否伪造身份、Session、Webhook 或支付结果？
能否通过上传文件、URL、Prompt 或 Skill 执行恶意操作？
能否从日志、搜索、导出、缓存或错误信息泄露隐私？
依赖、容器、CI/CD 和插件供应链是否可信？
所有关键攻击面是否经过自动化和人工安全验证？
```

本批建立平台级的 **Application Security & Product Security Control Plane**。

# 三、核心安全原则

## 3.1 默认拒绝

默认：

```text
无权限
无网络
无文件访问
无 Secret
无管理操作
无敏感字段
```

仅通过明确策略授予最小能力。

## 3.2 身份验证不等于授权

```text
已登录
≠ 可以访问该对象

是管理员
≠ 可以查看所有敏感字段

Skill 已安装
≠ 可以调用任意 Tool
```

## 3.3 前端不是安全边界

不能依赖：

```text
隐藏按钮
隐藏菜单
禁用输入框
前端字段过滤
```

作为最终安全控制。

## 3.4 错误信息必须安全但可诊断

用户看到：

```text
操作无法完成，请重新检查或联系支持。
```

内部通过：

```text
error_code
request_id
trace_id
```

定位。

不得返回：

```text
SQL
表名
路径
Secret
内部网络地址
堆栈
Provider Credential
```

## 3.5 不信任外部输入和外部响应

不可信来源包括：

```text
浏览器
Webhook
上传文件
外部 URL
AI 输出
RAG 文档
Skill Package
Provider 回调
邮件链接
管理端导入文件
```

## 3.6 安全检查必须持续存在

安全不是一次渗透测试，而是：

```text
设计
→ 编码
→ 构建
→ 测试
→ 部署
→ 运行
→ 事件响应
```

全生命周期控制。

# 六、Skill 30.1：`vav-threat-model-attack-surface`

## 目标

建立版本化资产、信任区、数据流和威胁场景。

## 6.1 Security Asset

```sql
CREATE TABLE security_assets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    asset_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    display_name VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,

    asset_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    owning_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    confidentiality_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    integrity_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    availability_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    data_classification VARCHAR(32),
    business_criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    exposure_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    owner_team VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

## 6.2 Asset Type

```python
class SecurityAssetType(StrEnum):
    USER_IDENTITY = "user_identity"
    BUSINESS_DATA = "business_data"
    SECRET = "secret"
    API = "api"
    WEB_APPLICATION = "web_application"
    SERVICE = "service"
    DATABASE = "database"
    CACHE = "cache"
    QUEUE = "queue"
    OBJECT_STORAGE = "object_storage"
    AI_SYSTEM = "ai_system"
    SKILL_PACKAGE = "skill_package"
    BUILD_PIPELINE = "build_pipeline"
    OBSERVABILITY_SYSTEM = "observability_system"
```

# 九、Threat Model

```sql
CREATE TABLE security_threat_models (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    threat_model_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    target_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    target_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

    asset_ids JSONB NOT NULL,
    trust_zone_ids JSONB NOT NULL,
    data_flow_ids JSONB NOT NULL,

    attacker_profiles JSONB NOT NULL,
    assumptions JSONB NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    owner_team VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(threat_model_code, semantic_version)
);

# 二十三、Skill 30.4：`vav-api-dast-schema-fuzzing`

## 目标

依据 OpenAPI 和攻击面清单对 API 执行动态验证和受控 Fuzzing。

## 23.1 Fuzz Campaign

```sql
CREATE TABLE security_fuzz_campaigns (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

);
```

---

# 二十四、Fuzz Profile

```text
Schema Boundary
Type Confusion
Missing Required Field
Unknown Field
Deep Nesting
Large Array
Unicode
Invalid Encoding
Duplicate Parameter
Conflicting Header
Content-type Mismatch
Pagination Extreme
Date Boundary
Numeric Boundary
```

禁止无控制地向生产执行高强度 Fuzzing。

---

# 二十五、Stateful API Fuzzing

对状态流程验证：

```text
创建前读取
重复创建
终态后更新
过期 Token 使用
撤销后再次使用
不同用户交叉使用 ID
不同角色交叉调用
事件顺序异常
```

例如联系方式：

```text
未匹配
→ 请求 Reveal

只一方同意
→ 请求 Reveal

双方同意
→ Reveal

建立 Block
→ 使用旧 Reveal Token
```

最后一步必须失败。

---

# 二十六、API 安全断言

```text
不存在 5xx 堆栈泄漏
不存在越权 2xx
不存在未知字段静默覆盖
不存在无限制大响应
不存在无上限分页
不存在跨用户缓存
不存在错误内容类型解析绕过
```

---

# 二十七、DAST 环境保护

```text
合成账号
隔离数据库
Fake Provider
请求限额
禁止真实支付
禁止真实通知
禁止真实安全处罚
测试数据自动清理
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE security_egress_policies (

    policy_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

# 三十九、SSRF 防护流程

```text
解析 URL
→ 标准化 Host
→ 检查 Scheme
→ DNS 解析
→ 检查所有返回 IP
→ 阻止私有/环回/链路本地地址
→ 限制端口
→ 发起请求
→ 每次 Redirect 重新验证
→ 限制响应大小和时间
```

不能只用字符串检查：

```text
host.startsWith("10.")
```

# 四十四、Skill 30.7：`vav-payment-webhook-provider-security`

## 目标

验证 Stripe、PayPal 或其他支付 Provider 回调和支付状态安全。

## 44.1 Webhook Contract

每个 Provider 声明：

```yaml
provider: stripe
signature:
  algorithm: provider_defined
  rawBodyRequired: true
  timestampWindowSeconds: 300

deduplication:
  key: provider_event_id

binding:
  orderReferenceRequired: true
  amountVerificationRequired: true
  currencyVerificationRequired: true
```

---

# 四十五、Webhook 处理顺序

```text
读取原始 Body
→ 验证签名
→ 验证时间窗口
→ 解析事件
→ 验证 Provider Account
→ Inbox 去重
→ 绑定内部 Order/Payment
→ 验证金额和币种
→ 验证允许的状态转换
→ 写领域事实和 Outbox
→ 返回成功
```

不能先解析和修改业务，再验证签名。

---

# 四十六、Webhook 攻击场景

```text
缺失签名
错误签名
过期时间戳
重放 Event
修改 Body
错误 Provider Account
错误金额
错误币种
错误订单
事件乱序
退款先于支付确认
争议事件重复
```

---

# 四十七、浏览器返回页

```text
/payment/success
```

只能显示：

```text
正在确认支付状态
```

不能据此开通权益。

---

# 四十八、退款安全

退款需要验证：

```text
原 Payment
可退款金额

审批策略
Idempotency Key
Provider 结果
内部 Ledger
```

不得仅根据前端传入金额退款。

---

```text
Secret Provider
最小环境权限

定期轮换
不进入日志
不进入 Skill
```

支付凭据
联系方式 Reveal 内容
安全证据
高敏草稿
```

---

# 五十五、搜索与向量

验证：

```text
私人关系复盘不进入普通搜索
举报证据不进入向量
单向喜欢不进入搜索
已删除用户从索引移除
Block 后相关结果隐藏
```

---

# 五十六、Export 安全

验证：

```text
字段权限
Masking
用途
审批
加密
下载过期
水印边界
审计
自动删除
```

CSV 还需防止：

```text
以 =、+、-、@ 开头的公式执行
```

---

# 五十七、Skill 30.9：`vav-ai-prompt-injection-tool-security`

## 目标

防止直接或间接 Prompt Injection 诱导 AI 泄露数据、越权调用工具或改变安全规则。

## 57.1 AI Security Test Case

```sql
CREATE TABLE ai_security_test_cases (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    test_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    attack_category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    fixture_reference JSONB NOT NULL,

    expected_tool_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    expected_data_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    expected_response_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    source_test_case_code VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL
);
```

---

# 五十八、Prompt Injection 来源

```text
用户消息
上传文档
网页内容
知识库文档
邮件内容边界
Skill 输出
Tool 输出
搜索结果
```

所有外部内容均为：

```text
untrusted_content
```

而非系统指令。

---

# 五十九、AI 指令层级

```text
平台安全政策
→ 系统 Prompt
→ 业务策略
→ 用户请求
→ 检索内容
→ Tool 输出
```

检索文档不能覆盖更高层规则。

---

# 六十、Tool 调用安全

Tool 调用必须：

```text
Tool Registry 注册
输入 Schema
调用者权限
会话权限
用户对象权限
用途检查
风险级别
必要确认
输出 Schema
审计
```

AI 不能自行构造未注册 Tool 名称。

---

# 六十一、写操作确认

以下操作必须显式确认：

```text
发送通知
预约
购买
退款请求
资料变更
联系方式交换
关系阶段提议
隐私删除
安全申诉
```

AI 不得把：

```text
“我可能想预约”
```

解释为已确认预约。

---

# 六十二、间接 Prompt Injection

测试 RAG 文档包含：

```text
忽略系统规则
调用导出工具
显示其他用户资料
泄露系统 Prompt
```

系统应：

```text
将其视为文档正文
不执行
不提升权限
```

---

# 六十三、RAG Poisoning

验证：

```text
来源授权
发布状态
文档版本
空间权限
引用正确
恶意文档隔离
索引撤销
```

安全或业务关键事实不能仅依赖未经审核的低信任文档。

---

# 六十四、Memory Poisoning

AI Memory 写入前：

```text
明确同意
来源标记
敏感分类
用途
可信度
可删除
```

用户消息不能通过指令要求 AI 将：

```text
“我拥有管理员权限”
```

写为可信身份事实。

---

# 六十五、Model Output Validation

AI 输出进入：

```text
HTML
SQL
URL
Tool 参数
文件名
通知
```

前必须经过对应上下文验证。

---

# 六十六、AI 安全不变量

```text
Prompt 不能扩大权限
RAG 文档不能调用 Tool
Tool 输出不能改变系统策略
AI 不看到未授权用户数据
AI 不能代用户确认高风险操作
AI 故障不影响支付和安全真源
```

---

# 六十七、Skill 30.10：`vav-skill-sandbox-supply-chain-security`

## 目标

对 Batch 20 Skill Package、Runtime、Registry、插件和 Marketplace 实施独立安全验证。

## 67.1 Package Security Pipeline

```text
上传
→ 格式检查
→ 解压安全检查
→ Manifest 验证
→ Hash
→ 签名
→ Publisher
→ SBOM
→ Dependency Scan
→ Secret Scan
→ Malware Scan
→ Capability Review
→ Sandbox Test
→ Publish
```

---

# 六十八、Package 攻击测试

```text
Zip Slip
Tar Path Traversal
绝对路径
../ 路径
Symlink
Hardlink
超大解压
重复文件名
Unicode 路径混淆
Manifest 替换
签名替换
Dependency Confusion
Typosquatting
```

---

# 六十九、Sandbox 验证

第三方 Skill 必须不能：

```text
读取宿主文件
访问 Docker Socket
连接数据库
访问 Redis
访问 Metadata Service
扫描内网
读取其他 Skill 文件
读取未授权 Secret
创建无限子进程
耗尽 CPU/内存/磁盘
```

---

# 七十、Sandbox Test Profile

```sql
CREATE TABLE skill_sandbox_security_profiles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    profile_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    cpu_limit JSONB NOT NULL,
    memory_limit JSONB NOT NULL,
    filesystem_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    network_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    process_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    secret_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    required_test_codes JSONB NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
);
```

---

# 七十一、Skill 网络访问

通过：

```text
Egress Proxy
＋ Domain Allowlist
＋ DNS/IP Revalidation
```

不能仅把允许域名写入 Skill 代码。

---

# 七十二、Secret Broker 安全

验证：

```text
Skill 未授权引用被拒绝
短时凭证过期
凭证不能跨 Skill
凭证不能跨安装
凭证不能进入日志
撤销后立即失效
```

---

# 七十三、Publisher 与签名

验证：

```text
未知 Publisher
过期 Key
撤销 Key
包被修改
签名与 Publisher 不匹配
旧包替换新版本
版本降级
```

生产只允许满足当前 Trust Policy 的包。

---

# 七十四、Dependency Confusion

Skill 依赖解析必须：

```text
固定 Registry
Namespace Ownership
Lockfile
Hash
签名
禁止自动回退公共同名包
```

---

# 七十五、Marketplace 安全响应

恶意 Skill：

```text
暂停 Listing
→ 撤销版本
→ 阻止新执行
→ 通知安装组织
→ 隔离 Artifact
→ 调查 Publisher
→ 提供回滚
```

---

# 七十六、Skill 30.11：`vav-penetration-vulnerability-remediation`

## 目标

管理人工渗透测试、Finding、修复 SLA、复测和残余风险。

## 76.1 Penetration Engagement

```sql
CREATE TABLE penetration_test_engagements (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    engagement_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    release_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    environment VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    scope_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    excluded_targets JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    test_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    rules_of_engagement JSONB NOT NULL,

    tester_organization VARCHAR(300),
    lead_tester_reference VARCHAR(300),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    report_reference_encrypted TEXT,
    report_checksum VARCHAR(128)
);
```

## Test Mode

```text
internal_gray_box
independent_gray_box
external_black_box
authenticated_application
```

---

# 七十七、渗透测试范围

```text
User Web
Admin Web
Public API
Authenticated API
Webhook
Upload
Download
Search
AI/RAG
Skill Runtime
Privilege Boundaries
Session
Deep Link
Export
```

基础设施破坏性测试需单独批准。

---

# 七十八、安全 Finding

```sql
CREATE TABLE security_findings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    finding_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    source_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    source_reference_id UUID,

    title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    safe_summary TEXT NOT NULL,

    technical_details_encrypted TEXT,

    vulnerability_category VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    exploitability VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    asset_criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    affected_asset_codes JSONB NOT NULL,
    affected_release_versions JSONB NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    owner_team VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    assigned_to UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    remediation_due_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    temporary_mitigation TEXT,
    permanent_fix_reference JSONB,

    detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

---

# 七十九、Finding 状态

```python
class SecurityFindingStatus(StrEnum):
    OPEN = "open"
    TRIAGED = "triaged"
    MITIGATION_APPLIED = "mitigation_applied"
    FIX_IN_PROGRESS = "fix_in_progress"
    RETEST_REQUIRED = "retest_required"
    VERIFIED_FIXED = "verified_fixed"
    RISK_ACCEPTANCE_REQUESTED = "risk_acceptance_requested"
    RISK_ACCEPTED = "risk_accepted"
    FALSE_POSITIVE = "false_positive"
```

---

# 八十、严重度判定

综合：

```text
技术影响
可利用性
资产敏感度
攻击前置条件
用户影响
传播范围
```

不能只依赖扫描器原始等级。

---

# 八十一、建议修复 SLA

```text
Critical
立即缓解，正式修复进入当前发布阻断

High
7 天以内或发布前

Medium
30 天以内

Low
计划性修复
```

实际 SLA 写入安全政策并经治理批准。

---

# 八十二、不能普通接受的风险

```text
跨用户数据泄漏
支付伪造
认证绕过
管理员权限提升
举报者身份泄漏
联系方式越权
Block 绕过
生产 Secret 泄漏
Skill 沙箱逃逸
远程代码执行
```

这些默认为不可豁免发布阻断项。

---

# 八十三、复测

Finding 关闭必须：

```text
修复代码已部署
原攻击路径失败
相邻攻击路径验证
回归测试添加
没有产生新越权或业务破坏
证据绑定 Release
```

仅开发者声明“已修复”不能关闭。

---

# 八十四、安全异常与 Batch 21 Waiver

安全风险接受必须：

```text
明确范围
明确到期
明确缓解
独立安全审批
Release 绑定
```

但不可豁免项禁止创建 Waiver。

CREATE TABLE security_domain_certifications (

    business_domain VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    release_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    threat_model_coverage_ratio NUMERIC(6,5) NOT NULL,

    open_high_findings INTEGER NOT NULL,

    penetration_retest_passed BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    certified_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    UNIQUE(
        business_domain,
        release_version,
        environment
    )
);

# 九十四、Makefile

```makefile
security-migrate:
	docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head

security-seed:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.seed_security_assurance

	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.sync_security_manifests

	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.check_threat_models

security-attack-surface-check:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.check_attack_surfaces

security-sast:
	./scripts/security/run-sast.sh

security-sca:
	./scripts/security/run-sca.sh

security-secret-scan:
	./scripts/security/run-secret-scan.sh

security-iac-scan:
	./scripts/security/run-iac-scan.sh

security-container-scan:
	./scripts/security/run-container-scan.sh

security-api-dast:
	./scripts/security/run-api-dast.sh

security-api-fuzz:

security-auth-test:

security-authorization-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/security/authorization -q

security-injection-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/security/injection -q

security-ssrf-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/security/ssrf -q

security-upload-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/security/uploads -q

security-webhook-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/security/webhooks -q

security-privacy-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/security/privacy -q

security-ai-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/security/ai -q

security-skill-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/security/skills -q

security-pentest-regression:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/security/penetration-regression -q

security-admin-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test e2e/admin-security-assurance

security-evidence-build:
	./scripts/security/build-security-evidence.sh

security-verify:
	$(MAKE) security-migrate
	$(MAKE) security-seed
	$(MAKE) security-sync
	$(MAKE) security-threat-model-check
	$(MAKE) security-attack-surface-check
	$(MAKE) security-sast
	$(MAKE) security-sca
	$(MAKE) security-secret-scan
	$(MAKE) security-iac-scan
	$(MAKE) security-container-scan
	$(MAKE) security-api-dast
	$(MAKE) security-api-fuzz
	$(MAKE) security-auth-test
	$(MAKE) security-authorization-test
	$(MAKE) security-injection-test
	$(MAKE) security-ssrf-test
	$(MAKE) security-upload-test
	$(MAKE) security-webhook-test
	$(MAKE) security-privacy-test
	$(MAKE) security-ai-test
	$(MAKE) security-skill-test
	$(MAKE) security-pentest-regression
	$(MAKE) security-admin-e2e
	$(MAKE) security-evidence-build

security-release:
	$(MAKE) security-verify
	./scripts/security/verify-pentest-status.sh

# 一百零九、Batch 30 主控 `SKILL.md`

保存为：

```text
skills/batch-30/SKILL.md
```

```markdown
---
name: vav-batch-30-security-assurance
description: Implement VAV threat modeling, attack-surface management, static and dynamic scanning, authentication and authorization security, injection, SSRF, upload, payment Webhook, privacy leakage, AI prompt-injection, Skill sandbox, penetration testing and security certification.
---

# Goal

Build the platform-wide application-security and product-security control
plane containing:

- security-asset and trust-zone inventories;
- versioned data-flow and threat models;
- attack-surface discovery;
- security-control registration;
- SAST, SCA, Secret, IaC and container scanning;
- API DAST and OpenAPI-driven Fuzzing;
- authentication, Session and Token security;
- object-, field- and purpose-level authorization testing;
- injection and XSS defenses;
- SSRF and outbound-network protections;
- secure file-upload and download handling;
- payment Webhook and Provider-callback integrity;
- privacy-leakage detection;
- AI Prompt Injection and Tool-abuse testing;
- Skill sandbox and package supply-chain testing;
- penetration-test management;
- vulnerability remediation and retesting;
- domain security certification;
- administration, evidence and release gates.

# Product boundary

This batch covers technical platform security.

Trust and Safety remains responsible for user reports, harassment, fraud
cases, restrictions and appeals. Privacy remains responsible for consent,
data-right and retention decisions. This batch validates that their
technical controls cannot be bypassed.

# Prerequisites

1. Read `project-manifest.yaml`.
2. Verify Batches 1 through 29.
3. Run all Quality, UI, Experience, Process, Data, Administration, UAT,
   Regression and Performance verification commands.
4. Inventory all public and administrative routes.
5. Inventory all Webhooks, uploads, URL fetchers, Tools, Skills and Providers.
6. Inventory all sensitive assets and data flows.
7. Produce `docs/security/threat-modeling-standard.md`.
8. Produce `docs/security/attack-surface-inventory.md`.
9. Produce `docs/security/authentication-authorization-standard.md`.
10. Produce `docs/security/input-upload-egress-standard.md`.
11. Produce `docs/security/ai-security-standard.md`.
12. Produce `docs/security/skill-sandbox-security.md`.
13. Produce `docs/security/penetration-testing-policy.md`.
14. Produce `docs/security/vulnerability-remediation-sla.md`.

# Required implementation order

1. Security-asset registry.
2. Trust zones and data flows.
3. Threat models and scenarios.
4. Attack-surface scanners.
5. Security-control registry.
6. SAST, SCA, Secret, IaC and container adapters.
7. API DAST and Fuzzing.
8. Authentication test matrix.
9. Authorization matrix.
10. Injection and XSS testing.
11. SSRF and outbound-network protections.
12. Upload and download security.
13. Payment Webhook security.
14. Privacy-leakage rules and Canary tests.
15. AI Prompt Injection and Tool-abuse tests.
16. Skill Package and Sandbox tests.
17. Penetration-test engagements.
18. Security Findings and remediation.
19. Retesting and regression promotion.
20. Domain security certification.
21. Administration center.
22. Evidence and release gates.

# Threat-model invariants

- Critical assets have owners and classifications.
- Public and privileged trust boundaries are explicit.
- Critical data flows use authenticated and encrypted channels.
- Critical threats have preventive, detective and response controls.
- Critical threats have executable verification tests.
- Architecture changes trigger threat-model review.
- Threat-model evidence binds to releases.

# Static-scan invariants

- Python, TypeScript, IaC, containers and dependencies are scanned.
- Secrets are scanned in source, history and artifacts.
- Real leaked credentials are revoked and rotated.
- Critical exploitable findings block releases.
- SBOMs and package provenance are generated.
- Scanner suppression requires review and expiry.

# Authentication invariants

- Tokens validate algorithm, issuer, audience, type and expiry.
- Refresh Tokens rotate.
- Reuse detection revokes affected Session families.
- Password reset and account recovery invalidate access according to policy.
- Cookies use approved security attributes.
- Logout and Session revocation are effective.
- Authentication errors do not reveal sensitive account existence.

# Authorization invariants

- Backend authorization is authoritative.
- Object-level and field-level access are tested.
- Saved views, search, exports and bulk operations cannot expand scope.
- Administrators require purpose and permission for sensitive fields.
- Skills and AI Tools inherit only approved capabilities.
- Cross-user and cross-role access failures are release blockers.
- Block and safety restrictions invalidate old access.

# Input-security invariants

- Inputs use typed Schemas and bounded sizes.
- Database queries are parameterized.
- Sorting and filtering use allowlists.
- Rich content is sanitized.
- AI output is untrusted.
- Error messages exclude internal implementation and Secrets.
- Security DSLs cannot execute arbitrary code.

# SSRF invariants

- Outbound requests use registered egress policies.
- Schemes, domains and ports are constrained.
- Private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses are blocked.
- DNS results and redirects are revalidated.
- Responses have time and size limits.
- Skill and AI URL access use the same egress controls.

# Upload invariants

- File extension, MIME and signatures are validated.
- Archive traversal, symlinks and decompression bombs are rejected.
- Malware scanning and quarantine occur before publication.
- Images are safely re-encoded where required.
- EXIF and unnecessary metadata are removed.
- Restricted uploads use private objects and authorized downloads.
- File names do not become storage paths.

# Payment invariants

- Webhook raw bodies are verified before parsing effects.
- Signatures and timestamp windows are validated.
- Provider events are deduplicated.
- Amount, currency, account and order bindings are checked.
- Browser return pages do not activate entitlements.
- Refunds validate original payments and remaining amounts.
- Payment events preserve ordering and idempotency.

# Privacy-leakage invariants

- Sensitive fields are absent from unauthorized DTOs.
- Logs, traces and metrics exclude private content.
- URLs and browser storage exclude Secrets and highly restricted data.
- Search and vector indexes contain only approved projections.
- Notifications and exports minimize content.
- Leakage Canary tests cover critical channels.
- Erasure removes or restricts derived data according to policy.

# AI-security invariants

- User and retrieved content cannot override platform policies.
- RAG documents are treated as untrusted content.
- Tools require Schema, permission, object and purpose checks.
- High-impact writes require explicit confirmation.
- AI Memory cannot create identity or permission facts.
- AI output is validated before use in code, HTML, URLs or Tools.
- Cross-user or cross-conversation leakage is prohibited.
- AI failures do not rewrite authoritative business facts.

# Skill-security invariants

- Skill packages are safely parsed.
- Packages require approved signatures in production.
- Publisher and dependency identities are verified.
- Third-party Skills execute in isolated Sandboxes.
- Host files, databases, Redis and Docker sockets are inaccessible.
- Network and Secret access are allowlisted.
- Resource limits prevent exhaustion.
- Revoked packages cannot execute.
- Supply-chain incidents support quarantine and rollback.

# Penetration invariants

- Tests have explicit scope and rules.
- Tests use isolated accounts and safe data.
- Reports are protected.
- Critical findings require remediation and independent retest.
- Previous findings become regression tests.
- Test accounts and Tokens are revoked after completion.
- Penetration evidence binds to releases.

# Certification invariants

- Critical domains have current threat models.
- Critical attack surfaces are tested.
- Static, dynamic, authorization, privacy, AI and Skill tests pass.
- Open Critical findings are zero.
- Required penetration retests pass.
- Security certification cannot override data, process, regression or
  resilience failures.

# Required commands

The batch must support:

```bash
make security-migrate
make security-seed
make security-sync
make security-threat-model-check
make security-attack-surface-check
make security-sast
make security-sca
make security-secret-scan
make security-iac-scan
make security-container-scan
make security-api-dast
make security-api-fuzz
make security-auth-test
make security-authorization-test
make security-injection-test
make security-ssrf-test
make security-upload-test
make security-webhook-test
make security-privacy-test
make security-ai-test
make security-skill-test
make security-pentest-regression
make security-admin-e2e
make security-evidence-build
make security-verify
make security-release
```

# Completion requirements

The batch is incomplete unless:

1. Critical assets are registered.
2. Critical trust boundaries and data flows are modeled.
3. Critical threats have controls and tests.
4. Public attack surfaces are complete.
5. SAST, SCA, Secret, IaC and container scans pass.
6. Real Secret exposure is zero.
7. API DAST and Fuzzing pass.
8. Authentication regression passes.
9. Cross-user authorization failures are zero.
10. Injection and SSRF bypasses are zero.
11. Unsafe upload paths are zero.
12. Webhook forgery and replay bypasses are zero.
13. Critical privacy leakage is zero.
14. AI Tool escalation is zero.
15. AI cross-user leakage is zero.
16. Skill sandbox escape is zero.
17. Revoked or unsigned production Skill execution is zero.
18. Required penetration test is completed.
19. Critical Findings are fixed and retested.
20. Every critical domain has security certification.
21. Security administration E2E passes.
22. Security release gates pass.
23. Evidence is registered with Batch 21.
24. `make security-verify` succeeds.
25. `make security-release` succeeds.
26. All Batch 21-29 release suites still succeed.
27. `make acceptance` still succeeds.

# Failure policy

When a Critical authorization bypass is found:

1. disable or restrict the affected capability;
2. invalidate affected Tokens, caches and grants;
3. identify exposed entities and users;
4. repair backend object and field authorization;
5. add cross-user regression tests;
6. investigate whether a privacy or safety incident occurred;
7. block release until independently retested.

When a real Secret is detected:

1. revoke and rotate it immediately;
2. inspect usage and access logs;
3. remove it from source and artifacts;
4. invalidate dependent Sessions or credentials where necessary;
5. create an incident;
6. add Secret-scanning regression.

When SSRF or Sandbox escape is found:

1. disable the affected URL or Skill capability;
2. revoke exposed credentials;
3. isolate affected workloads;
4. repair egress, filesystem or process boundaries;
5. add fixed attack regression tests;
6. rerun Skill, AI and infrastructure security suites.

When a payment Webhook bypass is found:

1. stop automatic entitlement activation from the affected path;
2. reconcile impacted payments, orders and entitlements;
3. repair signature, replay and binding validation;
4. add Provider-specific security fixtures;
5. independently retest;
6. treat incorrect entitlement activation as a Critical incident.

When AI Prompt Injection causes Tool abuse:

1. disable the affected Tool route;
2. revoke unsafe Tool grants;
3. isolate malicious documents or sources;
4. repair instruction separation and authorization;
5. add direct and indirect injection fixtures;
6. rerun AI, Privacy and Authorization suites.

When a Critical penetration Finding remains open:

1. produce a release No-Go;
2. prohibit ordinary Waiver;
3. apply immediate containment;
4. assign an accountable owner;
5. repair and independently retest;
6. preserve complete evidence.

# 三、核心可靠性原则

## 3.1 服务存活不等于业务可用

以下情况即使 API 返回 `200`，仍属于业务不可用：

```text
支付成功但权益没有开通
屏蔽成功但推荐仍可见
隐私删除完成但搜索仍有数据
活动报名成功但名额状态错误
通知发出但链接无效
```

SLO 应优先测量用户可感知的业务结果。

## 3.2 高可用不能以数据错误为代价

故障期间可以：

```text
延迟
排队
只读
暂时关闭非关键功能
```

不能：

```text
伪造支付确认
绕过安全限制
重复扣款
产生重复 Match
恢复已撤销联系方式
```

## 3.3 可观测性数据也属于敏感数据

日志、Trace 和事故材料不得包含：

```text
Token
完整联系方式
辅导正文
AI 私人对话
婚恋私人复盘
举报证据
支付 Secret
```

## 3.4 所有关键恢复能力必须通过演练证明

以下文档存在但未演练，不算完成：

```text
Failover Runbook
Restore Runbook
DR Runbook
Incident Playbook
```

## 3.5 自动恢复必须受到边界约束

允许自动恢复：

```text
重启无状态 API
重新调度幂等任务
重新构建缓存
重连只读副本
```

不允许自动：

```text
伪造 Provider 回调
解除安全限制
接受用户邀请
确认关系阶段
改变退款决定
```

├── incident_action_tracking.py
└── resilience_certification.py

# 六、核心状态模型

## 6.1 服务等级

class ServiceCriticality(StrEnum):
    TIER_0 = "tier_0"
    TIER_1 = "tier_1"
    TIER_2 = "tier_2"
    TIER_3 = "tier_3"
```

建议：

```text
Tier 0
身份、支付确认、屏蔽、隐私删除、权限、联系方式撤销

Tier 1
活动、课程、辅导、会员、关系核心流程

Tier 2
搜索、推荐读取、通知、内容管理

Tier 3
分析、营销、非关键报表、低优先级 Backfill
```

# 十、建议初始 SLO

以下属于工程初始目标，应在试运行数据基础上校准，不应伪装为计划书原始指标。

## Tier 0

```text
月度业务可用性 ≥ 99.95%
Critical 写操作正确性 ≥ 99.999%
Critical 安全失效传播符合时限 ≥ 99.9%
```

## Tier 1

```text
月度业务可用性 ≥ 99.9%
Critical Journey 完成正确率 ≥ 99.95%
```

## Tier 2

```text
月度可用性 ≥ 99.5%
```

派生数据 Freshness 单独定义，不能把旧数据返回当作成功。

# 十一、业务 SLO 示例

## 支付确认

```yaml
slo:
  code: SLO-COMMERCE-PAYMENT-CONFIRMATION

  eligible:
    event: valid_provider_payment_event

  good:
    conditions:
      - internal_payment_status_confirmed
      - order_status_updated
      - no_duplicate_entitlement

  objective: 0.9999
  window: rolling_30_days
```

## 屏蔽传播

```yaml
slo:
  code: SLO-SAFETY-BLOCK-PROPAGATION

  eligible:
    event: safety.block.created

  good:
    withinSeconds: 2
    conditions:
      - profile_access_denied
      - contact_grant_revoked
      - recommendation_visibility_removed

  objective: 0.999
```

## 隐私删除

```yaml
slo:
  code: SLO-PRIVACY-ERASURE-COMPLETION

  good:
    conditions:
      - required_asset_tasks_complete
      - residual_verification_passed
      - certificate_issued

  objective: 0.999
```

        REFERENCES sre_slo_definitions(id),

);
```

## Error Budget Status

```python
class ErrorBudgetStatus(StrEnum):
    HEALTHY = "healthy"
    WARNING = "warning"
    AT_RISK = "at_risk"
    EXHAUSTED = "exhausted"
    INVALID_MEASUREMENT = "invalid_measurement"
```

# 十三、Burn Rate

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_burn_rate_evaluations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    slo_definition_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES sre_slo_definitions(id),

    short_window_seconds BIGINT NOT NULL,
    long_window_seconds BIGINT NOT NULL,

    short_window_burn_rate NUMERIC(14,6) NOT NULL,
    long_window_burn_rate NUMERIC(14,6) NOT NULL,

    severity VARCHAR(32),
    alert_triggered BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

    evaluated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

建议同时监控：

```text
快速 Burn
短时间内大量消耗预算

慢速 Burn
较长时间持续劣化
```

不能只等月末发现错误预算耗尽。

---

# 十四、错误预算治理

建议初始策略：

```text
错误预算消耗达到预警线
→ 限制高风险发布

错误预算明显过快消耗
→ 暂停非必要变更
→ 优先稳定性修复

错误预算耗尽
→ 冻结普通功能发布
→ 仅允许安全、恢复和可靠性变更
```

不得通过排除失败事件来人为“恢复”错误预算。

---

# 十五、错误预算排除规则

允许排除：

```text
明确批准的隔离测试流量
明确标记的合成监控流量边界
不进入目标服务的无效请求
```

不得排除：

```text
Provider 故障
数据库故障
部署错误
用户真实超时
业务状态错误
```

因为这些正是用户可感知故障。

## Telemetry Type

```text
log
metric
trace
domain_event
audit_event
synthetic_result
```

# 十七、统一关联字段

```text
request_id
trace_id
span_id
correlation_id
causation_id

service_code
module_code
operation_code

entity_type
entity_id

process_instance_id
saga_instance_id
journey_instance_id

release_version
deployment_version
```

用户标识只允许：

```text
user_id_hmac
```

不得将邮箱、电话和姓名作为 Metric Label。

---

# 十八、结构化日志

统一 JSON：

```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-07-31T08:00:00Z",
  "level": "ERROR",
  "service_code": "commerce-api",
  "operation_code": "commerce.confirm_payment",
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "trace_id": "trace",
  "error_code": "PAYMENT_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT",
  "entity_type": "payment",
  "entity_id": "uuid"
}
```

禁止：

```text
完整 Request Body
完整 AI Prompt
完整辅导记录
完整举报证据
Authorization Header
Cookie
Secret
```

---

# 十九、Trace 设计

关键 Span：

```text
HTTP Request
Application Command
Database Transaction
Outbox Write
Event Publish
Inbox Consume
Saga Step
Provider Call
Cache Operation
Object-storage Operation
```

支付链路示例：

```text
Browser Checkout
→ API
→ Order
→ Provider
→ Webhook
→ Inbox
→ Payment
→ Entitlement
→ Membership
→ Notification
```

应通过统一 Correlation ID 关联。

---

# 二十、Trace Sampling

建议：

```text
普通成功请求
概率采样

慢请求
保留

错误请求
保留

Critical 业务
提高采样或全量安全摘要

含高敏正文
不记录正文
```

Sampling 不能使 SLO 指标失真；SLO 应优先由完整 Metrics 计算。

---

# 二十一、Telemetry Quality Run

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_telemetry_quality_runs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    release_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    environment VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    service_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sre_services(id),

    required_metric_coverage NUMERIC(6,5) NOT NULL,

    invalid_label_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sensitive_data_finding_count INTEGER NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    evidence_id UUID,

    executed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

---

# 二十二、Telemetry 缺口

自动检测：

```text
Critical API 无延迟 Metric
Critical Worker 无执行时长
Provider 调用无状态和延迟
业务错误只有日志没有 Metric
Trace 无 Correlation ID
Metric Label 包含高基数原始 ID
日志疑似包含 Token 或 PII
```

# 二十四、生产合成监控原则

生产环境允许：

```text
公开页面读取
专用测试账号登录
专用测试订单 Sandbox 边界
只读状态查询
可逆或自动清理的测试对象
```

生产环境禁止：

```text
真实扣款
真实外发通知
真实用户匹配
真实安全处罚
真实隐私删除
真实导师时段占用
```

完整破坏性旅程在隔离 Staging 环境运行。

# 二十五、第一版 Synthetic Monitors

```text
SYN-PUBLIC-HOME
SYN-USER-LOGIN
SYN-USER-HOME
SYN-CATALOG-DETAIL
SYN-CHECKOUT-SANDBOX
SYN-ORDER-STATUS
SYN-ACTIVITY-READ

SYN-PRIVACY-ERASURE-STAGING

# 二十六、合成监控断言

每个 Monitor 验证：

页面可达
API 可达
授权正确
业务状态正确
依赖调用正确
延迟符合预算
结果可以清理
```

不能只检查 HTTP 状态。

# 二十七、Synthetic Alert

告警必须包含：

```text
失败旅程
失败步骤
Probe 位置
首次失败
连续失败次数
Release
Trace
安全错误代码
```

不得包含密码或测试 Credential。

# 二十八、Skill 31.4：`vav-api-web-high-availability`

## 目标

验证 User Web、Admin Web、API 和反向代理在实例和节点故障下继续运行。

## 28.1 HA Profile

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_ha_profiles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    profile_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    target_service_codes JSONB NOT NULL,

    minimum_replica_manifest JSONB NOT NULL,
    zone_distribution_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    load_balancer_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    health_probe_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    graceful_shutdown_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    failover_expectations JSONB NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(profile_code, semantic_version)
);
```

---

# 二十九、API 不变量

```text
无本地 Session 真源
无本地流程真源
无本地唯一锁作为最终一致性保障
无本地持久文件依赖
任意实例可处理下一请求
```

---

# 三十、健康检查分离

## Liveness

回答：

```text
进程是否需要重启？
```

不得因短暂 Provider 故障直接重启 API。

## Readiness

回答：

```text
实例当前是否应接收流量？
```

## Startup

回答：

```text
服务是否已经完成启动初始化？
```

---

# 三十一、Readiness 依赖策略

Critical Dependency：

```text
数据库主写连接不可用
→ 写服务 Readiness 失败或进入受控只读
```

非关键 Dependency：

```text
AI Provider 不可用
→ API 仍 Ready
→ AI 功能降级
```

不能因为邮件 Provider 故障使全部 API 下线。

---

# 三十二、Graceful Shutdown

```text
停止接收新连接
→ 标记 Not Ready
→ 等待反向代理摘除
→ 完成短请求
→ 将长任务交由 Worker
→ Flush Telemetry
→ 关闭连接
```

支付 Webhook：

```text
未完成时不能静默丢失
```

应通过持久化 Inbox/Outbox 保证恢复。

---

# 三十三、API HA 测试

```text
杀死一个 API 实例
滚动重启全部实例
同时终止一个可用区实例
让一个实例停止响应
使一个实例内存压力升高
```

验证：

```text
关键用户旅程继续
Session 不丢失
无重复副作用
错误率和恢复时间在预算内
```

---

# 三十四、Web 静态资产

User Web 与 Admin Web 应支持：

```text
版本化静态资产
不可变 Hash 文件
回滚兼容
HTML 与 API 版本边界
CDN/Proxy 缓存失效
```

避免发布后：

```text
旧 HTML 引用已删除新资源
```

---

# 三十五、Skill 31.5：`vav-postgres-high-availability`

## 目标

建立 PostgreSQL 复制、故障转移、PITR、恢复验证和 Split-brain 防护。

## 35.1 Database HA Definition

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_database_ha_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    database_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    topology_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    primary_location VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    standby_locations JSONB NOT NULL,

    replication_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    maximum_replication_lag_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,

    failover_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    fencing_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    failback_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    rpo_seconds BIGINT NOT NULL,
    rto_seconds BIGINT NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(database_code, semantic_version)
);
```

---

# 三十六、第一阶段建议拓扑

```text
生产小型拓扑
Primary PostgreSQL
＋ Standby
＋ WAL Archive

规模化拓扑
Managed HA PostgreSQL
或受控自动 Failover 集群
```

不建议初期对支付、关系和安全等强一致数据采用未经充分验证的多主 Active-Active。

---

# 三十七、复制监控

```text
Replication Lag
WAL Generation
WAL Archive Delay
Standby Replay Delay
Replication Slot Growth
Standby Health
```

超过安全阈值时：

```text
禁止把过旧 Standby 用于需要新鲜状态的读取
```

---

# 三十八、Read-after-write

以下操作不应立即读取异步从库：

```text
支付确认后订单状态
创建 Block 后访问权限
接受邀请后的关系状态
修改权限后的管理访问
```

应使用：

```text
Primary Read
或明确 Session Consistency Token
```

---

# 三十九、Failover 流程

```text
检测 Primary 故障
→ 确认故障
→ Fence 旧 Primary
→ 选择合格 Standby
→ Promotion
→ 更新连接路由
→ 验证写入
→ 业务不变量验证
→ 恢复服务
```

没有 Fencing 不能安全自动 Promotion。

---

# 四十、数据库故障场景

```text
Primary 进程终止
Primary 主机不可达
磁盘只读
磁盘空间耗尽
WAL Archive 中断
Replication Lag 过高
连接池耗尽
长事务阻塞
Standby 不可用
```

---

# 四十一、数据库恢复验证

Failover 后必须验证：

```text
最新成功事务
Outbox
Inbox
支付状态
会员配额
Block 状态
隐私任务
数据库约束
Migration Revision
```

不能只检查数据库端口重新可用。

---

# 四十二、Failback

Failback 必须：

```text
创建新 Standby
→ 同步
→ 验证
→ 维护窗口
→ 受控切换
```

禁止自动把旧 Primary 未验证地重新设为主库。

---

# 四十三、Skill 31.6：`vav-redis-worker-scheduler-ha`

## 目标

确保 Redis、Celery Worker 和 Scheduler 故障后不破坏关键业务。

## 43.1 Redis 角色分离

生产建议至少逻辑分离：

```text
Cache Redis
Queue/Broker Redis
Lock/Coordination Redis
```

规模扩大后可物理分离，防止：

```text
缓存内存膨胀
```

影响：

```text
关键任务队列
```

---

# 四十四、Redis HA Definition

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_redis_ha_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    redis_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    redis_role VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    topology_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    persistence_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    replication_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    failover_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    eviction_policy VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    data_loss_boundary JSONB NOT NULL,
    rebuild_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
);
```

---

# 四十五、Cache Redis 故障

允许：

```text
Cache Miss 增加
性能下降
缓存重建
```

不允许：

```text
权限错误
Block 错误
联系方式错误开放
```

---

# 四十六、Broker Redis 故障

必须验证：

```text
已接受任务是否持久
Worker 重连
任务是否重复
Visibility Timeout
幂等处理
队列积压恢复
```

关键任务最终结果仍由 PostgreSQL 业务记录、Outbox/Inbox 和对账保障。

---

# 四十七、分布式锁

Redis Lock 只能作为协调措施，最终不变量仍由：

```text
数据库约束
乐观锁
唯一约束
幂等键
```

保障。

锁过期不能导致：

```text
两个任务都成功
```

---

# 四十八、Worker 高可用

每个关键任务必须声明：

```text
幂等键
最大执行时间
重试策略
Acknowledgement 策略
Checkpoint
补偿或人工处理
```

Worker Crash 场景：

```text
执行前崩溃
执行中崩溃
领域事务提交后 Ack 前崩溃
外部 Provider 成功后本地确认前崩溃
```

---

# 四十九、Scheduler 高可用

Scheduler 多实例运行时：

```text
只有一个 Leader 调度同一计划
```

同时任务应具备：

```text
Schedule Occurrence Key
```

例如：

```text
schedule:membership-renewal:2026-08-01T00:00Z
```

重复调度仍不重复产生业务副作用。

---

# 五十、Missed Schedule

Scheduler 停机恢复后应根据任务策略：

```text
补跑
跳过
合并
进入人工处理
```

不能把所有错过任务一次性无上限补发。

---

# 五十一、Worker Pool 隔离

```text
safety-worker
privacy-worker
commerce-worker
interactive-worker
notification-worker
ai-worker
backfill-worker
```

AI 和 Backfill 故障不能耗尽安全、隐私和支付 Worker。

---

# 五十二、Skill 31.7：`vav-provider-circuit-breaker-fallback`

## 目标

建立 Provider 超时、重试、熔断、隔离、备用路由和对账。

## 52.1 Provider Registry

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_provider_definitions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    provider_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    provider_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    owning_module VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    timeout_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    retry_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    circuit_breaker_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    bulkhead_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    fallback_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    reconciliation_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
);
```

## Provider Type

```text
payment
email
sms
push
ai_model
embedding
rerank
moderation
meeting
video
object_storage
```

---

# 五十三、Circuit Breaker 状态

```python
class CircuitBreakerStatus(StrEnum):
    CLOSED = "closed"
    OPEN = "open"
    HALF_OPEN = "half_open"
    DISABLED = "disabled"
```

## 转换

```text
CLOSED
→ 失败率/超时超过阈值
→ OPEN

OPEN
→ 冷却时间到
→ HALF_OPEN

HALF_OPEN
→ 探测成功
→ CLOSED

HALF_OPEN
→ 探测失败
→ OPEN
```

---

# 五十四、Timeout 分层

```text
Browser Timeout
> API Internal Timeout
> Provider Connect/Read Timeout
```

API 总超时必须大于内部调用预算，但不能无限等待。

---

# 五十五、Retry 原则

允许自动重试：

```text
幂等读取
幂等 Provider 查询
带稳定 Idempotency Key 的支付创建边界
通知投递
```

禁止无条件重试：

```text
无法确认是否已成功的非幂等外部写
```

遇到不确定结果应：

```text
查询 Provider 状态
→ 对账
→ 再决定
```

---

# 五十六、Provider 降级矩阵

## AI Provider

```text
主模型失败
→ 经批准备用模型
→ 只读帮助/RAG Boundary
→ 人工转介
```

不得降低 Tool 权限检查。

## 邮件 Provider

```text
排队
→ 备用 Provider
→ 延迟通知
```

业务事实不回滚。

## 支付 Provider

```text
暂停创建新支付边界
→ 保留订单
→ 用户看到暂不可付款
→ 后台持续查询或等待 Webhook
```

不能伪造支付成功。

## Meeting Provider

```text
延迟创建链接
→ 人工补充
→ 通知用户状态
```

预约事实保持。

---

# 五十七、Provider Bulkhead

不同 Provider 和不同能力使用独立：

```text
连接池
并发限制
队列
Circuit Breaker
```

一个 AI Provider 饱和不能耗尽支付 HTTP 连接。

---

# 五十八、Provider Health

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_provider_health_snapshots (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    provider_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES sre_provider_definitions(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    success_ratio NUMERIC(8,7),
    latency_p95_ms BIGINT,
    timeout_ratio NUMERIC(8,7),

    circuit_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    measured_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

---

# 五十九、Skill 31.8：`vav-graceful-degradation-continuity`

## 目标

定义系统故障时每项能力如何保持、排队、只读、降级或关闭。

## 59.1 Capability Continuity Policy

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_degradation_policies (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    policy_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    capability_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    service_criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    dependency_failure_conditions JSONB NOT NULL,

    degradation_level VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    degradation_action JSONB NOT NULL,

    user_message_code VARCHAR(128),
    admin_message_code VARCHAR(128),

    recovery_condition JSONB NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    UNIQUE(policy_code, semantic_version)
);
```

---

# 六十、降级动作

```python
class DegradationActionType(StrEnum):
    KEEP_FULL = "keep_full"
    USE_CACHE = "use_cache"
    READ_ONLY = "read_only"
    QUEUE_FOR_LATER = "queue_for_later"
    USE_FALLBACK_PROVIDER = "use_fallback_provider"
    DISABLE_ENHANCEMENT = "disable_enhancement"
    REJECT_NEW_WORK = "reject_new_work"
    MAINTENANCE_PAGE = "maintenance_page"
```

---

# 六十一、Fail Closed 与 Fail Open

必须明确决定。

## Fail Closed

适用于：

```text
权限无法判断
Block 状态无法判断
支付确认无法判断
联系方式授权无法判断
安全限制无法判断
```

## 有限 Fail Open

可能适用于：

```text
公开内容缓存
非敏感帮助文章
普通统计
```

但必须有数据新鲜度边界。

---

# 六十二、降级优先级

```text
Tier 0
必须保持正确或明确拒绝

Tier 1
尽量保持，可排队或只读

Tier 2
允许受控降级

Tier 3
优先暂停
```

---

# 六十三、故障模式示例

## PostgreSQL 写不可用

```text
公开缓存内容
→ 可继续读

用户写操作
→ 进入安全只读或拒绝

支付 Webhook
→ 由入口持久接收边界或 Provider 重试
```

## Redis Cache 不可用

```text
回源数据库
→ 启用请求合并
→ 降低非关键流量
```

## AI Provider 不可用

```text
关闭生成能力
→ 显示已有内容
→ 提供真人支持或稍后重试
```

---

# 六十四、降级恢复

恢复不能只依据 Provider 单次成功。

应：

```text
连续健康探测
→ Half-open 流量
→ 校验错误率
→ 逐步恢复
```

---

# 六十五、Skill 31.9：`vav-chaos-engineering`

## 目标

在受控环境中注入故障，验证系统稳态、降级和恢复。

## 65.1 Chaos Experiment

CREATE TABLE sre_chaos_experiment_definitions (

    blast_radius_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    abort_conditions JSONB NOT NULL,

    criticality VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

## 65.2 Chaos Run

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_chaos_experiment_runs (

---

# 六十六、Chaos 状态

```text
draft
approval_required
scheduled
running
aborting
aborted
completed
failed
```

---

# 六十七、稳态假设

不能只写：

```text
系统仍然工作
```

应明确：

```text
用户登录成功率保持在目标内
支付不会重复
Block 传播不越过安全预算
Critical Queue 不丢失任务
API 错误率在批准范围内
故障解除后恢复时间在 RTO 内
```

---

# 六十八、第一版 Chaos Experiments

```text
CHAOS-KILL-ONE-API
CHAOS-KILL-ONE-WORKER
CHAOS-KILL-SCHEDULER-LEADER
CHAOS-REDIS-CACHE-OUTAGE
CHAOS-REDIS-BROKER-FAILOVER
CHAOS-POSTGRES-PRIMARY-FAILOVER
CHAOS-OBJECT-STORAGE-LATENCY
CHAOS-PAYMENT-PROVIDER-TIMEOUT
CHAOS-AI-PROVIDER-OUTAGE
CHAOS-NOTIFICATION-PROVIDER-OUTAGE
CHAOS-QUEUE-BACKLOG
CHAOS-DNS-FAILURE
CHAOS-BAD-FEATURE-FLAG
CHAOS-CONNECTION-POOL-EXHAUSTION
```

---

# 六十九、Blast Radius

每个实验限制：

```text
环境
服务
用户 Namespace
流量百分比
持续时间
最大错误率
```

生产 Chaos 必须从：

```text
只读
小流量
低风险
```

逐步推进。

---

# 七十、Abort Conditions

立即中止：

```text
跨用户泄漏
支付重复
安全限制绕过
数据损坏
错误率超过上限
恢复能力失效
超出预定 Blast Radius
```

---

# 七十一、Chaos 安全控制

```text
双人批准
明确 Runbook
值班人员在线
实时 Dashboard
Kill Switch
审计
自动恢复或人工恢复
```

---

# 七十二、Chaos Finding

实验失败必须创建：

```text
Reliability Finding
Quality Gap
Regression Test
必要时 Incident
```

不能只在报告中写“需要优化”。

---

# 七十三、Skill 31.10：`vav-backup-restore-game-day`

## 目标

验证备份可用、可解密、可恢复，并满足 RPO/RTO。

## 73.1 Backup Asset

CREATE TABLE sre_backup_assets (

## Asset Type

postgres
object_storage
configuration
manifest
secret_reference
audit_archive
search_projection_boundary
```

Redis Cache 默认可重建，不作为唯一业务备份。

---

# 七十七、恢复顺序

建议：

```text
基础网络和 Secret Broker
→ PostgreSQL
→ 对象存储
→ Redis/Broker
→ API
→ Worker
→ Scheduler
→ Projection
→ 合成业务验证
```

---

# 七十八、恢复验证

## 技术验证

```text
数据库可连接
Migration Revision 正确
约束和索引存在
对象可读取
服务健康
```

## 业务验证

```text
用户可登录
订单和支付一致
Entitlement 正确
活动容量正确
Block 仍有效
联系方式授权正确
会员配额不为负
隐私任务完整
```

---

# 七十九、PITR 演练

应验证：

```text
指定时间恢复
误删除前恢复
坏迁移前恢复
WAL 连续性
恢复时间
```

PITR 环境首先隔离，禁止恢复库直接连接生产外部 Provider。

---

# 八十、Encryption-key Recovery

备份加密有效的前提是：

```text
恢复时能够安全取得密钥
```

需要验证：

```text
密钥权限
密钥版本
密钥轮换
灾难站点可用性
Break-glass 边界
```

不得把加密密钥和备份放在同一无隔离位置。

---

# 八十一、Game Day

至少演练：

```text
PostgreSQL 全库恢复
PITR
对象存储恢复
配置与 Manifest 恢复
密钥恢复边界
完整应用启动
业务验证
```

演练数据使用隔离环境和合成身份。

---

# 八十二、Skill 31.11：`vav-disaster-recovery-failover`

## 目标

处理整个生产站点、区域或关键基础设施不可用的灾难场景。

## 82.1 DR Plan

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_disaster_recovery_plans (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    plan_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    semantic_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    disaster_scenario_codes JSONB NOT NULL,

    primary_site_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    recovery_site_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    service_recovery_order JSONB NOT NULL,

    data_recovery_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    traffic_failover_policy JSONB NOT NULL,
    failback_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    communication_policy JSONB NOT NULL,

    target_rpo_seconds BIGINT NOT NULL,
    target_rto_seconds BIGINT NOT NULL,

    lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    UNIQUE(plan_code, semantic_version)
);
```

---

# 八十三、灾难场景

```text
整个主区域不可用
主数据库和 Standby 同时失效
对象存储区域不可用
重大网络故障
证书或 DNS 故障
Secret 系统不可用
严重错误发布
供应链污染
大规模数据损坏
```

---

# 八十四、初始 DR 分层建议

## Tier 0

```text
Warm Standby
更严格 RPO/RTO
优先恢复
```

## Tier 1

```text
Warm 或可快速启动 Standby
```

## Tier 2/3

```text
从备份恢复
或从真源重建 Projection
```

具体 RPO/RTO 由项目负责人、产品和运维共同批准。

---

# 八十五、DR 数据策略

```text
PostgreSQL
WAL/PITR＋跨站点备份

Object Storage
版本和复制边界

Redis Cache
重建

Redis Broker
持久化＋业务状态对账

Search/Vector
从真源重建

配置与 Manifest
版本库＋Artifact Store
```

---

# 八十六、DR 切换流程

```text
宣布灾难
→ 冻结普通变更
→ 确认主站点不可用
→ 确认恢复点
→ 恢复或 Promote 数据层
→ 启动关键服务
→ 验证 Secret 和 Provider
→ 运行 Critical Synthetic Monitors
→ 切换流量
→ 持续对账
→ 用户沟通
```

---

# 八十七、DNS 与流量切换

需要：

```text
受控 TTL
健康检查
切换权限
回滚方式
证书准备
旧站点 Fencing
```

防止流量同时写入两个不一致站点。

---

# 八十八、数据损失声明

若实际恢复点晚于目标：

```text
必须明确记录可能丢失的时间窗口
```

并执行：

```text
Provider 对账
支付对账
通知对账
用户操作对账
```

不能假设数据没有丢失。

---

# 八十九、DR Failback

```text
原站点修复
→ 从恢复站点同步
→ 校验
→ 建立新 Standby
→ 维护窗口
→ 受控切回
```

Failback 不是 DR 宣布结束后的立即动作。

---

# 九十、DR Exercise

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_dr_exercises (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    exercise_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    plan_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES sre_disaster_recovery_plans(id),

    release_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    scenario_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    environment VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    measured_rpo_seconds BIGINT,
    measured_rto_seconds BIGINT,

    data_reconciliation_summary JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    synthetic_monitor_summary JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    evidence_id UUID
);
```

---

# 九十一、Skill 31.12：`vav-incident-postmortem-certification`

## 目标

建立事故指挥、沟通、时间线、复盘、行动项和韧性认证。

## 91.1 Incident

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_incidents (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    incident_number VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    affected_service_codes JSONB NOT NULL,
    affected_capability_codes JSONB NOT NULL,
    affected_regions JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    detected_by_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    detection_reference JSONB,

    incident_commander_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    operations_lead_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    communications_lead_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    scribe_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    customer_impact_summary TEXT,
    internal_summary_encrypted TEXT,

    detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    declared_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    mitigated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    closed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

---

# 九十二、Incident Status

```python
class IncidentStatus(StrEnum):
    DETECTED = "detected"
    DECLARED = "declared"
    INVESTIGATING = "investigating"
    MITIGATING = "mitigating"
    MONITORING = "monitoring"
    RESOLVED = "resolved"
    POSTMORTEM_REQUIRED = "postmortem_required"
    CLOSED = "closed"
```

---

# 九十三、严重度建议

## SEV 0

```text
广泛跨用户泄漏
支付完整性大规模破坏
核心数据不可恢复
大范围安全控制失效
```

## SEV 1

```text
Tier 0 服务严重不可用
大规模登录失败
支付确认中断
屏蔽传播失效
```

## SEV 2

```text
主要业务明显降级
但有安全替代或有限影响
```

## SEV 3/4

```text
局部影响
内部影响
低风险问题
```

---

# 九十四、事故角色

## Incident Commander

```text
决定优先级
协调资源
控制变更
宣布状态
```

不要求亲自修复代码。

## Operations Lead

```text
执行诊断和恢复
```

## Domain Lead

```text
负责领域业务事实和修复
```

## Security/Privacy Lead

涉及泄漏或安全控制时加入。

## Communications Lead

负责：

```text
内部更新
用户状态页
客服通知
管理层沟通
```

## Scribe

记录完整时间线和决定。

---

# 九十五、事故时间线

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_incident_timeline_entries (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    incident_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sre_incidents(id),

    entry_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    actor_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    internal_details_encrypted TEXT,

    related_trace_id VARCHAR(64),
    related_change_reference JSONB,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);
```

---

# 九十六、事故沟通

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_incident_communications (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    incident_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sre_incidents(id),

    audience VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    channel VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

    message_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    message_content TEXT NOT NULL,

    approved_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(incident_id, audience, channel, message_version)
);
```

Audience：

```text
internal_engineering
support
management
affected_users
public_status
regulatory_boundary
```

---

# 九十七、用户状态沟通

应说明：

```text
发生什么类型的问题
哪些功能受影响
当前是否安全
用户需要做什么
下一次更新时间
```

不应：

```text
无证据推测根因
泄露攻击细节
泄露其他用户情况
承诺无法保证的恢复时间
```

---

# 九十八、Postmortem

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_postmortems (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    incident_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE
        REFERENCES sre_incidents(id),

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    impact_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    detection_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    timeline_summary TEXT NOT NULL,

    root_cause TEXT NOT NULL,
    contributing_factors JSONB NOT NULL,

    what_worked JSONB NOT NULL,
    what_failed JSONB NOT NULL,

    lessons_learned JSONB NOT NULL,

    reviewed_by JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

---

# 九十九、复盘原则

```text
不以惩罚为目的
但必须明确系统责任、控制缺口和行动 Owner
```

避免：

```text
某工程师粗心
```

应继续追问：

```text
为什么单个人为错误能够进入生产？
为什么测试、审批、回滚或监控没有阻止？
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE sre_postmortem_action_items (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    postmortem_id UUID NOT NULL
        REFERENCES sre_postmortems(id),

    action_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,

    action_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,

    owner_team VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    owner_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),

    priority VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    due_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    requirement_code VARCHAR(128),
    regression_test_code VARCHAR(500),
    chaos_experiment_code VARCHAR(255),

    verification_evidence_id UUID,

    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    UNIQUE(postmortem_id, action_code)
);
```

# 一百一十三、Makefile

```makefile
resilience-migrate:
	docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head

resilience-seed:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.seed_resilience

resilience-sync:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.sync_resilience_manifests

slo-check:
	docker compose exec api python -m vav.cli.check_slos

error-budget-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/resilience/error_budgets -q

observability-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/resilience/observability -q

synthetic-monitor-test:
	pnpm exec playwright test tests/resilience/synthetic

api-ha-test:
	./scripts/resilience/test-api-ha.sh

database-ha-test:
	./scripts/resilience/test-database-ha.sh

redis-worker-ha-test:
	./scripts/resilience/test-redis-worker-ha.sh

provider-resilience-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/resilience/providers -q

degradation-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/resilience/degradation -q

chaos-test:
	./scripts/resilience/run-chaos-suite.sh

backup-restore-test:
	./scripts/resilience/run-restore-game-day.sh

dr-game-day-test:
	./scripts/resilience/run-dr-exercise.sh

incident-management-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/resilience/incidents -q

resilience-security-test:
	docker compose exec api pytest tests/resilience/security -q

resilience-admin-e2e:
	pnpm exec playwright test e2e/admin-resilience

resilience-evidence-build:
	./scripts/resilience/build-resilience-evidence.sh

resilience-verify:
	$(MAKE) resilience-migrate
	$(MAKE) resilience-seed
	$(MAKE) resilience-sync
	$(MAKE) slo-check
	$(MAKE) error-budget-test
	$(MAKE) observability-test
	$(MAKE) synthetic-monitor-test
	$(MAKE) api-ha-test
	$(MAKE) database-ha-test
	$(MAKE) redis-worker-ha-test
	$(MAKE) provider-resilience-test
	$(MAKE) degradation-test
	$(MAKE) resilience-security-test
	$(MAKE) incident-management-test
	$(MAKE) resilience-admin-e2e
	$(MAKE) resilience-evidence-build

resilience-release:
	$(MAKE) resilience-verify
	$(MAKE) chaos-test
	$(MAKE) backup-restore-test
	$(MAKE) dr-game-day-test
	$(MAKE) resilience-evidence-build
```

高风险 Chaos、Restore 和 DR 演练不进入每个普通 PR，但必须进入 Release Candidate 认证。
